name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

name: Skriešanas seriāls “Ugāle”, III posms
description: The “Ugāle” running series is a running event organized by the Ventspils Municipality Sports School, bringing together runners of different ages and ability levels. The series’ third stage will take place in Ugāle, giving participants the opportunity to compete and improve their results. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized to a high professional standard, providing a quality competition environment.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin on 29 November 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness and enjoy the city’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the city
Training support for 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and includes various distances and age categories, as well as the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: Järvenpään Maraton
description: The Järvenpää Marathon has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon courses are officially measured and run mainly on a paved shared-use path around Lake Tuusula. For the first time, the route follows Tuusula’s Rantatie, offering cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transport connections, and there is plenty of parking nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

name: Trail Start: Nemokama Bėgimo Treniruotė
location: Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelė
description: Trail START. Nemokama bėgimo treniruotė su Monika Mile vyks gruodžio 2 d. (Antradienis) 18:30 Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelėje. Treniruotės trukmė bus apie 1 valandą, o distancija – apie 5 km, lengvu tempu, orientuota į pradedančiuosius, norinčius išmokti užtikrintai bėgti miške. Dėmesys bus skiriamas technikai, pojūčiui ir saugumui miške. Būtina turėti bėgimo batelius su protektoriumi, aprangą pagal orą, lempą ant galvos ir gerą nuotaiką.

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026 yra virtualus renginys, vykstantis nuo gruodžio 1 iki 24 dienos. Dalyviai kasdien gauna naują užduotį, kuri apima bėgimą, fizines, tikslumo ir kūrybines užduotis. Šis iššūkis skatina ne tik greitį, bet ir atkaklumą, kūrybiškumą bei įsitraukimą per visas 24 dienas. Dalyviai varžosi dėl Advento čempiono titulo ir gauna dalyvio krepšelį bei galimybę laimėti prizų fondą.
course_highlights: 24 dienos su 24 skirtingomis užduotimis
Fizinės, tikslumo ir kūrybinės užduotys
Virtualus bėgimo iššūkis su galimybe rinkti taškus ir varžytis
additional: Dalyvio krepšelis kiekvienam dalyviui. Prizinis fondas - 175 € (gali didėti nuo dalyvių skaičiaus). 24 dienų iššūkis su užduotimis, prizais ir registracija per Google formą

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sweden
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö is a trail running event held in scenic surroundings by the shooting range car park in Notteryd, Växjö. The event focuses on a unique experience in technical and challenging terrain rather than competition and prizes. The organisers place great emphasis on community and purpose, with a large part of the entry fee going to charity. The event is part of the Mossarun events, run by a group of friends with a passion for trails and nature.
course_highlights: Technical and challenging trails in scenic surroundings
Running across varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Focus on the experience and community rather than competition
additional: The event is run on a non-profit basis, and a large part of the proceeds goes to the Sangter Foundation, which helps people in Sikkim, India. The focus is on small events with few participants to create a personal and meaningful experience. Previous Mossarun events have included various distances and formats, including ultra and Backyard Ultra. The organisers are open to collaborations and innovative event ideas. The start and finish are near the shooting range car park in Notteryd. Start waves are listed as 17.30–18.00 and 19.00–19.30. Participants receive a start chip and check out and back in to record their lap time. Food and non-alcoholic beer are served after the race.

name: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas 2024 – gražiausias žiemos bėgimas, pasitinkant Kalėdas ir praleidžiant laiką su įsimintiniausiomis emocijomis bei užburiančia bėgimo energija! BĖGAME 2024 gruodžio 7 d. Vilniuje. Renginys išsiskiria šventine nuotaika ir dalyviais, pasidabinusiais kalėdiniais kostiumais bei šviečiančiais akcentais. Šiemet dalyviai galės bėgti jau sutemus, kai sostinės gatvėse atsiskleis tikra žėrinti bei magiška kalėdinė dvasia.

images.alt_text: Kalėdinis bėgimas su kostiumais, Vilniuje.
Senelis Kalėda su maišu prie eglutės.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2024. Šventinis bėgimas Vilniuje.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2023 metų logotipas su kalėdiniais elementais.

name: Edgaro atminimui Bėgimas
description: Spalio 18 d., kviečiame visus į jau 11-ąjį kartą organizuojamą pagarbos ir paramos bėgimą „In Memoriam“, skirtą šiais metais mirusių karių atminimui pagerbti. Visos bėgimo metu paaukotos lėšos bus skirtos mirusių Lietuvos karių šeimų paramai. Dvi čempionato distancijos dedikuotos Lietuvos sporto legendų atminimui – Felicijos Karoblienės taurė (2000 m merginoms) ir Jono Pipynės taurė (5000 m vaikinams).

name: Mispo talvemaraton
location: Vändra Stadium, Vändra, Pärnu County, Estonia
description: The Mispo Winter Marathon is a traditional winter running event held at Vändra Stadium. There are four distances: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon (21.097 km), and two recreational walk/run distances (14 km and 7 km). The race starts at 11:00, and all participants can look forward to drinks, food, a sauna, a diploma, and a medal at the finish. The event is designed for both experienced runners and recreational participants, offering a winter challenge and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Winter running event starting at Vändra Stadium
Four distances: marathon, half marathon, 14 km and 7 km walk/run
Sauna, food, drinks, diploma, and medal at the finish
additional: The event secretariat opens at 9:00 on race day. The entry fee is €5 higher on race day. Participants can enjoy a sauna, food, drinks, a diploma, and a medal at the finish. The entry fee can be paid by bank transfer to the Terviseklubi MISPO account. Registering on race day incurs an additional €5 fee. All finishers receive food, drinks, a sauna, a diploma, and a medal.

name: XII Półmaraton Mikołajkowy w Mikołajkach
description: The 12th Mikołajki St. Nicholas Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on 5 December 2026. Participants can compete over 21 km and 10 km, as well as in children’s and youth races. The event starts and race-pack pickup take place in the morning. After the races, trophies, prizes, and certificates are presented in a formal ceremony. The participant limit is 450, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21 km and 10 km routes through the streets of Mikołajki
Children’s and youth races with a separate schedule
Participant limit of 450
additional: Registration and race-pack pickup take place from 8:00 to 11:00. The children’s and youth races start at 10:30, with results and prize-giving immediately afterwards. Results and awards for the 10 km and half marathon take place at 14:15. Participation is free for people over 70, people with disabilities, and residents of the Mikołajki Municipality in both distances. The event is scheduled to start at 11:45. Online registration runs from 16 September to 1 December 2026; payment on the day is also available. The limit is 450 runners.

name: Trail!ON Stawiguda 2026/2027 #1
location: Ruś, Gmina Stawiguda, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE is a winter running series consisting of four events held over half-marathon and marathon distances, as well as Nordic Walking events. The races take place on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River area near Biedrusko, offering an intimate atmosphere for both recreational and professional runners. The course passes through picturesque areas along the Warta River, with varied surfaces and terrain. The start and race office are located at the Łysy Młyn forest car park by Lake Łyse, and the gun start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon is two loops.
The course follows mainly the blue cycling trail along the Warta River, as well as forest tracks and trails.
The course surface is slippery and uneven, with leaves, puddles, and mud, requiring care and preparation.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. During the 2026/2027 winter season, 5 km and 10 km races and Nordic Walking events are also held. Each race in the series has a theme and encourages participants to wear themed outfits. The course is not certified; it is measured using bike computers and a Garmin device. The race headquarters are at the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, by Lake Łyse. The venue can be reached by car or by local and suburban buses; free parking is available. The start is scheduled for 10:00. Nordic Walking takes place over the half-marathon distance.

name: Omega kiirus
description: Omega Speed is an indoor sprint and middle-distance competition that brings together participants of different ages in an exciting generational face-off. The event takes place at Lasnamäe Athletics Hall in Tallinn and offers a dynamic, engaging experience for all age groups. Registration is open until December 1, 2026.
course_highlights: Indoor sprint and middle-distance competition
Age-based generational face-off
Venue: Lasnamäe Athletics Hall in Tallinn

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
description: The Festival of St. Nicholas Runs in Toruń is Poland’s largest St. Nicholas-themed running event, attracting more than 2,000 participants each year. The event takes place in a festive atmosphere on Toruń’s charming streets, offering a range of distances from a half marathon to a Nordic walking event. The start and finish of the main races are at the Old Town Market Square and the Municipal Stadium, respectively. Participants can expect a generous race package and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route runs through the streets of Toruń, starting at the Old Town Market Square and finishing at the Municipal Stadium
Available distances: half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 5 km Nordic walking
Festive atmosphere and more than 2,000 runners dressed as Santa Clauses
additional: The Race Office is located at the MOSiR Tennis Courts in Toruń and is open on December 5 (15:00–20:30) and December 6 (8:00–11:00). The race package includes a long-sleeved technical shirt, a Santa hat, a sports bag, a race bib with a chip, energy bars, gifts from sponsors, a commemorative medal, and a hot recovery meal. Participants receive an SMS with their race bib number before the race. The Polish Santa Claus Half Marathon Team Championships are also held, with at least one woman required on each team. The race package includes, among other items, a long-sleeved technical shirt, a bag, and a Santa hat; at the finish, participants receive a medal, soup, and drinks. The event is accompanied by the “Santa Clauses for Children” charity campaign.

name: XIV Bieg Mikołajkowy
location: Stadion OSiR, ul. Piaskowa 97, Police, Poland
price_range: 85–110 zł (do 1 października; wpisowe będzie później stopniowo rosło)
description: The 14th St. Nicholas Run in Police is an annual running event held on December 6 at the OSiR stadium at 97 Piaskowa Street. Participants can choose between two distances—5 and 10 kilometers—on paved city roads. The event has a festive character, and participants traditionally start wearing Santa hats, with a special costume category also available. The program also includes children’s races, Nordic Walking, and the spectacular Dream Relay with Christmas trees. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and the winners’ awards ceremony will take place at 13:30.
course_highlights: A paved 5- or 10-kilometer route through the streets of Police
A festive atmosphere, with participants wearing Santa hats
The spectacular Dream Relay—a run with Christmas trees
additional: The race office opens at 8:00. Children’s and youth races start at 10:00. Nordic Walking starts at 12:10. The winners’ awards ceremony is at 13:30. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and Nordic Walking at 12:10. The main race is limited to 800 participants. Online registration is open until November 30 or until all places are filled.

name: Mikołajkowy Charytatywny Bieg i Marsz NW
Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: Kauno SK „Nemunas” 1000 m bėgimo taurės varžybos vyks 2024 m. gruodžio 14 d. Kaune. Šeštadienį 127 bėgikai rungtyniavo 1000 m distancijoje, o pirmąsias vietas užėmė Jaunimas – Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) su laiku 2:38.62 ir Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) su 3:04.08. Varžybose dalyvavo ir jauniai, jaunučiai bei vaikai, kurie taip pat pasiekė puikių rezultatų.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas lenktynėse su numeriu 49, SK Nemunas apranga.
1000 m bėgimo varžybų nugalėtojai ant pakylos.
Jauni bėgikai su medaliais ir dovanomis ant podiumo.
Dvi mergaitės po bėgimo su medaliais.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė yra Backyard ultra bėgimo varžybos, sukurtos tam, kad padėtų bėgikams kuo lengviau įveikti 100 mylių atstumą. Jei dar nesate gavę DNF savo gyvenime, tai galimybė jį garbingai užsitarnauti jau čia. Nugalėtojas bus tik vienas arba viena, todėl pasiruoškite išbandymui Alytuje.

name: 6 Wigilijny Bieg Charytatywny
price_range: 45–90 zł, zależnie od konkurencji i terminu zapisów
description: The 6th Christmas Eve Charity Run is a cross-country race on a forest course in Lasek Majoński in Luboń, taking place on December 12, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km run and a Nordic Walking event on the same course. The event is charitable and supports the Dobro się niesie Foundation, which helps people experiencing homelessness. Shorter distances are available for children, with separate categories for girls and boys. The organizers provide a race pack, a commemorative wooden medal, a meal, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km run and Nordic Walking on a 100% forest trail course
Babki Forest District grounds — Lasek Majoński in Luboń
Cross-country race with a 50-minute time limit
additional: The race office opens at 9:45 near the cemetery in Luboń, ul. Armii Poznań 51B. The race pack includes a race bib, a wooden medal, a meal (sweet yeast bun and tea), and gifts from sponsors. Timing is provided by reusable chips attached to shoes. Age categories and OPEN, Luboń residents, ZSM Poznań, and four-person team classifications are available. The limit for children's races is 100 participants. An additional race-pack pickup is available on December 10, 2026, in the afternoon (location to be announced by the organizer). The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start at 12:30. The time limit is 50 minutes, and the combined participant limit for these events is 200. The entry fee includes a charitable contribution of 10 or 20 zł.

name: Dwumaraton Olęderski
location: Sątopy, Nowy Tomyśl County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races organized by the Nowy Tomyśl Chyży Running Club, held off-road in autumn and winter. The event has a social and sporting character and is intended for both experienced and beginner runners. The minimum distance is 10.5 km, while the full marathon distance is 42.2 km, which can be completed by running multiple 10.5 km loops. The event takes place in Sątopy and aims to help participants stay active outdoors during the challenging autumn and winter months.
course_highlights: Off-road course with a 10.5 km loop
Option to complete a full marathon or multiple loops
Races take place in autumn and winter conditions
additional: Dwumaraton Olęderski is a series of races held one weekend per month from October to March, each in a different town. The race office opens at 09:00, and the first race starts at 10:00. The time limit for the first race is 16:00. The second race starts at 09:00 the following day, with a time limit of 15:00. The event is co-funded by Nowy Tomyśl County and is held in accordance with the applicable restrictions. Information for the 2026/2027 edition gives the date as December 12, 2026; the December 13 date provided by the user may refer to another event day or to the weekend.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Leśny Park Kultury i Wypoczynku Myślęcinek, Bydgoszcz, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: The Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Bydgoszcz. The race is recreational and competitive, aimed at people aged 16 and over, and promotes outdoor physical activity. The course runs through the forested areas of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District, offering beautiful natural surroundings. Races take place regularly, giving participants the opportunity to test themselves on the same course throughout the season.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the forests of Myślęcinek and the Żołędowo Forest District
Start and finish at Polana Różopole
A cross-country route through forests and urban parks
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:45 before the race. Parking is not available at Polana Różopole; participants are advised to use parking areas approximately 1–1.5 km from the start. The event schedule and race-office location remain the same throughout the season. The race is scheduled to start at 11:00. Register via the participant portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day.

name: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night
description: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night is a unique trail-running competition taking place in Dalby on December 12. The race features a 1 km light trail course with a substantial hill at the start. Participants run as many laps as they can within time limits that gradually decrease. It is a challenge combining speed and running strategy in dark, cold conditions, with the possibility of running up to 20 km. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap area, and prizes are awarded to many participants. The competition is open to all levels and ambitions, with a focus on enjoying the forest.
course_highlights: 1 km light trail course with 24 m of elevation gain per lap
A substantial hill at the start of the course
Running in the dark and cold weather
additional: Participants have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Water, cola and some food are available at the lap area, and broth may also be available. Prizes are awarded to many participants. Places are limited. Start at the Dalbybadet car park at 15:30. Lap times gradually decrease: 10 minutes for the first lap, then 9 minutes and 40 seconds, followed by 9 minutes and 20 seconds. Limited places; bring a headlamp.

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: „Santa Fun Run“ – tai graži šiauliečių ir miesto svečių tradicija, kai bene 500 dalyvių, pasipuošusių Kalėdų senelių kostiumais, bėga Šiaulių miesto gatvėmis. Šio bėgimo tikslas kilnus – visos surinktos lėšos yra skiriamos labdarai. Dalyvių amžiaus apribojimų nėra, o simbolinę 1,3 km distanciją nesunkiai įveiks kiekvienas. Pasiekus finišą dalyvių lauks staigmena – Kalėdų senelius–bėgikus sveikins vienas garsiausių Lietuvos atlikėjų, Jovani.

name: TreeningPluss Muraste jooks-matk
location: Muraste, Harku Parish, Harju County, Estonia

name: Noskrien Ziemu 2. posms Koknesē
description: Noskrien Ziemu Stage 2 in Koknese is a winter running event offering the opportunity to take part in various distances and sports. The event is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes and active people who want to test their abilities in winter conditions. The race takes place in Koknese, offering a challenge and enjoyment for both individual runners and teams. Registration is open, but participant numbers are limited, so it is also possible to join the waiting list.
additional: Participant numbers are limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on the waiting list. Registration is available only for one current Noskrien Ziemu stage at a time. Participants must provide the required details, including date of birth, gender, club, and place of residence for statistics.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: ul. Spokojna, Mały Kack, Gdynia, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Karnet można wykupić najpóźniej do środy przed drugim biegiem

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including the Tricity area in the Gdańsk Forest District and around Mały Kack in Gdynia. The races take place in natural settings among forests and urban parks, promoting outdoor physical activity. The series consists of four races in each location, and participants can compete in both local and overall rankings. The races are open to people aged 16 and over; younger participants may take part with a guardian’s consent. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The 5 km course runs through forests and urban parks
The Tricity location includes the Gdańsk Forest District and the area around Mały Kack in Gdynia
The race takes place in a natural setting and promotes outdoor activity
additional: The race office opens at 8:30. Race numbers and timing chips are collected on race day. The schedule is the same at all locations. Participants can buy a pass for the entire series or enter individual races. The entry fee is higher on race day. There is no participant limit. Participants under 16 may take part with a guardian’s consent. Pass holders can race for free in another city by registering in advance. Online registration is available through the Participant Portal at citytrail.pl/zapisy or on race day at the race office. A pass for four races at one location is available.

name: III Bieg Crossowy Śladami Bobra
description: The 3rd Cross-Country Beaver Trail Run is a trail race held in Szarlejka, on a 5 km course. The event is organized by the Positive Sport Foundation and is aimed at running and nordic walking enthusiasts. The event takes place in December, and participants can expect professional timekeeping and a friendly atmosphere. The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30, and the race starts on the same day at 2 Borowa Street.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Trail run in a natural setting
Participation in either the race or nordic walking
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. Organizer: Positive Sport Foundation. Electronic timekeeping. Categories: 5 km run and 5 km nordic walking. The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30.

name: VII Bieg Mikołajów
organizer: Stowarzyszenie WKR FAN, Superczas.pl i Miejski Ośrodek Kultury w Olsztynie
price_range: od 30 zł; opłata w dniu imprezy od 60 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Podstawowa opłata startowa jest równa 30 zł ale to Ty zdecydujesz jaką kwotą wesprzesz potrzebujące dzieciaki.

description: The 7th Santa Run is an annual charity race held in Olsztyn as part of the Warmia Christmas Market. The 5 km route passes through the picturesque Old Town, Central Park, and Łynostrada. The event is open to adults and young people aged 12 and over. Its aim is to have fun and support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats, and the limit is 420 participants.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through Olsztyn’s Old Town
Scenic paths in Central Park
A run along Łynostrada
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Participants receive commemorative Santa hats. Timing is provided by chips, which must be returned at the finish. All entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn. Participants must be at least 12 years old (born in 2014 or earlier). Online registration is open until December 9, 2026, or until the participant limit is reached. The race office is located at the Czesław Niemen Amphitheatre, ul. Zamkowa 1. Entry fees support the Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Ward in Olsztyn.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland’s largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, starts again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which returns as the event centre after a few years’ break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year’s new main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, runners will compete over 5 km and 10 km, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision will ensure safety during the race.

images.alt_text: Juoksijoita kilpailussa maantiellä.
Maantiejuoksukilpailu, jossa juoksijat lähtevät matkaan.
Juoksukilpailu Vantaalla, jossa joukko ihmisiä juoksee asfaltilla. Taustalla rakennuksia ja puita.
Juoksija-lehden kansi juoksijalla.

name: Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis
description: 2025 m. gruodžio 20 d. Varėnos sporto centras organizuoja Kalėdinį bėgimo renginį „Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis“. Renginys yra nemokamas, tačiau organizatoriai kviečia dalyvius, esant galimybei, prisidėti parama renginio kokybei gerinti. Jūsų palaikymas padeda mums kurti šventišką, sklandų ir įsimintiną bėgimo renginį visiems dalyviams.

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: Kauno Kalėdinis bėgimas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Kaune gruodžio mėnesį. Renginys skirtas visų amžiaus grupių bėgikams, siekiant skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir bėgimo populiarumą. Varžybos vyksta Panemunės šile, o trasos yra asfaltuotos, tinkamos tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams. Po bėgimo dalyviai vaišinami kūčiukais ir arbata, o taip pat yra galimybė pasinaudoti baseino paslaugomis.
course_highlights: Trasa Panemunės šile, Kaune
Asfaltuota danga, galimas sniegas ir ledas priklausomai nuo oro sąlygų
Galimybė bėgti 1,7 km, 5 km (vienas ratas) arba 10 km (du ratai)
additional: Dalyvių numerių išdavimas varžybų dieną nuo 10:00 iki 11:40 val. Starto mokestis mokamas į Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubo sąskaitą. Po bėgimo vaišinimas kūčiukais ir arbata. Nuo 14:30 iki 15:30 val. galimybė išsimaudyti Žalgirio baseine (Karaliaus Mindaugo pr. 50, Kaunas). Registruotis galima tik savo vardu, numerio perdavimas draudžiamas. Registracija iki spalio 31 d., vardiniai numeriai dalyviams, renginio data - 2026-12-19

name: Žieminis backyard 2026, Mariaus Zakarausko taurei laimėti
2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev is a traditional winter running event taking place on 19 December 2026 in front of Rocca al Mare School in Tallinn. The event centre and start/finish are conveniently located at the school, and the programme includes three distances: a marathon, a relay marathon and an 8.4 km run. The courses run mainly along shared-use paths and are well marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Participants are provided with medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at the refreshment stations and finish.
course_highlights: The 8.4 km run follows shared-use paths and is marked with signs and course marshals.
The marathon consists of 5 laps, each a 8.44 km paved shared-use path.
The relay marathon consists of 5 legs, each a lap of 8.44 km.
additional: The marathon and relay marathon have participant limits of 100 marathon runners and 150 teams, respectively. The 8.4 km run is limited to 150 runners. Race numbers are distributed on race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish area. Awards are presented after the run or marathon, as applicable. Running on the road is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The course is in an urban setting. Registration and entry fees are listed in detail. The event is held annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...

price_tiers.distance: Bieg dorosłych 5 km i 10 km oraz Nordic Walking

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 74 zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 84zł – w przypadku rejestracji w ostatni wtorek, środę i czwartek przed zawodami.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25zł – w przypadku rejestracji do ostatniego poniedziałku poprzedzającego zawody.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 35zł – w przypadku rejestracji po tym terminie.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The races take place on forest trails, on a 5.15 km loop that climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the park’s highest peak. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. It brings together runners and sports enthusiasts of all ages in a friendly atmosphere with a spirit of competition.
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The route passes through the event center, allowing spectators to cheer on participants
additional: Children’s races are held over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m, with a separate start schedule from 9:00 to 9:45. The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30. Registration for the adult race and Nordic Walking event is also available on race day until 10:00 (at a higher fee). Participants in the 10 km race complete two laps. After leaving the forest, the finish-area setup separates runners finishing the race from those continuing onto the second lap. The season comprises six races; routes are marked with orange ribbons, and times are recorded electronically.

name: XIX Nocny Bieg Wigilijny Od zmierzchu do...
Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: Pirmąjį žiemos šeštadienį vyks kasmetinis Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas, kuris šiemet švenčia 50-metį. Ši bėgimo šventė kvies tūkstančius dalyvių, išsiskirdama šventine nuotaika ir išskirtiniais dalyviais, pasipuošusiais kalėdiniais kostiumais. Renginio programa pasislinko, kad dalyviai galėtų bėgti sutemus, kai Panevėžio gatvėse atsiskleis magiška kalėdinė dvasia. Šiemet kviečiame ne tik ruošti kalėdinius kostiumus, bet ir šviečiančius akcentus, kurie pavers bėgikų būrį kalėdine švytinčia magija.

name: Kalėdinis bėgimas „AKTYVŪS TRAKAI 365“
location: Užutrakis Manor Estate Park, Trakai District Municipality, Lietuva
description: Gruodžio 27 d. Užutrakio dvaro parke vyks „Aktyvūs Trakai 365“ kalėdinis bėgimas, kviečiantis dalyvauti tiek patyrusius bėgikus, tiek norinčius aktyviai praleisti laiką ir pasimėgauti šventine atmosfera. Distancijos nuo 1 iki 13,5 km leidžia pasirinkti tinkamiausią pagal amžių ir pajėgumą. Visų dalyvių laukia originalūs dalyvio medaliai, o prizininkų - taurės ir prizai. Renginys yra nemokamas, todėl kviečiame suburti komandą ir susitikti Trakuose aktyviai ir smagiai praleisti laiką.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Užutrakio dvaro sodybos parke - vienoje gražiausių Lietuvos vietų
Distancijos nuo 1 iki 13,5 km, pritaikytos įvairaus amžiaus ir pajėgumo dalyviams
Šventinė atmosfera ir galimybė aktyviai praleisti laiką su bendraminčiais
additional: Renginys vyks nuo 11:00 iki 17:00 val. Bėgimas yra nemokamas. Visiems dalyviams numatyti originalūs medaliai, o prizininkams - taurės ir prizai.

name: XII Sylwestrowy Bieg i Nordic Walking
Bėgimas į Naujus
description: Bėgimas į Naujus - tai kasmetinis bėgimas, kuris vyksta paskutinę metų dieną. Šis renginys suburia bėgikus ir mėgėjus, siekiančius švęsti naujų metų atėjimą aktyviai. Dalyviai gali pasirinkti skirtingas distancijas, leidžiančias kiekvienam rasti sau tinkamą iššūkį. Bėgimo maršrutas siūlo gražias miesto vietas ir unikalią atmosferą, kurią sukuria dalyviai ir žiūrovai.

images.alt_text: Didelis fejerverkas virš miesto, švenčiant Naujuosius metus.
Bėgikai starte, renginys lauke.
Kalėdų eglutė su šventinėmis lemputėmis ir dekoracijomis, puikiai tinkanti Naujųjų metų šventei.
Bėgimas į Naujus 2026 su fejerverkais.

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: PAŽADŲ BĖGIMAS tęsiame 2018 metais pradėtą tradiciją. 2026-01-01 d. Rytas, kai ausyse dar aidi fejerverkų garsai, bėgimo metu patvirtinsite sau, jog Naujųjų metų pažadai tikrai išsipildys. Jokio varžymosi, registracijų, medalių ar prizų – tik jūs ir jūsų Naujųjų metų "PAŽADAI". Prabėgkite 10 km ir užrašykite savo tikslus, kad 2027-01-01 galėtumėte patikrinti, ar jie išsipildė. Startas vyks 2026-01-01 d. 14:00 val. Kauno santakos stadione.

images.alt_text: Bėgimas per miestą Naujųjų metų proga, daug bėgikų.
Kauno santakos stadionas.
Naktinis Kauno santakos stadiono vaizdas.
Bėgimo lenktynės, bėgikai.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai kviečia visus klubo narius ir draugus į 1-ąjį Naujametinį RUONIŲ MARATONĄ, kuris vyks Pasvalyje. Šis maratonas yra dalis tradicinių jau 18-tų Pasvalio rajone organizuojamų ledinių maudynių. Po maratono vyks klubo narių susirinkimas, kurio metu bus apdovanoti aktyviausi klubo nariai.

name: XVII Koszaliński Bieg Sylwestrowy
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, ul. Śniadeckich 4, Koszalin, Poland
description: The 17th Koszalin New Year’s Eve Run is a sporting way to say goodbye to the year in Koszalin, scheduled for December 31, 2026. The program includes a 5 km run, a 3.4 km Nordic walking event, and races for children and youth. The start and race office are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 4 Śniadeckich Street. It’s an event for runners and anyone who enjoys staying active at the end of the year.
course_highlights: 5 km main run
3.4 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races over 200 m, 400 m, and 800 m
additional: Online registration. The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:00 at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at 4 Śniadeckich Street. The Nordic walking event starts at 11:30.

name: 27 Szczeciński Bieg Noworoczny
location: Teatr Letni im. Heleny Majdaniec, Szczecin, Poland
description: Szczecin New Year’s Run 2027 is an annual running event held on January 1 by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre in Szczecin. The program includes a 5 km Main Run, Nordic Walking, and children’s races for different age groups. The Main Run route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana and goes around Jasne Błonia. The start and finish are by the Summer Theatre. The event is a great opportunity to start the new year actively in a family-friendly, sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 5 km route consists of two 2.5 km loops
The route follows paths in Jan Kasprowicz Park, passes by Psia Polana and goes around Jasne Błonia
Start and finish by the Helena Majdaniec Summer Theatre
additional: Children’s races take place before the Main Run at 13:20, 13:30, and 13:40 for different age groups. Capacity: 470 places combined for the Main Run and Nordic Walking, and 115 for the children’s races. Race bibs can be collected on December 29 and 30, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:30. A bag drop is available by the race office. Changing rooms are available in the start area. The program also includes Nordic Walking over two 2.5 km loops and children’s races of approximately 100, 200, and 400 m, depending on age group. Places are limited.

name: Bydgoszcz na Orientację
description: Bydgoszcz Orienteering is a series of orienteering events organized by the Bydgoszcz Orienteering Foundation, held in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. It is an activity for everyone, regardless of age or experience, combining sport with adventure and exploring nature using a map and compass. The Foundation promotes accessibility by also creating courses for blind and visually impaired participants. The series includes a variety of courses at different difficulty levels, and participants can earn badges for completing individual rounds.
course_highlights: A variety of forest terrain around Bydgoszcz, changing with each round
Courses for beginners and advanced participants, including courses for blind and visually impaired participants
The opportunity to earn digital badges and collectible stickers for completing rounds
additional: The series consists of six rounds held from November to January in various forests and areas around Bydgoszcz. For each completed round, participants receive a digital badge and a sticker for their collector card. A special final badge is available after completing the entire series. Courses cater to different ability levels, and the final round features a mass start on the semi-open grounds of a former farmstead.

name: Kresowe Trail #1
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are for both beginner and experienced runners, aiming to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. Each race offers carefully marked courses, electronic timekeeping, and a generous race package.
course_highlights: Trail courses ranging from approximately 5 km to over 18 km
Carefully marked trails with colored arrows (green, red, purple)
Aid stations along the course and at the finish; time limit of approximately 2 hours
additional: Registration is available on race day until 08:40 and on-site from 8:00. New race numbers are in use starting with the 2026 season; the first race number is free of charge. The race package includes a hot recovery meal (vegetarian option also available), electronic timekeeping, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography service, and points toward the series’ overall standings. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. Online registration and race-day on-site registration are available.

name: Lekkoatletyczne Halowe Mistrzostwa Europ... Bieg Uliczny 5 km
description: The 15th European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships will be held in Toruń. As part of the event, a 5 km road race is being organised, offering masters runners an excellent opportunity to compete on the city’s scenic routes. The competition combines sporting rivalry with a spirit of camaraderie among masters athletes.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race in the centre of Toruń
Scenic urban routes with historic views
An accompanying event to the indoor athletics championships
additional: The 5 km road race is part of the programme of the 15th European Masters Athletics Championships Indoor in Toruń. Programme details are available in a PDF on the main website. No information is available about entry fees or online registration. The 5 km road race was also one of the championship events in 2026.

name: XVII Noworoczny Bieg z Ochotą
description: The New Year's Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, giving participants the chance to run into the New Year full of energy. The course passes through the capital's scenic spots, offering both amateur and more experienced runners a unique sporting experience. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging everyone to celebrate together and start the new year actively.

name: Wbiegnij z Nami w Nowy Rok
price_range: Od 20 zł do puszki na cel charytatywny
description: “Run” into the New Year with us is an annual running meet-up held in Szczecin by Lake Głębokie. Participants cover around 5 km together. The event is social and charitable, combining sport with an opportunity to support those in need. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run, and the whole event takes place in a friendly atmosphere that encourages people to exchange New Year’s wishes. This informal running event invites everyone to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: An approximately 5 km route by Lake Głębokie
Option to take an ice bath after the run
A social meet-up with New Year’s wishes
additional: The event takes place on 1 January at 12:00 by Lake Głębokie in Szczecin. There is an option to take an ice bath after the run. The event is charitable, with a minimum donation of 20 zł to the collection tin. It is not a traditional running event, but a social running meet-up. The start is at 12:00 from a forest clearing or car park, approximately 400 m from the roundabout at Głębokie, in the direction of Wołczkowo. Participation is non-competitive and at your own risk. Anyone planning to take an ice bath should bring suitable equipment.

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Race in Kalmar is a local running classic organised by Högby IF Friidrott and held on 31 December 2026. Basic information about the race is available on the club’s website. Officials and volunteers register through the club’s login system.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
A medal and a specially designed hat for everyone who registers
A 5 km untimed walking category, as well as various age-group categories
additional: The Kalmar Sylvester Race is described as a running classic. Officials and volunteers register via the website’s registration form (WordPress), which requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for the different categories include P/F 5–13, 0.4–2.0 km; M/K 5 and 10 km; and the untimed 5 km walking category. Late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: Sylvesterloppet in Olofström is a traditional year-end race organised by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 m), run over two laps on the current course since 2018. There is also a shorter course of approximately 5.3 km. The finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving have long been held at Idrottshallen, creating a welcoming setting for runners and spectators. Its history and connection to the club make the race a popular event for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon: 10,549 m (run over two laps on the current course since 2018)
A shorter course of approximately 5.3 km is also available
Finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving at Idrottshallen
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord (as stated in the invitation). The race information, race instructions and course maps are available as PDF files on the organiser’s pages (invitation, race instructions, course). The start list is published separately on the organiser’s website. History and course profile, including the start and finish points around Idrottshallen and Nya torget.

name: XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lietuva
description: XIV tradicinis Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas vyks 2027 m. sausio 1 d. Startas bus Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryžoje. Tradicinė 20 km bėgimo trasa driekiasi per Čičinų ir Kurmagalos kaimus, o finišas - Kauno gatvėje prie valymo įrenginių. Renginys pasižymi kalvota trasa ir žiemiškomis sąlygomis, o po bėgimo dalyviai kviečiami pasivaišinti arbata, užkandžiais bei atsiimti atminimo medalius.
course_highlights: 20 km tradicinė bėgimo trasa
Startas Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryžoje
Trasa driekiasi per Čičinų ir Kurmagalos kaimus, finišas Kauno gatvėje
additional: Po bėgimo dalyviai apdovanojami taurėmis ir prizais, gauna atminimo medalius bei gali pasivaišinti arbata ir užkandžiais. Trasa yra kalvota, o žiemą gali būti slidoka ir vėjuota. Trasa driekiasi per Čičinų ir Kurmagalos kaimus, oras dažnai būna žiemiškas, o renginys yra populiarus tarp vietos bėgikų naujų metų pradžiai.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 yra greitas ir lygus 5K bėgimas, vyksiantis Naujųjų metų dieną, sausio 1 d. 2026 m., 10.15 val. Galway miesto centre. Maršrutas veda per miesto centrą, pradedant nuo Claddagh, per Wolfe Tone tiltą, Merchants Road ir Docks, grįžtant į Grattan Road ir Prom, kol greitai finišuojama South Park, prie Nimmos Pier. Šis maršrutas praeina pro daugumą žymiausių miesto lankytinų vietų. Varžybos yra AAI sertifikuotos.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 kviečia pradėti naujus metus energingai ir aktyviai. Tai puiki proga įgyvendinti Naujųjų metų pažadus bėgant kartu su entuziastingų bėgikų minia. Renginys garantuoja gerą nuotaiką, šypsenas ir smagų startą į metus Kaune.
course_highlights: Distancijos: 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km
Apšilimas visų distancijų dalyviams
Bėgimas Kauno miesto trasomis
additional: Dalyvių krepšelių išdavimas ir apdovanojimai numatyti renginio programoje. Renginio metu bus oficialus atidarymas ir apšilimas visų distancijų dalyviams. Renginys vyksta Kaune, organizuoja VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distancijos: 2,5 km, 5 km, 10 km; renginys vyks Kaune; organizatorius siūlo šventišką startą ir bendruomenės dvasią.

name: Warta Challenge
location: Łysy Młyn forest parking, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej
description: WARTA CHALLENGE Marathon&Half is a winter tournament consisting of a series of four races and Nordic Walking events, held on forest tracks and trails in the Warta River forests. The events offer half-marathon (21.3 km) and marathon (42.2 km) distances, as well as shorter 5 km and 10 km runs and walks. The event has an intimate atmosphere and is intended for both amateur and professional athletes, with themed races and special touches. The start and race office are located by the Łysy Młyn forest car park in Biedrusko, and the race starts at 10:00. The course follows forest trails and tracks, with some paved sections and natural obstacles such as leaves, mud, and puddles.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is one 21.3 km loop; the marathon consists of two loops.
The course mainly follows the blue cycling trail along the Warta River and the Łysy Młyn running trail.
The forest surface is slippery and uneven, with leaves, mud, and puddles; total elevation gain is 110 m for the half-marathon.
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 7:45 to 9:30 at the race office. Themed outfits and touches are encouraged for the individual races. The course is not officially certified and is measured using bicycle odometers and a Garmin device. Nordic Walking events are also held over 21.3 km, as well as runs and walks over 5 km and 10 km. The New Year's Run is event no. 2 in the series. The event centre and race office are by the Łysy Młyn forest car park, ul. Poznańska 4, 62-003 Biedrusko. Race-pack collection on race day is scheduled for 7:45–9:30, and the start is at 10:00. Free parking is available by the event centre.

name: Ełcka Zmarzlina

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: W terminie do 11 grudnia 2026 r., dla dystansu TP 50 km, TP 25 km – 120 zł

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: W terminie do 9 stycznia 2027 r., dla dystansu TP 50 km, TP 25 km – 150 zł

description: Ełcka Zmarzlina 2027 is a walking orienteering marathon held in Ełk, offering two routes of 50 km and 25 km. The event takes place on January 9, 2027, and is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk. Participants can expect professional organization, registration at the marathon office, and a celebratory closing with a feast. It is a unique opportunity to spend an active winter day on routes of varying difficulty.
course_highlights: 50 km walking orienteering route
Alternative 25 km route
Time limits: 12 hours for 50 km and 9 hours for 25 km
additional: Participant registration takes place on January 8, 2027, from 16:00 to 20:00, and on January 9 from 6:00 to 9:30 at the race office. The time limit is 12 hours for the 50 km route and 9 hours for the 25 km route. A celebratory closing and a feast for participants are planned for 21:00 after the event. Registration is conducted through Timekeeper. According to the 2027 event page, TP 50 km starts at 08:00, and TP 25 km at 10:00. The event is funded from the budget of the City of Ełk, and KOMA EŁK is a partner.

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainių sporto centras organizuoja LBT 1 – Naujametinį bėgimą „KĖDAINIAI 2025“, kuris vyks sausio 5 d. 12:00 val. Kėdainių miesto centrinio stadiono (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.) teritorijoje. Bėgimo distancijos apima 400 m vaikų bėgimą, 4 km ir 8,5 km trasas.

images.alt_text: Naujametinis bėgimas "Kėdainiai 2025" plakatas su informacija apie datą, vietą ir distancijas.
Bėgimo lenktynės Kėdainiuose, startas. Sportininkai bėga stadione.
Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas, kur vyks bėgimo varžybos.
LBT I Kėdainiai apdovanojimai.

name: 5 Wieluński Bieg Noworoczny
description: The 5th Wieluń New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Atelier Sport Association in Wieluń. The race takes place in early January and attracts runners from various regions. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00, and timing is provided using modern electronic systems. The organizers ensure a high standard of event organization and sporting competition, providing professional support and an atmosphere conducive to racing.
additional: Timing is provided using a state-of-the-art electronic system based on RFID chips and mats at the start and finish lines. The organizer provides telephone contact from 8:00 to 16:00 and support on race day. The event is organized by the Atelier Sport Association. No confirmed details are available about the 2027 edition.

name: Bieg Noworoczny
organizer: Fundacja Duet – Rozwój z Pasją; Stowarzyszenie Wroniecki Klub Biegacza
description: The New Year’s Run is an annual running event organized by the Wronki Runners Club, held on scenic routes in the Wronki municipality. Participants can choose distances of approximately 5 km or 10 km for runners, or approximately 5 km for walkers. The start and finish are on Rzecińska Street in Wronki, and times are recorded using a chip timing system. The event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and brings together local residents and running enthusiasts in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 5.5 km for runners and Nordic walking participants
Scenic forests and landscapes of the Wronki municipality
Start and finish on Rzecińska Street in Wronki
additional: The race office is open on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 by the start line on Rzecińska Street. Chip timing is provided by PLUS TIMING. Participants under 18 must submit written consent from a parent or guardian. The organizer does not allow participants under 15 to take part. Hot tea and coffee will be available in the catering area after the race. The winners’ awards ceremony will take place at the Zamość estate community center on Topolowa Street. The start is at 11:00. Participation is open from age 15; minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. Paying the entry fee on race day does not guarantee a medal.

name: Noworoczny Bydgoszcz FAN Maraton od 2014...
description: Bydgoszcz Fan Marathon is a unique long-distance event held in Bydgoszcz since 2014, mainly at the KS Gwiazda stadium and along the Old Bydgoszcz Canal. The course consists of multiple loops of approximately 4.22 km, following park paths with a gravel-and-asphalt surface and little elevation change. The event is small-scale and friendly, promoting recreational exercise and active leisure while continuing the tradition of similar races in other European cities. Participants time themselves and report their times to the organizers. Both runners and Nordic walkers are welcome. The start is usually in the morning, and the atmosphere is informal and friendly.
course_highlights: The course follows park paths around the Old Bydgoszcz Canal, with 4.22 km loops
Gravel-and-asphalt surface, mostly gravel
Start and finish at the KS Gwiazda stadium; little elevation change (approximately 53 m above sea level at the start and 45.95 m above sea level at the turnaround)
additional: There is no time limit; participants time themselves and report their times by email. People over 18 may take part, including Nordic walkers and walkers. The race office is located on the park path by the KS Gwiazda stadium. No entry fee is planned, except in special circumstances. Participants provide their own drinks and nutrition. The start is usually at 8:00 or 9:00. The course requires completing a multiple of the loop, up to a maximum of 10 loops. Participants arriving after the scheduled start time start together with the first participant. The event has no entry fee and no medals.

name: SpriT Frontyard Frozen - Torna Hällestad
location: Kaninlandet, Torna Hällestad, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: SpriT Frontyard Frozen in Torna Hällestad is a unique trail running race featuring a 1 km light trail course at Kaninlandet. The course starts gently, includes a challenging 100-metre hill with 15 metres of elevation gain, and finishes with a relaxed 300-metre sprint along a pleasant trail with no asphalt or gravel road. The aim is to run as many laps as possible within set time limits that gradually decrease, challenging both speed and running strategy. The race is for all levels and ambitions, with a lovely forest setting and a friendly atmosphere. Drinks and a little food are available at the lap point.
course_highlights: 1 km light trail course with no asphalt or gravel road
A 100-metre hill with 15 metres of elevation gain
A finishing 300-metre sprint along a pleasant trail
additional: Water, cola and a little food, and possibly broth, are available at the lap point. The race has a limited number of places, and registration is binding once payment has been made. The course route is available via Strava. Water, cola and light refreshments are available at the lap point. The start is at 09:00.

name: SpriT Frontyard Frozen 2027
location: Torna Hällestad, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden

name: 10 Bieg Trzech Króli
description: The 10th Łódź Three Kings Run is a 5 km street race held on January 6, the Feast of the Epiphany. The start and finish are at Manufaktura Market Square, and the route runs through the streets of Łódź, including Piotrkowska Street. Join us to kick off the year with a sporting event in a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Manufaktura Market Square
5 km street route
The route includes Piotrkowska Street

name: Ultra CK Maraton
description: Ultra CK Marathon is a winter endurance event featuring running and cycling in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Participants can choose from three routes: a 51 km ultra run with substantial elevation gain, a fast 15 km mountain run, and a 30 km MTB ride. The ultra route passes through challenging, snow-covered forests and the freezing Piekło Cave, making it especially demanding and atmospheric. Held in harsh winter conditions, the event offers participants a true challenge and the satisfaction of conquering a hellish course.
course_highlights: Hellish Loop: 51 km ultra run with approximately 1,520 m of elevation gain through snow-covered forests and Piekło Cave
Devil’s Breath: 15 km fast mountain run with approximately 422 m of elevation gain on technical forest trails
Ghostly Thirty: 30 km MTB ride on wintery, slippery singletracks with approximately 828 m of elevation gain
additional: The race office is open on 5.01.2027 from 16:00 to 20:00 and on 6.01.2027 from 6:00 at Hala Legionów Kielce. Mandatory equipment for participants in the 51 km ultra run: a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, a charged mobile phone, proof of identity, and clothing suited to the weather conditions. Time limits apply at the individual checkpoints and at the finish. Ultra-run participants must carry safety equipment, including a headlamp, an NRC emergency blanket, and a charged phone.

name: Grand Prix Trójmiasta 1/3
location: Brzeźno Pier (Molo w Gdańsku-Brzeźnie), Gdańsk, Poland
description: The 3 Kings Run is the first event in the 2027 Grand Prix of the Tri-City series, held on a 100% sandy beach course in Gdańsk-Brzeźno. The event includes a 6 km cross-country run and 6 km Nordic walking, with age categories and three-person team competitions requiring at least one woman. The event is small-scale, with a participant limit of 500, offering an intimate atmosphere and sporting competition on the scenic coast. The run starts at 9:00, and the winners’ awards ceremony will take place at around 11:30.
course_highlights: 100% beach course
6 km cross-country run
6 km Nordic walking
additional: The event office opens at 07:30. Three-person teams (for both the run and Nordic walking), with at least one woman, must register at the event office. Participant limit: 500. Participants can choose the 6 km cross-country run or Nordic walking. Three-person team competition is also available, with at least one woman on each team.

name: 10 Bieg III Króli
location: Hotel Barczyzna Medical Spa, Barczyzna, Nekla, Poland
description: The 10th Three Kings Run is a 10 km road race taking place on January 6, 2027, in Nekla. The event is an excellent opportunity to start the new year actively and check your running fitness. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using individual training plans tailored to their level. The race is moderately challenging and takes place on an asphalt course.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Moderate difficulty
Held in scenic Nekla
additional: Individual training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and supported by experts with detailed training instructions.

name: Noskrien Ziemu 3. tumsas posms Smiltenē
description: Noskrien Ziemu 3rd Night Stage in Smiltene is a winter running race that gives participants the opportunity to test their abilities in wintry and challenging conditions. The race takes place in Smiltene and is part of the Noskrien Ziemu series, which brings together athletes from different places. The event is welcoming to both experienced runners and amateurs, offering various distances and the opportunity to take part in a hike. The organizers provide a convenient registration process and support for participants.
additional: Registration is available only for the current Noskrien Ziemu stage. The number of participants is limited, and once the limit is reached, applications are placed on a waiting list.

name: Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 79
location: Wieluń-Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.description: 90 zł przy rejestracji po 31.10.2026 – karnet na 4 biegi

description: Trail!ON Stawiguda is a series of four 5 km trail races held monthly on the same scenic route near the forests and the Łyna River, close to Ruś. The winter scenery, forest trails and changing terrain create unique running conditions, giving runners a chance to test their fitness and enjoy the excitement of competition throughout the season. The event is for everyone who wants to spend their winter Saturdays actively, regardless of experience level. The organizers help make the event comfortable for participants by offering passes for the full series as well as the option to enter a single race.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the beautiful forests of Ruś
Start and finish by the beach at the bend of the Łyna River in Stawiguda Municipality
Winter forest scenery with natural, changing terrain
additional: Mini Trail!ON children’s races are held over distances from 300 m to 1,000 m, with age-group divisions. Children’s races take place from 9:45 to 10:15. The race office closes at 10:30. An awards ceremony for the series winners and a bonfire with the Mayor are planned for the final race. Single-race entry can be purchased at the race office on race day. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:00. The program also includes children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m, 500 m and 1,000 m, as well as winter swimming. Online registration is open until January 6, 2027, at 23:59.

name: Backyard Ultra Polska
location: Poligon Wojskowej Akademii Technicznej, Bemowo, Warsaw, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Warszawa - Bemowo is the first edition of a backyard-format race, held on the grounds of the Military University of Technology training area in Warsaw. The course is 6,706 km long, in accordance with the worldwide backyard rules. The event lasts a maximum of 24 hours, during which runners complete successive loops. The participant limit is 80, and the winner receives cash prizes, a trophy, and gifts from partners. All participants receive a commemorative medal and certificate.
course_highlights: A 6,706 km course in accordance with the backyard rules
The race takes place on the grounds of the Military University of Technology training area in Warsaw
A time limit of 24 hours (24 loops)
additional: The participant limit is 80, with the possibility of an increase at the organizer’s discretion. The winner receives a cash prize, a trophy, and prizes from partners. The winner of the Polish Uniformed Services Open Championships receives a trophy and prizes. The top resident of the Bemowo district receives a statuette and prizes. The limit is 80 runners. Available entry-fee options include a “for fun” participation option of up to 7 loops and a discount for members of the Polish Ultra Sports Association and the Bemowo Biega group.

description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series consists of six races on a scenic course in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The route follows a 5.15 km loop through forest, climbing the highest hill, Dziewicza Góra, twice. The races bring together runners of different ages and abilities across various distances, and also offer Nordic walking and races for children and young people. The organizers provide professional timing and a welcoming atmosphere, creating a unique “Dziewicza Family.”
course_highlights: A 5.15 km loop through the forest
Two climbs to the summit of Dziewicza Góra
The course passes through the event centre, where spectators can cheer on participants
additional: Electronic timing using an ankle-mounted chip band. Race office open from 8:15 to 10:30. Participant limit: 500. The races are held as a series of six stages. Children’s and youth races over 200 m, 500 m, 1,000 m and 1,500 m. The course is marked with orange ribbons and directional arrows. Participants in the 10 km race complete two loops; after the first loop, they cross the finish line and continue onto the second loop. The 2026–2027 season consists of six stages; passes for the whole series were also available.

name: Viva Las Natalin
description: Viva Las Natalin is the 3rd Carnival Run, held in the picturesque forests of Natalin and attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the Mazovia region. The event takes place in a wintry setting, and participants start in colorful costumes, creating a unique, lively atmosphere. It is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. The event offers several distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking, with separate classifications for women and men.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forests of Natalin
Picturesque winter scenery
Carnival atmosphere with participants in colorful costumes
additional: The event is organized by the “Z Biegiem Dwóch Rzek” Association in cooperation with Wyszków Municipality, WOSiR, and the Wyszków Forest District. Participants can take part in 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km Nordic walking. Prizes are presented by the authorities of Wyszków Municipality. The event has a carnival theme, with participants wearing colorful costumes.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za pojedynczy bieg uiszczona najpóźniej do środy poprzedzającej start

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The Szczecin course runs through beautiful woodland around Emerald Lake, with the start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn. The race is open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with parental permission. The event aims to promote running and outdoor physical activity, and to offer the opportunity to compete on a permanent course.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Emerald Lake
Start and finish behind the Szmaragd Inn at ul. Kopalniana
Varied course profile with uphill and downhill sections
additional: The race office opens at 8:30; race bibs and chips can be collected on race day. Participants can purchase a pass for the entire series or enter a single race. The pass allows one free start in another city, provided the participant registers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. The main race starts at 11:00, with a group warm-up at 10:45. The race-day entry fee is higher (60 zł). The start is at 11:00. Registration is available online through the CITY TRAIL website or at the race office on race day.

description: The 13th Winter Run as part of the Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity (WOŚP) will take place on January 10, 2027, in Krajkowo at the Riding Center IDMAR. The main race, covering approximately 10 km, starts at 12:00. Races for children and young people are also held over several shorter distances. The start, finish, and race village are inside the arena, providing comfortable conditions regardless of the weather. A public collection will be held in support of WOŚP, along with challenges and competitions for spectators, so there will be something for everyone.
course_highlights: Main race distance: approximately 10 km
Start and finish inside the Riding Center IDMAR arena in Krajkowo
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,000 m
additional: Race Office opening hours: January 8, 2027, in Mosina (17:00–20:00), and January 10, 2027, in Krajkowo (09:30–11:55). Participants can support WOŚP with voluntary donations when collecting their race packs. Challenges and competitions for spectators, as well as the HARPAGAN challenge, will also be held. The main race starts at 12:00. Registration is open until January 3, 2027; voluntary donations to WOŚP will be collected during race-pack collection.

name: Bieg do Herbacianego Domku #332
description: Tea with Tadek, or the Run to the Tea House, is a social run held in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event attracts runners who want to spend time actively outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The run is recreational and brings people together, encouraging socializing and having fun with fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Bródno Park
A social, recreational run
An atmosphere that encourages socializing and having fun
additional: The run takes place in Bródno Park in Warsaw. The event is social and recreational, with no details provided about distances, start waves, or entry fees.

name: VII Żniński Bieg Powstańczy
description: The VII Żnin Uprising Run is a 5 km race taking place in Żnin. The course is flat and paved, with one small hill and a turnaround halfway through. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street, near the tennis courts. The race is organized by the Jedynka Association and is limited to 200 participants.
course_highlights: 5 km course measured by GPS
Flat paved course with one small hill
Turnaround 2.5 km from the start
additional: The race is limited to 200 participants. The start and finish are on Szkolna Street in Żnin, near the tennis courts (property number 14). The payment title must include the participant’s first name, surname, and year of birth.

name: XIII Bieg Zimowego Dziadka
description: The XIII Winter Grandfather Run is a friendly 10 km race held on the Kuchary Forest District running route. The route is fully marked and has limited vehicular traffic, ensuring participants’ safety. The time limit for completing the course is 90 minutes. The event starts with a warm-up, followed by an awards ceremony and refreshments for participants after the race.
course_highlights: Kuchary Forest District running route
Fully marked 10 km course
Limited vehicular traffic on the route
additional: Registration takes place from 10:00 to 10:30 on race day. There is a warm-up before the 10:30 start. The participant limit is 120. The awards ceremony and refreshments take place after the race, at around 12:30. The entry fee was PLN 40 when registering in advance and PLN 50 on the day of the event, and the participant limit was 120.

name: Zimowa Piątka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Zimowa Piątka is an annual race organized by the Suwałki Sports and Recreation Centre, held by Arkadia Reservoir. It is a unique opportunity to kick off the winter season with an active outing in the picturesque surroundings of Suwałki, known for its harsh climate and beautiful landscapes. The event attracts both recreational and experienced runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting competition among residents and visitors. For years, OSiR Suwałki has ensured the professional organization of sporting events, providing participants with comfort and safety.
course_highlights: The race route follows a picturesque course around Arkadia Reservoir
The winter scenery of Suwałki, with its characteristic cold climate
A well-prepared and marked route suited to runners of different abilities
additional: In previous editions, the race was part of Stacja Pogodne Suwałki, whose program also included a Nordic walking event and a children's race. Participants in Zimowa Piątka could take part in carnival costumes.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti Klaipėdoje yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, skirtas pagerbti žuvusius ir kovojusius už Lietuvos laisvę. Renginys suburia miesto bendruomenę ir svečius, vyksta sausio 18 dieną Klaipėdoje. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš dviejų distancijų - 8 km pagrindinės trasos ir 3 km trumposios trasos, skirtos moksleiviams, senjorams ir visiems, kuriems ilgoji trasa per sudėtinga. Startas vyksta vakare, o trasos driekiasi gražiomis miesto vietomis, įskaitant dviračių taką ir Vasaros estradą.
course_highlights: 8 km trasa driekiasi dviračių taku pro Klaipėdos Vasaros estradą, Liepojos ir H. Manto gatves
Finišas prie Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės (Liepų g. 11)
3 km trasa startuoja prie Klaipėdos Vasaros estrados, skirta moksleiviams ir senjorams
additional: Numeriai su lauko fiksavimo čipu. Numerių atsiėmimas iš anksto rekomenduojamas, kad būtų išvengta eilių renginio dieną. Numerių atsiėmimas 8 km bėgikams vyksta autobuse nuo Rotušės, 3 km bėgikams - prie Vasaros estrados. Autobusų išvykimas į starto vietas 19:00 val. Individualus apšilimas 19:45 - 19:55 val. Trasos uždarymas 21:20 val. Dalyviams suteikiamos medaliai pirmiems 900 finišavusių, renginys organizuojamas su autobusais ir bendruomenės dalyvavimu, startas Klaipėdoje Girulių radijo ir TV bokšte.

name: Aplink Želvos ežerą
description: Bėgimas „Aplink Želvos ežerą“ įvyks 2025 m. sausio 11 d. Suginčiuose (Molėtų raj.), skirtas Lietuvos laisvės gynėjų dienai atminti. Varžybos rengiamos siekiant populiarinti bėgimą Lietuvoje, kelti sportinį meistriškumą ir propaguoti sveiką bei aktyvų gyvenimo būdą. Rekomenduojame atvykti ~10:00 val., o varžybų startas – 11:00 val.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event brings together runs, hikes and run-walks, giving participants the opportunity to discover the region’s beautiful, scenic landscapes. For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in beautiful, wooded settings in city parks, including Młociński Park in Warsaw. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the required permission. The event is recreational and competitive in nature, promoting outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The start and finish in Warsaw are in Młociny Forest, and the course stays the same, allowing results to be compared over the years.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the wooded setting of Młociński Park
The start is about 1.5 km from the finish, which is on a clearing in Młociny Forest
The course is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. In Warsaw, the warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place at 10:30. The course stays the same throughout the season. Parking nearby is limited, so using public transport is recommended. Register online at citytrail.pl/zapisy or at the race office on race day. A pass for four races at one location is also available.
