description: Lake Run is a unique trail race held on the shores of Lake Strzeszyńskie in Poznań. The approximately 5 km and 10 km routes, as well as the Nordic Walking course, follow natural paths around the lake, offering a light trail feel with uphill sections and a short off-road stretch. The start and finish are right by the water, providing beautiful views and an intimate atmosphere that’s ideal for both beginners and experienced runners. Organized by the EVsport Foundation, the race combines a passion for sport with closeness to nature and a welcoming community.
course_highlights: The routes loop around Lake Strzeszyńskie, with views of the lake
Natural paths and a light trail feel, including a short off-road stretch
Start and finish right by the water, with no streets or traffic jams
additional: One entry fee applies to all distances: 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. Souvenirs from the “Feel the Rhythm of the Lake” collection can be purchased separately (T-shirt, mug, bandana, premium bag or set). Participants under 18 must have a consent form signed by a parent or guardian. The routes have a light trail feel, with natural surfaces and gentle uphill sections. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip. The available options are 5 km, 10 km and Nordic Walking. The organizer recommends shoes with good grip; a detailed route map will be published later. Participants under 18 need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian when collecting their race pack.

name: Charytatywny II Fenomenalny Bieg Kolorowy
price_range: Bezpłatnie dla dzieci i młodzieży; 50 zł dla dorosłych
description: The Charity 2nd Phenomenal Color Run is an event in Łupstych near Olsztyn, combining recreational running with support for people with Down syndrome. The routes follow forest roads in the Kudypy Forest District and are designed for children, teenagers, and adults. Participants can choose a distance of 600 m, 2 km, or 3.5 km, and commemorative medals await them at the finish. The run is informal and does not include timekeeping.
course_highlights: Forest routes in the Kudypy Forest District
Three distances: 600 m, 2 km, and 3.5 km
Routes for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Adult entry fees go toward the charitable cause. Participants receive commemorative medals; the run is not timed.

name: Ekstremalna Droga Krzyżowa
location: Kościół przy ul. Kościelnej 2, Bezrzecze, Poland
description: The Extreme Way of the Cross is a demanding route from the church at 2 Kościelna Street in Bezrzecze to the cross by the church in Bezrzecze. The route is interesting and varied, passing partly through woodland and partly through urban areas. Most of the route is on paved surfaces, so soft-soled footwear is recommended. It is a spiritual and physical challenge for participants, combining reflection with outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Partly woodland and partly urban route
Most of the route is paved
Start and finish by the church in Bezrzecze
additional: Soft-soled footwear is recommended because of the varied terrain. The route description recommends soft-soled footwear. The Extreme Way of the Cross takes place in silence and contemplation, with reflections on the Stations of the Cross.

name: Grand Prix Cross Polska cz.1
location: ReMi fish fry, ul. Lipowa 31, Stegna, Poland
organizer: Gmina Stegna i Valdano Organizacja Imprez Sportowych
description: Grand Prix Cross Polska Part 1 is a prestigious running event held in the picturesque seaside municipality of Stegna. The event launches the Grand Prix Cross Polska 2027 series and offers participants a unique sporting atmosphere combined with the beauty of the Amber Coast. The organizers look after runners’ comfort by providing a race office and a recovery meal at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and fair play, bringing together the local community and athletes from across Poland.
course_highlights: A route through the seaside scenery of the Municipality of Stegna
Start and finish near the “ReMi” fish fry shop at 31 Lipowa Street
The event is organized and concludes at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre
additional: The race office, recovery meal, and award ceremony take place at the Stegna Municipal Cultural Centre. The event is held under the patronage of the Municipality of Stegna and the Polish Olympic Committee. The route passes near beach access No. 69 from Lipowa Street. The organizers provide comfortable conditions and opportunities for participants to connect.

name: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka skansen forteczny
description: Prymulek-Dąbrowska Górka Fortified Open-Air Museum is a 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of Karczew. Runners can prepare for the start with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is intended for runners seeking a challenge on a moderately difficult course. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy outdoor activity amid the historic fortified open-air museum.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Moderate difficulty
Picturesque surroundings of the fortified open-air museum in Karczew
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. The organizer encourages using the platform to manage the race listing and for marketing collaboration. The date in the race calendar is marked as tentative and differs by one day from the stated event date.

name: Stęszewski Bieg Przełajowy
description: The Stęszew Cross-Country Run is an annual running event organized by the Municipality of Stęszew, bringing the local community together through active recreation. The races take place on scenic routes in Wielkopolska National Park, mainly along forest trails and dirt tracks. The main race offers 5 km and 10 km distances, alongside a 5 km Nordic Walking event and children’s races tailored to younger participants’ ages. The start and finish are on the beach by Lake Lipno, and the time limit is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: 95% of the route follows forest trails, dirt tracks, and unpaved roads
The 5 km race is one loop through the forest by Lake Lipno and the Trzebaw forest
The 10 km race consists of two loops of the same route
additional: The participant limit is 300. Net chip timing is used. The course is not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The Nordic Walking event starts at 13:15. Parking is available by the Sports and Entertainment Hall and along Trzebawska Street. Previous editions have included children’s races over age-appropriate distances and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The official website lists the contact details: +48 698 050 150, bieg@steszew.pl.

name: Tropem Wilczym
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Olsztyńska, Dobre Miasto, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Wolność i Demokracja; lokalnie OSiR w Dobrym Mieście
description: Tropem Wilczym – Run in Memory of the Cursed Soldiers in Dobre Miasto is an annual running event commemorating the Cursed Soldiers. The race takes place at the municipal stadium on Olsztyńska Street and consists of two events: an individual 1.963 km race and an 8 km relay held on the stadium’s tartan track. The event has a sporting and patriotic character, and participants can expect commemorative medals and T-shirts. The organizers provide timekeeping and professional race-office support.
course_highlights: The individual race course runs on the stadium’s tartan track
The 8 km relay consists of 20 laps of the stadium
Time limit for the individual race: 20 minutes
additional: The race office is open from 10:30 to 12:30 at the Municipal Stadium. The relay starts at approximately 13:00. Each participant collects their own race bib and race pack. The team captain receives a relay baton with a timing chip. Timing chips are returned at the finish. Participant limit: 150 (70 individual runners + 20 four-person relay teams). Previous editions featured relays with teams of 4–6; each participant had to cover at least 400 m.

name: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Lwówku, Rozbiegany Lwówek, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu w Nowym Tomyślu
description: Wiosenna Lwówecka 5 is an annual race held in the picturesque town of Lwówek, attracting runners from various places. The course runs through the charming grounds of the Municipal Park, offering participants pleasant conditions for competition and recreation. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors in an atmosphere of sporting camaraderie.
course_highlights: The course runs through Municipal Park in Lwówek
Picturesque surroundings that are welcoming to runners
A 5 km distance suited to different ability levels
additional: The race office is open on event day from 7:30 to 8:30 at the start location, Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek. For the 2025 edition, the address was listed as Parkowa 2, 64-310 Lwówek, with opening hours of 7:30–8:30.

name: XI Maraton Gocki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Lokalna Grupa Działania Sandry Brdy
description: The 11th Gocki Marathon is a unique running event held in the picturesque village of Wojtal, in the heart of the Tuchola Forest, near the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry. The marathon, half-marathon, and 10 km race courses pass through unique areas associated with the ancient Gothic culture, offering participants a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and beautiful scenery. The event is a regular fixture on the region’s sporting calendar, attracting running and outdoor recreation enthusiasts. The organizers warmly invite everyone to take part in this event, which combines sport with local history and nature.
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of the Tuchola Forest
Close to the Stone Circles Nature Reserve in Odry
Picturesque landscapes and unique natural surroundings
additional: The event features three races: a marathon, a half-marathon, and a 10 km race. It is organized by the Sandry Brdy Local Action Group Association as part of the implementation of the Local Development Strategy (LDS) and is co-financed by the European Union. The Municipality of Czersk was a co-organizer of the event.

name: XVII Maraton Jastrowski
organizer: Gmina i Miasto Jastrowie; współorganizator: Dariusz Mańkowski
description: The 17th Jastrowie Marathon is an annual running event organized by the Municipality and Town of Jastrowie, held in late March. Competitors race over three distances: the marathon (42.195 km), the half marathon, and a 10.55 km Nordic walking event. The marathon course is cross-country in character and consists of four loops, taking runners along forest roads in the forest district and through a built-up area just after the start. Participants who finish receive a commemorative medal and a race pack. This is a small-scale event, limited to 50 starting places, giving it a distinctive character and local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A cross-country course along forest roads in the forest district
The marathon consists of four loops
The start and finish are near the Sports and Entertainment Hall and Jastrowie-Miasto railway stop
additional: The race office is located in the Sports and Entertainment Hall and will be open on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The limit is 50 starting places, allocated in order of registration. Once the limit is reached, registration will close and any overpayments will be refunded. Every participant who finishes receives a commemorative medal and a race pack.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E5. Bražuolė. Finalas
description: Trailo Kalvė S4E5 Bražuolė Finalas yra finalinis etapas tradicinio Lietuvos trail bėgimo taurės sezono renginys, vykstantis Bražuolės apylinkėse. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas, pritaikytas skirtingo amžiaus ir patirties dalyviams, nuo jaunimo iki suaugusiųjų. Trasos pasižymi miškinga aplinka, su įvairaus ilgio ir sudėtingumo maršrutais, leidžiančiais patirti gamtos grožį ir iššūkius. Dalyviai startuoja Bražuolės stovyklavietėje, o renginys yra draugiškas ir atviras visiems bėgimo entuziastams.
course_highlights: Miškingos trasos Bražuolės apylinkėse
Skirtingo ilgio distancijos nuo 4.8 km iki 24.8 km
Trasos su įvairiu aukščio sukilimu ir gamtos vaizdais
additional: Startas Bražuolės stovyklavietėje. Trasos apima įvairius aukščio sukilimus nuo iki 150 m iki virš 500 m, priklausomai nuo distancijos. Renginyje dalyvauja jaunimo ir suaugusiųjų kategorijos. Renginio atributika įkvėpta miško gyvūnų, o dalis pajamų skiriama paramai globos organizacijoms. Renginyje siūlomos skirtingos distancijos, registracija vyksta internetu, o vieta - Bražuolės stovyklavietė, Pugainiai.

name: 20 Półmaraton Warszawski LET’S RUN THIS PARTY!
description: The 21st Warsaw Half Marathon is a prestigious running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting both professionals and amateurs. The 21.0975 km course is fast and flat, certified by the PZLA and World Athletics, and passes some of the capital’s most beautiful landmarks, including views of the Vistula River, PGE Narodowy Stadium and the Presidential Palace. The event also includes a 5 km race and a rich programme of accompanying events, including the Running&Lifestyle Expo and live music. The organisers also promote the #BiegamDobrze charity initiative, combining sport with support for people in need.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km course certified by the PZLA and World Athletics
A very fast, flat course conducive to personal bests
Views of the Vistula River, PGE Narodowy Stadium and the Presidential Palace
additional: The start and finish are in central Warsaw, by the Palace of Culture and Science. Participants start in corrals marked on their race bibs. Bag drop facilities, changing rooms and toilets are available on race day. The event also includes the New Balance Bieg na Piątkę 5 km race and the Running&Lifestyle Expo. The organisers encourage spectators to cheer along the course, with activities for fans of all ages. The entry limit for the 2026 half marathon has been reached.

name: Biegi Powitanie Wiosny
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Sportowa 1, Mińsk Mazowiecki, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: The Welcome Spring Runs are an annual running event held at the Municipal Stadium in Mińsk Mazowiecki, combining sporting competition with a joyful spring atmosphere. It is a great opportunity to check your fitness after the winter break, get some fresh air and spend time actively with family or friends. The program includes races for children and young people in various age categories, as well as the Spring Flower Parade for the youngest participants. Participants can look forward to beautiful medals, prizes and a unique, family-friendly atmosphere on a sporty morning.
course_highlights: Cross-country races at the Municipal Stadium in Mińsk Mazowiecki
Age categories for children and young people
Spring Flower Parade for children born in 2021 or later
additional: The event is part of the Powiatowa Trzynastka series. Participants can look forward to medals, prizes and special awards. The races take place at the Municipal Stadium, ul. Sportowa 1, Mińsk Mazowiecki. In 2026, the event was held at the Municipal Stadium at ul. Sportowa 1.

name: Biegowa Niegowa
description: Biegowa Niegowa - ExtremeJura is a race held in the picturesque town of Niegowa, at the amphitheater on Sportowa Street. The event is part of the ExtremeJura series, offering participants professional timekeeping and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition. The race is scheduled to start at 10:30, and it is organized by Grupa ExtremeJura. The event attracts runners who appreciate well-organized races and the beautiful landscapes of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the amphitheater in Niegowa, on Sportowa Street
Picturesque landscapes of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Professional timekeeping using an RFID system
additional: In the 2025 edition, distances from 6.5 km to 30 km were available, with Nordic walking also offered on most routes. The start and event venue for the 2026 edition were listed as the amphitheater on Sportowa Street in Niegowa.

name: Duch Pogórza
description: Duch Pogórza is a series of ultra races held in the Przemyśl-Dynów Foothills, with its base near Dubiecko. The 2027 edition offers courses ranging from 13 to 350 km, so the event is open both to those looking for a shorter challenge and to ultra runners. The races include Diabelska Trzynastka, Duszek, Duch, Upiór, and Ultra Demon.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Przemyśl-Dynów Foothills.
The 2027 edition offers distances of 13, 34, 60, 115, and 350 km.
The races include both the shorter Diabelska Trzynastka and the 350-kilometre Ultra Demon.
additional: Registration is available for several distances: Diabelska Trzynastka 13 km, Duszek 34 km, Duch 60 km, Upiór 115 km, and Ultra Demon 350 km. The final registration deadline for most distances is 20.03.2027; for Ultra Demon 350 km, it is 17.03.2027. You can contact the organizer via the registration form on the website. The registration page lists the distances and provides participant lists. The 2027 edition dates listed there differ from the date 2027-03-28 in the metadata.

name: IX Cartusia Półmaraton
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. 3 Maja, Kartuzy, Poland
description: The IX Cartusia Half Marathon is a prestigious race in the heart of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the picturesque landscapes of Kashubian Switzerland and a rich historical heritage. Participants run a certified, fast course through the lakes, forests and post-glacial hills of the Kartuzy region. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy. This event is a true celebration of running for the whole family, with a rich program and regional Kashubian cuisine. The organizers provide attractive prizes, a prize draw and a unique medal for every participant.
course_highlights: A certified, fast course through the picturesque areas of the Kartuzy region
Route through lakes, forests and post-glacial hills
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy
additional: The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy at ul. 3 Maja. Full facilities are available at Primary School No. 1 (race office, bag drop, changing rooms, showers and changing areas). Safety and medical support is provided by firefighters, police, municipal police, medical staff and volunteers. Race packs include commemorative items, and participants can access a recovery area at the finish. Regional Kashubian cuisine will be available for participants to sample. Prizes will be drawn among all participants in the main race. Start and finish: Municipal Stadium in Kartuzy at ul. 3 Maja. Event facilities are to be located at Primary School No. 1; accompanying races have also been announced, including a race for preschoolers.

name: Kibolska Dycha
description: Kibolska Dycha is the fourth edition of the Kolejorz fans’ race, taking place on 28 March 2027 at the Malta Regatta Course in Poznań. Runners will cover a 10-kilometre route that includes almost two laps of Lake Malta. The event is open to everyone, with a maximum time of 120 minutes to complete the course, making it accessible to less experienced runners too. The event also includes children’s races, which start earlier. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: The route includes almost two laps of Lake Malta
10-kilometre distance
Start and finish at the Malta Regatta Course
additional: The maximum time to complete the course is 120 minutes. Children’s races start at 10:00. Before the main race, participants take a commemorative photo, after which runners head to their starting corrals. The time limit for the main race is 120 minutes. Children’s races are also included in the programme.

name: Niebieska Fala
location: ENEA Stadion, ul. Bułgarska 17, Poznań, Poland
description: Niebieska Fala is a charity run held in Poznań, combining a passion for running with support for people in need. It focuses particularly on raising autism awareness and purchasing therapeutic equipment. The main race route follows scenic paths through Marceliński Forest and Węgorka Street, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The youngest participants can take part in the Niebieska miniFala family run, covering 1 km around ENEA Stadium. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting a healthy lifestyle and working to prevent the social exclusion of people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The main course is a 5 km loop in Marceliński Forest, with 30% paved and 70% forest surface
New on the course: a section along Węgorka Street, adding variety and making the run more comfortable
The Niebieska miniFala family run covers 1 km around ENEA Stadium on a paved, child-safe route
additional: The time limit for completing the main race (5, 10 or 15 km) is 120 minutes. The course is marked with blue-and-white tape, and volunteers assist participants along the route. There is a refreshment station on the course. The MiniFala family run starts at 11:30, the main race at 13:00, and Nordic Walking at 12:30. The start and finish are by Stand 2 at ENEA Stadium. In the 2026 edition, the start and finish were by Stand 2 at ENEA Stadium, at 17 Bułgarska Street. The time limit for the race was 120 minutes. Information about fees and the course refers to the previous edition.

name: V Bieg W samo południe
location: Kompleks sportowy Zespołu Szkół im. Mikołaja Kopernika, Samborowo, Poland
description: The 5th “W samo Południe” Run is an annual running event held at the sports complex of the Mikołaj Kopernik School Complex in Samborowo. The race attracts both amateurs and more experienced runners, offering an opportunity to compete and spend time actively outdoors. The event is local in character and provides an opportunity to bring the community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: An approximately 10-kilometer loop around Samborowo
A cross-country route running mainly along rural tracks
Start and finish at the sports complex of the Mikołaj Kopernik School Complex
additional: Participant limit: 250 people. A prize drawing will take place after the race.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Annandag Påsk den 29:e mars 2027 är det dags för den 49:e upplagan av Enhörna IF:s Påsksmällen.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual race for all ages, from young children to older runners. There are several distances to choose from, ranging from a short 1.3 km children’s race to the 21 km main event, which takes place along the border between Skåne and Småland. The courses offer beautiful scenery, with gravel roads, winding stone walls, meadows and forests. The race starts and finishes at Hallaryd School and offers a well-organized race day with water stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge dating from 1870, with four arches
Much of the course follows gravel roads lined with stone walls, meadows and forests
The 21 km course has a challenging climb of approximately 25 metres over 500 metres
additional: Race bibs must be collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Late entries are accepted on race day until the start for an additional fee of 50 kr (not available for youth and walking classes). Timing is done using a barcode on the race bib. Water stations along the course provide sports drink and water. Changing facilities and showers are available in the school gym and HIF’s clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. The start and finish are at Hallaryd School, Häradsvägen 3. Water stations offer water and sports drink. Register in advance by email no later than 23 March 2027; late entries are accepted on race day for an additional fee of 50 kr, except for the youth and walking classes.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.hallarydsloppet.se/): 2027-03-29 — "Hallarydsloppet 29 mars 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-05)

name: Cytadela by Night # 113
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Poznań. The event takes place in the Citadel, offering participants a unique opportunity to run at night. The run is open to everyone who wants to spend time actively and take on the course in the scenic surroundings of the park.
course_highlights: 5 km course
The run takes place in the Citadel in Poznań
Night-time atmosphere
additional: The run is free and timed.

name: Halowe Mistrzostwa Europy Masters - 5 km
description: The European Masters Athletics Indoor Championships are an international athletics competition for masters athletes, held in Toruń. The event is a championship competition and brings together experienced athletes from across Europe. It is organized by the Polish Masters Athletics Association and takes place at the indoor athletics arena on Bema Street. It is an excellent opportunity for high-level competition and for bringing the masters community together.
course_highlights: 5 km race inside the indoor athletics arena
International championship-level competition
Organized by the Polish Masters Athletics Association in Toruń
additional: Masters competitions are intended for athletes born on March 27, 1991, or earlier.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lietuva
description: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“ yra Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapo dalis, vykstanti Panevėžyje, Senvagės ir Kultūros ir poilsio parke. Šis renginys suburia bėgimo entuziastus iš įvairių miestų, siekiant skatinti sportinį judėjimą, sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir Lietuvos regionų gamtos bei kultūros grožio pažinimą. Varžybos yra dalis ilgametės Lietuvos bėgimo taurės tradicijos, kuri nuo 2009 metų vienija bėgimo profesionalus ir mėgėjus visoje šalyje. Renginys vyksta pavasarį, suteikdamas galimybę dalyviams mėgautis gamta ir aktyvia veikla.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Senvagės ir Kultūros ir poilsio parke Panevėžyje
Tradicinis Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapas su įvairių miestų bėgikais
Skatina pažinti Lietuvos regionų gamtą ir architektūrą
additional: Registraciją prižiūri VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. Sumokėtas starto mokestis negrąžinamas, nebent renginys atšaukiamas. Dalyviai gali keisti distanciją ar perleisti registraciją kitiems ne vėliau nei uždaroma išankstinė registracija, keičiant distanciją iš brangesnės į pigesnę kainų skirtumas negrąžinamas. Dalyvio keitimo mokestis - 10 eurų. Renginys vyks Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, su galimybe registruotis internetu.

name: Apkārt Māras dīķim 12 h un stafete 6h
organizer: Šri Činmoja Maratona komanda; biedrība “Rīgas Šri Činmoja centrs”
description: The “Pārspēj sevi” (Surpass Yourself) run is a 12-hour individual race and a 6-hour relay held on a loop around Māras Pond in Riga. The event is intended for both amateur and professional runners. Its main goal is to help participants discover and push beyond their abilities with a positive attitude and determination. The loop is 1.355 km long, and the spirit of the race is based on perseverance and enjoyment rather than winning. Participants are encouraged to take part with a smile and keep going as they overcome both internal and external challenges during prolonged exertion.
course_highlights: Certified 1.355 km loop around Māras Pond
Choose between the 12-hour individual race and the 6-hour relay
Relay team members may change an unlimited number of times, but only after a full lap in the start/finish area
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race morning from 6:00 to 6:45 for the 12-hour race and from 12:00 to 12:45 for the 6-hour relay. Pacing is prohibited, and any assistance is allowed only in the start/finish area and in the approximately 100-metre section beyond it. The number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended. In the relay, team members may change after a full lap in the start/finish area.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarmilen/): 2027-04-03 — "ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027" (was estimated 2027-03-27)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: ANMÄLAN ÄR ÖPPEN – VI SES DEN 3 APRIL 2027

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Zajazd Szmaragd, ul. Kopalniana, Szczecin, Poland
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in 7 locations, including Szczecin. The course runs through beautiful woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe, with varied uphill and downhill sections, making the event appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The races aim to promote running and outdoor physical activity, while providing an opportunity for friendly sporting competition. The start and finish are located at Zajazd Szmaragd, and races take place regularly during the season from October to April.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Szmaragdowe
Varied uphill and downhill sections, including the most challenging section about 1.7 km from the start
Start and finish behind Zajazd Szmaragd on Kopalniana Street
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start, at 10:45. The event also includes races for children in various age categories. The course is permanent, making it possible to compare results over the months and years. The race is scheduled for 4 April 2027, with the start at 11:00. CITY TRAIL Junior races are also held as part of the series.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen, offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km. The races are open to all runners, from elite athletes to recreational runners, and participants in the 25 km race must be at least 17 years old. The courses include both classic routes and new trails, with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful views of nature. After the race, a classic Giffa burger is included for the 10 km and 25 km races, or a hot dog in a bun for the 5 km race, along with a drink. There is no time limit, and the 25 km race is part of the Skåne Trailcup.
course_highlights: A technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen
Courses with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful natural views
Three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km, featuring both classic routes and new trails
additional: Showers and changing rooms are available after the race. Water and energy stations are located along the course and at the finish. The 25 km race is the first event in the Skåne Trailcup. There is no time limit; the race ends when all participants have reached the finish. Previous editions have had water and energy stations along the course and at the finish, as well as showers and changing rooms. Food and drink after the finish have been included in the entry fee.

name: GIFT 2027 - SM/VSM/JSM i trail
location: Ekevallen, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
organizer: Genarps IF i samarbete med Björnstorps IF
description: Welcome to GIFT 2027, a technical and challenging trail race in the hills of Romeleåsen, starting and finishing at Ekevallen, Genarp’s sports ground. The race offers three distances—5 km, 10 km and 27 km—for children, young people, recreational runners and elite athletes. This year’s edition is also the Swedish Championships, Veterans Swedish Championships and Junior Swedish Championships in short trail, making the competition especially prestigious. Food and drink are served after the finish instead of a medal, and participants can pre-order an exclusive finisher shirt in a Swedish Championships edition. All runners compete for overall placings, regardless of club affiliation or whether they are unaffiliated.
course_highlights: A technical and challenging trail race in the hills of Romeleåsen
Start and finish at Ekevallen, with changing rooms and showers
Aid stations along the course serving water, Coca-Cola, sports drink and snacks
additional: All distances start in the same race and compete for overall placings. Water, Coca-Cola and food are available at the finish. A finisher shirt can be pre-ordered for 200 kr; the order deadline is 7 March. The race centre has drinks, energy products, changing rooms and showers. Food and drink are included after the finish.

name: Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 82
location: Wieluń-Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: SpriT Frontyard - Genarp
description: SpriT Frontyard Genarp is a fast and fun trail-running race at Genarpsbadet, suitable for all levels and ambitions. The course is approximately 1 km long and consists of gravel road, forest trail and sand, with no asphalt, and two small hills at the beginning. The race is about running as many laps as you can within time limits that gradually decrease. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish, and great prizes are awarded to many participants.
course_highlights: A mix of gravel road, forest trail and sand
Two small hills at the beginning of the course
A fast course with an exciting finish on the final straight
additional: You have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Great prizes are awarded to many participants. Registration is binding once payment has been made. The organiser recommends insurance in case of injury or illness. The race details found apply to previous editions.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course consists of two clockwise laps around scenic Lake Rocksjon and offers a wonderful running experience. Your Varvetmilen result can be used for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organised by Göteborgsvarvet in cooperation with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour of Sweden.
course_highlights: Two clockwise laps around Lake Rocksjön
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Qualifies for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Race bib collection and bag drop take place at Knektaparken on race day. Minivarvet also takes place alongside Varvetmilen: a 210-metre race for children aged 0–6, with a medal for every participant. Registration for Minivarvet is available on site via Swish (80 kr). The race starts in Knektaparken and covers two laps around Lake Rocksjön. Race bibs can be collected the day before and on race day. Showers, changing facilities, bag storage and a small café are available on site.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a recreational race for women, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the start and finish at Studenternas IP. The event is all about the joy of movement and camaraderie, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and offers an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to take part.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnics can be collected using the team captain’s race bib. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. There is a place to leave warm-up clothes and showers are available at the arena. Water stations and toilets are located at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 for the 2.5 km distance (from age 7 when accompanied by an adult) and 13 for the 5 km distance (from age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the start. Optional timing is available, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. The event is suitable for recreational runners and teams and is held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a six-leg relay race that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied gravel and asphalt surface, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, and all teams start at the same time. In the anniversary year, a Mini Race for children is also held, with a medal and certificate for every participant.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Start and finish in the heart of Bruksparken, Bromölla
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is provided by data chip, and both the total finish time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and prizes are also drawn for all participants. The Mini Race for children starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing, all children receive a medal, certificate, drink and fruit. The event includes a mini category for children and is open to both recreational and elite runners. Participants can expect chip timing to record total and individual times.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Östhammar City Race is a local city race in Östhammar, organised by Östhammars Friidrott. For 2026, Frösåkersvallen is listed as the start location. Welcome to take part in a race with strong local roots in Östhammar.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging uphill sections and enjoyable downhills, with an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal as proof of their effort. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in cooperation with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging uphill sections and enjoyable downhills
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May, 12:00–18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. Fitness4You will lead the warm-up before the start. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is possible until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with the option of a company tent; registration is via the website, race bibs are collected at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship is possible.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm, offering both half-marathon and 10 km distances. The race follows flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to set a personal best. The event is a celebration for all, with the start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half-marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a celebration for all, with flat courses suited to setting a personal best. There is also a children’s race. The start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus services and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, children’s race for up to age 13

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a trail race that welcomes everyone, from children and recreational participants to experienced runners and mountain bikers. The race follows a scenic route through the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör, along trails and gravel roads with moderate hills and technical sections. The event has an open, welcoming atmosphere created together by volunteers, spectators and participants, and is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis. Many return year after year, while new participants take part for the first time.
course_highlights: Trail running and cycling along a pine-covered esker
Trails and gravel roads with moderate hills
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday before race week. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis, with a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: Petzl Helsinki Night Trail
description: Petzl Helsinki Night Trail is a springtime night trail running event held on the trails of Helsinki Central Park. The route is approximately 13 kilometres long, and the event starts beneath the canopy of Helsinki Olympic Stadium. Runners are timed electronically, and the maximum time allowed is 2.5 hours. The event also has a category for non-binary runners. A headlamp is mandatory for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 13 km route on the trails of Helsinki Central Park
Night trail running on a spring evening
Start and finish area beneath the canopy of Helsinki Olympic Stadium
additional: The race office and bib collection are open on event day from 18:00 to 20:00 at Olympic Stadium. The maximum time allowed is 2.5 hours. There are two cut-off points on the route, which runners must reach by the specified times. A headlamp is mandatory; lamps are not available for rent. The race office does not accept cash, including for on-site registrations. Free gear storage is available next to the race office. The maximum time allowed is 2.5 hours.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti
organizer: Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras
description: Kėdainių sporto centras kviečia visus dalyvauti bėgime, skirtame Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti. Renginys yra bendruomeniškas ir aktyvus, skirtas skatinti sveiką gyvenseną, fizinį aktyvumą bei stiprinti bendruomenės fizinę ir protinę sveikatą. Tai puiki proga šeimoms, vaikams, jaunimui ir vyresnio amžiaus žmonėms susiburti ir aktyviai praleisti laiką Kėdainiuose. Renginys yra Nacionalinės fizinio aktyvumo programos dalis, skirta masiniams fizinio aktyvumo renginiams organizuoti.
course_highlights: Fizinio aktyvumo veiklos
Sveikatos testavimai
Bendruomenės įtraukimas
additional: Renginys skirtas visoms amžiaus grupėms - šeimoms, vaikams, jaunimui ir vyresnio amžiaus gyventojams. Organizuoja Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras. Renginys yra dalis Nacionalinės fizinio aktyvumo programos, skatinančios masinį fizinį aktyvumą. Renginys apima įvairias fizinio aktyvumo veiklas, testavimus, sporto varžybas ir paskaitas, vyks Kėdainių mieste, pagrindinė vieta - centrinis miesto stadionas.

name: 6/12 stundu skrējiens “Pārspēj sevi”
organizer: Šrī Činmoja Maratona komanda; Biedrība “Rīgas Šrī Činmoja centrs”
description: The 6- and 12-hour “Beat Your Own Best” run takes place around Māras Pond in Riga, giving participants the opportunity to push their limits and experience personal growth. The certified course is 1,355 km long, allowing runners to focus on sustained endurance and pace. The event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has served the running community for almost 50 years, inspiring athletes to develop physically and spiritually. Registration is by email, and the entry fee depends on the payment date. Race numbers are provided to participants on race day.
course_highlights: A certified 1,355 km course around Māras Pond
An endurance run with 6- and 12-hour events
An event with almost 50 years of tradition and spiritual inspiration
additional: The number of participants is limited, so early registration is recommended. The entry fee depends on the payment date, not the registration date. Race numbers are issued on race day. To register, email the required information. No refunds are given if a participant does not take part.

name: Skrējiens un soļošana pa Preiļu ielām “Cīruļputenis”
organizer: Preiļu novada Bērnu un jauniešu sporta skola
description: The “Cīruļputenis” run and walk through the streets of Preiļi is a traditional spring running and walking event in the city, bringing together athletes and active residents of all ages. Held on the city streets, the event offers a chance to enjoy running and walking in a friendly, sporting atmosphere. The competition is organized by the Preiļi Municipality Children and Youth Sports School, which provides professional support and a safe environment for participants. It is a great opportunity for both beginners and experienced athletes to test their abilities and enjoy an active day with fellow sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Running and walking through the streets of Preiļi
A friendly, sporting atmosphere for all age groups
Organized by the Preiļi Municipality Children and Youth Sports School
additional: In previous years, the competition has started outside Preiļi Municipality Council or on Raiņa Boulevard.

name: 23 Bieg Europejski Mistrzostwa Polski Ciepłowników
organizer: Klub Sportowy Altom Gniezno oraz Przedsiębiorstwo Energetyki Cieplnej w Gnieźnie Sp. z o.o.
description: The 23rd European Run is an annual running event held in Gniezno, commemorating Poland’s accession to the European Union. The 10 km main race runs through the city streets, with the start and finish on Gniezno’s Market Square. The course is certified by the PZLA and consists of one loop with asphalt and cobblestone surfaces. The event attracts runners from many countries, creating an international atmosphere for this sporting celebration. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal on the Market Square and attend the winners’ awards ceremony.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the streets of Gniezno, asphalt and cobblestones (5%)
Start and finish on Gniezno’s Market Square
PZLA-certified, single-loop course
additional: The race office is open on Friday, 10.04.2027, from 17:00 to 20:30, and on race day, 11.04.2027, from 11:00 to 15:00 (the location has changed to the sports hall at Primary School No. 2 in Gniezno). The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour 30 minutes. Timing is by chips in the race bibs. A recovery meal will be served after the race on the Market Square (available to runners only). The winners’ awards ceremony takes place at 18:00 on the stage on the Market Square. The event also includes a Preschoolers’ Run, divided into age groups, with wristbands and T-shirts required. The Polish Heating Professionals Championships are intended for employees of the district heating industry.

name: 9 Półaraton Leśny Na Żarcie
location: Leśna polana przy ul. Zakopiańskiej, Legionowo, Poland
price_range: 50 zł; biegi dzieci i młodzieży bez opłat
description: The 9th Półmaraton Leśny "Na Żarcie" is a cross-country race of approximately 21 km, held in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street in Legionowo. The course consists of two loops and runs exclusively along forest roads, giving the event the character of a trail race. The event is open to adults and also features cross-country races for children and young people with no entry fee. Participants receive a race pack with a bib, a sports gadget, a meal, and a commemorative medal. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions in April, with a 12:00 start.
course_highlights: A cross-country course of approximately 21.1 km over two loops
Runs exclusively along forest roads
Start and finish in a forest clearing on Zakopiańska Street
additional: A baggage deposit is available to participants in the main race. The race pack includes a returnable race bib, a baggage-deposit bag, a sports gadget, a "Na Żarcie" meal, and a commemorative medal. Prizes and trophies are awarded to the top finishers in the overall and age categories, as well as to the top participants from Legionowo. The event takes place regardless of weather conditions. The main race course is not officially certified.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu im. Adama Mickiewicza, Poznań, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań is a spring edition of a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Poznań, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. Since 2014, the organizers have emphasized the aesthetics of the courses and the promotion of running among different age groups. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and discover Poznań’s charming surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque, aesthetically pleasing natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska
additional: The organizer is Stowarzyszenie Biegiem w Las, based in Poznań. The event is a cross-country race and emphasizes the aesthetic qualities of its proposed locations. In summer 2026, the organizers are celebrating the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. The organizer provides a participant guide and separate information about children’s and youth races. Registration for the main distance and children’s races has closed.

name: Leśny Zryw w Starych Jabłonkach
location: Hotel Anders Beach, ul. Spacerowa 2, Stare Jabłonki, Poland
description: Leśny Zryw in Stare Jabłonki is a race held on the beach at Hotel Anders and in the forest managed by the Stare Jabłonki Forest District. The event combines sport with an environmental initiative to plant a forest, offering two distances: a 10 km individual run and a 5 km family run or walk with tree planting. The event is family-oriented and inclusive, with additional culinary and educational activities for participants and their families. The start and finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders, and the 5 km route is on gravel and asphalt surfaces. Online registration has closed, but registration and payment are available at the Race Office.
course_highlights: 5 km route: 4 km on gravel, 1 km on asphalt
Pine saplings are planted along the 5 km route (1 tree per person)
Start and finish on the beach at Hotel Anders; the route runs through the forest managed by the Stare Jabłonki Forest District
additional: The Race Office and the start/finish are on the beach at Hotel Anders. Parking is available on the municipal sports field opposite the hotel. The time limit for the 5 km route is 2 hours. Participants receive a timing chip, which must be returned after the race. After the race, there are culinary and educational activities, as well as attractions for children. In the 2025 and 2026 editions, the start, finish, and Race Office were on the beach at Hotel Anders at ul. Spacerowa 2. Entry fees from those editions were allocated to charitable causes.

name: Niebieska 5-ka
description: The Blue 5K is a race organized in Słupsk by the “Sub ventum” Foundation for Supporting Unconventional Initiatives. The event invites everyone to run together and spend time actively.

name: Towarzyskie Mistrzostwa Polski w 12-godz...
location: Stadion Miejski w Morągu, Morąg, Poland
description: The Polish Social Championships in the 12-hour cross-country race “Parkowy Ultra Kros #STOPdepresji” is a unique running event held at the Municipal Stadium in Morąg. Competitors race on an approximately 1.46 km loop for 12 hours. To be classified, participants must spend at least 3 hours on the course. The event offers electronic timing, a marked course and a generous race pack, including a commemorative medal and refreshments. The race is recreational in character and promotes physical activity and support for mental health.
course_highlights: The course follows an approximately 1.46 km loop
Electronic timing using returnable chips
Medical support on the course and at the Race Base
additional: The race pack includes an original race bib, a marked course, electronic timing, hot and cold drinks, and a cold refreshment station available throughout the event. Participants receive a commemorative medal. Medical support is provided on the course and at the Race Base. The participant limit is 150. Runners must spend at least 3 hours on the course to be classified. Classification requires at least 3 hours of activity on the course.

name: VIII Festiwal Pieszo-Biegowy Przedwiośni...
description: The 8th Przedwiośnie Hiking and Running Festival is a unique event bringing together fans of long-distance challenges and mountain scenery in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Participants can choose from a range of distances: the family-friendly 7 km Przedwiośniaczek, Mini (25 km), Marathon (44 km), Ultra (76 km), and the demanding Giga (101 km). The routes pass through scenic areas, including the vicinity of Łysica, with the start and finish at the symbolic Stefan Żeromski Manor in Ciekoty. The festival welcomes both beginners and experienced hikers and runners, offering an unforgettable spring experience on the trails.
course_highlights: Routes pass through scenic areas of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, including the vicinity of Łysica
A range of distances from 7 km to 101 km, suited to different experience levels
Start and finish at the symbolic Stefan Żeromski Manor in Ciekoty
additional: The festival offers five distances: Przedwiośniaczek (7 km), Mini Przedwiośnie (25 km), Marathon Przedwiośnie (44 km), Ultra Przedwiośnie (76 km), and Giga Przedwiośnie (101 km). The routes are planned anew each year to visit the most interesting and scenic parts of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. The event brings hikers and runners together and welcomes both beginners and experienced participants. It combines running and hiking; the shortest, 7-kilometre route is for hikers. The date, 10 April 2027, comes from the event data.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women featuring 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö. The event is all about the joy of running and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ability levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and focuses on promoting women’s health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course around Lake Växjö
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. Bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. You can opt out of timing. The event area has a water station, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after the finish. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. Women born in 1994–1999 can also receive free HPV vaccinations on site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Tjust Trail Run
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic nature of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running across varied terrain. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Sections over beautiful rocky outcrops
Beautiful and varied terrain
additional: Changes to the race distance are possible by email until 31 March. On the longest distance (The Long Run), runners must complete a lap by 11:45 to be allowed to continue for the second lap. Race bibs must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If withdrawing, participants must notify a race official or call the number provided. Transport can be arranged from aid stations if needed. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. Distance changes can be made until 31 March.
