name: Kurts 300:e maraton - halvmaran
description: Kurt’s 300th Marathon is a special race organized by Hultsfreds Löparklubb to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race follows a 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred, combining park paths and asphalt. The half marathon consists of two long laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, where changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen
20% asphalt, the rest park paths
Two water stations offering water, sports drink, cola, and fruit
additional: The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen at the restaurant. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned. The start and finish are at Knektavallen; changing rooms, showers, toilets, and water stations are available according to the organizer’s information.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Stadion Miejski im. Kazimierza Deyny, Starogard Gdański, Poland
organizer: Miasto Starogard oraz Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Starogardzie Gdańskim
description: The 42nd Bieg Szpęgawski with AQ is one of the oldest road races in Pomerania, held since 1983. The race is intended for amateurs, professionals, and young runners alike. The certified 5 km course is historic and symbolic, running from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański. The organizers provide bus transport to the start and a bag drop for runners. This event has a rich tradition and attracts runners hungry for records and personal bests.
course_highlights: Certified, fast 5 km course
Historic and symbolic route from Szpęgawsk to Starogard Gdański
Organizer-provided bus transport to the start
additional: The organizer provides bus transport to the start from 10:40 to 11:20. Transport is not guaranteed after 11:20. Road traffic is completely stopped at 11:45. A mobile bag drop and a bag drop under a tent at the start are available. Bags can be collected after the race, at approximately 13:15, at the Deyna Center. The organizer provides free bus transport to the start. A mile race is also available.

name: Bieg Mestwina
description: Bieg Mestwina is a running event held in Przywidz and part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The race offers two main routes, 5 km and 10 km, through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia. It attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting an active lifestyle and local running culture. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization, continuing the tradition of the largest running event in northern Poland.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in Przywidz, surrounded by Kashubian nature
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: Bieg Mestwina is one of many events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, which includes various distances and locations across Kashubia. The event promotes physical activity and brings the local community together. The series also features children’s and youth races, as well as other accompanying events. In the edition described in the sources, the children’s races are free and require no registration. Open, age-group, and Przywidz municipality resident classifications are listed.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa
location: Ogród Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego, Warszawa, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Warsaw. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has promoted running and the beauty of natural routes since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate beautiful surroundings and being close to nature. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the unique setting of a botanical garden.
course_highlights: A cross-country route through the Botanical Garden in Warsaw
Picturesque natural surroundings
Part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, which promotes trail running
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014, with an emphasis on cross-country running and the aesthetic appeal of the routes. In summer 2026, they are celebrating the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. No details are available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: Cross Śrem Grand Prix
location: Orlik w Psarskiem, Psarskie, Śrem County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Śremski Sport, Gmina Śrem i Nadleśnictwo Konstantynowo
price_range: 40 zł za jeden bieg online; 120 zł za pakiet czterech biegów; 50 zł w dniu startu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – przy zapisie online na jeden bieg

description: Cross Śrem Grand Prix is a series of trail races held in the scenic forests around Psarskie, near Śrem. The approximately 5.4 km course follows forest paths and paved cobblestones, giving runners a chance to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, which also houses the race office and is the venue for the warm-up and official opening. Participants can expect a medal, a recovery meal, and prizes in the age-group classifications. The event is organized by Śremski Sport together with the Śrem Municipality and Konstantynowo Forest District.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.4 km over forest paths and paved cobblestones
Start and finish at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie, with a modern building and changing rooms
A run through scenic woodland close to the centre of Śrem
additional: The race office, warm-up, and official opening take place at the Orlik sports complex in Psarskie at around 11:45. Participants have access to water, hot tea, and coffee in the new building with changing rooms. The event is funded from the Śrem Municipality budget as part of its programme for preventing and addressing alcohol-related problems and drug addiction. Information about fees and the series is from the 2025–2026 edition. In this edition, the start was scheduled for 12:00; participation in at least three of the four races was required for the final classification.

name: DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run
description: DOZ Maraton Łódź 10K Run is a 10 km race held as part of DOZ Maraton Łódź. In the previous edition, runners set off from the area around Atlas Arena and ran through the streets of Łódź, finishing inside Atlas Arena. It is suitable both for people making their 10K debut and for runners looking to test their fitness at a major running event.
course_highlights: Urban route through the streets of Łódź
Start near Atlas Arena
Finish inside Atlas Arena
additional: Route and schedule information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Ekonomiczna Piątka
description: Ekonomiczna Piątka is an annual race organized by the Poznań University of Economics and Business, held in the area around Lake Malta. The 5 km course runs on asphalt, making it appealing to both beginner and experienced runners. The event combines sport and socializing, offering a chance to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course around Lake Malta
Asphalt surface
Scenic recreational areas of Poznań

name: IX Bieg Wiosny
description: The 9th Spring Run is an annual running event held at the Tustań Forest Lodge in the Naruszewo municipality. Participants can choose 2.5 km and 10 km running routes along forest roads, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The event combines sport and recreation, attracting runners from across Poland. At the finish, commemorative medals, trophies, and gifts await the top finishers. The organizers also provide post-race refreshments and music, creating a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: The running routes follow forest roads in the Tustań Forest District
Available distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and a 5 km Nordic walking event
The scenic areas of the Naruszewo municipality provide an appealing setting for sporting competition
additional: The main race starts at 11:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal at the finish, while the top finishers receive trophies and gifts. Post-race refreshments and music are provided. Around 157 runners from across Poland took part in the event. In the 2026 edition, the 10 km race followed two 5 km loops.

name: IX Mazurski Bieg na Kulke
description: The 9th Mazurian Kulka Run is an annual running event held at the picturesque Kulka Holiday Resort near Szczytno. The course has been slightly modified and runs through the beautiful Masurian countryside, with the start and finish on the resort grounds. The event is open to runners of varying abilities, and participants can look forward to a positive atmosphere, a medal, and a post-race recovery meal. The event also has a charitable purpose, supporting Kornelia through fairs and auctions. Organizers provide activities for children and young people, as well as the option to stay overnight at the resort.
course_highlights: A picturesque course starting and finishing on the grounds of Kulka Holiday Resort
A slightly modified route through the heart of Masuria
An atmosphere full of positive energy and sporting adventure
additional: Race packet pickup is on race day from 08:30 to 10:30 at the Race Office. Registration on race day is available until the limit of 250 participants is reached (16 places currently available). After the race, a recovery meal prepared by the resort’s cooks is served. Children and young people can take part in activities at the resort under instructors’ supervision, depending on weather conditions. The event is charitable, with fairs and auctions in aid of Kornelia. For the 2026 edition, the time limit is 105 minutes and the participant limit is 250. The event also features activities for children and a recovery meal.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, friendly and family-oriented sporting competition held in Międzyzdroje. In the 2026/2027 season, participants can compete in runs of approximately 5 and 10 km and in nordic walking events of approximately 5 and 7 km. The league is known for its healthy competition and welcoming atmosphere, inviting both regular participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete the required distances in at least four events. Participation is free, and people aged 14 and over may take part.
course_highlights: Running routes of approximately 5 and 10 km
Nordic walking routes of approximately 5 and 7 km
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: To qualify for the league’s overall standings, participants must enter at least four events and complete the required distances: two 5 km and two 10 km runs, or two 5 km and two 7 km nordic walking events. Participants must be at least 14 years old. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian and must be accompanied by them. The league final is scheduled for 11 April 2027. Registration is available at protiming24.pl.

name: Podkowa Biega
location: Centrum Podkowy Leśnej, Podkowa Leśna, Poland
description: Podkowa Biega is an annual race held in Podkowa Leśna, promoting sport and physical activity among residents and bringing the local community together. The main 10 km race runs through the town centre and along the picturesque paths of Młochowski Forest, showcasing the varied character of this garden city and its historic landmarks. The event also includes children’s and youth races over shorter distances suited to participants’ ages. After the race, participants can enjoy a finisher’s area with a recovery meal, massage and group stretching. The event is family-oriented and co-funded by the Podkowa Leśna Municipal Office.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the centre of Podkowa Leśna and Młochowski Forest
Picturesque paths and historic landmarks of the garden city
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 1 km
additional: Children’s races start from 9:30 a.m., grouped by year of birth. Race packs can be collected at the Bohaterów Warszawy Primary School on Saturday from 11:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. and on Sunday from 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.; children’s race packs are handed out at the start on Aleja Lipowa. After the race, a finisher’s area is available with a recovery meal, massage, cakes and group stretching. In the previous edition, the children’s and youth races were free, and the time limit for the main race was 2 hours.

name: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem is a colorful and joyful sporting event held in Suwałki, combining sport, fun and a unique atmosphere. The event is aimed at runners of different ability levels, as well as families and groups of friends who want to spend time actively. The program features a variety of events, including the High-Heel Run, the Egg Run and the main races over 3.5 km for women and 5 km for men. It is also an opportunity for creative fun and shared excitement, with numerous contests for the most interesting outfits and Miss titles.
course_highlights: The High-Heel Run combines a sporting challenge with elegance
The Egg Run calls for concentration and precision
Main races over 3.5 km (women) and 5 km (men)
additional: The event also includes the Little Lady and Little Gentleman Run for children. Participants receive commemorative medals. Men are required to have a moustache, natural or artificial. The event promotes creativity and fun, and also features the Suwałki Miss Fashion, Miss Photo and Miss Audience Choice contests. The program also includes children’s races and contests and pageants. Moustaches, including artificial ones, are required for the Bieg z Wąsem.

name: Wiosenna Dycha
description: Wiosenna Dycha is an annual road race held in Lublin, attracting both amateur and experienced runners. The event takes place in spring and is a great opportunity to spend time actively and test your fitness over the 10 km distance. Lublin, one of Poland’s most running-friendly cities, offers participants an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. The event’s organizer, the Lublin Sports Development Foundation, promotes a healthy lifestyle and brings the running community together.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
The race takes place in central Lublin
An atmosphere that encourages amateur and professional runners to connect
additional: The race is organized by the Lublin Sports Development Foundation, which works to promote physical culture and develop sport in the region. Wiosenna Dycha is one of many running events held in Lublin, with different distances and categories for various age groups. In 2026, the race was scheduled for 09:00.

name: XIV Bieg Wojciechowy
description: The 14th Wojciech Run is an annual running event held in Serock that attracts runners of all ages. The races take place on scenic urban routes, and the organizers provide timing by Time-Sport. The event also includes races for children, making it appealing to families and the local community. Serock, as the host town, offers a wide range of recreational and sporting activities, further highlighting the event’s character.
course_highlights: The running routes pass through the center of Serock
Scenic views of the lake and green areas
Professional timing provided by Time-Sport
additional: Timing is provided by Time-Sport. The event takes place at the Market Square in Serock. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: XVI Bieg Raszyński
description: The 16th Raszyn National Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Raszyn. The course consists of three laps of approximately 3.33 km, along Raszyn’s streets through residential areas. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and runs over flat asphalt, which is conducive to fast times. The participant limit is 600, and the event attracts runners from across Poland.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Three laps of approximately 3.33 km along Raszyn’s streets
Flat asphalt surface
additional: The start and finish are in Raszyn: the start is on Szkolna Street and the finish is at 1 Unii Europejskiej Street. The race office is open from April 7 to 9, from 17:00 to 20:00, and on race day from 8:00 to 10:30. The time limit for completing the race is 2 hours. A 5 km Nordic Walking event with a separate classification and a 10:45 start is also held for residents of Raszyn Municipality. Children can take part in the accompanying races free of charge. For the 2026 edition, the participant limit is 600 and the time limit is 2 hours. The program also includes children’s races and Nordic Walking.

name: Leśne Poruszenie
location: Skwer, ul. Pomorska 71, Dębogórze, gmina Kosakowo, Poland
description: Leśne Poruszenie - Dębogórze is a unique sporting event held on the forest trails of the Kosakowo municipality. The event is for everyone who enjoys an active lifestyle, offering cross-country races for children and adults, a Nordic Walking race, and a cycling ride. Its aim is to bring residents together, promote a healthy lifestyle, and spend time together in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and race office are located at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. Participants will receive race packs, commemorative medals, and prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Kosakowo municipality
Cross-country races for children and adults (1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Nordic Walking race and cycling ride
additional: The start and race office are at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. In the 2026 edition, the start and race office were at the square in Dębogórze, at 71 Pomorska Street. The previous edition’s program included children’s races of approximately 1 and 2 km, adult races of approximately 5 and 10 km, Nordic Walking over approximately 5 km, and a cycling ride of approximately 10 km.

name: Hässleholmsloppet
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at the beautiful Hovdala Castle in Hässleholm. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5.4 km. All courses feature gentle, winding trails through varied woodland, with stretches alongside water. The longest course, 21 km, is part of Spring i Skåne’s Trail Cup and offers extra elevation and a scenic route. The race is open to both recreational runners and young people; the recommended minimum age for the longest distance is 17.
course_highlights: Gentle, winding trails through varied woodland
Sections alongside water along the courses
The 21 km course is a scenic route at Hovdala with extra elevation
additional: Start and finish at Hovdala Castle. Runners should arrive 10 minutes before the start. Bibs must be collected at the venue at least 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly at the front. Electronic timing is used. There are no shower or changing facilities, but toilets are available. Water and sports drink stations are available on all courses. The maximum number of participants is 400. Name changes are possible for a fee of 100 kr via the registration page. The race information specifies electronic timing, aid stations on all courses and a participant limit of 400. The prices and practical details apply to the published information for 2026.

name: Top Cross Torunia
description: Top Cross is a series of 12 cross-country races held in Rudelka Forest Park in Toruń. Each race consists of 5 laps plus a short run-in, for a total distance of approximately 6,666 metres. Participants earn points for taking part, and their 8 best results count towards the overall standings. Runners who take part in at least 8 editions receive a commemorative medal. It is also possible to complete a race individually without earning points.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Rudelka Forest Park
The course consists of 5 laps plus an approximately 200 m run-in
Course distance: approximately 6,666 metres
additional: Registration takes place at V LO Toruń, at ul. Sienkiewicza / Fałata. The race office opens one hour before the race. A runner can complete a race individually without earning points. The series consists of 12 races. The eight best results count towards the overall standings; a commemorative medal is awarded for taking part in at least eight editions.

name: Siguldas apļi
organizer: Biedrība “Siguldas Maratona klubs & Siguldas Takas” sadarbībā ar Siguldas novada pašvaldību

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: OPEN, SV30 – SV50+ dalības maksa 5.00 eur

description: Sigulda Circuits is a series of running and Nordic walking training races in Sigulda, held in several stages at different locations around the city. The aim of the races is to promote an active lifestyle, encourage meaningful ways to spend free time, and bring together friends and like-minded people. The series offers opportunities for schoolchildren, families, and individual runners, with a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere. The races are organized by the association “Siguldas Maratona klubs & Siguldas Takas” in cooperation with Sigulda Municipality.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes at various locations around Sigulda
Stages take place at Festivity Square, near the Sigulda bobsleigh track, and in Gutman’s Cave
Nature trails and urban scenery in Sigulda Municipality
additional: Participant timing chips are issued from 17:30. Participants with an S! Card receive a 20% discount on the entry fee. Use of the electronic timing system equipment is free of charge. Participants can look forward to pleasant surprises and prizes at the end of the series.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fun run in Stockholm, with races for all ages, including a Mini Race for the youngest participants, the Little Skärholms Race for children from preschool class through Year 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in million-programme suburbs in their personal development through running. There will be music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Little Skärholms Race, approximately 1.6 km, for children from preschool class through Year 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race 10:30; Little Skärholms Race from 11:30, with different start groups by age; 1.6 km Fun Run 12:25; 5 km race 13:00. Registration is free and available until 17:00 on 14 May. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The race takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC (Tyresö Extreme Challenge) is an ultramarathon held at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö, Stockholm. The event offers several distances, including the 46 km MiniUltra, Backyard Ultra, 50 miles, 100 miles and 200 miles, on a beautiful and challenging 11.5 km loop course. The start and finish are at the TEC tent beside the outdoor gym, and the event takes place over a weekend in April, with different start times for each distance. It is a tough and fun challenge for ultrarunners, with the option to change distance during the race.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop course at Alby Friluftsgård
Backyard Ultra course of approximately 6.7 km, with hourly starts
Aid station at the start/finish
additional: Start times: 200 miles starts Friday at 10:00, with a 54-hour time limit; Backyard Ultra starts Friday at 18:00, with hourly starts and a 46-hour time limit; 50 and 100 miles start Saturday at 10:00, with a 30-hour time limit; MiniUltra 46 km starts Sunday at 08:00, with an 8-hour time limit. Bibs can be collected from Friday at 08:00 at the TEC tent. Changing rooms, showers and sauna are currently unavailable due to renovation. Setting up your own tents or aid tables at the start/finish or along the course is not permitted. Runners’ bags are stored in the tent in a designated area. Changing distance during the race is permitted, but a Swedish record can only be set in the distance entered. The finish closes Sunday at 16:00. Previous editions have also included the 50 miles, 100 miles and Backyard Ultra distances.

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: Tarptautinis bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“ vyks Vilniuje, Vingio parke, ir skirtas pagerbti antinacistinio, antikomunistinio ir antisovietinio pogrindžio karius. Renginys populiarina bėgimą ir lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje, skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą bei siekia suburti įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus. Dalyviai galės rinktis iš kelių distancijų, o renginys organizuojamas su dideliu dėmesiu saugumui ir profesionalumui. Tai puiki proga tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams dalyvauti prasmingame sporto renginyje.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Vingio parke prie estrados
Distancijos: simbolinis 1963 m. bėgimas, 5,2 km, 10,5 km ir pusės maratonas
Trasos uždarymas ir eismo apribojimai saugumui užtikrinti
additional: Varžybų dieną laiko matavimo sistema veikia iki 13:30 val., po to laikas nebus fiksuojamas. Dalyvių skaičius ribotas iki 1200. Galimas rungties keitimas į trumpesnę už 2 Eur mokestį. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Renginys jungia sportą ir istoriją, siūlomos kelios distancijos, įskaitant simbolinę 1963 metrų trasą, ir pabrėžiama bendruomeniškumo svarba. Dalyvių amžiaus grupės ir draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ar asmeninę palydą.

name: BYU Lūša pēdās Jēkabpilī
description: BYU In the Footsteps of the Lynx in Jēkabpils is a unique running event where participants compete by running a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains. The race is physically and mentally challenging, attracting both local and international runners. The event is well organized, with precise timing and a friendly atmosphere that fosters sportsmanship and a sense of community. The participant list reflects a broad range of runners from Latvia and neighboring countries.
course_highlights: Run a set distance every hour until only one finisher remains
The race takes place in Jēkabpils, with precise timing using RFID equipment
The event attracts both local and international participants
additional: Timing with RFID equipment ensures accurate recording of results. The participant list is available online, and registration takes place online. The race is part of a wider range of events organized by RaceTiming.LV.

name: Aizkraukles novada 12. pusmaratons
description: The 12th Aizkraukle Municipality Half Marathon is a traditional running event offering a half-marathon distance and a popular run. The race takes place in Aizkraukle and brings together runners of all levels, with children’s races also on offer. The event is suitable for athletes and families looking to spend time actively outdoors and enjoy running.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.097 km
Popular run: 5.3 km with a slight elevation gain (300 m)
Children’s races: 500 m and 1,000 m
additional: The event offers a variety of races, including children’s distances, making it suitable for families. Registration takes place online at sportlat.lv, where participants can create a profile and access personalized options.

name: Rudes Maratons un Kultūras festivāls
location: Rude, Rojas pagasts, Talsi Municipality, Latvia
description: The Rudes Marathon and Culture Festival offers a running route around Rude that is relatively flat and approximately 1.8 km long. This loop follows roads, providing an easy and accessible distance for both beginners and experienced runners. The event combines sporting activities with the atmosphere of a cultural festival, creating a friendly, community-focused environment.
course_highlights: Relatively flat loop
The route follows roads
Approximately 1.8 km long
additional: The route profile and elevation data are available for download. The route is also suitable for hiking and is easy to access using various route-planning and navigation options with plotaroute.com tools.

name: 7. 6 godzin pełnej MOCY
location: Stadion OSiR Targówek, ul. Łabiszyńska 20, Warsaw, Poland
price_range: Bieg indywidualny: 260 zł; sztafeta: 640 zł (ceny z edycji 2026)

tiers.description: Opłata startowa w biegu indywidualnym wynosi 260 zł (dla członków Stowarzyszenia 230 zł)

description: The 7th edition of the “6 Hours of Full POWER” race will take place on April 17, 2027, at the OSiR Targówek stadium in Warsaw. The event includes an individual race and relay races over a 6-hour time limit, run on laps of approximately 400 m and 422 m. Participants compete in two groups simultaneously, with results combined. An official split time is recorded at the 50 km mark. The event also includes the Masovia Relay Running Championships.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a stadium track with laps of 400 m and 422.382 m
Official split time at the 50 km mark
Two groups compete simultaneously, with results combined
additional: Participant limit: 70 in the individual race and 16 relay teams. A relay team may consist of 4 women, 4 men, or be mixed (at least one woman). The organizer assigns participants to start groups. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the POLSKIE ULTRA Sports Association after completing the entry form.

name: 9 Dziesiątka Babicka
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Stare Babice
description: Skynet Dziesiątka Babicka is the largest running event organized in the Municipality of Stare Babice near Warsaw, aimed at running and healthy-lifestyle enthusiasts. The centerpiece is the main 10 km race on a certified course, following flat asphalt roads with an uphill section in the final 100 meters. The event also includes children’s races over shorter distances, without timing and divided into age categories. Participants receive race packs containing a bib with a chip, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start and finish are located at 32 Rynek Street in Stare Babice. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 10 km course
Entirely asphalt and flat, with an uphill section in the final 100 meters
Start and finish at Stare Babice Municipal Office, 32 Rynek Street
additional: Race packs can be collected at Stare Babice Primary School, 40 Polna Street, on April 17 (17:00–20:00) and April 18 (7:00–11:30). Each pack contains a race bib with a chip, safety pins, a commemorative T-shirt, and a sponsor pack. The start line will close 10 minutes after the starter’s gun. The time limit for completing the main race is 1.5 hours, with an additional 10-minute allowance for runners who pass the 9 km mark after the cutoff. The children’s races start at 9:45, are untimed, and every participant receives a medal. Awards ceremonies take place on the main stage immediately after each children’s race.

name: II Półmaraton Karolewo - Pruszcz
description: The 2nd Karolewo–Pruszcz Half Marathon is a certified 21.0975 km race taking place on 17 April 2027. The course is entirely paved, flat and marked every kilometre, making it conducive to good results. The race office is open on race day, and participants receive race packs containing, among other things, a bib, a timing chip, a T-shirt and a voucher for a recovery meal. The event is organised by the Agro-Economic School Complex in Karolewo, and timing is provided by STS-Timing.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course
Entirely paved and flat
Course marked every 1 kilometre
additional: The race office is open on race day from 8:30 to 16:00. Race packs contain a bib, a timing chip, safety pins, a voucher for a recovery meal, running memorabilia and a T-shirt. Participants should indicate their T-shirt size in the registration form. Unclaimed race packs will not be mailed or made available at a later date.

name: II Żelechowska Nocna Piątka
organizer: Żelechów Aktywni Sportowo oraz Miasto i Gmina Żelechów
description: The 2nd Żelechów Night Five is an annual race held in Żelechów that kicks off the running season in the town. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and a chance to spend time actively. The race takes place in the evening, giving it a distinctive character and adding to the appeal for participants. It is organized by the local authorities of the town and municipality of Żelechów together with the Żelechów Active in Sport group.
course_highlights: Evening road race in Żelechów
5 km distance
First stage of the 2nd Żelechów Running Triad
additional: The race takes place in the evening and is organized by the Żelechów Active in Sport group. The event is part of the local sports calendar and aims to promote physical activity among residents. Registration for the race is open.

name: III Mistrzostwa Polski Masters
organizer: Koszalińskie Towarzystwo Krzewienia Kultury Fizycznej i Polski Związek Lekkiej Atletyki Masters
description: The 3rd Polish Masters Championships is a race organized by the Koszalin Society for the Promotion of Physical Culture, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place on Góra Chełmska in Koszalin and is aimed at masters-category runners. It has a recreational and sporting character, with chip timing and overall classifications for women and men. The organizer provides third-party liability insurance, and participants can expect official award ceremonies.
course_highlights: A race on the natural terrain of Góra Chełmska
Chip timing using returnable chips attached to footwear
Overall classifications for women and men, with trophies for places 1–3
additional: No license was required for the 2026 edition.

name: Kresowe Trail #2
description: Kresowe Trail in Mielnik is a small-scale trail race held in the scenic Topolina woodland. The event offers two distances: the shorter Szpurt (7.8 km) and the longer Wertep (15.6 km), along carefully marked routes with natural surfaces and green markings. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and the local natural and cultural attractions of eastern Poland. Participants can expect professional organization, electronic timing, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and commemorative medals for those who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Two laps on the Wertep 15.6 km distance
An aid station along the Wertep course
additional: Online registration is available until 08:40 on race day. The first race bib is free; if it is lost or you change distances, you can purchase a replacement for 30 zł. The course time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. The race package includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, medical support, aid stations at the finish and along the course, and a photography service. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited. The 2026 edition started at 11:00 and had a time limit of 2 hours 15 minutes. The organizer announced electronic timing, medical support, and a hot recovery meal.

name: Pobiegnij z Siódemką
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Siódemka, Niepubliczna Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Marii Skłodowskiej-Curie w Słupsku i Słupski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji
description: Pobiegnij z Siódemką is a charity cross-country run organized by the Maria Skłodowska-Curie Non-Public Primary School No. 7 in Słupsk. The event is held to support the treatment and rehabilitation of a child with a cleft palate, and taking part in the run is a real way to help Mateusz and his family. The run is community-focused and inclusive, combining sport with charitable activities. This is the fourth edition of the event, which enjoys strong support from the local community and sponsors.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Słupsk
Charity event supporting a child’s treatment
Organized by a local primary school
additional: The run is a charity event supporting Mateusz, who has a cleft palate. In previous editions, funds were raised and transferred to the Siepomaga foundation’s account. The event is supported by local sponsors and donors. The organizers thank everyone for their support and emphasize the importance of every step in the run. Proceeds from an earlier edition were donated to support Mateusz; one edition raised PLN 7,014.

name: Wiosenna Hała
description: Wiosenna Hała is a walking orienteering marathon organized by KS Hała in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, in the village of Ruda. The event offers courses of varying difficulty, with the event base at Widok 1. Participants tackle challenging routes with numerous checkpoints, making it an event for fans of navigation and endurance. The start takes place in the afternoon, and the time limit for completing the course is 14 hours. Wiosenna Hała is a great opportunity to test your skills in the outdoors and compete with other orienteering enthusiasts.
course_highlights: TP50 course with 40 checkpoints
14-hour time limit to complete the course
Event base in Ruda, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship
additional: The late-arrival time limit on the course is 14 hours. The TP50 course has 40 checkpoints. The event is organized by Klub Sportowy Hała. The event base is at the primary school in Ruda, Widok 1, 27-230 Ruda. A cycling course is also listed.

name: Rock The Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan kan göras via hemsidan fram till tisdagen 13/4 kl 23.59

late_fee.price: Swish betalning på plats, hamburgare kan ta slut

description: Rock The Trail is a trail race on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten, Uppsala. The race offers four categories, including a children’s race of approximately 1.5 km and longer distances of 8 km, 16 km and 48 km. The start and finish are at OK Linné, and participants are offered hamburgers and drinks after the race. The course features scenic trails and mixed terrain, and the longer distances are registered with ITRA.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten
The longer-distance course is approximately 16 km, adjusted from the previous 15.8 km
Children’s race of approximately 1.5 km around the start and finish area
additional: Late registration is available on site with payment by Swish, but hamburgers after the race may run out. Umara sports drink is served during the race. Toilets are available at the start/finish. Parking is limited; taking public transport or cycling is recommended. The start location is listed as OK Linné, Tallbacksvägen 68.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon in which participants run a 6,706-metre loop on the Stensö exercise trail. The race starts at 10:00, with a new start every hour on the hour. To continue, runners must complete a lap within one hour. The winner is the person who completes the most laps, making the race an exciting, tactical challenge for ultrarunners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat, gravel-surfaced trail on the Stensö exercise trail
The course is clearly marked with red-and-white ribbons and arrows
In the evening and at night, the course follows only the floodlit trail
additional: The original Backyard Ultra format: each lap must be completed within one hour, with the next start on the hour. The 6,706 m loop is on the Stensö exercise trail (gravel-surfaced trail). 24 laps equal 100 miles. Organiser: Högby IF. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02.

images.alt_text: Kalmar Backyard Ultra-logotyp.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://irunkalmar.com/kalmar-backyard-ultra/): 2027-04-17 — "Kalmar Backyard Ultra 17 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-17)

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is an annual running race organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb at Sollentunavallen in Sollentuna. The race offers runners of all ages a great opportunity to compete on a well-organized course with good training facilities. Turebergs Friidrottsklubb is an experienced organizer that also hosts several other athletics and running events throughout the year. Sollentunavallen is a centrally located, easily accessible venue that contributes to a pleasant race environment.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the running track at Sollentunavallen
Organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb, an experienced club
Centrally located venue with good training facilities
additional: Turebergs Friidrottsklubb covers up to 15 race entries per season for its members. Late registration and failure to participate are charged to the participant. Training at Sollentunavallen may be affected by other events and football matches, but the track is generally available for running. Previous editions have offered Minivarvet for children.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt 300 Marathon in Hultsfred is a welcoming and inclusive race celebrating Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a scenic 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, combining park paths and asphalt. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned, with timing and water stations along the way. After the race, participants are invited to a social gathering with food and good company near the start and finish area.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, with the final lap 3 km shorter
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park paths
Two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola and energy supplies at the lap point and at 4 km
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take more than 5 hours should start at 09:00. After the race, a social gathering with food and good company is planned for around 14:30, approximately 1 km from Knektavallen. Start and finish at Knektavallen.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: The Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The races offer accessible road-running competitions, with the option to enter using a series pass or by paying for a single race. The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School, which also serves as the event centre. At the final event, the top runners in each category are awarded prizes based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses for course records. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School in Vantaa
Sotunki Upper Secondary School serves as the event centre, with changing rooms and showers
Sports drinks are available at the finish area, along with a café
additional: A series pass lets you take part in all five events without registering separately. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded based on points after the final event, and runners must take part in at least two events to qualify for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training sessions, and members can participate in the road-running cup for free by claiming a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races, such as the 5K and 10K. These popular local events offer accessible road-running races.

name: Kaarina Rata-Ultra
description: Kaarina Rata Ultra (KARU) is an annual track-running event offering six- and 12-hour ultramarathons, as well as a track marathon and half marathon. The competition takes place on the running track at Kaarina Central Sports Field, providing a challenging but well-organised setting for both elite runners and recreational athletes. The event has been awarded IAU Bronze Label status and is known for its high standard and several Finnish records. The running direction is changed halfway through, and the tracks are precisely measured, ensuring the competition is reliable.
course_highlights: The running direction changes at the three-hour mark
Elite runners use lanes 1 and 2; other runners use lanes 5 and 6
Lane 1 is 400 m long; lane 5 is 430.66 m long
additional: The number of participants is limited to 120. The marathon and six-hour race start at 10:00, and the half marathon starts at 13:00. The time limit is approximately six hours for the marathon and three hours for the half marathon. Late registration is available at the race office up to one hour before the start, but payment must be made in exact cash. Race numbers must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. Entry fees are non-refundable, but in cases of illness, participation may be deferred to the following year with a medical certificate. Payment can also be made using sports and culture vouchers (Smartum, Edenred, ePassi). There is ample parking, and signage is provided.

name: 8. Gdańsk Maraton
description: Energa Gdańsk Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The marathon route passes some of the city’s most distinctive landmarks, including the European Solidarity Centre, the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island, the Baltic Philharmonic, the Neptune’s Fountain, the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre, and ERGO Arena. The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The event uses staggered start waves, and participants can expect a full race pack and extensive support along the course.
course_highlights: The route passes the European Solidarity Centre and the retractable footbridge to Ołowianka Island
Views of the Baltic Philharmonic, Neptune’s Fountain, and the Gdańsk Shakespeare Theatre
The start and finish are at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, with a visit to ERGO Arena
additional: The marathon starts in waves. The start line will close 5 minutes after the final starting signal. Holders of a Gdańsk resident card receive a 10% discount on the entry fee. The race pack includes a bib with a chip, a medal, medical support, course refreshment stations, a hot meal at the finish, and gifts from sponsors. The official marathon T-shirt and backpack are available for purchase. The event is scheduled for 24–25 April 2027; the website lists the marathon, a 5 km race, a relay, and the Junior Marathon. Entry fee details are not provided in the available sources.

name: 6 Falstartowa Triada
description: Falstartowa Triada is a running competition across three forest routes, organized by the FALSTART Rudniki Running Club. The event combines a chance to experience forest terrain with sporting competition. Participants can compete individually and in the team classification.
course_highlights: Three forest routes
Individual competition
Team classification

name: Bieg Pamięci - wokół Góry Śmierci
location: Ekspozycja Historyczno-Dydaktyczna przy Górze Śmierci, Paszczyna, Poland
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Dębica
description: The Memorial Run around Góra Śmierci is an annual sporting event held in Paszczyna to commemorate the victims of Nazi labour camps and promote a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The event takes place at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci and includes short-distance children’s races, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a 10 km main race. Participants in the main race receive a race pack, and classifications and prizes are provided for both children and adults in various age categories. The main race is scheduled to start at 12:00.
course_highlights: 10 km main race route around Góra Śmierci
5 km Memorial Nordic Walking march
Children’s and youth races from 50 m to 1,000 m
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 11:30 and closes 15 minutes before the start of each distance. The main race entry fee includes a race pack. Prizes are awarded for places 1–3 in the main race, as well as in the age-group classifications. OPEN category winners are not awarded prizes in the age-group categories. The start and event venue are at the Historical and Educational Exhibition at Góra Śmierci in Paszczyna.

name: Bydgoski Bieg Urodzinowy
description: The Bydgoszcz Birthday Run is an annual running event held in Bydgoszcz, taking place on April 18, 2027. The race starts at 11:00. The participant limit is 1,500, and the first 1,300 people to register will receive a T-shirt. The route will be announced soon, and the event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels.
additional: A T-shirt is available to the first 1,300 people to register. A T-shirt is provided for the first 1,300 registered participants.

name: Cross na sześć łap
description: Uniejów Cross on Six Paws is a unique race for dog-loving sports enthusiasts, held in the picturesque areas along the Warta River near Uniejów Castle. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometer routes, combining sport, adventure, and time in nature. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, a canicross world champion, who brings his experience and passion to the course. At the finish, medals, trophies for the top finishers, and refreshments await both runners and their four-legged companions. The event is open to anyone who wants to spend active time with their dog and enjoy a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through picturesque areas along the Warta River near Uniejów Castle
Available distances: 5 and 10 kilometers
Run alongside your dog in natural surroundings
additional: At the finish, participants will receive medals, trophies for the top finishers, refreshments, water, and treats for dogs. The event takes place by Uniejów Castle. The race ambassador is Jakub Krzemiński, 2025 IFSS canicross world champion. Advance registration is required. The previous edition also featured children's races of 100 and 300 m.

name: IV Białołęcki Bieg Leśny
description: The IV Białołęcki Forest Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The race takes place on a forest course, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and varied running conditions. The organizers, Fundacja Małopolskie Szlaki, provide professional race services and timing using RFID technology. The participant limit is 500, and the start is scheduled for 10:00.
course_highlights: Forest course in Warsaw’s Białołęka district
Professional RFID timing
Limited to 500 participants
additional: The race takes place in Warsaw’s Białołęka district. The organizer provides electronic RFID timing. The start is at 10:00. The participant limit for the 2026 edition was 500. Timing was provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: Poznań Półmaraton
location: ul. Roosevelta near Międzynarodowe Targi Poznańskie, Poznań, Poland
description: The PKO Poznań Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Poznań, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering a unique sporting experience and an opportunity to test your fitness. The organizers ensure the event has a family-friendly atmosphere, also offering an activity zone and races for children and young people. The event is well organized and enjoys considerable prestige in the running community.
course_highlights: Start on Roosevelta Street, near the Poznań International Fair
Course through the streets of Łazarz and Grunwald
The race also passes through Junikowo and Ławica
additional: Registration for the 19th PKO Poznań Half Marathon will open in December. The regulations and price list are being finalized and will be announced soon. The organizers are providing an activity zone and races for children and young people as accompanying events. The course and program are in preparation, and participants are encouraged to follow the official information channels. Registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open in December; the entry form is being prepared.

name: Siedlecki Maraton Na Raty
organizer: Fundacja Ultramaratonu Nadbużańskiego, Agencja Rozwoju Miasta Siedlce oraz Triathlon Siedlce Club
description: The Siedlce Stage Marathon is a unique running event held in Siedlce, offering two distances to choose from: a marathon and a half marathon. The race takes place in three stages at three different locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest and Muchawka Reservoir, making it an exciting challenge spread over three days. The event has a new format that lets participants tackle the distance in stages and also includes races for children. The organizers provide professional event production and an awards ceremony at the finish.
course_highlights: Three stages held at three locations: City Park, Sekulski Forest and Muchawka Reservoir
Choice of distance: marathon or half marathon
Children’s races during the final stage
additional: The race office is open on April 17 from 17:00 to 18:30 at the Rector’s Office of the University of Siedlce. The awards ceremony will take place on April 19 at around 15:15 by Muchawka Reservoir. Children’s races take place during the final stage, starting at 14:45. Participants may use poles; Nordic Walking classification is available only for the half marathon. The combined participant limit for the marathon and half marathon is 200. Previous editions also featured children’s races and a Nordic Walking competition over the half-marathon distance.

name: XVIII Bieg Piaśnicki
organizer: Gmina Wejherowo i The North Event
description: The Piaśnica Run commemorates the victims of the German occupation of Poland during World War II. The running and Nordic walking routes pass through places where thousands of innocent people were murdered. The event aims to honor the victims, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the local community together. It also features cultural events, such as exhibitions, lectures, and concerts, that introduce the history of Gdańsk Pomerania.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes through historic sites of wartime atrocities
Commemoration of the victims of the German occupation of Poland
Cultural events: exhibitions, lectures, concerts, and meetings with historians
additional: The event includes running races and Nordic walking. It promotes a healthy lifestyle and community integration. The event is commemorative and educational. Previous editions have also included races for children and young people.

name: Bronek Run Forest Edition
description: Bronek Run - Forest Edition is the fifth-anniversary edition of the race, held in the picturesque Grudziądz Municipal Forest. It’s an event for running enthusiasts who enjoy being surrounded by nature, with soft forest trails, natural climbs, and the peaceful atmosphere of the woods. The 10 km race is part of the Grand Prix of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, and special Bronek Run Kids - Forest Edition races have been prepared for the youngest participants. Participants can look forward to a special forest-themed medal and forest-themed socks in the race pack, as well as an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: Picturesque routes through the Grudziądz Municipal Forest
Natural climbs and the peaceful atmosphere of the woods
Soft forest trails
additional: A race for children and adults. The race pack includes forest-themed socks, and participants receive a medal inspired by the race’s forest setting.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Vårruset in Stockholm is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in Norra Djurgården. The event celebrates the joy of movement and togetherness, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition level. Participants can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen, near Stockholm University
The course follows gravel paths and forest trails in a scenic setting
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 17 April; otherwise, they must be collected at the event. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. You can opt out of timing when registering. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike or by public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and focuses on community and health.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
location: Baltoji Vokė, Rūdiškių seniūnija, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lietuva
description: Tradicinis tarptautinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė yra kasmetinė pavasario sporto šventė, vykstanti Baltojoje Vokėje. Tai tradicinis bėgimas, kuris suburia bėgimo entuziastus iš Lietuvos ir užsienio. Renginys pasižymi ilga istorija ir draugiška atmosfera, skatinančia aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir bendruomeniškumą.
course_highlights: Tradicinis maršrutas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
Pavasario sporto šventės dalis
Kasmet vyksta nuo bent 2018 metų
additional: Renginys vyksta pavasario sporto šventės metu. Registraciją prižiūri Lietuvos bėgimo taurė. Ankstesnių metų starto laikas dažniausiai būdavo 11:00 val. Renginyje dalyvauja keli šimtai sportininkų, vyksta apdovanojimai ir rėmėjų palaikymas, renginys apima ir saugumo užtikrinimą.
