description: Pilsēttakas Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s scenic forest trails. This event offers a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels, encouraging an active lifestyle and enjoyment of nature. The race welcomes both beginners and experienced trail runners, with particular attention given to youth and children’s categories. The event is well organized and offers the option to participate individually or in teams, as well as season passes.
course_highlights: Routes with varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, forest firebreaks and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for various age groups and fitness levels
Late registration and participation in a non-timed walk are available on race day
additional: Late registration is available at the race center on race day, up to 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; walking participants may set out on the course from 9:00 to 10:30 without timekeeping. Walkers should note that after 12:00 they may encounter fast runners on the courses. Season passes are available at a discount, but an additional fee applies if the “Vilks” distance is selected on 20 June.

name: 7 Bieg Korczaka
organizer: Specjalny Ośrodek Szkolno-Wychowawczy nr 1 dla Dzieci Niepełnosprawnych Ruchowo w Policach im. Marii Grzegorzewskiej
description: The 7th Korczak Run is an annual running event organized by Special Education Center No. 1 for Children with Physical Disabilities in Police. The event includes a 5 km main race, Nordic walking, and children’s races over various distances, including races for children in wheelchairs. The main race route consists of two loops with an additional section, making for an interesting and varied course. The event promotes inclusion and physical activity among people of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The main race route consists of 2 loops with an extra section
The event includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 600 meters
Nordic walking is available over a distance of 5 km
additional: Medals for race participants. Forms are available to download: transfer of a race entry, guardian’s statement/consent, and authorization to collect a race pack. Recommended parking areas are listed on the website. Numerous photo galleries and videos from previous editions are available. The event website provides registration, regulations, and a course map. Electronic timing by B4SPORT is available.

name: XXXVI Biegi im. Tomasza Hopfera
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janowcu Wielkopolskim
description: The 36th Tomasz Hopfer Runs is an annual running event held in Janowiec Wielkopolski. The main event is a 10 km race that attracts runners from various regions. The organizers also offer races for children, promoting physical activity among the youngest participants. The course is certified, ensuring it has been accurately measured and professionally prepared.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km race course
Children’s races tailored to different age groups
Scenic areas of Janowiec Wielkopolski
additional: The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janowiec Wielkopolski. Phone: +48 452 469 185. The program includes races for children and the main 10 km race. The website includes regulations and results from previous years.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
description: PKO Gdynia Half Marathon is one of the largest running events in Poland and will take place on April 24, 2027. The half-marathon course runs through the modern city of Gdynia, showcasing its unique modernist character. The race starts in the evening at 19:30, so runners finish after dark, creating a special atmosphere. The event attracts individual runners, relay teams, and participants in accompanying 5 km and children’s races.
course_highlights: A half-marathon course of over 21 km through Gdynia
Evening start at 19:30, with the finish at City Beach after dark
A PZLA-certified 5 km course, as well as children’s races and relays
additional: The half-marathon participant limit is 15,000. The time limit for completing the half-marathon is 4 hours. The entry fee can be transferred to the next edition up to 14 days before the event. Refunds are available up to 45 days before the race if registration took place within the first 30 days after entries opened. Half-marathon relays consist of teams of 3. The 5 km course is PZLA-certified. The children’s race (Kids Run) takes place on Saturday at midday, with a unique medal at the finish. The event will also include 5 km races, relays, and Kids Run. Early registrants can receive a full refund if they withdraw up to 45 days before the race; the fee can be transferred free of charge to the next edition up to 14 days before the event.

name: 43 Bieg Kujawiaka
organizer: Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy VECTRA we Włocławku
description: The 43rd Bieg Kujawiaka is the oldest sporting event in the Włocławek region, held in memory of Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski. The race attracts people who enjoy physical activity and runners from various places, and takes place at Przylesie Stadium. This event has a rich tradition, brings the local community together, and promotes a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs around Przylesie Stadium in Włocławek
An event with a long tradition and historical significance
A race in memory of local sports figures Napoleon Dzwonkowski and Wiesław Wesołowski
additional: The organizer is the Sports and Recreation Centre in Włocławek. The event takes place at Przylesie Stadium. The website does not provide details about start waves, participant limits, or race packages.

name: 8 Bełchatowski Bieg Nocny
organizer: Miejskie Centrum Sportu w Bełchatowie oraz Bełchatowski Klub Lekkoatletyczny
description: The 8th Bełchatów Night Run is a unique sporting event combining racing with the one-of-a-kind atmosphere of an evening run through the streets of Bełchatów. Participants cover a 10-kilometre course certified by PZLA, which is well suited to setting personal bests. The start and finish are at Gabriel Narutowicz Square, and the evening schedule adds to the event’s distinctive character. The race promotes an active lifestyle and brings the local running community together.
course_highlights: A certified 10-kilometre course through the streets of Bełchatów
Start and finish at Gabriel Narutowicz Square
Evening start at 21:00, with a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes
additional: The race office is in the concert hall of the Municipal Cultural Centre at 3 Narutowicz Square and is open from 18:00 to 23:00. A baggage deposit is available for participants’ personal belongings. Participants must be over 16; minors need permission from a parent or guardian. Timing is recorded using chips attached to race bibs. The participant limit is approximately 400. Information about the 21:00 start and the 1-hour-40-minute time limit comes from the previous edition.

name: Backyard Ultra TRICITY
description: Backyard Ultra TriCity is a unique ultra race in a format that originated in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, when they begin another lap. The race continues until only one runner remains at the start and completes the final loop within the hour limit. It is a demanding and exciting race in which only one winner is crowned.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km (4.167 mile) loop
Starts every full hour
A 1-hour limit to complete each loop
additional: Runners have 15 minutes to rest after completing a loop if they finish it in less than 60 minutes. The race takes place in Gdańsk. The organizer provides downloadable rules. The race is for adults. The available registration page is for the 2026 edition.

name: Bieg Zająca
description: Bieg Zająca is one of the Warsaw Grand Prix events, held in the picturesque Kabaty Forest. The event offers running routes of various lengths, suited to runners of different ability levels. Participants can expect professional organization, a race package, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race. The event has a family-friendly, community-oriented atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and special recognition for the oldest participant and the funniest costume.
course_highlights: Routes in Kabaty Forest — natural woodland trails
Time limit: 60 minutes for the 5 km race and 80 minutes for the 10 km race
Start and race office on the clearing beside the Kabaty Metro Technical Depot
additional: The race office opens at 09:00. Race bibs are issued only on race day. A special trophy for the oldest male or female participant and recognition for the funniest costume. Prizes in the overall and age-group classifications. Participant limit: 450.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin is the spring edition of a popular cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, highlighting the aesthetic appeal of the venue. The race is recreational and sporting in nature and is part of a series of cross-country races in Wielkopolska and other cities. The organizers aim to promote running and create a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the UMCS Botanical Garden
Picturesque and attractive race setting
Passionately organized since 2014
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races. In summer 2026, they will celebrate the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn series. Previous editions included races for children over four shorter distances.

name: Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca
location: Pałac i Folwark Łochów, Łochów, Poland
organizer: Fundacja Leny Grochowskiej i Stowarzyszenie Arche
description: Paratriathlon Kraina Liwca is a charity team event that brings together people with and without disabilities. It takes place in the picturesque Liwiec Valley at the Łochów Palace and Folwark. The event consists of three stages: a 5.5 km run, a 7 km kayak trip and a 22 km bike race. The running route passes through green spaces and historic buildings, while the kayak trip takes place on the Liwiec River. The event promotes physical activity and social inclusion, and proceeds from entry fees go towards creating supported housing.
course_highlights: 5.5 km run on the grounds of Łochów Palace and Folwark — 3 laps through picturesque green spaces and past historic buildings
7 km kayak trip on the Liwiec River, with equipment provided and life jackets required
22 km bike race through Karczewizna, Twarogi, Matały, Zambrzyniec and Kamionna, returning to Łochów Palace and Folwark
additional: Teams of 3–4 people, with at least 1 person holding a disability certificate. The kayak trip uses equipment provided by the organiser; life jackets are mandatory. Time-trial bikes and road bikes with aerodynamic wheels are prohibited, as is drafting during the bike race. Timing is electronic, using chips. The race office is open on 24 April from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 25 April from 8:30 to 12:30. The organiser provides transport for participants to the kayakers’ start. After the event, there will be an open food area and a concert. The start and event are based at Łochów Palace and Folwark. The 2026 edition’s rules allowed teams without a person holding a disability certificate, but added 30 minutes to their result. Route and organisational information is from the 2026 edition.

name: Pelplin Forest Run
description: Pelplin Forest Run is a running and Nordic walking event held at Rajkowski Mill since 2024. The start, finish, and race office are located at the kayak marina, and the routes pass through the scenic Bukowiec Forest District. The event is co-organized by the Kociewie Sports and Cultural Association and the Pelplin Municipality Sprint Kulice Sports Club, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete in a beautiful forest setting.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Bukowiec Forest District
Start and finish at the kayak marina in Rajkowski Mill
Running and Nordic walking in a natural forest setting
additional: The distances and location provided are from previous editions.

name: XLIV Uliczny Bieg Bartów
location: Stadion w Barcianach, ul. Sportowa 1a, Barciany, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Przy zgłoszeniach internetowych udział osób niepełnoletnich jest bezpłatny.

description: The 44th Bartów Street Run in Memory of Jan Liniewski is a traditional road race held at the stadium in Barciany. The event has a rich history and is open to various age groups, from preschoolers to adults, including people with disabilities. The main race course is approximately 3,800 metres long and runs through the streets of Barciany. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping, medals and prizes, as well as a friendly atmosphere and support from spectators.
course_highlights: The main race course is approximately 3,800 m long and runs through the streets of Barciany
Age categories range from preschoolers to adults, including a race for people with disabilities
Start and finish at the stadium in Barciany, 1a Sportowa Street
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Registration and race-pack collection are available until 45 minutes before the start of each category. Electronic timekeeping uses a returnable chip. Medical care is available on site. Prizes are drawn after the race. Race numbers must be placed on the chest or on a special belt at the front of the body. The co-organizer of the previous edition was the Warmian-Masurian LZS Association.

name: XVIII Złotowski Bieg Zawilca
description: The 18th Złotów Anemone Run is an annual running event held in Złotów, aimed at people who enjoy running, active recreation and a sporting atmosphere. The race takes place on courses suited to different groups of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The event is open and welcoming to runners of varying experience levels. The organizers provide professional event management and attractive conditions for starting and competing.
additional: The event is co-organized by the Złotów Municipal Office, Granqvists Manufacturing Sp. z o.o. and the Alfred Sokołowski District Hospital in Złotów.

name: XXXV Biegi Uliczne Wiosna Cekowska
description: The XXXV Wiosna Cekowska Street Races is an annual running event held in Ceków-Kolonia. The races attract runners from various towns and offer street courses of different lengths. The event is open and welcoming to participants of different ages and ability levels. The start and finish are at the Public Preschool in Ceków-Kolonia, and the races take place in the afternoon.
course_highlights: Street running courses in Ceków-Kolonia
Start and finish at the Public Preschool
The event takes place from 12:00 to 15:00
additional: The races take place from 12:00 to 15:00. A list of confirmed and unconfirmed participants is available on the website. No information is available about entry fees or participant limits.

name: III Bieg na dychę
description: The “Fabianki Ten” is a running event held at the stadium in Chełmica Cukrownia. Its name indicates a distance of 10 km, and an earlier edition took place in April 2026. The race combines sporting competition with an active day out in the Fabianki municipality.
course_highlights: The stadium in Chełmica Cukrownia is the event venue
A 10 km race, as suggested by the name “Ten”
Located in the Fabianki municipality

name: Zabiegani na tropie
organizer: Zabiegani Częstochowa wraz z Miastem Częstochowa

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 180 zł z koszulką - w miarę dostępności koszulek

description: Bieg Częstochowski is an annual running event organized by the Zabiegani association in Częstochowa, promoting running as a simple form of physical activity. The route passes through the city center, and participants can expect professional organization, water stations along the course, and attractive prizes. The race office is located in the sports hall of the H. Sienkiewicz Secondary School No. 4, and the race starts on Sunday at 11:30. The event is very popular and has a positive atmosphere, as confirmed by its many editions and the involvement of the local running community.
course_highlights: The route passes through the center of Częstochowa
Water stations at approximately 3.3 km and 7.3 km
Start and finish near NMP Avenue III, by the City Art Gallery
additional: The race office is open on Saturday from 12:00 to 15:00 and on Sunday from 8:30 to 10:45. Collecting the race pack requires proof of identity or authorization. Using public transport is recommended due to traffic disruptions and the lack of parking at the race office. An awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants are scheduled after the race. According to the organizer’s materials, every team receives a prize at the finish.

name: Skrylleloppet
description: Skrylleloppet is a trail race organized by Björnstorps IF at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. Races are offered over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, with the 3 km race also having recreational categories for men and women. The courses follow Skryllegården’s fitness trails through varied woodland terrain on gravel surfaces. Skrylleloppet is a welcoming race with professional timing and results reporting, and also serves as a qualifying race for the TCS Lidingöloppet.
course_highlights: Trail race on varied woodland trails
Gravel surfaces on fitness trails
The 10 km race offers the opportunity to qualify for the TCS Lidingöloppet
additional: Registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start. On race day, participants can also register on site and make a name or category change for an administrative fee of 100 kr; payment is by Swish only. Bib numbers are sent by email during race week and can also be collected from Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race. Participants who cycle to the race can enter a prize draw at the awards ceremony at 11:30. Parking is limited, so carpooling is recommended.

name: Skälbyloppet
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly race through the scenic surroundings of Skälby Gård in Kalmar. The event offers several distances, from short 600-metre youth races to 8 km for adults, on routes featuring lovely park paths, gravel, asphalt and trail. It’s a perfect race to kick off the running season, with water available on the lap and at the finish. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal as a memento.
course_highlights: The course runs on gravel and park paths, with a short section on asphalt and some trail.
Water is available on the lap of the long course and at the finish.
The 4 km and 8 km courses are one and two laps respectively, crossing the bridge.
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Skälby loge on race day from 8:30 a.m. Youth races start from 10:00 a.m.; adult men’s and women’s races start at 11:00 a.m. New: a 4 km untimed walking category. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Information about previous editions also lists a 4 km untimed walking category. All finishers receive a medal. The published information applies to the 2026 race and does not confirm the date of 24 April 2027.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon that runs through scenic parts of Gärdet and Södra Djurgården in Stockholm. The start and finish are at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen. The race is perfect preparation for adidas Stockholm Marathon, but also suits anyone who wants to welcome spring with a great half marathon in an urban setting. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of asphalt, gravel and paving stones, with a total elevation gain of 183 metres.
course_highlights: The course runs through Gärdet and Södra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen
Surfaces include asphalt, gravel and paving stones
Total elevation gain of 183 metres, with kilometre markers at every kilometre
additional: The race has a time limit of 3 hours. Enervit sports drink will be available during the race. Bib collection takes place at Gärdet sports field on Friday 24 April from 10:00 to 19:00 and Saturday 25 April from 08:00 to 11:00. Participants who collect their bib on Friday receive IcePower Cold Gel and a Scholl foot mask. Registered participants receive 25% off adidas shoes and clothing at the adidas pop-up store at Löplabbet from 20–26 April. Race rules prohibit, among other things, strollers, inline skates, roller skis and competition wheelchairs. Wheelchair participants start in the final starting group, and guides are free of charge. The provisional start time is 11:00 and the time limit is three hours. Minimum age: 17. Race-day registration is available until 09:00, subject to availability.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.stockholmmarathon.se/premiarhalvan/): 2027-04-24 — "Spring adidas Premiärhalvan den 24 april 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-24)

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
location: Olshammar, Askersund Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is an ultramarathon through the enchanted forests of Tiveden, from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå. The race follows a historic trail used by monks in the 15th century and offers challenging, scenic terrain. A new course is planned for 2027, with a longer distance of approximately 53 km for the Swedish Championship categories. The course is well marked, and participants receive a map to minimize the risk of taking a wrong turn.
course_highlights: Historic trail used by monks in the 15th century
Enchanted forest landscape in Tiveden
Well-marked course with two aid stations
additional: Bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee for individual starters. For teams, transport is included for the first runner. Timing is recorded using SportIdent every 10 km. Participants receive a plaque and are served a hot meal after finishing. Teams can consist of 2–5 runners, with exchanges permitted anywhere along the course. The regular race can be completed individually or in teams of 2–5 runners. There are two aid stations, and bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee. Finishers receive a plaque and a hot meal after finishing. The organizer’s website contains maps, an elevation profile, and a GPX file.

name: Vårmilen (Lidingöloppet Vårmilen)
organizer: Lidingöloppet (IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb)
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge featuring one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km courses. The race takes place on scenic, hilly trails through forests and meadows and along the archipelago coast, with a soft, gentle surface suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The race qualifies runners for seeding at TCS Lidingöloppet, offering the chance to get a better start group in the classic autumn trail race. Water and sports drinks are available at aid stations, and there is entertainment along the course. After the race, refreshments and light food are available to buy at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest trails and hilly terrain
The course is mostly on soft trails and gravel
Beautiful scenery featuring forests, meadows and the archipelago coast
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Aid stations with water and sports drinks at 5 km and at the finish. The course is marked with white flagging tape and spray-painted arrows, with course marshals at difficult points. Changing rooms with showers and a sauna are available at Lidingövallen. Free bag storage is available, but not for electronic items. Valuables storage costs 20 kr. Group warm-up before the start. Public transport or cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Category changes and name changes are possible for a fee. A children’s race (Knattarnas Vårmil) takes place before the main races. The 10 km starts at 11:00 and the 5 km at 11:10 on 24 April 2027. The 10 km course has an aid station at 5 km and drinks at the finish. Parking is limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lidingoloppet.se/lidingoloppet-varmilen/startinformation): 2027-04-24 — "Start lördag den 24 april 2027 på Lidingövallen" (was estimated 2027-04-24)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Start lördag den 24 april 2027 på Lidingövallen

name: VXO Ultrafest
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning festival and Swedish Championship organized by Växjö Running Club in collaboration with the Swedish Athletics Federation. The competition takes place on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö and offers several Championship-status distances, including 24-hour running and 100 km. The course is flat and consists mainly of asphalt with some gravel sections, making it fast and spectator-friendly. The event welcomes both runners and walkers for a weekend full of challenges and camaraderie.
course_highlights: Flat loop course of approximately 820 metres with asphalt and gravel
Approximately 3.2 km loop around Lake Trummen on asphalt and gravel
Event area on open grassy grounds on the southern shore of Lake Trummen
additional: The pre-race dinner is held on Friday, April 24. Lap counting takes place at the arena, where there is space for the organizer’s tents and participants’ own tents. The Women’s SM Half Marathon Walk starts at 10:00. The VXO24h course is approximately 820 m, while the VXO100k and the SM 42 km and 21 km walking courses are approximately 3.2 km around Lake Trummen. The organizer’s website states that VXO Ultrafest is taking a break after five years.

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: Kauno Akropolio maratonas yra kasmetinis tarptautinis bėgimo renginys Kaune, pritraukiantis tūkstančius dalyvių. Renginys skirtas visiems, nepriklausomai nuo amžiaus ar fizinio pasirengimo, ir siekia skatinti socialinį bei fizinį aktyvumą bei sveikos gyvensenos tradicijas Lietuvoje. Maratono ir pusės maratono trasos yra sertifikuotos Tarptautinės lengvosios atletikos federacijos (WA) ir Tarptautinės maratonų bei ilgųjų distancijų bėgimo asociacijos (AIMS). Tai sporto šventė tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams, vykstanti saugioje ir aukštus standartus atitinkančioje aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Maratono ir pusės maratono trasos sertifikuotos WA ir AIMS
Trasa išmatuota pagal tarptautinius standartus
Renginys sertifikuotas 5 žvaigždučių kokybės ženklu
additional: Renginys sertifikuotas 5 žvaigždučių kokybės ženklu, užtikrinantis aukščiausio lygio saugumą ir paslaugas. Maratono trasos atitinka tarptautinius standartus. Renginys skirtas tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams, vyksta Kauno mieste. Organizuoja VšĮ "Kauno maratono klubas". Renginio metu siūloma nuotolinio bėgimo galimybė, grupinės registracijos ir įvairios distancijos, sertifikuotos trasos.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“ yra aukštos kokybės pusės maratono renginys, skirtas Jurginių šventei. Renginys siekia įtvirtinti Palangą kaip Europos sporto miestą, skatinti fizinį aktyvumą ir sveiką gyvenimo būdą tarp gyventojų ir miesto svečių. Bėgimas vyksta Palangos ir Šventosios kurortuose, didinant masinių sporto renginių pasiūlą ir vietos bendruomenės įsitraukimą į sporto veiklas.
course_highlights: Startas Šventojoje ir finišas Palangoje
Trasa pažymėta ir pritaikyta bėgikams
Skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir sporto populiarinimą
additional: Renginyje numatomi eismo apribojimai ir viešųjų ryšių kampanijos, siekiant užtikrinti sklandų renginio vykdymą.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: 23 Bieg Jakubowy
description: LOTTO 23rd Jakubowy Run is a road race in Olsztyn with a tradition spanning more than twenty years, organized by the HORUS Association. The 10 km course, certified by PZLA, passes through some of the city’s most beautiful and charming places, with the start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain. The event is one of the most popular running events in the Warmia and Masuria region and takes place at the beginning of the running season. In addition to the main race, children’s races and a 10 km Nordic Walking event are also held.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Olsztyn’s Old Town by the fountain
The route passes through Podzamcze Park, the boulevards along the Łyna River, and the avenues by the lake
A 10 km road course certified by PZLA
additional: Side events: children’s races over 150–200 m, 300 m, and 400 m, and 10 km Nordic Walking. The start and finish are located in the Old Town by the fountain, and winners are presented with awards after each race. The race office also allows registration and payment of entry fees on race day, if race packages are still available. The 2026 program included races for children in three age groups and Nordic Walking.

name: 35 Maraton Juranda
description: The 35th Jurand Marathon is a historic race held since 1981 and one of the most important marathons in Poland. Its certified course is exceptionally flat and entirely paved, making it ideal for setting personal bests. The route passes through the picturesque Masuria region, including villages, forests, and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes. The event combines competitive running with a picnic atmosphere and is open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Certified, flat marathon course measuring 42.195 km
Entirely paved route, with no uphill or downhill sections
Picturesque Masuria region, villages, forests, and the landscapes of the Land of a Thousand Lakes
additional: 6:00–8:30. All distances start together at 9:00; wheelchair participants start at 8:55. The marathon time limit is 6 hours. Side races: the Knight’s Half Marathon (21.0975 km), Jurand’s Daughter’s 10K (10 km), and races for children and young people over 800 m, 600 m, and 300 m. Start, finish, and race office: Świetlica Gminna, Lipowiec 48B.

name: 42 Memoriał Winanda Osińskiego
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczecinku
description: The Winand Osiński Memorial Street Run in Szczecinek is an annual running event with a long tradition, organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Szczecinek. The main 10 km street race runs through the city on roads closed to vehicle traffic. The course is marked every kilometre and has a refreshment point. The event also includes youth races over various distances to promote physical activity among children and young people. The main race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional timing and a unique sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the streets of Szczecinek, closed to vehicle traffic
Course markings every kilometre and a water refreshment point
Electronic timing using chips in race bibs
additional: The time limit for the main race is 2 hours. The start and finish are on Piłsudskiego Street (the start is near “Mała Poczta”; the finish is at the Czesław Kazimierz Lis Municipal Stadium). Race bibs must be attached to the front of the shirt and remain visible throughout the race, or the runner may be disqualified. Youth races start at 8:55, with age groups and distances ranging from 400 m to 1,000 m. The organizer also invites organizations to set up stands during the event. Registration is through the Datasport service. The time limit for the main race is 2 hours.

name: 66 Biegi Ulicami Sieradza
description: The 66th Biegi Ulicami Sieradza is an annual road race held at the Market Square in Sieradz. The event features 5 km and 10 km races, and the PZLA-certified course runs along the city’s asphalt streets. The event promotes physical activity among different social groups and families, encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The race office opens at 9:00, and the main races start at 11:30.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified asphalt course
Two 5 km laps for the 10 km distance
Start and finish at the Market Square in Sieradz
additional: The participant limit is 250 paid entries. The time limit is 90 minutes for the 10 km and 50 minutes for the 5 km. After the time limit, participants must leave the course and will not be classified. The program also includes children’s races and a corporate relay. The race office opens at 9:00, the corporate relay starts at 10:00, the children’s race starts at 11:00, and the warm-up is at 11:15. The race office opens at 9:00. The 400 m family run is free.

name: II Charytatywny Bieg
description: The 2nd St. Ursula Ledóchowska Charity Run at Góra Chełmska near Koszalin is an event bringing together runners and enthusiasts of physical activity. Organized by the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering “SFX” Association, the run is charitable and promotes sporting activity accessible to everyone, regardless of age or fitness level. The course takes participants through the scenic areas of the Chełm Hills, offering a chance to connect with nature and spend time together outdoors. The event is part of the local running calendar and aims to build Koszalin’s sporting community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Chełm Hills
Scenic views and contact with nature
Accessible to runners of different ability levels
additional: The organizer is the Sport, Recreation and Volunteering “SFX” Association, based in Koszalin. The event is charitable and brings people together. There is no entry fee; participation is free. Organizer contact by phone: Michał Bieliński +48 696 137 257 (does not respond to SMS). Proceeds were intended to support the establishment of the Zakład Aktywności Zawodowej z Miłością in Koszalin.

name: IV Wielkoocki Bieg
location: Zespół Szkolno-Przedszkolny, ul. Leśna 13, Wielkie Oczy, Poland
organizer: Gmina Wielkie Oczy, Stowarzyszenie Centrum Inicjatyw Społecznych „Terra Nostra” oraz Centrum Kultury w Wielkich Oczach
description: The 4th Wielkie Oczy Run and Nordic Walking event promotes an active, healthy lifestyle and participant integration. It is organized by the Wielkie Oczy Municipality together with the “Terra Nostra” Center for Social Initiatives Association and the Cultural Center in Wielkie Oczy. The courses run mainly on asphalt and forest roads, and may be changed depending on weather conditions. After the competition, the organizers invite participants to a get-together around a campfire, with food and drinks. Participants can expect electronic timing, a race bib with a chip, a medal, and a hot meal after the run.
course_highlights: 10 km run course — one loop, mainly on asphalt and forest roads
6 km Nordic Walking course — one loop
Water refreshment points on the run and Nordic Walking courses
additional: Capacity: 100 participants for the run and 50 for Nordic Walking. Start and finish at the School and Preschool Complex in Wielkie Oczy, ul. Leśna 13. The time limit for completing the run is 2 hours (until 12:00). Participants must sign a declaration stating that they are taking part at their own risk. The race bib with chip must be worn in a visible place, and the chip must be returned after finishing the event. After the event, there will be a get-together around a campfire, with food and drinks. Overall and age-group classifications for women and men, as well as Nordic Walking. Awards: a commemorative medal for every participant who finishes, and trophies for the top finishers in the classifications. Start and finish at the School and Preschool Complex in Wielkie Oczy, ul. Leśna 13. The announced edition had a limit of 100 participants in the run and 50 in Nordic Walking; the fee was payable online.

name: Kresowe Trail #3
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate off-road races organized by the Kresowe Maratony Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The event brings together passion, competition, and friendship, offering courses of varying lengths for both beginners and experienced runners. The races are held with respect for local communities and the natural environment, and participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a generous race pack. The course in Tykocin passes through scenic areas, and the time limit for completing the distances is 2 hours and 15 minutes.
course_highlights: Off-road courses marked with colored arrows (green on a yellow background for Szpurt; red and purple for Wertep)
On-course aid stations for the Wertep distance
Scenic areas of eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities
additional: The race pack includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, a free race bib with a chip valid for the entire season, Medival medical support, an aid station at the finish and on the course (for Wertep), a carefully marked course, awards for the top athletes in age categories, points toward the series’ overall standings, a commemorative medal (for online registration at least 10 days before the event), and photography services. Littering is strictly prohibited; gel and bar wrappers may be left in the aid-station area. A fee of 30 PLN applies if a race bib is lost or changed. The 2026 edition will also feature Nordic walking and competitions for children and cyclists.

name: Ksawerowska Piątka
description: Join the first-ever Ksawerowska Piątka Run, taking place on April 25, 2027, in Ksawerów. The certified course runs along the streets of the Ksawerów Municipality, offering a great opportunity to set personal records. The event is organized by Fitness Klub Shape from Ksawerów, which will provide a unique atmosphere, plenty of attractions, activities for children, and a family gathering picnic. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Head of the Ksawerów Municipality, and participants can look forward to attractive race packages and prizes.
course_highlights: The course is certified
The run takes place along the streets of the Ksawerów Municipality
The organizer will provide activities for children and a community picnic
additional: The first 100 people to register will receive a ticket to Helios cinema in Pabianice. Plans include coaching and nutrition advice, as well as prizes for the winners and the two fastest residents of Ksawerów. The event also includes children's races.

name: Półmaraton Koło
description: Koło Half Marathon is the fifth edition of the race, taking place on April 25, 2027, at Park 600-lecia in Koło. The course is exceptionally flat and fast, with just 19 metres of elevation gain over the full distance, making it ideal for setting new personal bests. Alongside the half marathon, the 4 km Debutant Run is also held, for both beginners and anyone looking for a short, fast race. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and the organizers provide well-stocked race packs.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course with 19 metres of elevation gain
PZLA-certified course, certification valid until 2029
Start and finish at Park 600-lecia in Koło
additional: The race office is open on April 24 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on April 25 from 08:30 to 10:00 at the MOSiR Stadium in Koło, ul. Sportowa 12. The Debutant Run starts at 11:05, and the Half Marathon starts at 11:00. The winners’ awards ceremony is at 14:00. Entry limits: 700 for the half marathon and 150 for the Debutant Run. Every participant will receive a medal and a race pack. The half marathon has a 3-hour time limit; water stations are located along the course. The event is co-organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Koło. The Debutant Run has a separate entry limit of 150.

name: VI Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 6th Charity Run in Kartuzy is a sporting event held as part of the “Fields of Hope” campaign, aimed at supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. The run takes place on April 26 and is part of a family fair packed with attractions for participants of all ages. Proceeds from the run will go toward the hospice’s operations, underscoring the charitable nature of the event. It brings together sport, fun, and support for those in need, engaging the local community.
course_highlights: A charity run supporting the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice
A family fair with attractions for all age groups
The event takes place on the sports field at ZSO No. 2 in Kartuzy
additional: The run is part of the larger “Fields of Hope” event, which also includes a concert by the band GIS, a raffle, activities for children, a bicycle rally, and a motorcycle gathering with a blessing. An NFZ mammobus offering mammography screenings and an NFZ educational stand will be available on site. Proceeds from the run will support the Kartuzy DOM NADZIEI Hospice. Running calendars list April 26, 2027, as an approximate date, one day later than the date in the metadata.

name: XI Cross Szalonego Kurpsia
description: The 11th Cross Szalonego Kurpsia is an open running event and Nordic walking race held on the Narew River Meadows in Ostrołęka. The event offers varied routes suited to different ability levels, including 5 km and 10 km races, a 5 km Nordic walking race, and races for children and young people over 500 m and 2 km. The event stands out for its regional atmosphere, with a folk dance performance and refreshments for participants. It is organized by the “Arkadia” Association for the Promotion of Health and Sobriety and takes place under the honorary patronage of the city authorities, in partnership with the Masovian Voivodeship local government.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking routes on the Narew River Meadows
A regional atmosphere featuring the “Lelisioki” folk dance group
Routes suited to different age groups and ability levels
additional: Starts take place in waves: children’s 500 m race at 11:15, youth 2 km race at 11:30, and the main 5 km and 10 km races and 5 km Nordic walking race at 12:00. Participants can collect their race packs before the event. An awards ceremony and post-race refreshments are planned. The event takes place at the entrance from Obozowa Street on the Narew River Meadows. In the previous edition, registration was conducted online through dostartu.pl.

name: XII Bieg nad Tanwią
description: The 12th edition of the Run by the Tanew is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Cultural Center in Susiec. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Susiec, giving participants an opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. The event is local in character and provides an opportunity to bring the community together and promote a healthy lifestyle.

name: XX Wojewódzki Bieg Przełajowy
location: Stadion Gminny, ul. Sportowa 37, Linia, Poland
description: The 20th Voivodeship Cross-Country Race through the Kashubian Landscape Park in Linia is a jubilee edition of the event, held at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street. The program includes races for children and young people, a local government officials’ race, a competition for people with disabilities, and an open 10 km race. Participants can also take part in the “Na Szlaku Kaszëb” Nordic Walking march.
course_highlights: A cross-country race through the Kashubian Landscape Park
An open race over 10 km
Various distances for children and young people, from 200 m to 3,200 m
additional: The event takes place at the municipal stadium at 37 Sportowa Street in Linia.

name: XXX Biegi Lewarta
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Lubartowie we współpracy ze Stowarzyszeniem Aktywny Lubartów
description: The XXX International Lewart Runs are a jubilee edition of national running races held in Lubartów. The event takes place under the patronage of the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Lubartów, which has supported the development of sport and recreation in the region for many years. The races attract competitors from across the country and offer sporting competition on scenic routes. They are a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the running community together.
course_highlights: Main race over a distance of 5 km
PZLA-certified course through the streets of Lubartów
In the previous edition, the route ran along Lubelska, Cicha, 1 Maja and Piaskowa streets
additional: The previous edition’s program also included the Little Kids’ Run and youth races.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp is a fast and enjoyable spring race held in central Bålsta, starting and finishing at Gröna Dalens IP. The race has grown steadily since it began in 2019 and is known as a PB course, where many runners beat their previous records. The course is a 5 km loop that can be run once or twice, with 99% asphalt and a finish on an athletics track. The event is marked by speed, joy and community, and welcomes runners of all ages and categories.
course_highlights: 5 km loop in central Bålsta, finishing at Gröna Dalens IP
99% asphalt, with a finish on an athletics track
Fast course with a small incline removed to make even faster times possible
additional: Bib collection starts at 08:00 outside Gröna Dalens IP. Start times are 09:30 for 5 km and 10:45 for 10 km. Runners self-seed at the start to reduce congestion. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the start, subject to availability. There is a bag drop and limited changing facilities. Take the commuter train to Bålsta station, within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking areas are nearby. Badhusvägen is closed to traffic on race day. Registration is open. The sports drink served in the cups is Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Landsjön runt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km GRATIS

description: Landsjön Runt is a traditional road race organized by IK Vista since 1982 in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. The event offers several distances for the whole family, from a children’s race and obstacle course to 5.5 km and 12.5 km in scenic surroundings around the lake. The start and finish are at Vistavallen, and the course runs clockwise around the lake, with the climbs in the first half. Participants can enjoy music and refreshments along the way for a great running experience. There are also team competitions and awards for youth and Fun Run participants.
course_highlights: The course runs clockwise around Landsjön, with climbs in the first half
The start is on the grass field and the finish is on the running track at Vistavallen
Scenic surroundings, with the course running beside the waters of Landsjön
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vistavallen on the Saturday before the event, between 14:00 and 16:00. IK Vista members can participate for free if they register by 18/4. A team competition for teams of four is available for the 5.5 km and 12.5 km races. Each team’s total time is recorded, and teams receive a bag of treats. The children’s race for ages 0–6, approximately 500 m, starts at 12:00. The Vista FUN RUN obstacle course, approximately 1 km, starts at 12:20, with an awards ceremony afterward. Recommended parking is at Vistavallen or Hunnerydsbadet; use of public transport is encouraged. The race has been held annually since 1982.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://landsjonrunt.se/): 2027-04-25 — "25 April 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-25)

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet Trail is organized by Huddinge AIS at Källbrinks IP and offers 7 and 17 km of running in Gömmarskogen. The courses mainly follow narrow forest trails and follow Gömmaren’s yellow trail for 7 km and black-and-white trail for 17 km. Expect some technical terrain with rocks, roots and steep hills, mixed with scenic sections. The race is for anyone looking to challenge themselves on the trails, whether running, jogging or moving at their own pace.
course_highlights: The 7 km course follows Gömmaren’s yellow trail, called Sparven.
The 17 km course follows Gömmaren’s black-and-white trail, called Skatan.
Mostly narrow forest trails with technical sections, rocks, roots and steep hills.
additional: Start and finish at Källbrinks IP. The courses are stated to be approximately 5% longer or shorter than the indicated distance.

name: Orion Trail
description: Orion Trail is a beautiful running race in the scenic Ådalen valley in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona, where participants run along trails beside a winding stream. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-road sections, gravel roads and asphalt, as well as a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km race consists of two laps of the course. The youngest participants can take part in a 500- or 1,000-metre children’s race. All participants receive a medal, a drink and a bun, and showers and refreshments are available at the finish. Orion Trail is part of Oriondagen, a family-friendly day with activities in nature.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5,000 metres long, including 3,700 metres of trails and off-road terrain
The route follows the scenic Ådalen valley beside a winding stream and a waterfall
The children’s race is 500 or 1,000 metres, with the option of running one or two laps
additional: The start and finish are at Orionstugan in Jämjö, with parking in the designated area. Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 on race day. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, a drink and a bun. Showers and changing facilities are available. Refreshments, including grilled sausages, hamburgers, cakes and coffee, are on offer. Entries can be made on site up to 30 minutes before the start. Oriondagen runs from 10:00 to 13:00 and includes several family activities, with drop-in participation. Start times: 5 km and 10 km at 10:30; children’s race at 12:00. The race can be completed by running or walking.

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
description: Strömsnäs Trailrun is a wonderful trail race held in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd. The races mainly follow trails and forest roads, with some sections of rough terrain, offering a nature-filled and challenging running experience. The event is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and welcomes runners in various categories, with honorary prizes and medals for everyone who finishes. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk, and the organiser SK Graal looks forward to welcoming participants for a great day in their running shoes.
course_highlights: Run on trails, forest roads and rough terrain
Scenic forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd
Start and finish at Graalstugan
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race bib, which must be returned at the finish. The prize-giving ceremony is at approximately 12:30, with honorary prizes for places 1–3 in each category and prizes awarded by draw. All finishers receive a medal. Changing facilities and showers are available, with limited space. A cafeteria is located by the finish area. Late registration is available on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before the start, with an additional fee of 60 kr. Clubs can be invoiced when registering more than three participants. Timing is electronic, and participants who finish receive a medal, according to the 2026 information.

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run is a trail race held on Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, with the start and finish at Fisksjöäng. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting at 11:00 and 12:00, respectively. The course offers a wonderful experience in nature, with varied terrain, and is easy to reach by public transport. The event is open to young people aged 11 and over when accompanied by a parent or guardian, and has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. All participants receive a medal, refreshments along the course and race timing with a bib.
course_highlights: Trail running on Norra Djurgården through varied natural scenery
Start and finish at Fisksjöäng, near Ropsten metro station
Refreshment stations along the course and chip timing
additional: The start and finish are at Fisksjöäng, a 10-minute walk from Ropsten metro station. Bibs can be collected the Friday before the race at the Icebug store in Stockholm or at the venue on race day. The bib is personal and must be worn visibly on the chest, with the chip unfolded. A medal, refreshments along the course, finish-line services and race timing are included. Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the start. Participants receive a discount on Icebug running shoes. A bib with race timing, refreshments along the course, a medal and finish-line services are included. The price information applies to the price periods listed on the organizer’s website and may refer to an edition other than 2027.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Den 26 april 2026 kan du ta dig an terrängen på Norra Djurgården

name: Cytadela by Night # 114
description: Cytadela by Night 2.0 is a series of free, timed 5 km runs held in Cytadela Park in Poznań. The event attracts runners who want to enjoy the outdoors and the charm of the park in the evening. The run is recreational and open to a wide range of participants, promoting a healthy lifestyle and friendly sporting competition. It is well known in the local community and popular with Poznań residents.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km distance
The route runs through scenic Cytadela Park
An evening run in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run is free and takes place regularly. Timing is provided during the run.

name: Twardziel Świętokrzyski
location: Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Strawczynku, Strawczynek, Poland
description: The “Twardziel Świętokrzyski” Supermarathon is an extreme hiking marathon covering approximately 100 km in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. The route follows the Edmund Massalski red hiking trail for 90% of its length, with the start and finish at the Culture and Sports Centre in Strawczynek. Participants must be in very good hiking condition and prepared to complete the route within 23 hours, with a one-hour extension possible in exceptional circumstances. Checkpoints along the route offer opportunities to replenish supplies and rest. The event is organized by the University of Applied Sciences in Kielce and local cultural and sports institutions.
course_highlights: 90% of the route follows the Edmund Massalski red hiking trail
Checkpoints in Masłów, Tumlin, and Scholasteria offering a hot meal and drinks
A scenic observation tower on Mount Siniewska and a route through the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
additional: Participants must carry a mobile phone, a map of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains at a scale of at least 1:75,000, lighting for the night section (a headlamp or flashlight), and reflective elements on their clothing. The pace on the night section should be adjusted to the checkpoints’ opening hours. Participants must notify the organizers if they withdraw from the route. The time limit is 23 hours, with a one-hour extension possible in exceptional cases. Participation is open to adults; registration is online.

name: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė
description: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė yra unikalios ištvermės varžybos Alytuje, Dailidės ežero apylinkėse. Šis renginys kviečia bėgikus išbandyti savo ribas, bėgant Backyard ultra formato trasą, kuri padeda lengviau įveikti 100 mylių atstumą. Varžybose nugalėtojas bus tik vienas, o iššūkis yra didelis - lengva atrodo tik iki tam tikro momento. Tai puiki galimybė patirti tikrą ištvermės bėgimo dvasią ir garbingai užsitarnauti DNF statusą.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.trailokalve.lt): 2027-04-30 — "SwampMan Backyard ultra 7 by Trailo Kalvė 04-30, pn Alytus" (was estimated 2027-05-07)
