name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“ kviečia dalyvius gegužės 7 dieną aktyviai praleisti laiką nuostabaus grožio Anykščių kraštovaizdyje. Bėgimo trasos ilgis ir sudėtingumas pritaikyti įvairaus amžiaus ir fizinio pasirengimo dalyviams, nuo vaikų pramoginio bėgimo iki 11 km ištvermingiesiems. Renginys yra seniausias Lietuvoje ir garsėja savo tradicija bei draugiška atmosfera, kuri pritraukia sporto entuziastus iš visos šalies. Dalyviai bus apdovanoti atminimo medaliais, o greičiausieji 11 km distancijoje - piniginiais prizais.
course_highlights: Vaizdinga trasa Anykščių kraštovaizdyje, besidriekiančioje Antano Baranausko apdainuotame Anykščių šilelyje
Skirtingos distancijos: nuo 300 m vaikams iki 11 km ištvermingiesiems
Startas šalia Angelų muziejaus, Anykščiuose
additional: Startai pagal amžiaus grupes: 10:30 val. - vaikų pramoginis bėgimas „Puntukėlis“; 11:30 val. - 3 km distancija; 11:50 val. - varžybų atidarymas; 12:00 val. - 6 km ir 11 km distancijos. Registracija vykdoma tik iki balandžio 28 d. 12:00 val., bėgimo dieną registracija nevyks. Dalyviai, pasiekę finišą, gaus atminimo medalius. Greičiausieji 11 km distancijoje apdovanojami piniginiais prizais. Dalyviams siūloma išankstinė registracija, galimybė atgauti jėgas po varžybų baseine ir pirčių komplekse, prizai ir nuolaidos, įvairios amžiaus grupės

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Girulių miško takais Klaipėdoje. Renginyje gali dalyvauti tiek mėgėjai, tiek profesionalai, skatinantys sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Trasos ilgis svyruoja nuo 2 km moksleiviams iki 42,2 km ekomaratono dalyviams, kurie bėga 10 ratų po 4,2 km. Renginys organizuojamas Klaipėdos miesto bėgikų klubo „Maratonas“ ir remiamas Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės.
course_highlights: Ekomaratono trasa - 10 ratų po 4,2 km Girulių miško takais
Moksleivių trasa - 2 km (1 km pirmyn, 1 km atgal)
Startas Girulių miške, dviračių takelio pradžioje už Vasaros Estrados
additional: Varžybų dieną laiko matavimo sistema veikia iki 15:00 val. Dalyvio starto mokestis mokamas vietoje atsiimant numerį. Pirmieji 300 dalyvių gauna atminimo medalius, visi dalyviai - pažymėjimus. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio organizatoriai gali naudoti renginio metu darytas nuotraukas ir filmuotą medžiagą rinkodaros tikslais. 4,2 km ir 42,2 km distancijos, moksleivių 2 km, startas Girulių miške, registracija internetu iki balandžio 30 d.

name: 12 Półmaraton Grudziądz-Rulewo
organizer: Gmina Miasto Grudziądz, Miejski Ośrodek Rekreacji i Wypoczynku w Grudziądzu
description: The 12th Grudziądz-Rulewo Half Marathon in the Footsteps of Bronisław Malinowski is a race with a unique character, deeply rooted in the history of the city and the life of its namesake, Olympic champion Bronisław Malinowski. The course passes places connected with Bronisław’s life and training, starting at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium, crossing the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge, and finishing at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo. The race combines a passion for sport with the memory of an outstanding athlete, offering participants an exciting experience and a sporting spirit that unites generations. The event takes place on the first weekend of May, and participants can look forward to a varied accompanying program and organizational support.
course_highlights: The course passes historic places connected with Bronisław Malinowski, including the Bronisław Malinowski Bridge in Grudziądz
Start at the Olimpia Grudziądz stadium; finish at Hanza Pałac Hotel in Rulewo
A course with varied surfaces, aid stations every 5 km, and markers every 1 km
additional: The race office is open on April 30 (16:00–20:00) at Marina Grudziądz and on May 1 (8:00–10:30) at the Olimpia stadium. The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours; the course closes at 14:00. There are at least 3 aid stations on the course (water, isotonic drink, fruit). After the race, participants receive a medal and diploma and can enjoy a recovery meal, massages from physiotherapists, and free MZK bus transport for runners. On race day, warm-ups are led by Fit House instructors. Children can take part in the accompanying “Be Like Bronek” races. Information for the 12th edition lists the race office at Marina Grudziądz and at the GKS Olimpia Stadium.

name: Sianowska Dyszka
organizer: Fundacja Zastopuj Sportowiec.info oraz Gmina i Miasto Sianów

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Wpisowe to wśród dorosłych 40 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Wpisowe wśród dzieci to 20 zł do 02.12.2026 r.

description: Sianowska Dyszka is a 10-kilometre race and part of a series of five races held in Sianów. The event promotes running as a natural form of physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the scenic running routes of the Sianów municipality. The races count towards the overall RUNking of Runners standings, which are summed up at the Runners’ Gala. The event is open to adults and children, with separate children’s races over shorter distances.
course_highlights: A 10 km race as part of the Sianowska Dyszka series
Scenic running routes in the Sianów municipality
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres
additional: Race packs can be collected from 9:30 to 10:45. Children’s races start between 11:00 and 11:30 over distances from 100 to 1,000 metres. A total of 120 medals have been prepared for participants. Prizes will be awarded to the three fastest women and men. Participants must register and verify their identity at the Race Office by presenting an identity document, and sign a declaration confirming that they are familiar with the regulations. Results from the Sianowska race series count towards the overall standings, which are summed up at the RUNking Runners’ Gala.

name: VIII Rydzewski przełaj - bieg dla trzeźw...
description: The VIII Rydzewski Cross-Country Run promotes a healthy lifestyle, sobriety, and running as a form of physical recreation. The event takes place on the sports field in Rydzewo and is open to everyone, regardless of age, gender, or place of residence. The organizers emphasize fair play and compliance with PZLA regulations. Participants run a cross-country course and discover the scenic and tourist attractions of the Miastkowo municipality. The run is co-funded by the Miastkowo Municipality from funds for preventing alcohol-related problems and also aims to promote local villages.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on the sports field in Rydzewo
Course showcasing the scenic and tourist attractions of the Miastkowo municipality
Open competition for children, young people, and adults, held in the spirit of fair play
additional: Start and finish on the sports field in Rydzewo. Race office opens at 13:00; group warm-up at 14:30; results announcement and awards ceremony at 16:30; event ends at 18:00. Participant limit: 100. Registration is under the participant’s full name via the website. Minors need written consent from a parent/guardian and must sign a declaration stating that they have no contraindications to taking part. On-the-day registration is possible from 13:00 to 14:30 if places remain available. Details for this date have not been confirmed in the available materials. In the edition described on the registration website, the event began at 13:00 and the run at 15:00; the limit was 100 participants.

name: X Półmaraton Doliną Rospudy
location: Filipów, Suwałki County, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Aktywni Znad Rospudy, we współpracy z gminami Bakałarzewo i Filipów
description: The 8th Rospuda Valley Half Marathon takes place in the scenic Rospuda Valley and is organized by the Aktywni Znad Rospudy Association. The half-marathon course is 21.0975 km long and 100% paved, providing comfortable running conditions. The start and finish are at the Filipów Municipal Office. Participants can expect refreshment stations and a race package with a technical shirt and drinks. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raising awareness about the fight against harmful addictions.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is 100% paved
Refreshment stations approximately every 4 km (5 stations on the course)
Start and finish at the Filipów Municipal Office, 2 Garbaska Street
additional: The time limit for completing the course is 3 hours. Participant check-in and bib distribution take place on race day from 9:00 to 11:30 at the Filipów Municipal Office. Participants receive a race package with a personalized bib, chip, technical shirt or promotional item, and drinks on the course and at the finish. The course is marked every 1 km, with checkpoints in place. Participants must be over 18. Electronic timing is used. The accompanying Filipów Jaćwing Run is 12.5 km long. Information about the course, organizer, and registration comes from previous editions.

name: XI Bieg o Strzałę Widanta
location: Park Miejski w Resku, Resko, Poland
description: The 11th Widant’s Arrow Run is an annual running event held in Resko Municipal Park. The competition includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through the park and nearby forests along the Rega River, on natural, gravel, and paved surfaces. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, and outdoor recreation for runners and enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course through Resko Municipal Park and nearby forests along the Rega River
Natural, gravel, and paved surfaces
Two laps for the 10 km race and one lap for the 5 km race and Nordic walking event
additional: Children’s and youth races take place from 10:00 in the Municipal Park area by Górka Borków. A professional warm-up is held by the park stage at 11:45, before the races. Participants over 70 are entitled to free entry after registering. In the previous edition, the start and finish were in Resko Municipal Park; the programme also included children’s and youth races. Wierzbicki Running Project was a co-organizer.

name: XIII Dycha po Piachu
description: Dycha po Piachu is a race held in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality. The 13th edition is scheduled for April 30, 2027. The event’s name refers to the sandy nature of the course and the local landscape. It is an option for runners looking to race in a coastal area.
course_highlights: Start in Czołpino, in the Smołdzino municipality
The event’s name suggests the race has a sandy character
Course in a coastal area

name: XXII Półmaraton Chełmżyński Chełmżyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 22nd Chełmża Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Chełmża, attracting runners from various regions. The half-marathon course runs through scenic areas of the town and its surroundings, offering participants attractive views and sporting challenges. The event is open to all and promotes an active lifestyle and integration within the local community. The organizers provide professional support and an atmosphere suited to both competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through central Chełmża and the surrounding areas
Scenic views and varied terrain
A well-marked and secured course

name: Risenloppet
location: Ekevallens idrottsplats, Genarp, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: RISEN-loppet is an annual running race organized by Genarps IF, starting and finishing at Ekevallen sports ground in Genarp. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10.7 km. The 5 km route runs mostly on asphalt through the village, while the 10.7 km route splits between the village and Risen Nature Reserve. The course is challenging, with tough elevation changes, and the race is part of Skånes VeteranCup. Participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug at the finish. There are water stations along the course, and an awards ceremony takes place after the race.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is 95% asphalt and 5% nature trail through the village
The 10.7 km course runs 50% through the village and 50% in Risen Nature Reserve
Tough elevation changes on both distances
additional: Electronic timing with gun time from the start signal. Bibs must be collected on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly on the chest. Water and energy (water and cordial) are available at 3 and 8 km. At the finish, water, cordial, recovery drink (Gatorade), and bananas are available. Rådjursloppet, a 700 m race for children up to age 9, starts at 12:15. All participants receive a medal, and registration is on site at no charge. On-site late registration is available for an additional fee of 100 SEK via Swish. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30 after the children's race. All participants receive a RISEN-loppet mug; gold mugs go to approximately the first 25% of finishers in each distance, and silver mugs to the others. A children's race of approximately 700 metres is also offered. Previous editions have started and finished at Ekevallen sports ground.

name: Vilnius trail run 2026
distance_verbose: 109 km, 108 km, 73 km, 70 km, Maratonas, 22 km, Pusmaratonas, 15 km, 4 km, 1.8 km
description: Vilnius Trail Run 2027 kviečia bėgikus patirti unikalią trasų įvairovę Vilniaus gamtoje ir miesto aplinkoje. Renginys siūlo maršrutus nuo pradedančiųjų 15+ km iki iššūkių kupinos 108 km trasos aplink Vilnių. Dalyviai galės mėgautis įvairiu reljefu, įskaitant miško takus, kalnų kelius ir vaizdingas apžvalgos vietas, kurios suteiks nepakartojamų Lietuvos kraštovaizdžio vaizdų. Tai puiki proga išbandyti savo ištvermę ir pažinti miesto gamtą bei kultūrą bėgimo metu.
course_highlights: Unikalūs maršrutai Vilniuje nuo 15+ km iki 108 km
Įvairus reljefas: miško takai, kalnų keliai
Vaizdingos apžvalgos vietos su Lietuvos kraštovaizdžio vaizdais
additional: Renginys vyksta Kalnų parko stadione, T. Kosciuškos g. 5, Vilnius. Dalyvių skaičius viršija 1000. Organizatorius VšĮ, adresas Balžio g. 21C-5, Vilnius, telefonas +370 610 24484. Renginyje siūlomos trasos apima miško takus, kalnų keliukus ir vaizdingas apžvalgas; dalyviai gali pasirinkti iš įvairių distancijų ir amžiaus grupių, įskaitant ultramaratoną ir vaikų bėgimus.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: Vilniaus Pavasario Maratonas kviečia bėgikus visų lygių išbandyti savo jėgas pavasario ritmu Vilniaus Vingio parke. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo 600 m vaikams iki klasikinio maratono 42,195 km, taip pat pusmaratonį ir trumpesnius bėgimus. Tai puiki proga pradėti bėgimo sezoną gamtos apsuptyje, judant per miestą ir parkus, mėgaujantis pavasario atgimimu. Renginys organizuojamas su dideliu dėmesiu visų dalyvių patirčiai ir skatina aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Vingio parko estradoje
Bėgimas per Vilniaus miesto parkus ir gatves
Distancijos nuo 600 m vaikams iki 42,195 km maratonui
additional: Vingio parko estradoje. Distancijos: 42,195 km, 21,098 km, 10,6 km, 5,3 km ir 600 m vaikams. Nuostatai skelbiami https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registracija vykdoma per https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. Renginyje siūlomos įvairios distancijos, įskaitant vaikų ir jaunimo bėgimus, taip pat galimybė dalyvauti su draudimu. Registracija vyksta per myrace.lt.

name: Ropažu novada RETRO skriešanas svētki
location: Vecā Kangaru stacija, Ropaži Municipality, Latvia
description: The Ropaži Municipality Retro Running Festival is an annual sporting event held on 1 May near Kangari Station. The festival invites everyone to take part and spend the holiday actively, enjoying running and a sense of community. The event is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a sporting atmosphere in the municipality.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Old Kangari Station
Various distance options for all age groups
A friendly, festive atmosphere with a retro theme
additional: The event runs from 9:00 to 14:30, offering a range of activities and opportunities for all participants. No registration fees or direct registration links are listed. The organizers encourage people to follow updates on the municipality’s website.

name: Skrējiensoļojums Rīga-Valmiera
description: The Rīga–Valmiera ultramarathon is an epic 107 km charity trail-running race held every year in early May. The race starts in Rīga and follows a route to Valmiera, offering participants a challenge and an opportunity to push their limits. The race has become a tradition, bringing together professional trail runners and enthusiasts, and is closely connected to Latvia’s national history and sporting community. The event also provides significant support to the Latvian trail-running team and serves as a platform for charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: A 107 km trail from Rīga to Valmiera
A route known for record-setting and challenges for trail runners
Starts on Latvia’s Proclamation Day, with a precise course record time
additional: The race starts on Latvia’s Proclamation Day, and the precise course record time is 7:30:49. The race is charitable in nature and supports the Latvian trail-running team. Participant numbers are record-breaking, and the route is known for its challenges and record-setting.

name: 42 Chojnickie Biegi Strażackie
description: The Chojnice Firefighters’ Run is a traditional 10 km road race held in Chojnice since 1985. The event is open to all running enthusiasts, not just firefighters. It takes place annually in early May and attracts runners from a variety of backgrounds. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and the event’s atmosphere highlights sporting competition and local community spirit.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race
A tradition dating back to 1985
Open to everyone, not just firefighters
additional: More than 200 people took part in the race in 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce
location: Geonatura Kielce – Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014, focused on promoting the sport and the scenic appeal of its courses. The event takes place in the picturesque Botanical Garden in Kielce, offering participants a unique experience on a route full of natural charm. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and stay active in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Botanical Garden in Kielce
Picturesque natural surroundings
Race organized by experienced running enthusiasts since 2014
additional: Location: Geonatura Kielce - Botanical Garden, ul. Jagiellońska 78, Kielce.

name: XII Bieg Flagi
location: Park Kępa Potocka, Żoliborz, Warsaw, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za udział w XII Biegu Flagi na dystansie 5 lub 10 km to 50 złotych.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Biegi dla dzieci 0-12 lat na dystansach 200, 400 i 800 metrów są bezpłatne.

description: The 12th Flag Run is an annual race held in Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw to commemorate the Day of the Flag of the Republic of Poland. The route runs through the picturesque park, giving participants the opportunity to celebrate Polish identity and national symbols through sport. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, as well as shorter races for children, creating a family-friendly and patriotic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through Kępa Potocka Park in Warsaw
5 km: one lap; 10 km: two laps
Children’s races over 200, 400 and 800 metres in the central part of the park
additional: The adult race route is a 5 km loop through the park; the 10 km race consists of two laps. Children’s races take place over shorter distances in the central part of the park. The organizer is the Żoliborz District Office of the Capital City of Warsaw.

name: XIX Półmaraton Węgorza
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Węgorzewie
description: The 19th Węgorzewo Half Marathon is one of the most important sporting events promoting the Masurian Lake District and active recreation. The race follows a scenic route, much of it running alongside the most beautiful Masurian lakes. The start and finish are at Freedom Square in Węgorzewo, where numerous accompanying events are also held. The event attracts around 1,500 participants and spectators, combining sporting competition with an appealing cultural and tourism program.
course_highlights: The route runs alongside the most beautiful Masurian lakes
Views of the Węgorzewo Canal and the Ekomarina
Passes through Ruska Wieś, with views of the Węgorapa Valley, and includes gravel sections along Lake Mamry
additional: The route includes urban sections, a promenade with an observation tower, stretches alongside the Węgorapa River and the Węgorzewo Canal, a loop around the old inland shipping port, a bridge on provincial road no. 650, as well as gravel sections and part of the Green Velo cycling trail. The event also features the 7 km White-and-Red Flag Run and the children’s May races, “Mazury: A Wonder of Nature.” The event also features the 7 km White-and-Red Flag Run and children’s races.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultrarunning event where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are available during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with especially fine medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara at bib collection. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen, and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at every lap. There is a team competition where the three best results from each club count, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with the race officials. The race is fully booked. There is also a team competition and Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent spaces are arranged in consultation with the race officials; a small number of motorhome spaces are available, but they do not have electricity.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultramarathon held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosaån river. The goal is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour per lap. Participants who complete a lap can start again at the beginning of the next hour. It is a festive, social competition with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the race. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and lovely medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosaån river
An easy, flat course suited to completing many laps
A 700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free silicone cup from Umara when collecting their race numbers. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, as well as sandwiches and sweets, is served at every lap turnaround. The team competition counts the three best results from each club. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is fully booked. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.trosaultrabackyard.se/): 2027-05-01 — "1 maj, kl. 10.00 2027 – Loppet är fullt!" (was estimated 2027-05-01)

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2027 in Strandbjörket, Växjö. This is a running festival for the whole family, with distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.1 km), as well as Lilla Växjöloppet for younger runners. The courses offer a scenic running experience featuring asphalt, forest roads and beautiful views around Lake Växjö and the Bokhultet Nature Reserve. Växjöloppet is a traditional, friendly race that puts the joy of exercise and community at its heart.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strandbjörket, with the first kilometre on asphalt
A scenic route through the Bokhultet Nature Reserve, mostly among deciduous trees
The final 3.5 km on asphalt around Lake Växjö, with a shared finish on Lagunvallen
additional: There are water stations on the 10 km course (4 stations) and the 21.1 km course (8 stations). Lilla Växjöloppet offers four different distances for younger runners, with no timing. Participants receive a race bib, medal and fruit, or a T-shirt and certificate, depending on the distance. The finish line is on Lagunvallen, approximately 300–400 metres from the finish at Strandbjörket. Lilla Växjöloppet is not timed. Registration and payment for the children’s races take place on site at Lagunen in Strandbjörket.

name: Porkkala Coast Trail
description: Porkkala Coast Trail kicks off the trail-running season in the stunning surroundings of Porkkalanniemi, Kirkkonummi. The route winds through varied coastal terrain, with twisting trails, old spruce forests, impressive coastal cliffs and beautiful sea views. The race venue is Porkkala Marina, and runners can choose between two distances: 8 km or 14 km. The event offers a well-marked course, water stations, first aid, a race souvenir and raffle prizes.
course_highlights: A varied route across rocky terrain, through spruce forests and along the water’s edge
Twisting trails and old spruce forests
Impressive coastal cliffs and sea views
additional: On race day, a bus departs from Tolsa station at 9:30, with a return transfer at 14:00. The race office opens at 9:30, and race bibs must be collected by 10:30 at the latest. Late registration is available at the race office from 9:30 to 10:30. The entry fee includes timing, results service, water stations, first aid, gear storage and a race souvenir. There is a sales stand at the venue, and the restaurant offers an affordable race-day lunch. Entries can be transferred for a transfer fee. In case of illness, entry can be transferred to the following year with a doctor’s note. The event centre is at Porkkala Marina.

name: Ritma skrējiens Liepājā
description: “Ritma skrējiens” in Liepāja invites everyone to run at their own pace—fast or slow, with a smile or in a competitive spirit. The event brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels, offering several distances, including children’s races. The race starts at Daugava Stadium, and the atmosphere is complemented by music, positive energy, and the joy of being together.
course_highlights: The start is at Daugava Stadium in Liepāja.
The course passes through Liepāja’s cityscapes and surrounding area.
Previous event descriptions mention distances ranging from children’s races to 21 km.
additional: The event’s motto invites runners to go fast or slow—the main thing is to run at your own rhythm.

name: Apkārt Cēsīm
location: Cēsu Pils parka estrāde, Cēsis, Latvia
organizer: Cēsu novada pašvaldība sadarbībā ar sporta klubu „Ašais”
description: The “Around Cēsis” run is a traditional spring running event held on the streets and in the park of Cēsis, attracting both local and international runners. The competition offers several distances—a children’s run, 5 km and 10 km—with the fastest runners recognized in different age groups and in the team classification. The courses are marked, and the 10 km course is certified, ensuring a professional standard of competition. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raise the profile of Cēsis Municipality as a centre for active living. Participants are provided with electronic timing, commemorative medals and safety along the course.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is certified and marked
A short children’s run takes place in the city park
The competition takes place on the streets of Cēsis and in the city park
additional: Race starts: children’s run at 11:00, 5 km at 11:30, 10 km at 12:15. Race numbers must be attached to the front of the sports shirt with four safety pins. Time limits: 5 km — 40 minutes; 10 km — 1 hour 30 minutes. After the run, physiotherapist massages and consultations are available in a designated tent. In the 10 km team classification, each team consists of 2 men and 1 woman. Team entries must be submitted separately. The event centre is located at the Cēsis Castle Park open-air stage. The 10 km course is certified, and finishers receive a commemorative medal.

name: Ultra Wysoczyzna
description: Ultra Wysoczyzna is a unique trail race held in the scenic Elbląg Upland, featuring five distances of varying difficulty. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the natural attractions of the region. The start and finish for most distances are in Elbląg, except for the 54 km distance, which starts in Tolkmicko. The event takes place on April 16–18, 2027, and attracts runners from across Poland.
course_highlights: Deer’s Roar — 103 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 2,300 m, 17-hour time limit
Wolf’s Howl — 54 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 1,160 m, 10-hour time limit, starts in Tolkmicko
Boar’s Squeal — 22 km, elevation gain/loss +/- 800 m, 5-hour time limit
additional: The start and finish for Deer’s Roar (103 km), Boar’s Squeal (22 km), Fox’s Squeak (13 km) and Owl’s Hoot (6 km) are in Elbląg at 6 Marymoncka Street (Bażantarnia Municipal Park). The 54 km Wolf’s Howl starts in Tolkmicko and finishes in Elbląg. Time limits range from 1.5 hours (6 km) to 17 hours (103 km). The technical briefing is held online on Facebook the day before the start. Bus transport to the 54 km start is available for registered participants who have paid their entry fee. Award ceremonies take place after each distance. The races are held on April 16–18, 2027; the event programme also includes junior races. The 54 km race starts in Tolkmicko.

name: 10 Bieg Króla Eryka
description: The 10th King Eric Run is an annual running event organized by the Darłowskie Charty Running Club in Darłowo. The event features a variety of distances, including races for children and a main race, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. The participant limit is 300 for the main race and 250 for the children’s races. Registration is available online until the end of April or until places are filled. The event has a family-friendly character and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: The course includes different distances suited to participants’ ages and categories
Children’s races range from 200 to 1,200 meters and are divided by birth year and gender
Participant limits: 300 for the main race and 250 for the children’s races
additional: The children’s races are divided into age categories, with distances ranging from 200 m to 1,200 m. In the 2026 edition, the children’s and youth races took place on May 2, and the main race took place on May 3. Entry fees from the children’s races were allocated to charity.

name: 32 Łaskarzewski Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja
location: Krępa to Łaskarzew, Garwolin County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 50 zł (bieg główny w 2026 r.); biegi dziecięce bezpłatne

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za udział w biegu

description: The 32nd Łaskarzew Constitution Day 3 May Run is an annual sporting and patriotic event held on the anniversary of the adoption of the Constitution of 3 May 1791. The 7 km main race runs from Krępa to Łaskarzew and is held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship and the Mayor of Łaskarzew. The event also includes a running picnic for children and young people, with free races over shorter distances. The organizers emphasize participants’ health and sobriety, promoting the slogan “FIT BECAUSE SOBER – SOBER BECAUSE FIT.”
course_highlights: A 7 km main route from Krępa to Łaskarzew
A running picnic for children and young people, with races over 100 m, 400 m and 800 m
An event held under the honorary patronage of local authorities and with a patriotic character
additional: The entry fee is treated as a donation and is non-refundable. Participants must pay within 3 days of registration; otherwise, they will be removed from the start list. The organizer decides the order in which race numbers are assigned. Complaints concerning the start list will not be accepted on race day. Participation in the children’s races is free.

name: 34 Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata na nordic walking jest stała i wynosi 89 złotych.

description: The May 3 Constitution Day Run is an annual, joyful running event held in central Warsaw, combining sport with a patriotic atmosphere and urban energy. Participants cover a 5-kilometre course along some of the capital’s most prestigious streets, starting and finishing at Three Crosses Square. The run is part of the Warsaw Running Triad, “Run for Remembrance,” commemorating important moments in Polish history. In addition to the run, a Nordic walking option is available, allowing people who prefer a more leisurely pace to take part. It is a great opportunity to enjoy an active May holiday in a spirit of community and sporting competition.
course_highlights: A certified 5 km course through central Warsaw
Scenic sections along Ujazdów Avenue, Savior Square and Constitution Square
A fast, visually appealing course that is ideal for chasing personal bests
additional: Participant limit: 6,500 in the running category and 250 in Nordic walking. The time limit for completing the run is 55 minutes. Start and finish at Three Crosses Square. Race packs can be collected on April 30 and May 2, and on race day only by people from outside Warsaw. The medal has space for an engraved time and name; engraving can be purchased. A technical T-shirt can be purchased during registration or by editing an entry. Nordic walking starts in the final wave, allowing participants to maintain a comfortable pace. Results are published online by STS TIMING; Nordic walking and 5 km wheelchair classifications are also available.

name: Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja (Strzyżów)
location: Stadion Miejski w Strzyżowie, Strzyżów, Poland
description: The Constitution of May 3 Run in Strzyżów is an annual sporting event commemorating the adoption of the Constitution of May 3. The competition takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów and includes various distances, including a half marathon, a run of around 10 km, and a Nordic Walking march. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle, the local community, and local culture. It is organized by the Strzyżów Municipality and the Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Strzyżów, together with local partners and patrons.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów
Distances: 21 km half marathon, and a run and Nordic Walking march of around 10 km
Age categories for children and young people, with shorter distances
additional: The race office opens at 11:00 at the Municipal Sports Stadium on 1 Maja Street in Strzyżów. Starts take place in waves: the half marathon at 15:00, the run and Nordic Walking march of around 10 km at 15:10, followed by children’s races over distances from 60 m to 800 m in various age categories. The event is held under the patronage of the Mayor of Strzyżów and the Strzyżów County Head. Previous editions have also included a 10 km run, a 10 km Nordic Walking march, a sprint for adults, and children’s races over various distances. The start and finish are at the Municipal Stadium in Strzyżów.

name: IX Rzekuńska Szybka Dycha
description: The 9th Rzekuń Fast Ten is an annual sporting event in Rzekuń that attracts running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. It is not only a competition, but also a great atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively. The race takes place on a course in Rzekuń, and participants can look forward to excitement and positive energy throughout the event.
course_highlights: Main race over a distance of 10 km
Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races were also held in the previous edition
additional: The event includes a race and a Nordic walking event. The regulations are available on the organizer’s website. Registration is through the dostartu.pl platform. In the previous edition, the Nordic walking event was 5 km, and the children’s and youth races were held over distances of 350 m, 700 m, and 1,050 m.

name: Lidzbarska 10-tka
description: The Lidzbarska 10-tka Running Festival is an annual running event held in Garbuzy Park in Lidzbark Welski. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, which start together. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, with professional organization and timing. The festival atmosphere encourages sporting competition and brings the local community together.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic Garbuzy Park
Two distances to choose from: 5 km and 10 km
Both distances start together at 13:00
additional: The race office opens at 11:00. The participant limit has been reached, and online registration is closed. Residents of the Lidzbark Municipality can take advantage of a special discount by registering in advance. Previous editions included 5 km and 10 km distances.

name: Poznański Bieg Konstytucji
location: Polana Harcerza, POSiR Malta, Poznań, Poland
description: The Poznań Constitution Run is a race held in Poznań to celebrate Constitution Day on May 3. In the 2026 edition, participants could choose between 5 km and 10 km, with the start scheduled at Polana Harcerza near POSiR Malta.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in the 2026 edition
Start and finish at Polana Harcerza
Race in the area around POSiR Malta in Poznań

name: X Bieg Warcki
description: The X Warta Run is an annual running event held at Jutrzenka Stadium in Warta. It attracts entire families, offering 5 km and 10 km races as well as a children’s race. During the event, a special play zone with inflatable slides and obstacle courses is available, making it appealing to participants of all ages. The run combines sport and recreation and is an opportunity to spend time together and cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races
Children’s race
Play zone with inflatable slides and obstacle courses
additional: Schedule: 13:00 — Race Office opens; 15:00 — children’s race starts; 16:00 — 5 km and 10 km races start; 17:30 — street traffic resumes; around 18:00 — awards ceremony. Please do not park along the race route and follow the instructions of event staff. The 5 km and 10 km races are scheduled to start at 16:00.

name: XII Biegu Konstytucji 3 Maja
description: The 12th May 3rd Constitution Run in Radom is an annual running event held to mark Constitution Day on May 3rd. The race takes place on city streets and starts at 09:00, attracting runners of various ages, including children. It is organized by Biegiem Radom, with timing provided using professional RFID technology to ensure accurate results. This sporting event combines patriotic and recreational elements, bringing together athletic competition and a tribute to an important historical event.
course_highlights: City-street course in Radom
Start at 09:00
Race with professional RFID timing
additional: The event is organized by Biegiem Radom and uses electronic RFID timing. It also includes children's races. Registration for the 2026 edition included a separate children's races category; timing was provided by Time-Sport.pl.

name: XXXIII Bieg im. Jana Kilińskiego
location: Stadion Miejski w Trzemesznie, Trzemeszno, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Trzemesznie
description: The 33rd Jan Kiliński National Run is a half marathon held with the participation of Trzemeszno and Mogilno. The course is 21.097 km long, with the start and race-pack collection scheduled at the Municipal Stadium in Trzemeszno. The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Trzemeszno.
course_highlights: Half marathon covering 21.097 km
The course connects Trzemeszno and Mogilno
Start in Trzemeszno, at the Municipal Stadium
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Municipal Stadium in Trzemeszno on event day, from 7:30 to 9:15. A race-pack exchange is available.

name: XXXIII Sztumski Bieg Solidarności 3 maja
description: The 33rd International Sztum Solidarity Run is an annual running event held on May 3 in Sztum at the Municipal Beach. The event includes races for children, a 10 km run, and a Nordic Walking march, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners. This sporting celebration combines tradition with outdoor recreation, promoting solidarity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The route runs along the scenic Municipal Beach in Sztum
A range of distances is available: races for children, 10 km, and Nordic Walking
The event is international in nature, attracting participants from various countries
additional: The event includes races for children and a Nordic Walking march. The start and finish are at the Municipal Beach in Sztum. The event is held annually on May 3, promoting physical activity and solidarity. The program also includes races for children.

name: XXXV Bieg Orłów
location: Kompleks sportowo-rekreacyjny, ul. Słupska 26a, Czarna Dąbrówka, Poland
description: The 35th National Eagles Run is an annual running event held at the sports and recreation complex in Czarna Dąbrówka. The event attracts runners of all ages, starting with children’s and youth races as part of the Cross Festival. The race office opens at 8:30, and the first races are scheduled to start at 10:00. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races, including distances from 150 to 1,200 m
additional: The race office is open from 8:30. Children’s and youth races are held as part of the Cross Festival. The start and finish are at the sports and recreation complex in Czarna Dąbrówka, at 26a Słupska Street. For the 2026 edition, the event venue was listed as the sports and recreation complex at 26a Słupska Street; the race office was scheduled to open at 8:30.

name: Łódzki Bieg Konstytucji 3 Maja
location: Park im. Adama Mickiewicza, Łódź, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata na nordic walking jest stała i wynosi 89 złotych.

description: The Łódź Constitution Day 3 May Run is a joyful annual running event held in the center of Warsaw, attracting thousands of participants who want to actively celebrate an important day in Polish history. The 5-kilometer course passes through the city’s most representative and picturesque locations, offering both sporting competition and the chance to enjoy urban views. The run is part of the Warsaw Running Triad “Run for Remembrance” and also offers a Nordic walking option for those who prefer a more relaxed pace. Participants receive commemorative medals, and the event’s atmosphere is perfect for celebrating the May holiday together through sport.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through central Warsaw, with views of Łazienki Park, the Botanical Garden, and Zbawiciela Square
Start and finish at Three Crosses Square; the route passes along Ujazdowskie Avenue and Marszałkowska Street, and through Constitution Square
A fast, scenic course suited both to personal-best attempts and to completing the distance at a comfortable pace
additional: Participant limit: 6,500 in the running category and 250 in Nordic walking. The time limit for completing the run is 55 minutes. Medal engraving and a technical T-shirt can be purchased during registration. Race numbers can be collected at the Race Office; on race day, collection is available only to people from outside Warsaw. The course is PZLA-certified and marked every 1 km. Start and finish at Three Crosses Square. Nordic walkers start in the final wave, after the runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: Jūrmalas skriešanas svētki
description: Jūrmala Running Festival is a running and Nordic walking event held on the beach at Majori, on the coast of Jūrmala, with sandy courses. The event offers distances for all ages and abilities, from a children’s race to a 21 km Nordic walking race in the sports class. Participants in the 10 km and 5 km races start alongside musician Ozols, creating a special atmosphere. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, with medals and a refreshment point at the finish.
course_highlights: Sandy courses on Majori Beach
Distances for children, beginners, and experienced athletes
10 km and 5 km races alongside musician Ozols
additional: Registration and race bib collection begin at 9:00 on race day. Bibs can be collected in advance at T/c “Riga Plaza” on 2 and 3 May from 10:00 to 19:00. The entry fee includes a race bib with a timing chip, a refreshment point at the finish, and a medal for finishers within the time limit. System service fee: EUR 1.21.

name: Latvijas čempionāts jūdzes 1609m skrējienā
description: The Latvian 1609 m Mile Running Championship is a prestigious running event that brings together Latvia’s best runners. The competition takes place in Līvāni and offers the chance to compete over a short, intense distance that demands speed and endurance. The event is part of Latvia’s sporting calendar and promotes the development of the country’s running tradition.
course_highlights: The distance is exactly 1609 metres, or one mile
The competition takes place within the city of Līvāni
A fast, intense race offering a chance to test your speed

name: Lisia Dycha # 59
description: Lisia Dycha #59 is a 10 km race in Gdańsk. It is another edition of the Lisia Dycha series, intended for people who want to take on the ten-kilometre distance. The results of this edition were recorded online; 12 runners took part.
additional: The race results are available online.

name: Top Cross Torunia
description: Top Cross is a series of 12 cross-country races held in Rudelka Forest Park in Toruń. Each race consists of five laps plus a short run-in, for a total distance of approximately 6,666 metres. Participants earn points for taking part, and their eight best results count toward the overall standings. To receive a commemorative medal, participants must take part in at least eight races. It is also possible to complete a race individually without earning points.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Rudelka Forest Park
The course consists of five laps plus an approximately 200 m run-in
Course length: approximately 6,666 metres
additional: Registration takes place at V LO Toruń, at ul. Sienkiewicza / Fałata. The race office opens one hour before the race. Participants can complete a race individually without earning points. In the series, points are awarded for the eight best results out of 12 races. Points from individual races contribute to the overall standings, which are based on the eight best results. The commemorative medal is awarded for taking part in at least eight races.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a wonderful fitness event for women, held at Studenternas IP in Uppsala. Participants can choose to run or walk 2.5 km or 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The event is all about the joy of movement and togetherness, with a fantastic atmosphere and entertainment along the course and in the event area. After finishing, teams that have registered five people are treated to a picnic, making it a sociable and enjoyable spring evening together.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. Participants are advised to arrive changed; changing facilities and showers are available. A water station and toilets are available at the start and finish. Parking is available south of the arena, but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. According to the local race information, registration can be completed online up to race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Timing for the 5 km can be opted out of. Teams of five participants are treated to a picnic after finishing.

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focused on the joy of being active rather than on achieving a personal best or running the fastest lap. The race offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a 900-metre Minivarv for children born in 2016 or later. The event is a community celebration with entertainment, activities and food, perfect for families, groups of friends and companies looking to strengthen team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarv for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities such as basketball, football, table tennis and boules, as well as food and drinks. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for strengthening team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30.
