description: The 7th Szczecin Night Run is an exciting sporting event held at night on the streets of Szczecin. Participants can choose between 5- and 10-kilometre routes through the city centre. The event offers a unique atmosphere with striking light displays and numerous attractions in the race village. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal, and the course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
course_highlights: The course runs through the heart of Szczecin.
Course length: approximately 5 km (one loop) or 10 km (two loops).
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a timing chip and 4 safety pins, a commemorative medal, photographers along the course, water at the refreshment point for the 10 km distance, and access to a baggage deposit. The race office is open on 7 May (14:00–20:00) at GALAXY Shopping and Entertainment Centre and on 8 May (16:00–23:00) at the Race Village on Jasne Błonia. The participant limit was 2,000. The 5 km and 10 km distances listed for the 2026 edition were certified by the PZLA.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija „Sporto renginiai“ ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: RASA Druskininkų maratonas yra tarptautinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Druskininkuose prie Vijūnėlės tvenkinio. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas: 500 m, 5 km, 10,5 km, pusmaratonį ir maratoną, skirtas tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams. Šis maratonas skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą, didina vietos gyventojų aktyvumą ir populiarina bėgimą Lietuvoje bei Druskininkuose. Dalyviai apdovanojami specialiais renginio medaliais, o geriausiems įteikiamos nugalėtojų taurės.
course_highlights: 500 m, 5 km, 10,5 km, pusmaratonio ir maratono rungtys
Startai prie Vijūnėlės tvenkinio Druskininkuose
Laiko limitas 5 val. maratonui, 43 min. 5 km distancijai
additional: Maratono ir pusės maratono rungtyse gali startuoti tik sulaukę 18 metų. 500 m distancijoje laikas nefiksuojamas. Visi dalyviai apdovanojami specialiu renginio medaliu. 5 km bėgimo rungtyje yra laiko limitas - 43 minutės. Organizatoriai laikosi Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacijos rekomendacijų. Maratono ir pusmaratonio rungtyse gali dalyvauti asmenys nuo 18 metų.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
price_range: Biegi główne: 50 zł za pojedynczy bieg lub 150 zł za cały cykl; biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe bezpłatne
description: The Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur is a series of races held on scenic routes in the Masurian region, including in Piecki. The event includes short-distance races for children and young people, as well as a 5.2 km main race that follows asphalt, cobbled and forest paths. Participants can expect commemorative medals, water and a hot meal prepared by local Rural Housewives’ Associations. The event has a family-friendly character and promotes outdoor activity surrounded by nature.
course_highlights: Distances from 5 to 10 km on asphalt, cobbled and forest roads
Children’s and youth races in several age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys
Scenic routes around Piecki and other towns in the Masurian region
additional: The participant limit across all distances for each race is 400. The race office is open 1.5 hours before the start; race-pack collection and registration are available until 30 minutes before the race. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. The race starts with a chip and a race number issued by the race office. The organizer provides water and a hot meal after the race. In the 2026 edition, the organizer provided participants with water, a hot meal and a commemorative medal. The limit was 400 participants per race.

name: Blue Power Run
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organised for people on the autism spectrum, their families and friends. The event aims to support social inclusion through a shared sporting event, raise awareness of autism and enable everyone to participate on equal terms. The race takes place on a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Complex in Szczecin. It is an opportunity to have fun and connect, with additional activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers. Finishing position is not what matters; the satisfaction of taking part and overcoming your own challenges is.
course_highlights: The race route follows a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Complex.
The start and race office are located by the Szyszka restaurant.
After the race, therapists and volunteers will coordinate activities for everyone to enjoy together.
additional: The event is limited to 300 participants. Race packs can be collected from the race office the day before the race and on event day. The start schedule includes races for different age groups, from 0 to 118 years old, with distances from 200 to 600 metres. After the races, activities for everyone to enjoy together will be coordinated by therapists and volunteers.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014, focused on promoting the sport and the scenic beauty of its courses. The event takes place in picturesque surroundings, offering participants a unique running experience. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and attractive locations, making the race appealing to a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque courses
Scenic and attractive locations in Łódź
Passionately organized since 2014

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route and the first stop of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. Participants can compete and visit local attractions, such as the communal feast table, the largest wooden shoe, and the snuffbox. The event takes place in the municipality of Nowa Wieś Lęborska, which offers certified Nordic walking routes for pre-race training. The event starts on May 9 at 11:00.
course_highlights: Red route, 8.2 km long
Scenic but challenging terrain with plenty of sporting challenges
Local attractions: the communal feast table, the largest wooden shoe, and the snuffbox
additional: The event in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie opens the Nordic Walking Grand Prix series. Participants are encouraged to use the certified Nordic walking routes in the municipality of Nowa Wieś Lęborska.

name: III M Park4RUN
location: Centrum Handlowe M Park, Tarnów, Poland
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race of approximately 21.2 km held in Tarnów, on the grounds of the M Park Shopping Center. The course is 100% asphalt, flat, and marked every 1 km, with restricted road traffic during the race. Participants have access to electronic timekeeping and aid stations along the course. The event promotes running and the integration of the local community. Shorter, age-appropriate races are planned for children.
course_highlights: Approximately 21.2 km, 100% asphalt course
Flat course, marked every 1 km
Aid stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the finish
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 180 minutes. The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:15. Children’s races range from 100 m to 800 m, with the children’s race office opening at 10:00. The awards ceremony is planned for approximately 12:30–13:00. Participants receive a race pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: Płużnicka Piątka is an annual 5-kilometer race held in the picturesque village of Płużnica. The course runs through the village center and features varied surfaces, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. The event attracts participants of all ages and also offers races for children. The atmosphere is friendly and full of positive energy, and the organization is highly regarded by participants.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% cobblestones
A scenic, varied course that appeals to runners of different abilities
additional: Schedule: 10:40 official opening, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children's races, 12:15 awards ceremony, 12:45 official closing. The course starts and finishes in the village center.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles is a 5.5 km race held in Łódź. Participants have access to training plans tailored to different experience levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is part of the Provi Run running championships series and promotes physical activity and running development in the local community. The race takes place on a paved course of moderate difficulty.
course_highlights: Distance: 5.5 km
Paved course
Difficulty: moderate
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support and detailed training instructions.

name: Rajd Beskidy Short
description: Rajd Beskidy Short is a European adventure race held in the picturesque Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The event includes a variety of disciplines, such as MTB, trekking, climbing, kayaking, cave exploration, and orienteering. The courses are demanding and vary in distance and time limit, catering to different teams and individual participants. The start and finish are at the Korzkiew Resort, and the event is part of a European adventure racing series.
course_highlights: Courses run through the picturesque Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Multidisciplinary challenges: MTB, trekking, climbing, kayaking, cave exploration, and orienteering
Different distances and formats: teams of 4, teams of 2, or individual participants
additional: Race office and start/finish at the Korzkiew Resort, 2 Eleonory Wodzickiej St. The time limit for the longest distance is 34 hours, plus 2 extra hours. The course counts toward the Polish Cup of Orienteering Foot Marathons. Teams of 4 for the 220 km distance; teams of 2 or individual participants for the 100 km distance. The start is on Friday morning, May 7, 2027.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The Warmiński Warneland Ultramarathon is a unique running event held on scenic routes in Warmia, near Olsztyn. The event offers a range of distances, including an ultramarathon and shorter races, giving participants a chance to test their endurance and enjoy the beauty of nature. It is an event for trail-running enthusiasts looking for an unforgettable adventure and a chance to recharge. The organizers provide professional event management and updated routes available to download in GPX format.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in Warmia, near Olsztyn
Updated GPX tracks for the W25+ and W50+ routes available to download
A range of distances, including an ultramarathon and shorter races
additional: The Warmiński Warneland Ultramarathon also includes races for the youngest participants (Ultra Warmiaczek) and the W10+ race (approx. 12.3 km), which hosts the Olsztyn Open Trail Running Championships. Routes are available in GPX format for download and self-extraction. The organizers invite participants to two editions each year—a spring and an autumn edition—which together make up the Grand Prix of Warmia, offering double the satisfaction and medals.

name: XXVII Bieg Wilka
description: The 27th Bieg Wilka is an annual 10 km road race held in Grajewo, Podlaskie Voivodeship. The event is a great opportunity to test your running fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day. The event attracts both local runners and participants from other regions, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km asphalt course
A moderately challenging road race
Scenic surroundings in Grajewo, Podlaskie Voivodeship
additional: The organizers offer 8- to 20-week training plans tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support.

name: Bieg Borków
description: Bieg Borków is an annual running event held in the scenic Spa Park in Połczyn-Zdrój. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering an appealing course surrounded by greenery and a spa-town atmosphere. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00, and participants can expect professional organization and the opportunity to discover the charms of the region. Registration and the rules are available on the race’s dedicated website, making it easier to prepare for the start.
course_highlights: The course runs through Spa Park in Połczyn-Zdrój
Scenic surroundings in a spa park
A course map file is available to download
additional: Registration and the race rules are available at biegnijmy.pl. The race course is available to download in JPG format. Public toilets in Spa Park are open 24 hours a day, cost 2 zł, and have facilities for people with disabilities. Information about registration, the rules, and the course for the 2026 edition is available at biegnijmy.pl.

name: Bieg Nadwiślański
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański in Wagańec is an annual running event organized by the Marshal's Office of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship. The race takes place in a picturesque area along the Vistula, offering participants the chance to compete on routes suited to different experience levels. The event promotes physical activity and brings together the local community and sports enthusiasts from across the region. It is part of the voivodeship’s sporting calendar and attracts runners and spectators.
additional: The 2026 edition was part of the 15th Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running.

name: Nocny Bieg na 5 km
description: The PKO Night 5K is a companion event to the PKO Białystok Half Marathon, offering a precisely measured 5 km course certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The start and finish are on Kościuszko Market Square, by the Town Hall in Białystok. The race is ideal both for first-timers and for runners looking to improve their personal bests, and the generous time limit allows almost anyone to finish. It is a great opportunity to join the largest running event in eastern Poland and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in May.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association and precisely measured at 5 km
Start and finish on Kościuszko Market Square, by the Town Hall
Generous 50-minute time limit, suitable for runners of varying experience levels
additional: The race is suitable for people of different ages and ability levels, and is ideal as a first road race. The course runs through the streets of Białystok. The event is part of the larger PKO Białystok Half Marathon. Time limit: 50 minutes. The race takes place as part of the PKO Białystok Half Marathon.

name: Pazur Gryfa
organizer: Słupskie Towarzystwo Osób Pozytywnie Aktywnych STOPA Słupsk
description: The Pazur Gryfa Orienteering Rally is a sports and tourism event held in the Słupsk region, known for its vast forests, hills, valleys, and rich flora and fauna. The route passes through scenic areas full of natural obstacles and historic landmarks, offering participants a unique orienteering experience. The event brings people together and attracts both beginners and experienced competitors. The organizers ensure that the routes are professionally prepared and that participants are safe.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the vast forests, hills, and valleys of the Słupsk region
Rich flora and fauna, along with numerous natural obstacles
Historic landmarks along the rally route
additional: The rally takes place at the Culture and Recreation Park and the Kayak Marina in Słupsk. The organizers professionally prepare the cycling and walking routes. The event is a sports and tourism rally with orienteering elements.

name: Silgan Ćwierćmaraton
location: SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A., ul. Rokicka 13, Tczew, Poland
description: The Silgan Quarter Marathon is a 10.54 km race held in Tczew County. The start and finish are located at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. in Tczew. The route passes through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny and has a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic, and the route is marked every kilometre. The event is small-scale, with a limit of 200 paid participants.
course_highlights: A 10.54 km route through Tczew, Rokitki and Śliwiny
Mixed asphalt and gravel surfaces
The route is marked with road markings every 1 km
additional: The start line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. The number of participants is limited to 200 paid entrants. The start and finish are at the headquarters of SILGAN Metal Packaging Tczew S.A. The race route runs with restricted vehicle traffic. Information about the route and organization is confirmed by the 2025 and 2026 editions; details of the 2027 edition were not available in the sources.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Hoby backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland in spring. The start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. There are two options: a longer course with eleven legs and a shorter one with six, allowing both experienced runners and beginners to take part. Teammates and spectators cheer the participants on, while organisers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets provide the best possible service, with marshals, a race announcer and timing. The race starts at 10:00, with a group warm-up beforehand.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 67.5 km in total, leg distances from 2.7 km to 8.5 km
Short course: 6 legs, 23.5 km in total, leg distances from 2.7 km to 5.4 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, with spectators and teammates cheering runners on
additional: Race bib collection is on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead a group warm-up before the start. Marshals are stationed along the course, at the changeovers, and at the start and finish. Individual leg times, split times and team finish times are provided. The long course has women’s and open categories, while the short course has an open category. Start at 10:00. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall, about 200 metres north of Ölands Köpstad. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a barbecue meal voucher.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-kyrkstafett/): 2027-05-08 — "Tid & datum 08 maj 2027 kl. 10:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a recurring running race organised by Hultsfreds Löparklubb. The race offers an enjoyable running experience in Hultsfred, with a course that passes close to the shoreline. It is a welcoming event for runners who want to challenge themselves in a scenic setting. Results from previous years are available to track progress and performance.
course_highlights: Running close to the shoreline
Scenic course in Hultsfred
Recurring annual race
additional: The start location is listed as Folkparksvägen 3 in Hultsfred. The event is scheduled for 10:00–13:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://visithultsfred.se/evenemang/strandmilen/): 2027-05-08 — "Strandmilen — 8 maj, 2027 kl.10:00 - 13:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med IK Akele och Mjölby Cykelklubb
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a popular running event featuring six enjoyable kilometres through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course follows the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and pleasant downhill stretches, with an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also the approximately 3 km Kyrkundan and a children’s race, which is completely free thanks to Bostadsbolaget. All participants receive a medal after finishing. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Mjölby Stadspark
Course follows the Svartån and has a 99% asphalt surface
Challenging climbs and pleasant downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon, or on race day from 09:00 in Stadsparken. Fitness4You will lead a warm-up before the start. The children’s race has four starts, with timing in eight categories for children up to 12 years old. Companies can book a tent in Stadsparken for their team and promotional exposure.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Östhammar City Race is an annual running event that starts at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The race brings together runners of different ages and abilities and is a popular local celebration. The event has a friendly atmosphere and offers the chance to run in beautiful surroundings near Östhammar. It welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners.

name: Spångaloppet
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race being held for the third year in a row and welcomes all participants. The race offers several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400-metre children’s race. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum, with the start and finish at Spånga IP. The goal for 2027 is to have more than 600 participants take part in this popular event.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful natural areas and Spånga Centrum
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km for younger runners, and a 400 m children’s race
Start and finish at Spånga IP
additional: There are distances for both adults and younger participants.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race that brings participants together in Älmhult to support the fight against cancer. The race offers several distances, with both runners and dogs welcome and special start times for dog owners. The event includes inspiring talks by prominent doctors and researchers, as well as a festive after-run at Grillen. It is a community where participants come together to support an important cause and enjoy a great running experience in Älmhult.
course_highlights: Choice of distances, with special start times for dogs in the 2.5 km and 5 km races
After-run party with a barbecue and music at Grillen after the race
Inspiring talks by experts from Lund University
additional: Online registration is open until 8 May at 20:00, with on-site late registration available from 08:00 on race day. No refunds for cancellations, as this is a charity race. Group registration is available. Dogs are welcome during special start times and must be kept on a leash. Älmhult Brukshundsklubb will be on site. The after-run party with a barbecue and music starts at 14:00 at Grillen. Accommodation and breakfast are available at IKEA Hotell during race weekend. Previous editions have offered on-site late registration subject to availability. Dog registration has cost 50 kr and included a scarf.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied mix of gravel and asphalt, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, with prizes for the top three finishers in each category and prize draws. A Mini Race is also held for children, featuring a fun course of approximately 650 metres. All participants receive a medal and a diploma.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs, with exchanges at the portal
Water station at the start/finish and after approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is done using data chips, and both total time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. There is a group warm-up before the start. The children’s Mini Race starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing the Mini Race, all children receive a medal, diploma, drink and fruit. Late registration for the Mini Race is available on site between 09:00 and 10:00. Proceeds go to Rotary’s international relief work and Ryssberget IK’s activities.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://humlestafetten.se): 2026-05-09 — "den 9 maj 2026" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Lundaloppet
description: Lundaloppet is a popular fun run in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and levels, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is a festive run through the city’s parks and city centre, with a welcoming atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners. The event has a long tradition and finishes inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, where participants can enjoy food and drinks from food trucks. Lundaloppet is a community celebration that brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, energetic atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km of running enjoyment through springtime Lund
5 km route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly Little Lundaloppet, approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Bib collection takes place at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen on the day before and on race day. The warm-up takes place at the start on Svanevägen, led by a running coach on raised platforms. Timing is done with a chip on the bib, and the finish is filmed. The official T-shirt can be purchased when registering or at the event. Meal packages and food trucks are available after the finish. It is also possible to add training sessions with a running coach before the race. The official information lists water stations at 5, 10 and 15 km; the 2.5 km course has no water station.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://lundaloppet.se/information/): 2026-05-09 — "Lundaloppet 2026 8 maj -> 13:00-19:00 9 maj -> från 9:00" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run yra unikalus bėgimas, vykstantis vienu metu visame pasaulyje, įskaitant Vingio parką Vilniuje. Dalyviai bėga tiek, kiek gali, kol juos pasivija „Gaudymo automobilis“. Šis renginys skirtas paremti stuburo smegenų traumų tyrimus, o 100 % dalyvio mokesčio skiriama moksliniams tyrimams. Prisijunkite prie tūkstančių bėgikų visame pasaulyje ir bėkite už tuos, kurie negali.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Vingio parke, Vilniuje
Startas vienu metu su bėgikais visame pasaulyje
Unikalus „Gaudymo automobilio“ formatas, kuris užbaigia bėgimą
additional: Startas vyksta 11:00 UTC. Renginys vyksta vienu metu visame pasaulyje, įskaitant Vilnių. Renginys vyksta Vingio parke, dalyvių pasirinkimas bėgti ar eiti, neturi tradicinės finišo linijos, surenkama lėšų stuburo traumų tyrimams.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos yra skirtos Lietuvos maratono bėgimo pradininko Alfonso Vietrino atminimui. Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyno parke, startas ir finišas prie S.Dariaus ir S.Girėno paminklo. Dalyviai gali rinktis 2,5 km arba 10 km distancijas, o trasa yra sertifikuota ir sudaryta iš 2,5 km ilgio rato. Renginys populiarina bėgimą Lietuvoje ir kviečia visus norinčius dalyvauti su gydytojo leidimu.
course_highlights: Trasa vyksta Ąžuolyno parke
Vieno rato ilgis - 2,5 km, sertifikuota trasa
Startas ir finišas prie S.Dariaus ir S.Girėno paminklo
additional: 2,5 km distancijos startas 11:30 val., 10 km distancijos startas 12:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Apdovanojami amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai ir prizininkai, taip pat jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyviai atminimo taurėmis. Varžybose draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ir asmeninę palydą. Renginio tikslas - skatinti fizinį aktyvumą ir bėgimo mėgėjų bendruomenę Lietuvoje

name: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“
location: Nemenčinės apylinkės, Nemenčinė, Vilniaus rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Vilniaus rajono savivaldybė, Vilniaus rajono sporto centras, Vilniaus rajono sporto mokykla, fondas Maratony Kresowe
description: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“ Nemenčinėje siūlo unikalią galimybę bėgti per Vilniaus rajono sporto centro apylinkes. Varžybos vyksta birželio 2 dieną, o trasos yra įvairaus ilgio - nuo trumpesnio 6 km Szpurt bėgimo iki ilgesnio 18,6 km Wertep trasos. Renginys pritaikytas tiek profesionaliems bėgikams, tiek mėgėjams, su elektroniniu laiko matavimu ir starto numeriu, galiojančiu visą sezoną. Dalyviai gali mėgautis žaliais ir raudonais rodyklėmis pažymėtomis trasomis, o po bėgimo laukia apdovanojimai ir šiltas maistas.
course_highlights: Szpurt 6 km bėgimas su žaliomis rodyklėmis geltoname fone
Wertep 18,6 km bėgimas su raudonomis rodyklėmis
Du maitinimo punktai Wertep trasoje
additional: Registracija vyksta prieš startą nuo 8:30 iki 9:20 val., ne vėliau kaip 10 min. iki starto. Varžybų biuras veikia birželio 1 d. nuo 15:00 iki 18:00 Vilniaus rajono sporto centre. Laiko limitas trasose - 2 val. 15 min. Elektroninis laiko matavimas ir nemokamas starto numeris su laiko skaitikliu, galiojantis visą sezoną. Po bėgimo dalyviams siūlomas šiltas maistas. Starto sektoriai atskirti pagal distancijas: Szpurt 6 km ir Wertep 19 km. Renginyje yra maitinimo punktų, elektroninis laiko matavimas, nemokamas starto numeris, medicininė apsauga ir apdovanojimai.

name: Backyard Race
description: Backyard Race is an obstacle course race in Ozolnieki, offering a short course with world-class obstacles. The race is suitable for both experienced athletes and those who want to try OCR (Obstacle Course Racing) in a short format. It is a dynamic and challenging event that brings together active participants and spectators.
course_highlights: A short course with world-class obstacles
The race takes place in Ozolnieki
Short-distance OCR race
additional: This short-distance OCR race takes place in Ozolnieki and offers world-class obstacles over a few kilometers.

name: Wings for Life World Run (Valmiera)
organizer: Wings for Life World Run Valmierā organizatori
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start at the same time around the world. There is no traditional finish line—participants run as far as they can until they are caught by a special “Catcher Car.” The event is open to runners, wheelchair users, and beginners, and 100% of entry fees are donated to spinal cord research. The race in Valmiera will take place at J. Daliņš Stadium and is part of this global event, bringing people together around the world to support those who cannot run themselves.
course_highlights: Starts simultaneously around the world
There is no traditional finish line—the finish is when the Catcher Car catches you
Participants can run, roll, or walk, and everyone competes together
additional: The start is not only in Valmiera but takes place simultaneously around the world. The Catcher Car begins pursuing participants 30 minutes after the start and continues catching up with them until everyone has been caught. The event is inclusive of everyone—beginners, athletes, and wheelchair users. The official Wings for Life World Run app is required to participate.

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race that takes place simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will start at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is a loop of approximately 3 km on a paved surface, with a slight uphill on the connector path. All entry fees support spinal cord research.

name: 13. PKO Białystok Półmaraton
description: The PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest running event in eastern Poland. Held since 2013, it has won numerous awards. The event takes place in May and features the main half-marathon race (21.097 km) and the accompanying 5 km Night Run. Both race courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association, and the event attracts runners from across Poland and more than a dozen other countries. The race weekend also includes children’s races, the Breakfast Run and the Sport Expo trade fair, making it a true celebration of running in the capital of Podlasie.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association
The 5 km Night Run has a certified course and finishes at Kościuszko Market Square
The Breakfast Run and children’s races are accompanying events
additional: The event includes the Breakfast Run (approx. 4 km, free, starting Saturday at 9:00), the PKO Junior Run for children aged 2–14, with distances from 100 m to 1 km, and the Sport Expo trade fair, featuring running apparel, supplements and activities. The generous time limit (50 minutes) for the 5 km Night Run allows runners of varying experience levels to finish.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a global race held simultaneously around the world. Participants start with the mobile app and run from the virtual Catcher Car. The race is unique because 100% of entry fees and donations go toward research into treatments for spinal cord injuries. The event is open to everyone, wherever they are, and promotes community and support for people with mobility impairments. The race is scheduled to start on May 9, 2027, at 11:00 local time.
course_highlights: Run with the Wings for Life World Run app—start anywhere in the world
Run from the virtual Catcher Car
Run, use a wheelchair, or walk together—also for those who cannot run
additional: 100% of entry fees go toward spinal cord research. Take part using the mobile app, which tracks distance and simulates the Catcher Car chase. An event-related running apparel collection is available.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the visual appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz
Routes with visual appeal and a natural character
Organized with passion and experience since 2014

name: Charytatywna Dycha
description: Charytatywna Dycha is a race held in Miechów to support the Blessed Sister Bernardyna Jabłońska Hospice. The event is charitable and community-oriented, encouraging participants to be physically active and help those in need. The race takes place in the area around Miechów, and taking part is also an opportunity to work together for the local community and hospice patients.
additional: The organizer is the Blessed Sister Bernardyna Jabłońska Hospice in Miechów. Telephone contact is available from 8:00 to 15:00. Psychological support and volunteering are integral parts of the hospice’s work. The website has no details about the course, start waves, or entry fees.

name: IX Bieg Pilicy
description: The 9th Pilica Run is a small-scale running event held in the charming town of Białobrzegi on the Pilica River. The start and finish are located in the centrally situated, revitalized Zygmunt Stary Square, and the route runs along the town’s main streets. The event combines sport, passion, and a family-friendly atmosphere, offering distances for different ability levels: a 10 km main race, a 3 km recreational run, and a 3 km Nordic walking event. Colorful races tailored to participants’ ages are organized for children and teenagers. Every participant can enjoy a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for local ice cream.

name: Wings for life world run App
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique race in which all participants start simultaneously around the world. The goal is to cover as much distance as possible before being caught by the virtual Catcher Car. The race takes place via a mobile app, allowing participants to join from anywhere, including Mądrzechowo. All entry fees go toward research into spinal cord injuries, and the race atmosphere is enhanced by a unique audio experience and motivational messages. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to experienced runners, wheelchair users, and walkers.
course_highlights: A race with no traditional finish line—the virtual Catcher Car determines when you finish
Join from anywhere in the world using the mobile app
A unique audio experience to keep you motivated during the race
additional: The 2027 race is scheduled to start at 11:00 UTC. Participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually catches up with them. Participants can use the mobile app to connect with other runners around the world and receive motivational messages as part of a unique audio experience.

name: XV Działoszyńska Dziesiątka
description: The 15th Działoszyńska Dziesiątka is an annual race organized by the Atelier Sportu Association in Działoszyn. The race takes place over a 10-kilometer course, with the start scheduled for 16:00. The event attracts runners from various regions and offers professional timing using modern RFID technology. The organizers ensure high sporting and organizational standards, providing participants with a comfortable experience and reliable results.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Professional timing using RFID chips
Start at 16:00 in Działoszyn
additional: Timing is provided by a state-of-the-art electronic system using RFID chips and start/finish mats. The organizer provides telephone support from 8:00 to 16:00, as well as an emergency number on race day.

name: XXXIII Biegi Żnińskie
description: The 33rd Żnińskie Runs is an annual running event held in Żnin, scheduled for May 10, 2026. The event includes road races over 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are located at Freedom Square. The 10 km race counts toward the Pałuki Grand Prix. Participants receive a race pack containing a commemorative medal from the “Great People of Żnin” series, a recovery meal, and souvenirs from Pałuki. The race office is open on race day from 9:00 to 11:45 at Primary School No. 1 in Żnin.

name: II Bieg Europejski Puck - Prolog
description: Energa II European Run Puck is an original sporting event organized by STONE TRI & RUN, bringing runners together to celebrate Europe Day. The event takes place at the Old Market Square in Puck and offers a range of distances, including a certified 10 km main race and a shorter 1,348 m Prologue. The event has a unique atmosphere and is supported by ambassador Jerzy Kowol, a legend of Polish long-distance running. In addition to adult races, children’s races and a Nordic walking event are also held.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km main race
1,348 m Prologue
The routes pass through the Old Market Square in Puck
additional: The event programme includes race-pack collection at Stary Rynek 2 at two times (15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00), bag drop in the Expo Zone tent, race and walk starts between 10:00 and 11:40, and the awards ceremony and event summary at 12:00. The event also includes children’s races in two age categories: Mini Kids Run (ages 3–7) and Mega Kids Run (ages 8–15). The distance and location information comes from the 2026 edition.

name: Poligon na Start
location: Żółta Trybuna, Pas Ćwiczeń Taktycznych Bucierz, Centrum Szkolenia Bojowego Drawsko, Drawsko Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 3rd Charity Poligon na Start Run takes place at the Drawsko Combat Training Centre, under the honorary patronage of the Centre’s Commandant. The event is charitable, and proceeds from entry fees and the public collection will go towards supporting a child’s medical treatment. The event also features accompanying demonstrations and performances. Four distances are available, suited to runners of different ability levels.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Drawsko training ground at the Drawsko Combat Training Centre
Four distances: 42 km, 21 km, 13 km and 7 km
Accompanying events include demonstrations and performances organised by the Drawsko Combat Training Centre and the Drawsko Pomorskie Cultural Centre
additional: The participant limit is 200. Payment must be made online via the Przelewy24 platform: click the link next to your name on the start list and enter the participant’s details. The start schedule includes four race waves from 9:30 to 13:30, with the awards ceremony at 15:00. The 2026 edition had a limit of 200 participants and was a charity event. The previously stated fees apply only to the 2026 edition.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö, with the start and finish at Strandbjörket. The event is open to everyone and offers both individual and team registration. Teams consist of five people and receive a shared picnic after finishing. The event has a wonderful spring atmosphere, with a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and prizes for participants. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km course, but participants can choose to run without timing if they wish. Vårruset is organized by IFK Växjö in collaboration with Marathongruppen and several athletics clubs.
course_highlights: The course goes around Lake Växjö through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish at Strandbjörket, near Strandbjörkshallen
A water station and toilets are available at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in Växjö a few days before the event. Team leaders receive a picnic voucher on their race bib to collect the picnic after the event. The event area opens at 17:00 with a sponsor village, and light refreshments are served. Participants are encouraged to arrive dressed for the race and to travel to the event area in an environmentally friendly way. The race bib must be clearly visible throughout the race. Participants can run, jog or walk. Individual registration includes a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and race bib; team registration also includes a picnic. Timing is available for the 5 km distance and can be opted out of. Published local information applies to the 2026 event.

name: Šventinis bėgimas „Kuršėnams 463“
location: Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tiltas, Kuršėnai, Šiaulių rajonas, Lietuva
price_range: nemokamai, 3-5 Eur, registracijos mokestis iki 2026-05-13 d. 23:59, vėliau 10 Eur

description: Šventinis bėgimas „Kuršėnams 463“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Kuršėnuose, Šiaulių rajone. Renginys skirtas populiarinti bėgimą ir skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą, kviečiant dalyvauti įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus. Varžybos vyksta prie Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tilto, siūlant tris distancijas: apie 463 m, 2,5 km ir 10 km. Dalyviai gali mėgautis simboliniu maršrutu ir draugiška atmosfera, o renginys baigiasi apdovanojimais ir bendru finišu apie 21:30 val.
course_highlights: Simbolinis apie 463 m maršrutas prie Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tilto
2,5 km ratas, kurį 10 km bėgikai įveikia keturis kartus
Varžybos vyksta miesto aplinkoje su patogiu startu ir finišu
additional: Varžybų programa: 19:30 val. 463 m startas, 19:40 val. 2,5 km startas, 20:00 val. 10 km startas. Apdovanojimai vyksta po paskutinio dalyvio finišo apie 21:30 val. Dalyviai privalo būti sveiki arba turėti gydytojo leidimą sportuoti. Nepilnamečių dalyvių sveikata ir elgesys prižiūrimi lydinčių asmenų. bėgimo vieta prie Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tilto, registracija ir numerių atsiėmimas prie tilto, dalyvių amžiaus grupės, COVID-19 saugumo reikalavimai

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The 5th Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique nighttime running event held in Reda by the retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants run in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive spirit and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and adding to the excitement.

name: Festivalio „Sportas visiems“ bėgimo varžybos
location: Vytauto and S. Dariaus ir S. Girėno streets intersection near Restaurant Gabija, Palanga, Lietuva
organizer: Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija ir Lietuvos asociacija „Sportas visiems“
description: Festivalis „Sportas visiems“ yra tradicinės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Palangoje, Vytauto ir S. Dariaus ir S. Girėno gatvių sankirtoje prie restorano „Gabija“. Renginys skirtas visiems norintiems, kurie gali dalyvauti laisva valia ir prisiima su tuo susijusią riziką. Varžybose numatyti 1 km, 5 km ir 10 km bėgimai su laiko limitais. Dalyviai apdovanojami medaliais ir atminimo suvenyrais, o gausiausiai dalyvavę klubai - taurėmis.
course_highlights: Bėgimo trasos Palangos miesto gatvėse
Startas ir finišas Vytauto ir S. Dariaus ir S. Girėno gatvių sankirtoje
Trijų skirtingų nuotolių bėgimai: 1 km, 5 km ir 10 km
additional: Registracija vyksta internetu ir varžybų dieną nuo 11:00 iki 12:20 starto vietoje. Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Griežtai draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones bėgimo metu, pažeidėjai bus diskvalifikuojami. Laiko limitai: 1 km - 20 min., 5 km ir 10 km - 80 min. Numatyta išankstinė registracija internetu ir registracija renginio dieną starto vietoje. 1 km nuotolio laiko limitas - 20 min., 5 ir 10 km - 80 min.

name: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“
location: Europa Tower, Vilnius, Vilnius County, Lietuva
description: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“ yra tradicinis ir kasmet vykstantis iššūkis, kviečiantis bėgimo entuziastus ir ekstremalaus sporto mėgėjus įveikti 31 aukštą verslo centre „Europa“, aukščiausiame Baltijos šalyse. Renginys suburia tiek profesionalus, tiek mėgėjus, siekiančius pagerinti savo ištvermę ir sportinius rezultatus. Trasą būtina įveikti per ne ilgiau nei 10 minučių, o prizininkai dažniausiai užbėga per 3-4 minutes. Greičiausi bėgikai apdovanojami piniginiais prizais ir rėmėjų dovanomis.
course_highlights: 31 verslo centro aukštas iki terasos
Trasos įveikimo laikas iki 10 minučių
Rekordai siekia 2 min. 55,6 sek. vyrų ir 3 min. 28,6 sek. moterų kategorijose
additional: Visi dalyviai startuoja kas pusę minutės, kad būtų išvengta grūsčių. Renginį organizuoja nekilnojamo turto plėtros kompanija „Hanner“ ir „Lietuvos bėgimo taurės“ komanda. Renginys planuojamas vykti 2027 m. gegužės 22 d., kviečiantis dalyvius iš visos Lietuvos ir užsienio. Dalyviams siūloma įveikti trasą įkopiant į Europa Tower, o renginys yra žinomas kaip vienas iš įdomiausių ir iššūkių pilnų bėgimo renginių Vilniuje.

name: LHV Maijooks - 7 km
description: LHV Maijooks is Estonia’s and the Baltic States’ largest women’s movement and sports event, taking place for the 40th time. Dedicated exclusively to women, it offers the opportunity to run, walk or Nordic walk along a beautiful 7 km route through Tallinn’s natural surroundings and the iconic Tallinn Song Festival Grounds. The event is for the whole family, with a children’s run and entertainment in addition to the women’s run. Participants receive an exclusive medal, a gift bag and a spring concert, creating a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 7 km route through Tallinn’s natural surroundings
Start and finish at the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds
Suitable for running, walking and Nordic walking
additional: A 20% discount on the 7 km distance applies to seniors (60+) and young people (under 20). A 10% group discount applies to teams of at least 10 people. Participants receive an exclusive medal, a gift bag, partner discount codes, a spring concert and a health fair at the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds. Both timed and untimed participation options are available. A 20% discount applies to people aged 60 and over and those under 20; groups of at least 10 people receive a 10% discount.

name: Rimi Rīgas maratons
description: Rimi Riga Marathon is an annual running festival held in Riga, offering a range of distances, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 6 km races, as well as relay races. The event takes place on 15 and 16 May, bringing together runners from around the world. It is part of the prestigious SuperHalfs European half marathon series and offers new, scenic and fast courses. Participants can also take part in relay races, making the longer distances more accessible to a wider audience.
course_highlights: New, scenic and fast courses in the city of Riga
Marathon relay with four legs: 10.5 km, 6.5 km, 12.5 km and 12.7 km
Half marathon relay with two legs: 10.2 km and 10.9 km
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Rimi Olympic Centre. The 6 km start is split into two start times, which are shown on the race bib. Relay teams can have 2 to 4 runners, and one runner may complete multiple legs. Registration details can be changed free of charge until 30 April 2027, including year of birth, email address, phone number, team name, nationality and country of residence.

name: 12. Dynowska ZaDyszka
description: The 12th Dynowska ZaDyszka is a 10 km race organized by the Jarosławska Grupa Biegowa „Sokół” Association. The event will take place at the “Błękitny San” Tourist Resort in Dynów. The race is held in the evening, and the route passes through scenic areas, promoting physical activity and the region’s tourist attractions. The event is part of the Piona Cup 2026 series, which brings together the local running community.

name: Bieg Iskier - IFMSA Poland Oddział Rzeszów
XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton Piastowski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 17th Piast Run is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław as part of the Piast Running Festival. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering an appealing course and a sporting atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and compete over the 21 km distance. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: 12 Ćwierćmaraton Komandosa
description: The Commando Quarter Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Sub ventum” Foundation in Słupsk, promoting physical activity among residents of the city and surrounding areas. The race is both a sporting and community event, open to runners of varying ability levels. The organizers provide professional support and a way to get in touch quickly via the registration form. The event takes place in the scenic areas of Słupsk, encouraging a healthy lifestyle.
additional: You can contact the organizers and register using the online form. The race director is Dariusz Kloskowski, available at 602 759 892. Participants are encouraged to log in during registration to speed up the processing of their entries.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
location: Okoniny Nadjeziorne, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Join the 8th edition of Okonińska Pętla, taking place on May 16 at 16:00 in Okoniny Nadjeziorne. This running event, organized by the Śliwice Municipal Office, attracts enthusiasts of physical activity and the beautiful landscapes of the Tuchola Forest. The scenic route lets participants enjoy the natural beauty and local scenery. More information and registration are available on the dedicated registration website.
course_highlights: Scenic route in the Tuchola Forest
Route through Okoniny Nadjeziorne
Race organized by the Śliwice Municipal Office

name: Bieg Krokodyla
description: Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 5 km Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The main races and the walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s races begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic package or an extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course follows a scenic route around the lake, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Rusałka in Poznań
Distances: 10 km, 5 km, and a 5 km Nordic Walking event
Children’s and youth races over shorter distances from 100 m to 1,000 m
additional: The main races and the walk start at 12:00. The children’s and youth races start from 9:00. Start location by Lake Rusałka (GPS: 52.423071, 16.884526). Participants aged 16–18 may choose the 5 km or 10 km distance with a guardian’s consent.

name: XIII Olecka Trzynastka
location: Stadion Miejski w Olecku, Olecko, Poland

description: The 13th Olecka Thirteen is an annual main race and Nordic walking event held at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko. Participants can expect professional organization and a welcoming sporting atmosphere. The main race has a fixed entry fee, while Nordic walking offers attractive prices across two registration periods. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete on a scenic course.
additional: Nordic walking entry fees vary depending on when you register. Proof of bank transfer should be sent to oleckobiega@wp.pl. The event takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy
Bieg Urodzinowy Miasta Skórcz
description: The Skórcz City Birthday Run is an annual running event organized by the Skórcz Municipal Office and held within the city. The event combines sport and recreation and offers an opportunity to celebrate the city’s birthday together. It attracts both residents and visitors, promoting an active lifestyle and a sense of community.
course_highlights: A road race through the streets of Skórcz
The historic route ran along, among others, Parkowa, Hallera, 3 Maja, Główna, and Sobieskiego streets
In 2011, the main race was approximately 1.5 km long
additional: Previous editions also included a Preschoolers’ Run. The race regulations and consent form for participation by minors are available.

description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive and encouraging community event that promotes exercise and togetherness.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for ages 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children from preschool class to year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet, 500 metres, for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. Race bib, medal, fruit and a drink are included in the registration. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times split by school year, with colour-coded starting groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration is possible at bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is metro red line 13 to Skärholmen.

name: POKONAJ LUCYFERA - Półmaraton
description: DEFEAT LUCIFER – The Half Marathon is a mountain race in Nasielsk. The course consists of a 7 km loop through scenic but challenging forest terrain, with numerous climbs and technical descents. The event offers four challenges to choose from: Lucifer 21 km (3 loops), Boruta 14 km (2 loops), Rokita 7 km (1 loop), and 7 km Nordic Walking. This race is for people who value endurance, strength, and determination, with professional timing and commemorative medals for participants.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn - edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Arboretum Leśne Warmii i Mazur, Olsztyn, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Olsztyn – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Warmia and Mazury Forest Arboretum, highlighting the scenic beauty of the course. The race is participant-friendly, and the organizers emphasize the beauty of the locations and promoting running among different groups. It is a great opportunity to combine sport with time in nature and earn a unique medal featuring a hyacinth motif.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and participation is open to all ages. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race or the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is held under the honorary patronage of the Voivodeship Marshal.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior is also held as part of the event for the youngest runners.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Baltic Coast Half Marathon is a flat road race set in the picturesque seaside surroundings of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the route. The start and finish are located at Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of a trail race held in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic walking event. The course runs through fields and forests between the towns of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to enjoy nature and spend time actively outdoors. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.

name: Półmaraton...Chce Ci się?
description: “Half marathon… Are you up for it?” is a cross-country race covering 21 km, with an additional 32 km race, held on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts near Blachownia. Participants can run or walk the course with Nordic walking poles. The event also includes races for children and young people. This is the fifth edition of the event, combining sport and recreation in a picturesque forest setting.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy - Run Toruń Plaza features two distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide professional, nationwide event organization while ensuring a friendly, family atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous children’s and youth races. The event features electronic timekeeping, an extensive program and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as amenities such as a bag drop, showers and a café.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Stanisław Komornicz Rector’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of varying ability levels and offers the opportunity to prepare with dedicated training plans. The race takes place on the streets of the picturesque city of Tarnów, giving participants an appealing course and sporting excitement.

name: XI Półmaraton Szelkowski
description: The 11th Szelków Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Szelków that attracts runners from various regions. The event includes a half marathon and additional races, such as the 1st Szelków Five and Nordic Walking. The competition is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Sports Club, offering a sporting atmosphere and the chance to compete on scenic routes. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part and celebrate sport together.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The 12th Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kuchary Królewskie. The event features various distances for different age groups, including races for preschoolers and schoolchildren, a 10 km main race, a 3 km accompanying race, and a 6 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are by the forester’s lodge, and participants can look forward to an awards ceremony and a prize drawing after the event. The participant limit is 300, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: Charytatywny bieg dla hospicjum WYBIEGAJ...
description: The “RUN FOR LIFE” Charity Run for the Hospice is a special sporting event held in Lisiniec Park in Częstochowa, combining physical activity with support for the hospice. Participants can choose from three options: the 5 km main run, 5 km Nordic walking, or the approximately 1 km Gnome Run for children. The event aims not only to promote a healthy lifestyle but, above all, to support hospice patients in need. Participants receive medals and a post-race meal, and the event’s atmosphere encourages people to connect and work together for a good cause.
course_highlights: A 5 km running and Nordic walking route in Lisiniec Park
An approximately 1 km Gnome Run for children accompanied by guardians
Scenic parkland suited to recreation and outdoor activity
additional: Participants receive a medal and a post-race meal. Places are limited. The event is charitable and supports the Hospice in Częstochowa. The 2026 edition is listed as taking place in Lisiniec Park, starting at 16:00, with a medal and post-race meal.

name: I Majowa Żelechowska 8
description: The 1st May Żelechów Eight is a race held in Żelechów that attracts participants despite unfavorable weather conditions. The event has a local, sporting character, promoting physical activity among residents and visitors. The race follows a route approximately 8 kilometers long, offering an opportunity for competition and community engagement. The event is part of the sports calendar of the town and municipality of Żelechów.
course_highlights: A route approximately 8 km long
The race takes place in the town of Żelechów
The event attracts local runners despite rainy weather
additional: The race takes place regardless of the weather, showing the participants’ commitment.

name: IV Bieg Dycha z Pompą
description: The 4th Tapflo Run – Dycha z Pompą is a 10-kilometer road race held in Tczew and organized by PCS Tczew, with Tapflo Sp. z o.o. as the main sponsor. The start and finish are at the company’s headquarters at 4b Czatkowska Street. The race takes place on a Sunday, and the starting line closes 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. Participants can register online, and places are limited to 200 runners.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Tczew
Start and finish at Tapflo’s headquarters at 4b Czatkowska Street
The starting line closes 15 minutes after the start
additional: The participant limit is 200. Applications without the entry fee paid within 7 days will be removed from the list. The start and finish are at the same location. The starting line will close 15 minutes after the starter’s gun. For the 2026 edition, the limit is 200 OPEN participants and the start time is 10:00; prices and registration information apply to this edition.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: V Bieg Ochota na Zdrowie
location: Park Forty Korotyńskiego, Ochota, Warszawa, Poland
description: The 5th “Ochota for Health” Run is a running event organized by the Ochota District of the Capital City of Warsaw. The 2026 edition will take place in Forty Korotyńskiego Park, a green space in Warsaw’s Ochota district. It’s an opportunity to spend time actively and take part in a sporting event in the district.
course_highlights: Forty Korotyńskiego Park
A green space in Warsaw’s Ochota district

name: XI Bieg Łomianek
description: The Irena Szewińska Łomianki Run is an annual sporting event held in Łomianki in memory of a legend of Polish athletics. The main 10 km race attracts both recreational and more advanced runners from across Poland. In addition to the main race, Mini Runs for children are held over 200, 400 and 800 metres, along with a 2x200-metre relay for parents and children. The event promotes physical activity and sporting values, making it an important local and sporting occasion.
course_highlights: The 10 km main-race course offers runners the chance to go for personal bests
Mini Runs for children over 200, 400 and 800 metres
A 2x200-metre relay for parents and children
additional: The number of places on the start list is limited.

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey Friidrott i samarbete med Kajen i Nacka Strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running experience along the waterfront in Nacka Strand, suitable for the whole family. The race is organised by Nacka Hockey Friidrott in collaboration with Kajen in Nacka Strand, with a focus on the joy of movement, community and local engagement. The course offers beautiful views of the inlet and takes runners past Svindersvik and around Kvarnholmen before the finish at Kajen. There are distances for everyone, from children’s races to longer routes, and the event is a lively celebration full of energy and spectators.
course_highlights: Run along the waterfront with views of the inlet
The course passes Svindersvik and loops around Kvarnholmen
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand
additional: The 400 m children’s race starts at 10:30, and the 1,200 m children’s race starts at 11:30. Kajenloppet is a lively celebration full of energy, spectators and community. Kajen also offers activities such as mini golf and pétanque near the event area. Previous editions have included 6 km and 10 km races as well as children’s races; distances and arrangements may vary from year to year.

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

images.alt_text: Löpare på en skogsstig under Adelsö ultra-loppet
Två löpare med en Adelsö Ultra-banner på en vagn i bakgrunden.
Två löpare springer på en skogsstig bland tallar och mossa.
Löpare på en klippig stig vid vattnet under en molnig dag

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-running event created in the USA. Runners start every hour and have to complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they have time to rest until the next full hour. The competition continues until only one runner remains, and they complete the final loop within the one-hour time limit. This is an endurance race where not only speed matters, but also strategy and perseverance.

name: Berga Brostafett
description: Berga Brostafett is a five-person relay in Berga in Lagan, where teams run legs along and across the Lagan River. Together, each team covers just over 10 kilometres, divided into five legs of approximately 1–3.2 kilometres. Teams start at the same time and compete in the adult or youth category. The relay is organised by Lagans AIK.
course_highlights: Five legs of approximately 1–3.2 kilometres each
Just over 10 kilometres of running in total per team
The course crosses the Lagan River in Berga
additional: Teams consist of five runners. If a team does not have five participants, one runner may run two legs, but no one may run the entire relay alone. The competition categories are adult and youth.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai tradicinis bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos yra atviros visiems Lietuvos ir užsienio bėgikams, vyksta penkiuose etapuose skirtingose vietovėse. Dalyviai varžosi tiek bendroje įskaitoje, tiek amžiaus grupėse, o trasos driekiasi įvairiomis Jonavos rajono vietovėmis, suteikdamos įdomią ir įvairiapusę bėgimo patirtį. Registracija vykdoma internetu, o numerių atsiėmimas - varžybų dieną starto vietoje.
course_highlights: Penki etapai skirtingose Jonavos rajono vietovėse: Šilai - Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai - Bartoniai, Jonava
Startas ir finišas įvairiose lokacijose, įskaitant Jonavos miesto centrinį stadioną ir seniūnijų pastatus
Varžybos vyksta vakaro valandomis, startas 19:30 val., numerių atsiėmimas nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val.
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje. Registracija į kiekvieną etapą vykdoma atskirai. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Renginys yra atviras visiems dalyviams, siūlo internetinę registraciją ir skirtingas trasas, vyksta penkiais etapais nuo gegužės iki rugsėjo.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over 5 km and 10 km distances. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique atmosphere of night racing. The event attracts runners of different age groups and experience levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 och 10 km; Lilla Blodomloppet gratis för de 250 första, därefter 100 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: NYHET – Spring gratis! Sparbanken Skåne bjuder på startavgiften för de 250 första anmälda

description: Blodomloppet in Kristianstad is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers Lilla Blodomloppet for children of different ages, with shorter distances inside Tivoliparken. The course passes through the scenic Vattenriket, with a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. Participants can take part with colleagues or friends, or on their own, contribute to a good cause and finish with a shared picnic in the event area.
course_highlights: Scenic course extending into Vattenriket
A mix of grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12 inside Tivoliparken
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline for team registration is 12 May. Late registration is available on site in Tivoliparken from 16:00 on 19 May. Lilla Blodomloppet distances are 100 m (ages 1–3), 550 m (ages 4–7) and 1,100 m (ages 8–12). The 5 km and 10 km courses have a mix of grass, gravel and asphalt. There are several cheer stations along the course. The event area offers picnic facilities, and the event concludes with a shared picnic. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances for children aged 1–12. Teams can have a maximum of five participants.
