name: Vårruset Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Vårruset Stockholm is a popular spring running event held on Norra Djurgården, with distances of 2.5 and 5 km. The event offers a lovely spring evening with timing, a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, and a music quiz with prizes. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, with teams able to enjoy a picnic after finishing. This recreational race welcomes both individual runners and teams, with a focus on fun and community.
course_highlights: Course on Norra Djurgården, starting on Fiskartorpsvägen
Distance options of 2.5 km and 5 km; the 5 km course is officially measured
Start and finish on the grass area at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register early; otherwise, they must be collected on site. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee at Frescati Sports Center. The event area is easily accessible by public transport and bicycle. Parking is limited and subject to a fee.

name: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“
location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lietuva
description: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“ kviečia visus aktyvaus gyvenimo būdo entuziastus dalyvauti 5 km ir 10 km distancijose Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelėje. Renginys skirtas skatinti fizinį aktyvumą įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams ir suteikti galimybę varžytis bei realizuoti savo bėgimo gebėjimus. Trasos driekiasi miško takais ir keliukais, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gaus atminimo medalį. Varžybos organizuojamos Kėdainių sporto centro ir Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacijos bendradarbiavimu.
course_highlights: Trasos driekiasi Babėnų miško takais ir keliukais
5 km ir 10 km distancijos
Varžybos vyksta Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelėje, Aušros ir Budrio gatvių gale
additional: Papildoma registracija vyks starto vietoje nuo 17:00 iki 18:15 val. Numeriai išduodami likus valandai iki starto ir baigiami dalinti likus 15 minučių iki starto. Apdovanojami kiekvienos amžiaus grupės nugalėtojai ir prizininkai, taip pat greičiausi 3 dalyviai 5 km ir 10 km distancijose. Visi finišavusieji gaus atminimo medalius. Renginys planuojamas 2027 m. gegužės 26 d., tačiau detalių apie trasas ar dalyvio mokestį nėra pateikta.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running an exciting 4 km leg each. There are timed and untimed categories, and the race is promoted as an accessible and festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can participate completely free of charge, and there is specific information for schools.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)
price_range: 350–450 kr individuellt; 1 750–2 000 kr per lag om fem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 1750 kr tom 29 april

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 2000 kr tom 13 maj

description: Blodomloppet in Karlskrona is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also an 800-metre children’s race and a dedicated 5 km walking course. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and the event ends with a shared picnic for all participants. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity for individuals and teams, with special discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four different courses: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
Courses are measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association
Walkers have a separate course and start first to make a shared picnic afterwards possible
additional: There is a special discount of SEK 40 per person for blood donors and ICA members, for both individual entries and teams. You can register individually or in a team of up to 5 participants. Team members can take part in different distances/classes. It is possible to register many participants using an Excel template, and larger organisations can use customer portals to manage registrations. Walkers start first on a separate course to make a shared picnic after the race possible. You can take part individually or in a team of up to five people. Blood donors and ICA members receive a SEK 40 discount per person. Prices may be updated ahead of 2027.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km running race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race offers a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course, making it a popular running event. Participants can run individually or in teams of at least five people, with the team result based on the five fastest runners. The 2.5 km lap is run twice, with the start, lap point and finish in Stadsparken. Race bibs are distributed well before the start, with the option to collect them the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km course in central Västervik, starting and finishing in Stadsparken
The 2.5 km lap is run twice
Pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the entire course
additional: Race bibs are distributed before 17:30 on race day. Teams receive their race bibs together in one envelope. Race bibs can be collected on Tuesday 18 May at Intersport from 11:00 to 14:00, or on Wednesday 19 May at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. You can participate individually or in a team of at least five people; the five fastest times are added together.

name: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę
description: Leśna Piątka Na Dychę is a 10 km trail race held in Koszalin on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s forest educational trail. The course winds through scenic woodland, offering participants a unique and enjoyable experience. Organizers prepare distinctive cast-steel medals for runners, presented at the finish. The race is part of the Leśna Piątka series and takes place annually, attracting running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: The course follows the Karnieszewice Forest District’s forest educational trail
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
Scenic woodland offering a unique experience
additional: The race takes place in the evening, with the start at 19:00. Every participant receives a cast-steel medal. The start and finish are at the car park on Słupska Street, where the forest educational trail begins. The race is part of the Leśna Piątka series, which includes various editions and distances.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
description: The XIII 5-Mile Run is a race over 5 nautical miles (9260 m), organized by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Navy Officers’ Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Center. The course consists of two 4630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski.” The event is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and registered civilian runners. Foreign nationals may participate after prior verification. The race course is not certified by the PZLA, and payments are processed through Przelewy24.
course_highlights: 5 nautical miles (9260 m), divided into two 4630 m loops
Start and finish in front of the ORP “Gen. K. Pułaski”
The course is not certified by the PZLA
additional: Participation is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and registered civilian runners. Foreign nationals may take part after prior verification and arrangements with the organizer. Payments are made through Przelewy24.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: IK Akele och Blodtappen i Östergötland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ungdomslag (alla fem lagmedlemmar födda 2009 eller senare) deltar för halva startavgiften tack vare samarbete med Lejonfastigheter och Maxi ICA Linköping. Gäller endast till och med 30 april.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Sista dag för laganmälan är 14 maj, därefter är det individuell anmälan som gäller.

description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and participants can choose different distances within the same team. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free of charge on public transport in Östergötland on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men
The race takes place in Linköping, with the start and finish in central areas
Water stations are available along the course
additional: All participants who register by 14 May and provide a mobile phone number will receive a ticket link by text message for six hours of free public transport in Östergötland on 21 May. Team registration is for 3–5 people, and you always pay for 5, even if the team has fewer members. Race bib collection and late registration are available at several locations in the days before the race. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person, both for individual entries and team entries. Registration for 2027 opens in a few weeks, according to the organiser’s website.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women and starts at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The race offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable both for experienced runners and for those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line bag and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: Šimkaičių miestelyje, Jurbarko rajone, siekiant paminėti generolo Jono Žemaičio 117-ąsias gimimo metines. Tai 11 km ilgio krosas, kuris startuos nuo Generolo Jono Žemaičio vadavietės. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą, sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir pagerbia Lietuvos laisvės kovotojo atminimą. Dalyviai kviečiami registruotis iš anksto ir dalyvauti bendruomeniškame sporto renginyje.
course_highlights: 11 km ilgio krosas Šimkaičių apylinkėse
Startas nuo Generolo Jono Žemaičio vadavietės
Autobusų transportas į starto vietą nuo Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinės mokyklos
additional: Dalyvių registracija vyksta nuo 9:00 iki 9:30 val. Registracijos vieta - Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinė mokykla. Išvykimas autobusu į starto vietą 09:45 val. nuo mokyklos. Apdovanojimai numatyti 13:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti gydytojo leidimą arba būti pasitikrinę sveikatą. Rezultatai bus skelbiami viešai. Renginio metu bus daromos nuotraukos ir filmuojama medžiaga rinkodaros tikslais. Renginys vyks Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinėje mokykloje, dalyvių amžiaus grupės ir registracijos galimybė internetu.

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: „If“ Vilniaus pusmaratonis yra didžiausia pavasario bėgimo šventė Vilniuje, vykstanti miesto senamiestyje. Renginys kviečia dalyvauti visų amžių bėgikus - nuo vaikų iki pusmaratonio distancijos dalyvių. Bėgimas skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą, fizinį aktyvumą ir bendruomeniškumą, o dalyviai gali jaustis saugiai, nes visi bėgikai yra apdrausti nuo nelaimingų atsitikimų. Renginys pasižymi įvairiomis distancijomis ir draugiška atmosfera, kuri sukuria ilgalaikius ryšius tarp dalyvių.
course_highlights: Startas Katedros aikštėje Vilniaus senamiestyje
Pusmaratonio distancija - 21,098 km
Vaikų ir jaunimo bėgimai įvairioms amžiaus grupėms
additional: Dalyviai, registruojantis iki balandžio 4 d., gauna vardinius numerius. Galima įsigyti renginio marškinėlius už papildomą mokestį. Renginyje yra vaikų bėgimai nuo 2 metų, jaunimo 4,2 km bėgimas, 5 km ir 10 km distancijos be amžiaus ribojimų. Dalyviai gauna starto paketus su laiko matavimo mikroschema. Renginio programa apima apšilimus ir apdovanojimus kiekvienai distancijai. Renginyje dalyvauja įvairaus amžiaus grupės, yra keli starto laikai ir papildomos veiklos Vilniaus mieste ir senamiestyje.

name: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos
location: Trakų stadionas, Trakai, Vilniaus apskritis, Lietuva
description: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos yra oficialios 1000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Trakų stadione. Renginys skirtas tiek jauniesiems sportininkams, tiek mėgėjams, norintiems išbandyti savo greitį ir patirti tikrą sportinę atmosferą. Varžybos vyksta profesionaliai paruoštoje aplinkoje su aiškia stadiono trasa. Tai puiki proga išbandyti save klasikinėje bėgimo rungtyje ir pasimėgauti sporto dvasia Trakuose.
course_highlights: 1000 metrų distancija stadiono lengvosios atletikos take
Profesionaliai paruošta trasa stadione
Varžybos vyksta Trakų stadione, Birutės g. 44
additional: Registracija vykdoma el. paštu drasutisbarkauskas@gmail.com. Renginys vyksta Trakų stadione, Birutės g. 44. Varžybos yra oficialios 1000 m rungties varžybos, skirtos tiek jauniesiems sportininkams, tiek mėgėjams. Renginys yra įtrauktas į ištvermės sporto kalendorių, o dalyviams siūloma galimybė varžytis ir mėgautis sportine atmosfera Trakuose.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio rajono kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti kviečia dalyvius registruotis ir varžytis. Renginys organizuojamas Kupiškyje, siekiant skatinti sportinę veiklą ir bendruomeniškumą. Varžybos yra puiki proga pasitikrinti savo jėgas ir pasimėgauti bėgimu gražioje aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Renginys skirtas visiems amžiaus grupėms
Prizai laimėti Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams
Vieta Kupiškis, Lietuva
additional: Renginys vyks 2027 m. gegužės 29 d., registracija vyksta internetu ir per socialinius tinklus.

description: The Wild Vidzeme Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, which offers various distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The event takes place on scenic forest trails in Latvia, where participants can enjoy a variety of surfaces, including asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain. This race takes place in the vicinity of Augstroze and is suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. Stirnu buks is a traditional, friendly event that promotes an active lifestyle and enjoyment of nature.
course_highlights: Trails with varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain
Scenic forest trails in Latvia’s Vidzeme region
Distances suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Last-minute registration is available at the event centre on race day, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first. Hike participants may set off on any distance between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timing. After 12:00, fast runners may be encountered on the courses. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors and special groups.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia - Spring 2026 edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and scenic beauty
Spring race as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who focus on cross-country races and the scenic appeal of the locations. The event is part of a race series held in various cities across Poland during the spring season.

name: Pancerna Piątka
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in a 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Regional Police Commander in Rzeszów and organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie region. More than 400 participants take part, and the course runs along roads through Żurawica, offering sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km road race
The course runs along roads through Żurawica
The event is held under the Honorary Patronage of the Regional Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: More than 400 participants took part in the most recent edition.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
description: The Hajnówka Half Marathon is the region’s most important running event, following a route from Białowieża to the center of Hajnówka. Participants cover 21.0975 km through the scenic Białowieża Forest. Despite its intimate scale, the race has earned recognition and numerous awards for its good organization and professional service. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and a chance to connect with nature.
course_highlights: Route from Białowieża to the center of Hajnówka
Half-marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Scenic areas of the Białowieża Forest
additional: The race office is open Friday from 15:00 to 21:00 and Saturday from 8:00 to 9:30 at the Hajnówka Municipal Park Amphitheater. An ID card is required to collect the race pack. Running under another participant’s name is not permitted. Entries are not accepted on the day before or on race day. Participants can enjoy a complimentary coffee buffet while collecting their race packs.

name: 48 Zdrojowy Bieg Zwycięstwa
description: The 48th Zdrojowy Victory Run is an annual running event held in Gołdap, promoting physical activity and sports culture among residents and visitors. The race takes place on cross-country trails suited to both recreational and more experienced runners. The organizer, the Gołdap Sports and Recreation Centre, provides modern sports and recreation facilities, creating opportunities for active leisure throughout the year. The event is an important sporting occasion for the region, held during the summer season.
course_highlights: Cross-country trails in the scenic surroundings of Gołdap
Modern sports facilities at the Gołdap Sports and Recreation Centre
An event promoting physical activity and sports culture in the region
additional: The organizer is the Gołdap Sports and Recreation Centre, which manages the municipal stadium, sports and entertainment hall, tennis courts, and indoor swimming pool. The Centre also offers fitness classes, aqua aerobics, and cross-country ski rentals. The event is part of Gołdap’s calendar of major sporting events, alongside, among others, the Gołdap Night Ten and the Jaćwingowie Ski Run.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnowo Podgórne, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Lion Run is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting runners from across Poland. The route passes through scenic areas, offering participants both sporting challenges and beautiful views. The event is part of the Lion Festival, which also includes other races and additional attractions, such as an EXPO featuring partners and cheering competitions. The Lion Run is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and socializing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route passes through Tarnowo Podgórne and includes refreshment stations
Scenic views and varied terrain
Organized as part of the Lion Festival, with additional attractions
additional: The event includes the Lion EXPO, with dozens of partner stands. The streets of Tarnowo Podgórne will be closed on race day from 17:00 to 23:00. A contest is being held in which every hundredth person wins prizes. Race and recovery packages are available for half-marathon participants.

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
description: Bieg Poznaniaka is an annual running event held in Szreniawa, surrounded by Wielkopolski National Park. The event includes main races over 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking event, and numerous races for children and young people. The main race course follows a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km, which participants in the longer race complete twice. The event is organized by the Aperio Association, and its goal is to support the education of children and young people with autism.
course_highlights: The main race and Nordic Walking course follows a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km in Wielkopolski National Park
Participants in the 11 km race complete the loop twice; those in the 5.5 km race and Nordic Walking event complete it once
Children’s races take place at the National Museum of Agriculture and Agro-Food Industry in Szreniawa
additional: Race packets can be collected on race day at the National Museum of Agriculture and Agro-Food Industry in Szreniawa from 9:00 to 14:00. A bag drop is available at the venue. Participants are advised to arrive at least one hour before the start. A limited number of race packets (10) for the 11 km, 5.5 km, and Nordic Walking events will be available on race day; payment is cash only. Children’s races are divided into separate heats for the safety of the youngest participants. Participants aged 16–18 who are not accompanied by a guardian must have consent from a parent or legal guardian. The children’s awards ceremony will take place at around 12:25, and the adults’ awards ceremony at 14:45. The event ends at around 15:00.

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego Józefa Piłsudskiego, Warszawa, Poland
description: The Ekiden Relay Marathon is Poland’s largest team race in the Japanese ekiden relay format, held in Warsaw. The event is designed for teams of 6, who cover the marathon distance together, making it ideal for company, club, or friends’ team-building. The course consists of two loops, 2.195 km and 2.5 km long, and the different relay leg distances allow runners of various ability levels to take part. The start and finish are on the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw, and the event features an extensive program of team-building and sports activities.
course_highlights: The course consists of two loops: a shorter 2.195 km loop and a longer 2.5 km loop
The first runner covers 7.195 km; the next runners cover 10 km or 5 km on the 2.5 km loops
Start and finish on the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw
additional: Starts take place in waves from 9:00 to 13:00, every 15 minutes. The team captain collects the race packs, and relay batons are collected immediately before the start. There is a water station on the course 150 metres before the relay exchange zone. The event takes place on the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw, with access to bag storage, changing rooms, and toilets.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a unique night road-running event held along the atmospheric, historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The event features two races: 5 km and 10 km, starting at 18:00 and 20:00, respectively. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals, and cash and in-kind prizes for the top runners. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and experience the magic of night running in the welcoming atmosphere of this charming town.
course_highlights: The course winds along the atmospheric, historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie
Night road races over 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square
additional: Participants receive generous race packs containing T-shirts, bags, commemorative magnets, and medals. Post-race meals are available. Both races start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. The event takes place in the evening, creating a unique night-running atmosphere.

name: Phoenix RUN
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a picturesque forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. The event offers a variety of activities for the whole family, including a 10 km main race, 5 km nordic walking, and children’s races over distances from 100 to 800 metres. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively surrounded by nature, regardless of sporting ability. The organizers provide generous race packs, healthy food, and a chillout zone, creating a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race in the forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge
5 km nordic walking for adults
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 800 m in age categories 3–15
additional: Start and finish by the Smolarnia forester’s lodge. Children’s races start at 9:00; the main race and adult nordic walking start at 11:00. The event takes place deep in the forest, offering the power of nature and a unique atmosphere. The organizers offer opportunities for participants to socialize, healthy and delicious food, and a chillout zone.

name: VII Skaryszewski Bieg Konia
description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held in Skaryszew at the Hubertus Stud Farm. The event includes the main “Końska Dycha” race and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for participants of different ages. The course runs through the stud farm’s scenic grounds, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature and horses. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of Hubertus Stud Farm in Skaryszew
Scenic views and horses nearby along the route
Special races for children alongside the main race
additional: The event takes place at Hubertus Stud Farm, 72 Partyzantów Street, 26-640 Skaryszew. It also includes races for children.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: The Wichrowo Forest District invites all running enthusiasts to the next edition of the Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach race. The event takes place in the Wichrowo Forest District and includes a 10 km main race, races for children and teenagers, a race for people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking march. The start and finish of the main race are located by the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters. A familiarization run on the course is organized for those interested.
course_highlights: A 10 km main race through the Wichrowo Forest District
Age categories for children and teenagers, with various distances (200 m, 600 m, 2,500 m)
A Nordic walking march of approximately 10 km, starting on Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto
additional: The course familiarization run takes place on June 6 at 10:00. The Nordic walking march starts at 9:00 on Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto, at the parking area by the forest.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon Through Hell to Heaven is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The marathon route passes through the region’s picturesque landscapes, offering runners a challenge and unforgettable views. The event is amateur in nature and open to all running enthusiasts who want to take on a demanding distance. The organizers provide professional support and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route crosses varied terrain, combining elements of “hell” and “heaven”.
Picturesque views and nature reserves in the area around Końskie.
The race follows a cross-country route with natural obstacles and varied surfaces.
additional: The organizer’s office is open Mondays 13:00–17:00 and Tuesdays and Thursdays 8:00–11:00. Telephone: +48 514 030 401. No registration forms are available on the website; registration is via the link provided. Bank account for payments: 28 1240 5006 1111 0000 5555 8686.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
description: The 28th Bieg Święców is an annual running event held in Sławno, commemorating important historical events and promoting physical activity. The 5 km main race runs through the municipal stadium, along a tartan track and on cycling paths, offering participants an attractive course. The event also includes children’s and youth races at the stadium, held on the tartan track. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping and a 45-minute time limit for finishing the race, ensuring safety and smooth organization.
course_highlights: Main race course: municipal stadium, tartan track, cycling paths (3 x 1.5 km)
Children’s and youth races at the municipal stadium — tartan track
Electronic timekeeping using the ChampionChip system
additional: The time limit for completing the main race is 45 minutes. Participants must follow the instructions of the judges and course marshals. The race is open to people aged 17 and over (born in 2009 or earlier). A medical certificate or a declaration stating that the participant is taking part at their own risk is required. Children and youth participating in their races must have permission signed by a legal guardian.

name: V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
description: UltraWR is an international nordic walking event held in Na Skarpie Forest in Toruń. The festival features individual and team competitions in various events, as well as the open Ultra Nordic Walking Rally, which is ideal for people of all ages and ability levels. The rally route is 3 km long and runs along forest trails; participants can complete it multiple times during the four-hour event. The event promotes outdoor activity, community, competition, and care for the natural environment.
course_highlights: A 3 km rally route along the forest trails of Na Skarpie
Officially measured route with a chip that counts laps
Participants can complete the route multiple times over four hours
additional: The rally is free for children under 6, who will be registered on site. Participants receive a race bib and a chip for counting laps. A race pack and a recovery meal await participants. Visitors can tour the Bielawy Nursery Farm after registering in advance. The Dobrzejewice Forest District will run environmental and educational activities during the event. The rally is scheduled for Sunday, May 24, from 10:00 to 14:00. The fee depends on the number of people in the entry: from 20 zł for one person to 50 zł for five people; children under 6 can take part for free. The competition program includes 10 individual and team events.

name: Tolvanloppet 12km
description: Tolvanloppet is a city race with a friendly, charming atmosphere and events for all ages (in 2026, participants ranged from 2 to 98 years old). Adults can choose between two distances, the main event being 12 km (the shorter distance is 6 km). The course winds through the old residential neighborhoods of Bromma and is described as beautiful but challenging, with quite a few hills. Along the route, expect plenty of support from residents, including their own water stations (in addition to the course’s four official ones) and refreshing sprinklers. All this makes the race Stockholm’s most charming street race.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-Varvet is a classic running race in Eskilstuna, offering a scenic and varied course along the water and through the city’s parks. The race is popular with both elite runners and recreational runners, with a great atmosphere and crowd support along the entire route. It’s a perfect event for anyone looking to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings while enjoying Eskilstuna’s charm.
course_highlights: The course runs along Eskilstuna’s waterways and through its parks
Varied terrain with both asphalt and gravel
Crowd support along the entire course
additional: The distance is 10,549 metres.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Bėgam už Marijampolę yra tradicinis, kasmetinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Marijampolėje ir suburiantis įvairaus amžiaus dalyvius. Tai ne tik varžybos, bet ir regiono gyventojų susitikimas po atviru dangumi, skatinantis aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir bendruomeniškumą. Renginys pasižymi atnaujinta bėgimo trasa, kuri leidžia išbandyti ištvermę gražiame Lietuvos mieste. Taip pat renginyje vyksta pažintinis žygis „Einam už Marijampolę“ su 8 km ir 14 km distancijomis, į kurį registracija yra nemokama.
course_highlights: Atnaujinta bėgimo trasa Marijampolės mieste
Pažintinis žygis 8 km ir 14 km distancijomis
Renginys vyksta po atviru dangumi, skatinantis bendruomeniškumą
additional: Pažintinis žygis „Einam už Marijampolę“ vyksta kartu su bėgimu, registracija į žygį yra nemokama. Renginys suburia daugiau nei 1000 dalyvių, nuo mažiausių iki vyriausių. Organizuoja Marijampolės lengvosios atletikos sporto klubas. Renginio data - 2027 m. gegužės 30 d., dalyvių skaičius ir distancijos nėra nurodyti

name: “Mizojam, ka prieks”
location: Zeltiņu pļavas, Zeltiņi, Alūksne Municipality, Latvia
description: We run for joy is an open cross-country running series in Zeltiņi Parish, organised by Sports Club Zeltiņi since 2013. The races take place in four rounds in the meadows of Zeltiņi and are open to different age groups and fitness levels, with distances ranging from 300 metres for children to walking distances for the 60+ age group. The event welcomes both recreational runners and experienced athletes, and is characterised by variety, accessibility and a sense of togetherness. Traditionally, warm-ups are led by Latvian Olympians and athletes, creating a special atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country running on trails through the meadows of Zeltiņi
Distances ranging from 300 metres for children to walking distances for the 60+ age group
Warm-ups led by Latvian Olympians and athletes
additional: The competition is a four-round series open to children and adults, as well as walkers in the 60+ age group. Local businesses and the community support the event, promoting an active and sporty lifestyle. The series consists of four rounds, with events held at different locations in Zeltiņi Parish. The season opening includes a group warm-up run and soup by the campfire.

name: 12 Bieg Elegant na 5
description: The 12th Elegant na 5 Run is an annual running event held in Mosina, scheduled for May 24 in 2026. The event offers a variety of distances for children, young people and people with disabilities, as well as a 5 km main race that runs through the streets of the Mosina municipality. The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października, and the main race begins at 11:15. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a T-shirt, making the event appealing to a wide range of runners.

name: Biegamy, nie klikamy!
organizer: Biegamy, nie klikamy i Rotary Club Warszawa Konstancin
description: Biegamy, nie klikamy! is a charity 5 km run held in the picturesque Chojnów Landscape Park in Konstancin-Jeziorna. The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all levels. The start and finish are located at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, providing easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event promotes inclusion and supports a charitable cause, with all proceeds going to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery. Participation is free for primary and secondary school students.

name: Gontyniec Ultra Trail
description: Gontyniec Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held on the picturesque Gontyniec Hill in Chodzież, the highest elevation in the Greater Poland Lake District. The courses run mainly along forest trails marked with red and yellow signs, offering runners a variety of distances and elevation gains. Organized by the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, the event attracts cross-country and ultrarunning enthusiasts from across Poland, offering unique challenges over distances from 12 to 52 km. This iconic event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and the history of the region.

name: IV Honorowy Bieg Kadecki
description: The 4th Honorary Cadet Run is a special sporting event organized by I LO PUL Kutno – Uniformed Services High School, held to mark the Regimental Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment. The run pays tribute to local history and uniformed services traditions. Participants tackle a 5.5 km obstacle course at the military training ground in Kutno. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno, Mariusz Sikora, and invites everyone who enjoys physical activity to compete and have fun. The run starts at 13:00 at the AMZ S.A. training ground in Kutno, on Metalowa Street.

name: VI Niechanowska Dyszka i Piątka
description: The 6th Niechanowo 10K and 5K is an annual race held in the picturesque Planty Park in Niechanowo. The event offers two popular race distances: 10 km and 5 km, attracting both recreational and more experienced runners. It is an athletics event and a great opportunity to spend time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers provide professional timekeeping and technical support.

name: XII Bieg z książką
description: The 12th Run with a Book, ON THE TRAIL TO THE FINISH, is an open running event organized by the Nicolaus Copernicus University Alumni Program and the NCUM Marathon Club. It is dedicated to the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń community and to fans of running and reading. The race takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and its route follows forest paths and lanes through the campus woodland. Participants must complete the course while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event’s unique combination of sport and the promotion of reading. The race is sponsored by Robert Małecki, a crime fiction author and NCUM alumnus, who takes part in the race and meets participants after the competition.

name: XXII Bieg Sanguszków
organizer: Uczniowski Klub Sportowy „OGRODNIK” i Zespół Szkół Ekonomiczno-Ogrodniczych w Tarnowie
description: The 22nd Sanguszko Run is an annual running event held in Sanguszko Park in Tarnów. The event is organised by Kępa Sport, LKS Burzyn and the “OGRODNIK” Student Sports Club. The run aims to promote running and bring the running community together. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and professional event organisation.

name: IX Bieg Uliczny Z Siódemką na 7-kę
organizer: Szkoła Podstawowa nr 7 im. Konstantego Ildefonsa Gałczyńskiego w Częstochowie
description: The 9th Z Siódemką na 7-kę Street Run is an annual running event organized by Konstanty Ildefons Gałczyński Primary School No. 7 in Częstochowa. The event takes place in the picturesque Lisiniec Park, offering participants the chance to compete on a street-running course. The run promotes physical activity and brings the local community together, particularly students and residents of Częstochowa. The organizers ensure a sporting atmosphere and participant safety.
course_highlights: Street course in Lisiniec Park in Częstochowa
Picturesque park surroundings make for an enjoyable run
Organized by a local school with a sporting tradition
additional: Information about the course and children’s races comes from the 2023 edition.

name: XII Bieg Ulicami Bohaterów
location: Rynek, Plac Tadeusza Kościuszki, Małogoszcz, Poland
description: The Małogoszcz Streets Run – Heroes’ Run is an annual running event held in Małogoszcz that combines athletic competition with a voluntary blood donation campaign. Races are held over various distances suited to different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The start and finish are at the Market Square, at Tadeusz Kościuszko Square, and the courses run through the town streets. The event promotes physical activity and remembrance of heroes, offering prizes in age categories and special cash cards for the winners.
course_highlights: Race distances range from 300 m to 10,000 m
Start and finish at the Market Square, Tadeusz Kościuszko Square, in Małogoszcz
Courses suited to different age categories
additional: Residents of Małogoszcz municipality are eligible to compete in the children’s and youth categories (ages 4–15); other participants may run out of competition and are not eligible for the main prizes. Prizes are cash cards redeemable at stores with a payment terminal anywhere in the country. The event program runs from 15:00 to 16:55. The registration form allows you to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Previous editions included children’s and youth categories for ages 4–15; these were open to residents of Małogoszcz municipality, while others ran out of competition. Participants who finished the race received a commemorative medal.

name: XVII Bieg Wegański
description: The Vegan Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw that promotes a healthy, vegan lifestyle. The route runs mainly along the path by the Vistula River, offering participants scenic views and pleasant running conditions. The event is open to everyone who wants to combine sport with veganism and an active lifestyle. The organizers provide professional support and assistance from volunteers.
course_highlights: The route runs mainly along the path by the Vistula River
Scenic views along the river
Pleasant running conditions in Warsaw
additional: Before collecting their race packs, participants should check that their names are on the start list. This helps the volunteers work efficiently and reduces waiting times. For errors in registration or questions, participants can contact the organizers by email: info@runvegan.pl.

name: Stadionloppet
description: Stadionloppet is a family-friendly running event held at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The main race is 5 km long and takes place on a scenic two-lap course created by Kalle Berglund. The event is marked by a wonderful sense of community, where children, young people and adults can all take part and cheer one another on. The start, lap point and finish are at the beautiful stadium, offering a unique running experience in a setting where the buzz of the city meets greenery and birdsong.
course_highlights: 5 km two-lap course around Stockholm Olympic Stadium
Course created by Kalle Berglund, a former world-class runner
Start, lap point and finish at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
additional: All members of Djurgården Friidrott run for free and receive a registration code when they join. Several shorter distances are available for children and young people. Members can also take part as volunteers and be part of the event. Start times and categories are preliminary and may change. Stadiongirot, a cycling race held in collaboration with Djurgården Cykel, also takes place on the same day. Members of Djurgården Friidrott can run for free with a registration code. Distance and category details for 2027 are preliminary and may change. Free trial training on the course is held ahead of the race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.diffri.se/stadionloppet/): 2027-05-23 — "Stadionloppet 23 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-23)

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo Sporty, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Centre for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. This evening sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. There is no information about participant limits, fees, or start waves. Previous events have taken place in the evening; available results from one edition indicate a distance of 5 km.

name: Vårruset Jönköping
organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women, where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The event is all about the joy of movement and togetherness, with a great atmosphere among women. Everyone who crosses the finish line receives a medal and a goody bag, and teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. It’s a festive spring evening with entertainment and encouragement along the course and at the event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 5 km course
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken
additional: You can opt out of timing when registering, in which case your result will not be published in the results list. The recommended age is 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants are allowed when accompanied by an adult. Registration is binding and is open until one hour before the first start on race day. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal and a goody bag.

name: Bėgimas „Kutaliai – Kaltinėnai“
location: Kutaliai, Kaltinėnai eldership, Šilalė District Municipality, Lietuva
description: Bėgimas „Kutaliai - Kaltinėnai“ yra tradicinis krosas, skirtas Lietuvos Respublikos Prezidento Aleksandro Stulginskio 141-osioms metinėms ir Steigiamojo Seimo dienai paminėti. Varžybos vyksta raižytoje vietovėje, skatinant fizinį aktyvumą ir pagarbą sportui. Startas yra Kutalių kaime, o finišas - Šilalės rajono Kaltinėnų Aleksandro Stulginskio gimnazijos stadione. Dalyvauti gali miestų ir rajonų mokyklų sportininkai bei visi norintys, turintys gydytojo leidimą. Varžybas organizuoja Šilalės rajono Aleksandro Stulginskio gimnazija.
course_highlights: Krosas raižytoje vietovėje
Startas Kutalių kaime, finišas Kaltinėnų gimnazijos stadione
Skirta Lietuvos Respublikos Prezidento Aleksandro Stulginskio metinėms ir Steigiamojo Seimo dienai
additional: Registracija vyksta iki 9:30 val. varžybų dieną Kaltinėnų Aleksandro Stulginskio gimnazijoje. Dalyviai privalo turėti gydytojo leidimus arba paraiškas su gydytojo viza. Visi dalyviai apdovanojami atminimo medaliais, o grupių nugalėtojai - I, II, III vietos medaliais. Ankstesniame renginyje dalyviams buvo įteikti atminimo medaliai.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp
description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is an annual fun run through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The race offers a 7-kilometre course with smooth, even surfaces, ideal for both runners and recreational participants. For a shorter challenge, there is AktivRundan, approximately 3.8 kilometres with no timing, and children can take part in XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan, a 1.7-kilometre route through an easy-to-run park setting. All participants receive a medal and energy products, and there are great prizes to be won. The race is open to everyone, whether they walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with smooth, even surfaces through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km without timing for walkers and joggers
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children through an easy-to-run park setting
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, 26 May, between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is available at the bib collection point and at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. Timing uses a chip on the race bib tab; without it, no time will be recorded. The children’s race has four start times between 17:00 and 18:00, depending on age group. All participants receive a medal, energy products and a water bottle sponsored by local businesses. The children’s race prize-giving takes place on the stage in Bruksparken at 18:15. The race’s official website currently provides information about the 2026 edition; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been specified.

description: Blodomloppet in Uppsala is a recreational race that highlights the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race is open to everyone, whether taking part alone or with colleagues and friends. There are also special races, including Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet, for different ages and abilities. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic and helps promote blood donation and youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is officially measured and runs through Uppsala
The 5 km and 2.5 km courses are popular but not officially measured
Option to participate as a team of 5
additional: Team registration for 5 people is available. An Excel template for large registrations can be downloaded. The 10 km course is officially measured, while the 5 km and 2.5 km distances are approximate. Dogs are welcome to participate. A shared picnic is offered after the race. Water stations are located along the course. Changing facilities and toilets are available. Medical services are on site. Race bibs are distributed before the start. The race highlights the importance of blood donation.

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
location: Parking Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice, ul. Słupska, Koszalin, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział jest bezpłatny, zachęcamy do dobrowolnych wpłat wspierających organizację

description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is an annual cross-country run held in Koszalin on the forest educational trail of the Karnieszewice Forest District. The route starts and finishes at the car park on Słupska Street and is open to participants of all ages and experience levels. There is no timing or racing; the event promotes recreation and spending time outdoors as a family. Participants are encouraged to wear fairytale costumes, creating a unique and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows the forest educational trail of the Karnieszewice Forest District
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
A recreational cross-country run with no timing
additional: Participation is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. Participants are encouraged to dress in fairytale costumes, creating a unique atmosphere. On-site registration is also possible, but keepsakes and participation in the prize quiz are not guaranteed.

name: S:t Hans Extreme
description:
The course winds around S:t Hans Backar in Lund. In the ultra classes, the goal is to run as many laps as possible in 6 hours. The 10 km runners complete 4 laps and the 5 km runners complete 2 laps. Extreme One runners complete one lap.

One lap is 2.55 km with 140 metres of elevation gain. This means 10.2 km and 560 m of elevation gain for the 10 km, and 5.1 km and 280 m of elevation gain for the 5 km. Each lap in the ultra classes is extended with a flat section where runners go out and back along the same route so they can cheer each other on. The ultra-class lap is 4.38 km in total.
course_highlights: The course runs through S:t Hans Backar: technical trail with clear climbs and descents
One lap is 2.55 km with 140 m of elevation gain (10 km = ~10.2 km, 560 m of elevation gain; 5 km = ~5.1 km, 280 m of elevation gain)
The ultra lap is 4.38 km, including an out-and-back section where runners can cheer each other on; ultra-class runners complete as many laps as possible in 6 hours
additional:
The ultra starts at 14:00; the other classes start from 17:45.
Registration is at 
https://mittlopp.se/Anmalan/Arrangemangsgrupp/SHE2027_1

Löpare som springer i ett grönt kuperat landskap under ett lopp.

name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks
description: The 3rd Benno Viirand Memorial Fun Run is a family-oriented running and Nordic walking event held in Mustla. The race follows a 5 km course, starting near the Vambola bus stop in Soe village and finishing at the Tarvastu Gymnasium stadium. The event aims to honour the memory of the legendary runner Benno Viirand and promote running as a healthy way to spend time. In addition to the main race, free children’s races are held at the stadium. Participants are provided with race numbers and can register in advance or in person on race day.

name: Rojas 24h, 12h, 6h un maratona skrējieni
description: Roja Marathon Festival offers a variety of distances, including 24-hour, 12-hour and 6-hour ultramarathons, as well as a half marathon and shorter races. The event takes place at Roja Stadium on a certified asphalt course suitable for timed races. It welcomes both professional runners and amateurs, with a range of races and Nordic walking. The festival also includes children’s races and is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and the spirit of competition by the sea.
course_highlights: Course lap length: 1,234.7 m
Course surface: stadium and asphalt
The course meets the requirements for timed races and has World Athletics certification
additional: The 24-hour ultramarathon starts at 15:00, the 12-hour race at 20:00, the 6-hour race at 09:00, and the 42 km race at 10:00. The course is a 1,234.7 m loop with stadium and asphalt surfaces. Registration and bib collection take place on race day from 12:00 to 14:00. The awards ceremony is at 17:00.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Warszawa - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in picturesque locations, and the night edition stands out for its unique medals for participants. The race is ideal for runners who value scenic routes and a sense of community.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Eksjö Stadslopp is a community race that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The race takes runners through the beautiful wooden town of Eksjö and offers an enjoyable running experience filled with energy, camaraderie and joy. The proceeds go to Eksjö Södra IK’s children’s and youth activities, so taking part also supports a good cause. The start and finish are at Stora Torget in Eksjö, and the event has a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race passes through one of Sweden’s most beautiful wooden towns
The course is available in several distances, including 10 km and a 5 km fun run
Start and finish at Stora Torget in Eksjö
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Snäckan next to the swimming pool. Changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Start times vary by category, with children’s races starting from 18:00 onwards, the 10 km races for men and women starting at 19:30, and the 5 km fun run starting at 19:50. Group registration is available by email with invoicing. Results will be published on the club’s website after the race. The programme also includes a 1,000-metre youth race and a 600-metre children’s race.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: The adidas Shake Out Run is a 5 km race starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. It’s a perfect warm-up for participants running the Stockholm Marathon the following day, as well as an opportunity for other runners to experience the unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 people to register will receive an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size to run in, distributed at the event. After the race, people who register later can also collect T-shirts in the remaining sizes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance, starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
The race serves as a warm-up for the Stockholm Marathon
A unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: Age limit: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options include online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, and invoice via Klarna. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. The age limit is 13 years, or 11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Late registration can be completed online until one hour before the first start.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
distance_verbose: Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5.3 km, 5 km, 3000 metrai, 1.35 km, 0.2 km
organizer: Mažesniųjų Brolių Ordino Lietuvos Šv. Kazimiero Provincijos Klaipėdos Šv. Pranciškaus Asyžiečio Vienuolynas, VšĮ „Šv. Pranciškaus vilties miestas“, Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija ir VšĮ Klaipėdos lengvosios atletikos akademija
description: Vilties bėgimas yra tradicinis paramos ir solidarumo bėgimas Klaipėdoje, skirtas palaikyti onkologinėmis ligomis sergančius žmones ir jų artimuosius. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo vaikų bėgimų iki maratono, vykstančio žiedine trasa miesto centre. Bėgimas skatina sveiką ir aktyvų gyvenimo būdą bei vienija bendruomenę solidarumo ir vilties tikslais. Dalyviai gali pasirinkti individualias distancijas arba komandinę estafetę, o renginys vyksta gegužės pabaigoje su startais nuo ryto iki popietės.
course_highlights: Žiedinė trasa Klaipėdos miesto centre
Maratonas - 8 bėgimo ratai, pusmaratonis - 4 ratai
Įvairios distancijos nuo 0,2 km vaikams iki 42,195 km maratono
additional: Registracija vyksta internetu iki gegužės 29 d. 21:00 val., taip pat išankstinė registracija ir dalyvių paketo atsiėmimas gegužės 28-30 d. vietoje Klaipėdoje. Komandinės estafetės dalyviai registruojasi atskirai el. paštu. Startai vyksta skirtingu laiku pagal distanciją nuo 9:00 iki 14:00 val. Yra specialios trasos vaikams, senjorams ir žmonėms su negalia. Dalyviai kviečiami solidarizuotis ir paremti onkologinius ligonius bei jų artimuosius. Renginys taip pat kviečia dalyvauti žmones su negalia. 2026 m. daugumos distancijų startas ir finišas buvo Tiltų g. 26, o 0,2 km bėgimas vyko amfiteatro aikštėje prie Jono kalnelio.

name: Seiklus x Tartu
description: Seiklus x Tartu is the fifth stage of the adventure racing series and takes place in the city of Tartu. This one-day adventure race has teams of three navigating the terrain on foot, by canoe and by bike. It is suitable both as a serious competition and as an active way to spend time with friends in Estonia’s beautiful nature. The course offers distances of varying difficulty, including an accessible short course for everyone.
course_highlights: The course is completed on foot, by canoe and by bike
The short course is technically easy and accessible to everyone
There are several refreshment stations along the course with snacks and drinks
additional: The race centre opens at 9:00, with registration and distribution of race materials. There are snack and drink stations on the course, and hot food and tea are served at the finish. No organised transport or official accommodation is provided; participants are advised to use their own transport and arrange accommodation themselves. The course is a loop, with the start and finish at the same location. Participants can compete in three-person men’s, women’s and mixed teams, and individual participation is also possible. The short course is technically easy. The race centre opens at 9:00 and the start is at 10:00; hot food and tea are served at the finish.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve
description: The 55th Arco Vara run around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race held on the shore of Lake Harku. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are water stations along the course, which is marked and secured by course marshals. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome and start in the final group. The event centre is at the start/finish area, where race numbers are also distributed and the awards ceremony takes place.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru Secondary School stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups and take part in several events, including the 100 m run, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 m run. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, and participants may enter all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s runs, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day outdoors, while highlighting time spent together with family and friends.

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event held in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a variety of routes, from short night races to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, which take them through the scenic landscapes of Roztocze. The event is organized by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: Rock Run Jarocin is a unique running event combining sport, music and the atmosphere of Jarocin, a city known as the heart of Polish rock. The race attracts both experienced runners and first-timers, offering a route through the most interesting parts of Jarocin Municipality. It is not only a sporting competition but also a community of enthusiasts and a great sporting adventure that will stay with you for a long time. The event is part of the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix and emphasizes good organization and enthusiastic crowd support.
course_highlights: The route passes through the most interesting parts of Jarocin Municipality
The event combines sport with the atmosphere of a music city and a rock vibe
The race is part of the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix
additional: Details of the race pack will be announced approximately 2 weeks before the race. The event offers music, spectator, photo and finisher zones. Participants will receive a medal and a T-shirt at the finish. The junior race gives children a chance to enjoy their first sporting experience and the joy of being active.

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
description: The 13th Bieg Konopielki is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Kościelny, attracting both local runners and visitors from other towns. The main 10 km race runs along the streets of Juchnowiec Dolny, with the start and finish at the stadium. After the race, participants can join a social picnic in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, featuring regional food, a concert, and a book prize drawing. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with a family run and numerous other activities.
course_highlights: A 10 km route along the streets of Juchnowiec Dolny, with a loop in Wólka
Start and finish at the stadium in Juchnowiec Dolny
Sandy roads and local streets along the route
additional: Registration is available on race day from 9:00 to 11:30 at the Race Office at the stadium. After the race, a social picnic will be held in Frampol, featuring regional food, a visit to Edward Redliński’s House of Creativity, a concert, and a book prize drawing. Race packages include an invitation to the feast. Meals can be reserved for accompanying guests (adults and children, including meat-free options).

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
location: Żelkowo, Gmina Główczyce, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema Run is a 10 km race held in Żelkowo, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to different experience levels, with support from experts. The event is a road race for runners looking to improve their 10 km times.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging asphalt course
10 km distance
Location: Żelkowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. There is also an opportunity to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.
price_range: 50 zł za pojedynczy bieg lub 150 zł za cały cykl; biegi dziecięce i młodzieżowe bezpłatne

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach głównych: 150,00 zł wpłata jednorazowa za cały cykl biegowy (opcja dostępna w elektronicznym formularzu zgłoszeniowym)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych jest bezpłatny.

description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in scenic towns across Masuria, including Sorkwity. The 5 to 10 km courses run along paved, cobbled, and forest paths, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature. The event also includes races for children and teenagers in various age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys. Every participant in the main race receives a commemorative medal, and the organizer provides water and a hot meal. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors and enjoy the beautiful Masurian scenery.
course_highlights: Courses from 5 to 10 km on paved roads, cobblestones, and forest paths
Races for children and teenagers in several age categories, with separate starts for girls and boys
Scenic Masurian surroundings near Sorkwity
additional: The participant limit for all distances at each race is 400. The race office opens 1.5 hours before the start. Race packs can be collected up to 30 minutes before the race. The organizer provides water and a hot meal prepared by local Rural Housewives’ Circles. The limit for the 2026 edition was 400 participants.

name: Dolska Dycha
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race held in Dolsk, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among the local community. The course is certified by the PZLA and marked every kilometre. It runs on roads closed to traffic within the Dolsk municipality. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect refreshment stations, medical care, and a post-race recovery meal. The start and finish are at the Janusz Kusociński Primary School.
course_highlights: Course certified by the PZLA
Markers every kilometre and volunteers on more challenging sections
The race takes place on roads closed to traffic
additional: Race packs can be collected at the Race Office on event day from 16:00 to 17:30. A race pack may be collected by a third party or transferred to another person. No bag drop is available for participants. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km and 60 minutes for the 3 km. A refreshment point with water is located at the 5 km mark.

name: Kresowe Trail #6
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate series of trail races held on scenic routes in eastern Poland, promoting a healthy lifestyle and respect for nature. The races offer two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), as well as Nordic Walking competition. Organized by the Maratony Kresowe Foundation, the races combine passion, competition, and friendship, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of varying ability levels. The events are held with respect for local communities and the natural environment.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Scenic areas of Podlasie and its surroundings, including hilly terrain and forest paths
Carefully marked routes with aid stations on the longer distance
additional: Starts are organized in corrals according to results from the previous season. The race package includes a race bib with a timing chip valid for the entire season, a hot post-race meal (with a vegetarian option), medical cover, aid stations along the route and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography services, and prizes for the top competitors. Online registration is also available on race day until 08:40. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Roztocze Ultra Race
location: Józefów, Biłgoraj County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a challenging ultrarunning event held in the picturesque Roztocze region, near Józefów. The course passes through diverse landscapes, including forests, hills, and valleys, offering participants unforgettable views and off-road challenges. The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, organized by a foundation with a passion for sport and development. It attracts runners looking for challenging courses and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The course runs through Roztocze National Park and the surrounding forests
Varied terrain: forest trails, gravel roads, and dirt roads
Picturesque views of the Roztocze hills and valleys
additional: The event offers live GPS tracking and live results. The varied routes range in distance from 3 km (Nocna Trójka) to 100 km (Roztoczańska Setka). The event is part of the Janosik Race Series, which also organizes other races in Poland. Participants can expect professional organization and support along the course.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The run commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels. The races take place on routes around Orchowo, giving participants the opportunity to compete and connect in a sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide professional support and attractive race conditions.

name: XI Bieg Pamięci Grupy Kampinos Żołnierzy...
location: Zespół Sportowo-Rekreacyjny, Leszno, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Kampinos Group Home Army Soldiers Memorial Run is a race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army. The event takes place in Leszno, and the start and finish of the main race and the Children’s Races are on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex. The main race is 11 km long and is held in a spirit of historical remembrance.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
description: The Kwidzyn Paper Run is an annual running event that began in 2010, born from a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and fun. The 10 km race runs through the center of Kwidzyn, bringing together the local community and runners from across Poland. The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participants can enjoy a range of free activities. It is organized by MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation. Join the running community and celebrate sport and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: The course is 10,000 meters long and runs through the center of Kwidzyn
There are two checkpoints and two water stations along the course
The course provides participants with comfort and safety
additional: The event accompanies Paperworker’s Day—a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees—with many free activities throughout the day. The schedule includes the opening of the race office, a group warm-up, yoga and mobility, a meeting with champion Robert Korzeniowski, the awards ceremony, and a children’s race. Photos and video footage are taken during the race for promotional purposes.

name: 12 Leżajski Bieg Zośki Turosz
organizer: Burmistrz Leżajska; Miejskie Centrum Kultury w Leżajsku; Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Leżajsku; Uczniowski Klub Sportowy przy SP1 w Leżajsku
description: The 12th Leżajski Bieg Zośki Turosz is an annual street race held in Leżajsk that brings generations together and promotes physical activity. The event features races at various distances for children, teenagers and adults, including a 15 km main race and additional races of 8 km, 3 km and 0.5 km. The event combines sport and community, commemorating Zośka Turosz. The organizers provide professional event services and support from the relevant services, and participants can look forward to an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: 15 km main race through the streets of Leżajsk
Additional 8 km, 3 km and 0.5 km races for children and teenagers
Street course with support from event organizers and the relevant services
additional: The event also includes 3 km races for adults and teenagers and a 0.5 km race for children. Consent forms for underage participants must be submitted to the Race Office on race day. The organizers include the Mayor of Leżajsk, the Municipal Cultural Centre, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Leżajsk.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, officially measured in accordance with current rules, and follows a new route through central Stockholm. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, officially measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and the IAAF
A new route through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), with a passage through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, features mixed surfaces and has a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours, and the contact email for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The course passes through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
description: The loop is a real gem, if we may say so ourselves—a slice of Uppland at its best. The race hub is High Chaparral Park, with its large green spaces: a natural race base in the heart of the community of Vänge. Backyard Ultra Vänge will draw spectators along the course, which awaits you dressed in lovely spring attire. We have taken care to create a varied and somewhat challenging course. The result is an experience where something is always happening and the running never gets monotonous. Large parts of the race take place on the slightly bumpy trail on the outskirts of the community. You’ll feel as if you’re flying over soft ground beneath big trees and past colossal rocks. Several national-team runners began their running careers here, and many prominent floorball players have sweated through hard training sessions. An oasis in the forest—with a glimpse of Highway 72. A road tunnel takes you beneath the highway and into the unique Uppland rowing village of Vänge-Ekeby. The village, which has been a listed building since 1998, has medieval origins and a preserved village layout. Vänge Hembygdsförening has given the village an active cultural life and attracted many visitors. The course winds through this fantastic setting. Take the opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and a glimpse of society as it once was. Then it’s back beneath the highway and into the forest on small trails. Before you know it, you’re back in the community and looping around High Chaparral. Take a short rest and perhaps enjoy some of the energizing snacks on offer. Then you’re off again. Wonderful!
