name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club och Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra is a welcoming race in the deepest forests of Småland, featuring a scenic, hilly 6.7 km backyard loop and a 3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners. The event is organised by Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö, with a focus on community and charity; all proceeds go to charitable causes. The number of laps is limited to 15, creating a challenging but fun experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Hilly 6.7 km backyard loop through the forests of Småland
3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners
Nature-focused race with a charitable purpose
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 09:00 to Sunday at 00:00. The number of laps is limited to 15. All proceeds from the race go to charitable causes. Backyard laps start on the hour. 09:00; information about the 2027 start time is unavailable.

name: Småland Adventure Race
description: A warm welcome to Småland Adventure Race 2027. After three fantastic years, we’re ready to take on a new challenge and aim for a race that’s at least as good as the last one. Småland Adventure Race is a multisport competition in which teams of 2–4 people use a map and compass to visit all checkpoints (CPs) as quickly as possible. CPs usually consist of a small physical orienteering marker and are marked with circles on the maps. The course will include a number of transition areas (TAs) where teams switch between disciplines. The race will mainly involve running, mountain biking and paddling, along with other adventures. In the three previous races, participants have paddled on air mattresses, climbed, tackled a high ropes course, gone SUPing and run a maze orienteering course. Some checkpoints have been at the top of climbing nets and others in the middle of a slackline, but most are in more accessible locations. We can promise many hours of wonderful adventure! We offer a long and a short class. Provisionally, teams in the long class will be out for 22–26 hours, and teams in the short class for 11–13 hours. In 2027, we’re also offering a Bike and Run class, a recreational class where you’ll be out for just 5–7 hours and take on a few fewer adventures—but still have a great time.

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
description: Markaryd Savings Bank Race is a well-organized running race in Markaryd, organized by SK Graal. The race has strong local roots, with Markaryd Savings Bank as its main sponsor, and offers an enjoyable running experience for participants of different ages and levels. SK Graal also offers training opportunities ahead of the race and supports the local running community. The event is a popular tradition that brings together runners from near and far.
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 until 30 minutes before the start. SK Graal offers training sessions on Mondays and Thursdays at 18:00. SK Graal members receive a 15% discount on running shoes at Team Sportia in Markaryd. Held in conjunction with Markaryd’s spring market.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
location: Långe Erik Lighthouse, Byxelkrok, Öland, Sweden
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon that starts at Långe Erik Lighthouse on Öland and offers three distances: 100 miles, 50 miles and 50 km. The race offers a fantastic running experience along the coast of the Kalmar Sound, through meadows and forests, and across the unique limestone pavement with views of the Baltic Sea. The finish location depends on the distance: 50 km in Djupvik, 50 miles in Lindby and 100 miles at Långe Jan Lighthouse. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal and a T-shirt as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik Lighthouse and finish at Långe Jan for the 100-mile distance
Run along the coast of the Kalmar Sound and through meadows and forests
Views of the Baltic Sea and Öland’s unique limestone pavement
additional: All distances start together on Friday afternoon at 15:00 at Långe Erik Lighthouse. Aid stations or energy stations are located approximately every 20 km along the course. Get 15% off accommodation at Böda Sand during the weekend when booking with the code Lighthouse Challenge. Energy and hydration stations are located along the course; the official race website states that they are approximately 20 km apart. Published prices apply to 2026 and may change before 2027.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Jog Together is a fun, relaxed family event taking place on 31 May at Haapsalu Railway Station. The group jog is about 3+ kilometres at an easy pace (~7:30 min/km), welcoming everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the campaign’s grand finale, bringing together the various jogs held across the county during May. Both previous participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy being active together and strengthen the sense of community.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Konstancin-Jeziorna (Park Zdrojowy im. hrabiego Witolda Skórzewskiego)
description: The course consists of two 2.5 km loops through pine and mixed forests, with gentle terrain suitable for runners of all ability levels. The start and finish are at the forest car park on Od Lasu Street, offering easy access and convenient viewing for spectators. The event combines sporting competition with community spirit and support for the local community, and all funds raised will be donated to the Special Education School Complex in Pęchery.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere filled with sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with wooded sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding even more excitement to the running festival.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a unique running event. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around picturesque Lake Swarzędzkie, while the 10 km race offers a dynamic route with forest sections and city streets. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a varied food area, partner expo, post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops, covering a total distance of 21.097 km and running scenically around Lake Swarzędzkie. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a unique atmosphere, and support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Run on the Occasion of the Ropczyce Land Days is a 10 km race taking place in Ropczyce. This running event is organized to mark a local celebration and attracts runners looking to spend time actively on a moderately long course. The route runs through the scenic surroundings of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather, with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part in the event.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Zduńska Wola Running Festival is a jubilee running event held to mark the 200th anniversary of Zduńska Wola being granted town rights. The races take place on the town’s streets and in nearby municipalities, starting and finishing at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. Participants can compete in the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and family run. The event attracts many runners, offering attractive routes and a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Zduńska Wola
Half-marathon turnaround in the village of Brzeski in Sędziejowice Municipality
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street
additional: The event is organized by the Zduńska Wola City Office. Previous editions have seen several hundred participants, including 151 in the 5 km, 111 in the 10 km, and 151 in the half marathon. The half-marathon route passes through Zapolice Municipality to the village of Brzeski.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
description: The Crown of Princess Dąbrówka Run is an annual running event held on the last Sunday of May in Dąbrówka. The main 10 km race follows forest trails surrounded by greenery. There is also a 7.5 km Nordic walking event and shorter races for children. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among local residents and running enthusiasts. The organizers foster a welcoming atmosphere and offer a range of classifications, including team categories and categories for people with disabilities.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race along forest trails surrounded by greenery
7.5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres
additional: The start and finish for the run and Nordic walking event are at the edge of the Palędzie-Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Race packets can be collected in the days before the event at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall and on race day at the race office. There are numerous classifications, including a team category for mixed teams of five, age categories, categories for people with disabilities, and awards for residents of Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer housing estates. The children’s races take place from 9:00 to 12:00, over distances suited to participants’ ages. The event is a jubilee celebration and a festival of running for the local community.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: LoveLas Trail is a unique sports and recreation event held in the heart of the Masovian forests in the village of Przystań, Olszewo-Borki Municipality. This forest race brings together a passion for physical activity, a love of nature, and social connection. Courses of varying difficulty are available to runners of different skill levels, as well as families and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The event has an atmosphere full of positive energy and respect for nature, making LoveLas Trail a special celebration of sport and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes along forest trails of varying difficulty
The Król Lasu distance of approximately 20 km for determined runners
The 2 km family race Zielona Przygoda, open to everyone, including the youngest participants
additional: Race office open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times: 09:00 - Król Lasu (approx. 20 km), 10:00 - Bieg Wiatrów (5 km) and Trasa Wilka (10 km), 10:05 - Spacer Szakala (Nordic Walking 5 km), 10:15 - Zielona Przygoda (2 km family run/walk). The entry fee includes a race bib, returnable timing chip, commemorative gift, medal, recovery meal, and sweet treat. Open classifications for women and men are held for the 5, 10, and 20 km distances and Nordic Walking, with trophies for the top finishers.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
description: Mazowiecka Piętnastka is a celebratory road race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Mińsk Mazowiecki. Held annually, the event attracts runners from across Poland and offers an appealing 15-kilometre course. It is a great opportunity to celebrate through sport and connect in the picturesque city of Mińsk Mazowiecki. In 2026, the race takes place on May 31, and MOSiR celebrates 50 years of operation.
course_highlights: A 15 km course along the streets of Mińsk Mazowiecki
Picturesque views and a clearly marked course
A celebratory edition organized by MOSiR, which has 50 years of experience
additional: The organizer is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Mińsk Mazowiecki, open from 8:00 to 16:00 Monday through Friday. The course is statically marked on a map available on the organizer's website.

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The Mokotów SGH Run is Poland’s largest student-organized charity run, combining sport with support for people in need. The event’s 13th edition is an opportunity to cover the streets of Mokotów together, in an atmosphere of sporting passion and community spirit. Participants can look forward to a gathering area, a group warm-up and a medal ceremony. The run supports the “Akogo?” Foundation, helping people in comas. It brings together sport, solidarity and the energy of student involvement.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes through Mokotów
Finish line in the SGH Rector’s Gardens
A run for children and whole families
additional: A race village with partner activities, a group warm-up before the start, a medal ceremony after the run, the option for whole families to take part, a charity run supporting the “Akogo?” Foundation.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: The Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual challenge that takes you on a 198 km route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro. Travel from the Santa Cruz da Barra Fortress to the famous Christ the Redeemer monument, tracking your progress with a mobile app. Every physical activity, from running to yoga, counts toward completing the distance, and participants can enjoy an interactive map and Street View. Join a community that motivates one another and earn a carnival-inspired medal.
course_highlights: A 198 km route from Santa Cruz da Barra Fortress to the Christ the Redeemer monument
An interactive map with Street View in the final stages
Track a variety of physical activities, including yoga and strength training
additional: Participants have access to a private Facebook group where they can share experiences and motivate one another. For every 20% of the challenge completed, the organizer plants a tree or helps prevent plastic pollution. You can choose your own start date and challenge duration. The app is available on iOS and Android and syncs with popular fitness trackers.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultrarunning festival held in Pabianice, featuring three main events: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km. The competition also serves as the Polish Cup of the Polish Ultra Sports Association and the PZLA Polish Championships in ultrarunning. This unique event attracts long-distance runners, offering challenging courses and a top-level competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: UltraPark 48h and UltraPark 24h courses — timed races that test endurance
UltraPark 100 km — a classic ultra distance certified by PZLA
High-level organization with professional support and timing

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
location: Lemany, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 5th Po Kolei Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Lemany, near Szczytno. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.1 km long and follows scenic routes around the village. In addition to the half marathon, the event includes children’s races over various distances and a 5 km race, making it appealing to participants of different ages and ability levels. The event combines sport and recreation and is organized by the District Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Szczytno together with local partners. The main race is scheduled to start at 9:00. Participants can collect their race packets the day before or on race day.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course of approximately 21.1 km
Children’s races over distances from 100 m to 800 m
A 5 km race as an additional event
additional: On race day, registration is available only for race packets that have been released. The race office is open from 7:00. Participants must start with a chip and race bib, which must be returned after the race. Minors must have written consent from their legal guardians. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 12:30.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. Adama Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Poland
description: The 11th Sieradz Friendly Cross is organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club. It promotes running as a simple form of physical activity and brings together the running community of Sieradz. The event takes place in A. Mickiewicz Municipal Park, where participants compete on a 2-kilometer gravel loop. The race lasts 6 hours, and the winner is the runner who completes the most laps in that time. Runners receive bibs with chips for electronic lap and time tracking.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in Sieradz Municipal Park
100% gravel surface
Lap markers every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00. Participants may stop and resume running at any time, but during breaks they must remain in the designated transition area. The participant limit is 250. Participants receive a returnable race bib with a chip to track laps and time. Minors may take part with parental consent and may run a maximum of 10 km (5 laps).

name: XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka
description: The 14th Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual running event organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism and Recreation Centre in Kostrzyn. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place on a course in Kostrzyn, engaging the local community and fostering integration. The organizers ensure participants’ comfort and safety by providing well-prepared sports facilities.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
description: The 39th Stolemów Run is an annual 10 km race held in Gniewino, attracting runners from different age categories. The event takes place at the Arena Mistrzów sports stadium and also includes children’s races, a Nordic Walking march, and a recreational run-walk. Participants are timed electronically, and medals and prizes for the top finishers await them at the finish. For those unable to attend in person, a virtual race option is also available during a designated period.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km main race
5 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races over distances from 80 m to 800 m
additional: 11:00, official warm-up at 13:10.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is an annual road race held in Kielce that promotes physical activity and social integration. The 5-kilometer course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the May Funds events in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, highlighting European values and the local community.
course_highlights: A 5 km road course
The race takes place in central Kielce
The event promotes physical activity and social integration

name: IV Marszobieg Politechniki Częstochowskiej
location: Olsztyn, Częstochowa County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: The event offers various distances and age groups suitable for runners, Nordic walkers, and recreational athletes of all ages. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide an opportunity to compete, and celebrate family-oriented activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the shared-use path and at the stadium, with recognition for the top runners and representatives of the area.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible, remote running event that allows participants to complete their chosen distance in their local area at a time that suits them. The event offers several distance options, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21 km), as well as the option to take part in a children’s race. Participants can record and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring that results are reliable and can be compared with those of other participants around the world. The virtual run offers a convenient, environmentally friendly way to take part in sport without having to travel to an event venue.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a traditional running series event that began in 2016 and will take place in three stages in 2026. The runs are held on the Kambja health trails, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt sections. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to take up recreational running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which uses body weight and elevation gain in its calculations. Runners who participate in all three stages will receive a series T-shirt, and the grand prize winners will receive a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.

name: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ (1 diena)
organizer: VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ “100 marathon club Lithuania”
description: „Vilnius 5 in 5“ yra unikalus penkių dienų bėgimo iššūkis Vilniuje, kuriame dalyviai gali įveikti penkis maratonus, pusmaratonius, 12,6 km arba 4,2 km distancijas iš eilės. Renginys skatina ištvermę, ryžtą ir kasdienį sugrįžimą į trasą, suteikdamas galimybę patirti tikrą etapinio bėgimo nuotykį. Tai pirmas tokio tipo renginys Lietuvoje, įkvėptas pasaulinės tradicijos, kuris vyksta Vingio parko estradoje. Dalyviai gali pasirinkti savo distanciją ir starto laiką, o renginį organizuoja VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir VšĮ „100 marathon club Lithuania“.
course_highlights: Vingio parko estrada Vilniuje
Galimybė pasirinkti starto laiką 9:00 arba 15:00 pirmosiomis trimis dienomis 4,2 km ir 12,6 km distancijose
Penki startai per penkias dienas su skirtingomis distancijomis: maratonas, pusmaratonis, 12,6 km ir 4,2 km
additional: Varžybų laiko limitai: maratonui - 8 val., pusmaratoniui - 4 val., 12,6 km - 3 val., 4,2 km - 1 val. Trasos GPX failas prieinamas internete. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Už nepilnamečius atsako tėvai, globėjai arba treneriai. Renginio metu bus gaivinimo punktas trasoje. Dalyviai sutinka, kad jų nuotraukos ir filmuotą medžiaga gali būti naudojama rinkodaros tikslais. Daugiadienis bėgimas, trasos Vilniaus Vingio parke, įvairios distancijos, registracija ir sveikatos patikrinimas būtinas.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
description: Stage 5 – Merimetsa is part of the 24th Tervisejooks ja -kõnd series, which takes place in the car parks at Pelguranna and Stroomi Beach. This 3.6 km stage gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and fitness trails in a coastal area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering varied landscapes and views.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö SOK
description: Blodomloppet in Stockholm is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or in a team with colleagues and friends. The race is a popular workplace wellness activity and ends with a large picnic, offering a social and meaningful experience for all ages and levels. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, Specialomloppet, and the option to participate remotely.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in central Stockholm
Walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12
additional: Dogs are allowed in the 5 km walking category. Wheelchairs and walking poles are permitted only in the walking categories. Strollers are not allowed during the race, but are allowed in the event area. Team registration (at least 5 people) includes a picnic bag, with extra bags available to purchase. Tents can be rented for teams or companies in the event area. Start times are divided into several groups for the 5 km and 10 km, including walking and competitive categories, with prizes for the top 3 runners. Teams must register with five people. The walking categories are not timed; blood donors receive a discount. Information about the course route and start times for 2027 will be announced later.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteerumispäevakud, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used at the competition, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 1. posms – Uzvaras parks
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series in Riga for the whole family, held at five unique locations around the city, including Victory Park. The series aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage Riga residents to be physically active. The races are suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, with distances ranging from children’s races to 10 km. The atmosphere is friendly and sporty, and participants can take part individually or in family teams.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Victory Park on a 1.52 km loop
The 5 km distance consists of three loops along the park paths
The relatively flat terrain is suitable for runners of different levels
additional: Bib collection starts at 18:00. There are two entrances to the start area, and participants are asked to assess their pace honestly when choosing a place in the start corral. A dedicated bag storage facility is available; participants receive a tag that must be kept for the entire season, and replacing it costs 2 EUR. It is recommended to arrive at least 30–45 minutes before the start. Public transport is the recommended way to get there, as parking in the area is limited. The series includes five events per season; participants who start in at least four events receive a commemorative season prize.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
description: Wydminy Night Run is an annual 5 km race held in the picturesque town of Wydminy. The event is organized by HERON ULTRA TRAIL and local partners, attracting runners who enjoy the atmosphere of a night race surrounded by the Masurian countryside. The course passes through forested areas and along lakes, offering participants exceptional views and challenges. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and connect with others in the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: The route runs through forests and the Masurian countryside
The race takes place at night, adding a unique atmosphere
Views of lakes and hilly terrain
additional: The organizer is HERON ULTRA TRAIL. The event is a night race covering 5 km. No information is available about entry fees or the start time. The event is promoted on Facebook, where you can find updates and contact the organizers.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Lammasmäe Eesti Ööjooks - Rakvere 2026
description: This is a popular sporting event that brings running enthusiasts together and offers an exciting, atmospheric night-running experience. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Rakvere, giving participants a unique opportunity to enjoy sport and the urban landscape at night.
course_highlights: Night run in the city of Rakvere and its surroundings
Beautiful and varied scenery
Atmospheric and energetic race environment
additional: The event includes various distance options and promotes healthy lifestyles and community support.

name: II Biegniem bez las
organizer: LUKS Huragan Lipniki oraz grupa „Razem możemy więcej”
description: “Biegniem bez las” is a running event held in Lipniki, in the Łyse municipality. Participants can choose a 5 km or 10 km race, or a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The routes follow forest roads in the Kurpie region, and the event combines sporting activity with a gathering of the local community.
course_highlights: 5 km race
10 km race
5 km Nordic Walking event
additional: The event takes place in Lipniki, in the Łyse municipality.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with ~70 meters elevation gain
Course runs through Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single/double tracks and gravel, day and night same loop
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. Minimum 7 loops (46.9 km) needed for award medal. Runners receive 3, 2, and 1-minute warnings before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. No showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents but are not the organizer's responsibility. Renginyje yra palapinių bazė ir pagalbos stotelės, tačiau yra apribojimų dėl pagalbos trasoje.

name: Vilnius 5000 2027
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lietuva
description: Vilnius 5000 yra unikalios 5000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniaus Vingio parko stadione. Dalyviai turi galimybę varžytis kartu su greičiausiais Lietuvos ir užsienio bėgikais, mėgautis gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera. Renginys siūlo įvairias rungtis, įskaitant individualius 5000 m bėgimus, 5x1000 m estafetę ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetę. Tai puiki proga pagerinti savo asmeninį rezultatą ir patirti nepamirštamą palaikymą bei bendruomenės dvasią.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
5000 m bėgimas, 5x1000 m mišri estafetė ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetė
Gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera su maisto vagonėliu po finišo
additional: Dalyviai suskirstomi į grupes pagal asmeninius rezultatus arba prognozuojamą įveikimo laiką. Elito grupių dalyviai privalo naudoti WA stadiono patvirtintus bėgimo batelius ir turėti antidopingo kursų pažymėjimą. 5x1000m estafetės komandos yra mišrios, o 2x400m tėčio ir vaiko estafetėje amžiaus ribojimų nėra. Renginio metu veiks maisto vagonėlis, o dalyviai sutinka, kad jų rezultatai ir foto/video medžiaga gali būti viešai skelbiami. Renginys vyksta Vilniaus Vingio stadione, dalyvių registracija vyksta renginio dieną, ir jame gali dalyvauti tiek profesionalūs, tiek mėgėjų bėgikai.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai Kaune kviečia miesto gyventojus ir svečius dalyvauti įvairiose nemokamose sporto veiklose. Renginyje siūlomos skirtingos bėgimo distancijos: 500 metrų vaikų bėgimas, 1988 metrų lietuviškos olimpinės mylios bėgimas, 5 ir 10 kilometrų varžybos. Be bėgimo, dalyviai gali išbandyti ekstremalų bėgimą su kliūtimis, orientavimosi sportą ir 3×3 krepšinio turnyrą. Šis renginys siekia suburti bendruomenes ir skatinti aktyvų gyvenimo būdą, kartu suteikiant galimybę susitikti su profesionaliais sportininkais ir olimpiečiais.
course_highlights: 500 metrų vaikų bėgimas
1988 metrų lietuviška olimpinė mylia
5 ir 10 kilometrų varžybos
additional: Renginyje dalyviams bus išdalinta daugiau nei 15 tūkst. prizų. Taip pat galima dalyvauti edukaciniuose ir olimpinio švietimo renginiuose, žaidimuose bei susitikti su olimpiečiais. Renginys yra nemokamas ir orientuotas į masiškumą bei bendruomenių subūrimą. daugiau nei 100 veiklų, bėgimai, turnyrai, edukaciniai renginiai, koncertas, kino seansas

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The Jaanikese running cross-country race is the second event in the series and takes place at the Jaanikese Motor and Leisure Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: The Narva City Run is the largest mass-participation sports event in Ida-Viru County, taking place on June 5 and 6 at Joaorg in Narva. The two-day event features a mile run around Town Hall Square on Friday, followed by the main races on Saturday, including the 5 km and 21.1 km distances. This year’s course is flatter, allowing runners to achieve better times, and the event also hosts the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The Narva City Run brings thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes to the course, offering a great mass-participation sports experience.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa Border Run is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows paved roads around the Luhamaa village hall and is approximately 5.9 km long. There are also shorter mini-distances and races for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to provide a sporting and friendly race experience amid Võrumaa’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Padise liigub
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Padise community centre of the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre. The route passes through Padise’s beautiful landscape, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races in addition to the main 5 km distance. It is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The 2nd Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the main 5.4 km run. The courses follow the cross-country track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The event is organised by the Valgamaa Sports Association, which welcomes everyone interested in running to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running experience held amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The run starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. Any group, circle of friends, or sports club can take part by forming a team and dividing the distance among its members. The aim is not to win, but to run together with friends at a comfortable pace and enjoy the experience. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a baton, and there are refreshment and food stations along the course.

name: Vilkaču maratons
description: Vilkaču Marathon is a challenging 42-kilometer marathon along forest trails in Tukums Municipality, considered one of the toughest marathons. The course includes more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain on steep and very steep climbs, and participants must complete thirteen laps, passing the race center several times. During the race, a hydration and food station is available in the start/finish area, and the winner receives 25% of all participants’ entry fees. This marathon offers seven hours of racing in a forest, among hills and in a place steeped in legends, where participants compete against themselves and the clock.
course_highlights: 42 km along forest trails with more than 2,000 meters of elevation gain
Thirteen laps, passing the race center several times
Steep and very steep climbs on the slopes of Āžu Hill
additional: A hydration and food station, staffed by the marathon chef, is available in the start/finish area.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
location: Fort Poznań Event Place, Poznań, Poland
description: Poznań Beer Mile is a series of mile races combining athletic competition with a passion for running and promoting an active lifestyle. The event takes place at Fort Poznań Event Place in Poznań and attracts runners who want to test themselves over a short, dynamic distance. The atmosphere encourages both sporting competition and socializing among participants.
course_highlights: A one-mile race
Held at Fort Poznań Event Place
A series of races combining sport and a passion for running

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk is a race along the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers, held in Nowogród. The half-marathon course is approximately 21.1 km long and runs mainly along field, forest and unpaved roads, with short paved sections. There are three aid stations on the course offering water, cola, isotonic drinks, homemade cakes, fruit and snacks. Participants receive a commemorative medal after completing the race within the 3-hour-and-30-minute time limit. The event also includes a 7 km race with no time limit. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a campfire gathering.
course_highlights: The approximately 21.1 km half-marathon course runs along field, forest and unpaved roads
Three well-stocked aid stations on the half-marathon course
The course includes short paved sections, including residential streets in Nowogród
additional: The race office and start/finish are by the stage near the open-air museum in Nowogród. The half-marathon time limit is 3 hours and 30 minutes; there is no time limit for the 7 km race. Medical support is provided along the course. After the race, there is an awards ceremony for the winners, a prize competition and a campfire gathering. Also on the event day, visitors can tour the open-air museum with a guide and watch a reenactment of the 1939 battles for Nowogród. In previous editions, the accompanying programme included a 5 km or 7 km race, Nordic walking and children’s races.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: Kwietny Bieg in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour running relay that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by the Holy Father John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on a certified 1,352-meter loop that is clearly marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to everyone and has a recreational and sporting character, attracting both amateur and experienced runners. Participants who complete 10 Flower Miles (35.3 km) receive a certificate and commemorative medal. Kwietny Bieg is also an opportunity to celebrate together and set records on the course.
course_highlights: A 24-hour relay on a 1,352-meter loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
A course clearly marked and illuminated with torches and lamps
The race is held over the symbolic Flower Mile distance of 3,530 meters
additional: The race takes place on a 1,352 m loop certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The course is illuminated with torches and lamps after dark. A relay team of standard-bearers keeps the race going, running with a white-and-red sash. The event is open and free of charge, and previous editions have seen records set for the number of participants and laps completed.

name: MnO Jaszczur i Czerwony Most
description: The “Jaszczur i Czerwony Most” Orienteering Marathon is organized by Zgromadzenie Wędrownicze in Koszalin. It is an event for orienteering enthusiasts, combining sporting competition with the exploration of the local area. Participants can expect challenging routes and an adventurous atmosphere. The event is small-scale and takes place in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Routes through varied terrain
Orienteering elements that require navigation
Scenic surroundings of Koszalin

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Nicolaus Copernicus. Participants can choose between the 10 km and 5 km distances, and can also take part in Nordic Walking. The race starts in the evening, offering an unforgettable experience of the city’s nighttime atmosphere. The finish is at the Municipal Stadium, and the organizers provide a bag drop and support from volunteers.
course_highlights: The 10 km course starts at Galeria Copernicus, 15 Żółkiewskiego Street
The 5 km and Nordic Walking start at Józef Piłsudski Bridge, Camping Tramp, Dybowska Street
Finish at the Municipal Stadium, 23/29 Bema Street
additional: The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour 20 minutes. The time limit for the 5 km is 50 minutes, and for Nordic Walking it is 60 minutes. The race office is located at Galeria Copernicus next to the Decathlon store and is open on June 6 from 15:00 to 21:00. The organizer provides a bag drop at the start and transports belongings to the finish. Volunteers hand out bag-drop bags marked with the race number; participants must tie them themselves and hand them in before the race.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a popular 10 km race around Södermalm in Stockholm, known for its beautiful, fast course along the water with no uphill sections. The race attracts many runners looking to set a personal best and offers a flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel. After the finish, runners can enjoy a popular After Run party with music, mingling, food and drinks. The start and finish are at Tantolunden and Hornstulls strand, respectively, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: 10 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
No uphill sections; many runners set personal bests
additional: Water stations are available after 4 km and at the finish. Strollers and dogs are not allowed. All participants receive a medal and products at the finish. The minimum age is 14 for the race and 18 for the After Run. Payment is made via the website by card, Swish, invoice or bank giro/postgiro for larger groups. The start is provisionally scheduled for 19:45. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Minimum age: 14; strollers and dogs are not allowed.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Jubileumsupplagan äger rum lördagen den 5 juni 2027 kl. 19:45.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival in Borgholm, held annually on July 15. The event offers several distances for all ages and levels, from Mini for the youngest runners to the 9 km main race. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful coastal views and an enthusiastic crowd. The event has a long history, dating back to its first edition in 1981, and donates part of its surplus to Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast and easy-to-run course
Beautiful coastal views
Live music at several locations along the course
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholm Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholm Sports Hall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is live music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive a medal or commemorative plaque, depending on the race. Most races use disposable timing chips; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the para-sport categories.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively over sand along the Baltic Sea beach, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique natural running experience right by the sea. Participants can choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short-distance race, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga Tauragėje yra šventinis renginys, kviečiantis dalyvauti visus bėgimo entuziastus kartu su šeima ir draugais. Tai puiki proga paminėti Tėvo dieną aktyviai ir smagiai, dalyvaujant miesto šventėje. Renginys vyksta Tauragės miesto šventės metu, suteikiant galimybę patirti bendruomeniškumą ir sportinę dvasią.
course_highlights: Šventinis bėgimas Tauragės miesto šventės metu
Draugiška atmosfera šeimoms ir draugams
Galimybė aktyviai paminėti Tėvo dieną
additional: Renginys yra dalis Tauragės miesto šventės, vyks lauke, ir skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį bei šeimų dalyvavimą.

name: 5000 m bėgimo varžybos „Vilnius 5000“.
description: Vilnius 5000 yra unikalios 5000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione. Renginys siūlo ne tik individualius 5000 m bėgimus, bet ir estafetinius bėgimus - 5x1000 m mišrią estafetę bei 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetę. Dalyviai gali mėgautis gyva DJ muzika, šventiška atmosfera ir palaikymu, kuris padeda siekti geriausių rezultatų. Varžybos skirtos tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams, o renginio organizatoriai siekia populiarinti lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje ir skatinti sportinę bendruomenę.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
5000 m bėgimas, 5x1000 m mišri estafetė ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetė
Gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera su maisto vagonėliu po finišo
additional: Dalyviai suskirstomi į grupes pagal asmeninius rezultatus arba prognozuojamą įveikimo laiką. Elito grupės dalyviai privalo naudoti WA stadiono patvirtintus bėgimo batelius ir turėti antidopingo kursų pažymėjimą. 5x1000m estafetės komandos yra mišrios, o 2x400m tėčio ir vaiko estafetėje amžiaus ribojimų nėra. Po finišo dalyvių laukia maisto vagonėlis. Varžybų nugalėtojai ir prizininkai apdovanojami rėmėjų prizais ir piniginiais prizais už aukštus rezultatus. Varžybos vyks 2027 m. birželio 13 d., siūlomos įvairios kategorijos, įskaitant elitinius ir mėgėjų bėgikus, su išsamia tvarkaraščio informacija. Renginys skatina sporto populiarinimą ir šeimų dalyvavimą.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series is the traditional Simuna–Laekvere Run, which has earned a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is distinctive because its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
description: E-LUX Peetri Run is one of Estonia’s liveliest mass-participation sporting events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, which is timed, with prizes awarded to the top finishers. There is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, alongside the running, features a large expo and market area with a variety of vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children’s Foundation of Tartu University Hospital and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere People’s Run is a traditional recreational running event held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and a few climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants, and also offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, creating a pleasant, relaxed atmosphere. Age-group prizes are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a running shirt.

name: Ventspils pusmaratons
description: Ventspils Half Marathon 2027 is an annual running event taking place on June 6 in Ventspils. The race offers various distances, including a half marathon (21.0975 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a children’s run, welcoming participants of different ages. The event is organized by the Maratona Klubs Association in cooperation with the Ventspils City Council, providing professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The course passes through some of Ventspils’ most beautiful spots, offering both city scenery and seaside views.
course_highlights: Half-marathon distance: 21.0975 km
Distances suited to different age groups, including a children’s run
The course passes through Ventspils city and seaside scenery
additional: Participants may transfer from a longer distance to a shorter one free of charge until 01.06.2027. During race week, changing distances costs 10 EUR. Young people born in 2008 or later receive a 50% discount on the 10 km and 5 km distances until 03.06.2027. Registration on race day is available, but full services may not be provided. Runners from Russia and Belarus are not permitted to participate.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Aleja Tysiącletnich Dębów, Rezerwat Pustelnik, Kazimierz Biskupi, Poland
description: The Run beneath the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest. The race brings together sport, history, and the beauty of the local natural surroundings, taking participants along an avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, beginners, and families, with races over various distances and a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Kazimierz Biskupi Municipality, and the race tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.
course_highlights: The course follows a picturesque avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve
The race takes place in the heart of the Bieniszew Forest, offering a chance to connect with nature
Running courses of 10 km and 5 km are available, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: The 10 km main race starts at 13:00; the 5 km accompanying race and 5 km Nordic walking event start at 13:10. The time limit for completing the race is 14:40. The winners’ awards ceremony and the closing of the event take place at 14:45.

name: I Bieg po Jagodę Kamczacką
location: PLANTIN Haskap Berry Plantation, Muniakowice, Poland
description: The 1st Haskap Berry Run is a unique sporting event that combines a passion for running with the idea of a healthy lifestyle and closeness to nature. The race takes place at PLANTIN’s haskap berry plantation in Muniakowice near Kraków, with the start, finish and race village located in the heart of the plantation. The race is part of the Berry Relay and promotes mindful food choices and local products. It is not just a competition, but also a gathering of people who value outdoor activity and authentic experiences.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining swimming, cycling, and running over the half-Ironman distance. The race starts at Zegrze Reservoir, and the cycling course passes through scenic municipalities and Warsaw streets, followed by a run in the Multimedia Fountain Park. This exceptional sporting event attracts athletes from around the world, offering not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to discover Warsaw’s cultural and historical riches.
course_highlights: A 1.9 km swim in Zegrze Lake, with a time limit of 1 hour 10 minutes
A 90 km cycling course through the municipalities of Nieporęt, Marki, and Radzymin, as well as the streets of Warsaw
A 21.1 km run over three laps through the streets of Warsaw’s historic center, finishing at the Multimedia Fountain Park
additional: The event offers services including bike rental, bike transfer, bike build & pack, medal engraving, finisher photos, and a camper park. The course is fully secured and closed off, with street closures and traffic control. A helpline for drivers is available during the event at 500 261 000. The start is at Zegrze Reservoir, and the finish is at the Multimedia Fountain Park. The time limit for completing the entire race is 8 hours 30 minutes.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Boisko przy ul. Leśnej, Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Poland
description: The Northern Poland Running and Physical Activity Festival in Wdzydze is the tenth anniversary edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia. The event takes place June 5–7 and features five main races in the Hard Runner series, with distances ranging from 1.6 km to a half marathon. Participants compete for an overall ranking based on the total points earned across all races. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland while also promoting local culture and nature.
course_highlights: Routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Picturesque landscapes of Kashubia and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Routes available to view on the Traseo platform
additional: Race number with a timing chip (returnable). The race office is open during the festival. The overall ranking is based on the total points earned across five races. Recognition for the top competitors from the Municipality of Kościerzyna.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
location: Opalenie, Gmina Gniew, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XIII DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon in Memory of Barbara Karaczyńska is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie to coincide with the anniversary of the founding of the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon course is entirely paved, runs through the picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie, is certified by the Polish Athletics Association, and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race is demanding due to the terrain and thermal conditions, but offers beautiful views and an unforgettable atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone receives a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.
course_highlights: An entirely paved course through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain with numerous steep climbs
The course is marked every 1 km, with refreshment stations every 5 km and mobile refreshment stations
additional: A recovery meal is served after the race. The 10 km “Olka” course is paved and partially follows the half-marathon course. The entry fee is donated in full to the DASZRADE Foundation, which supports people recovering from addiction.

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
Västerås Stadslopp
price_range: 2026: 120–400 kr beroende på lopp och anmälningstid
description: Västerås Stadslopp is a community festival in Vasaparken, inviting runners of all ages to take part in different races, including children’s races and team races. The event is organised by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and offers a great atmosphere, activities for children, mascots, and opportunities to participate regardless of disability. Race bibs are collected at the venue, and services include bag drop and water stations. Teams that register receive a food hamper after crossing the finish line, making it a fun and sociable running experience.
course_highlights: Children’s races with three different distances to choose from
Children’s activity area with an obstacle course, high jump and shot put
Start and finish in Vasaparken, with toilets and water refill points
additional: Race bibs are collected at Vasaparken on 7 June from 09:00, with a separate collection time for the 2.5 km race and longer distances after 11:00. Teams of four receive a food hamper after crossing the finish line. Toilets and water refill points are available at Rådhuset near the start. Bag drop is available, but there is no cover. The children’s races are limited to 400 participants and are fully booked for 2026. Mascots and a children’s activity area will be on site. The date for 2027 will be announced later. Teams of four can receive a food hamper/picnic after the race.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining track races, throwing events and jumps. Each evening features one throwing event, one jumping event and running distances, offering a varied athletics experience. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium, and the IAAF scoring tables are used to determine the rankings. The series has five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants must register separately for each stage, and their race bib is valid for the entire season.

name: Pärnu Aasta jooksud 4 etapp
description: Pärnu Aasta jooksud Stage 4 is part of the Pärnumaa public sports series, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part in varied running competitions. The event takes place at Pärnu Beach, offering participants a pleasant and sporty setting. Organized by the county sports association, it is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy exercise and the thrill of competition.
course_highlights: The runs take place at Pärnu Beach
The public sports series brings together various sporting events in Pärnumaa
Suitable for both recreational and experienced runners

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Rakvere. The events include several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and are intended for different age groups from U-14 through to adults. The competition aims to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. All age groups receive medals, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse health running and walking series organized by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers a chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, which is suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as through personal training. The event is open to everyone interested in physical activity who wants to improve their health and spend time actively.

name: Liikumissari" 8.Järvamaa järvede jooksud" V etapp Paide tehisjärve jooks
location: Paide tehisjärv, Paide, Järva County, Estonia
description: The Paide artificial lake run is the fifth stage of the “8. Järvamaa Lake Runs” series. The run takes place by Paide artificial lake and invites participants to explore the surroundings of Järvamaa’s lakes while staying active.
course_highlights: The start and running venue are by Paide artificial lake.
The stage is part of the Järvamaa Lake Runs series.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Vertikālais kilometrs (VK) Siguldā
description: The Vertical Kilometer in Sigulda is a challenging mountain run that offers a chance to test your strength and endurance on the trails of Sigulda’s hills. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to climb 1,000 meters in elevation. The event is part of the Sigulda Running Series, which brings together athletes and active people from all over Latvia. The run takes place in beautiful natural surroundings, with breathtaking views and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A challenging climb with 1,000 meters of elevation gain
Run along the mountain trails in Sigulda and the surrounding area
Breathtaking views and natural scenery
additional: Race bibs and timing chips will be issued at the start venue.

name: Nocny Półmaraton Piotrkowski
location: Amfiteatr Miejski, ul. Gabriela Narutowicza, Piotrków Trybunalski, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piotrkowie Trybunalskim
description: The Piotrków Night Half Marathon is an annual running event held on the streets of Piotrków Trybunalski. The half marathon course is 21.0975 km long and runs through the city streets, offering participants a unique nighttime running experience. The event also includes a Quarter Half Marathon over a distance of 5.2 km. The race starts at 21:00, and the race office is located at the Municipal Amphitheatre on Gabriela Narutowicza Street. The event is organised by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Piotrków Trybunalski.
course_highlights: Half marathon course on the streets of Piotrków Trybunalski
Half marathon distance of 21.0975 km
Night race start at 21:00
additional: The race office is open on 12.06.2027 from 12:00 to 20:00 at the Municipal Amphitheatre. The event centre is located at the Municipal Amphitheatre on Gabriela Narutowicza Street.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“ yra tradicinis respublikinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Krakių miestelyje, Kėdainių rajone. Varžybos kviečia dalyvauti visus - nuo profesionalų iki pradedančiųjų ir mėgėjų, siūlant įvairius distancijų variantus pagal amžiaus grupes. Startas ir finišas yra miesto centre, Laisvės aikštėje, o renginys pasižymi draugiška atmosfera ir apdovanojimais įvairiose amžiaus kategorijose. Dalyviai vaišinami tradiciniu šiupiniu, o renginio metu galima žaisti medinius lauko žaidimus „LPA GAMES“.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Laisvės aikštėje, Krakių miestelyje
Skirtingos distancijos pagal amžiaus grupes: 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km
Krakių garbės rato 600 m bėgimas „Pagauk gandrą“ vaikams ir šeimoms
additional: Starto numeriai išduodami nuo 11:00 val. Varžybų atidarymas ir 600 m bėgimas „Pagauk gandrą“ prasideda 11:30 val. Visi dalyviai vaišinami Krakių bendruomenės centro pagamintu šiupiniu. Apdovanojami amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai, jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyviai, greičiausi 10 km bėgimo dalyviai. registracija išankstinė internetu, starto mokesčio mokėjimas banku, įvairios distancijos ir amžiaus grupės, renginio metu taip pat vyksta žaidimai ir pramogos

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at the Jõhvi music square. This athletics event gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a run in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a nighttime running and walking event held near the Elva Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s exercise events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organizers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Eesti noorte KV
description: The Estonian Youth Archery Cup takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event on the calendar for young archers. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. The event is a tradition and supports the development of young people in archery.

name: Ezerkauliņi Salaspils pilsētas pusmaratons
description: The “Ezerkauliņi” Salaspils City Half Marathon brings together running enthusiasts, Salaspils residents and visitors for a sporting celebration in Salaspils. Participants can choose the half marathon, a 10.55 km run or Nordic walking, a 5.27 km fun run, or a 0.75 km children’s run. The course runs along Salaspils streets, and the event invites everyone to enjoy moving together and the city’s atmosphere.
course_highlights: The city course runs along the streets of Salaspils.
A 21.097 km half-marathon distance is available.
Participants can also take part in the 10.55 km distance by Nordic walking.
additional: A 0.75 km children’s run is also available.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual road race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event is taking place and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the registration form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile distance (1,609 meters) on scenic recreational grounds
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: Children’s races of approximately 200 meters are also held as part of the event. Participants can use the registration form available on the website to quickly contact the organizer and system administrator. Participants can use training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
description: The 4th Bilcza 10K is a road race held in Morawica, attracting running enthusiasts to its 10 km course. The event takes place in the recreational area of Bilcza Park and is part of the Bilcza Road Races, which also include races for children. A family festival accompanies the event, creating a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere for participants and their loved ones.
course_highlights: The course runs through the recreational area of Bilcza Park
A 10 km road race
An accompanying family festival
additional: A family festival is held on race day, adding to the event for participants and their families.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the city streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level and achieve officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime character. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packet collection is available from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packets available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver; apply by email.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
description: The eighth nationwide “Prescription for Health” race will take place in Arturówek, Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The race routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km races and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Shorter races for children and teenagers will be held on the same route. A family picnic with free health screenings and consultations will take place near the start and finish.

name: II Leśny Bieg Gminy Brzeźnio - Tumidaj
Leśna ZaDyszka
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin Municipality, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop through forest tracks and an asphalt section, showcasing the beauty of the Masovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (2 loops), and a 5 km Nordic Walking event. Children can take part in a 1,500 m run with no rankings. The start and finish are in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop through forest tracks and asphalt (4 km through the forest, 1 km on asphalt)
Picturesque Masovian countryside
Start and finish in a forest clearing by the Szulmierz–Regimin road
additional: Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. The race office opens at 9:00. All participants receive a commemorative medal and a recovery meal. Prizes are awarded for places in age-group and open categories. Participants can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Volunteers provide course support.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
description: The 13th Radomszczański Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko to honor Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by the professional company Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: A street race in central Radomsko
High-quality organization with professional timing
Evening start at 17:30

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km race in Kwidzyn, in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is scheduled for Saturday, 12 June 2027. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different experience levels to help participants prepare optimally for race day.
course_highlights: Moderately challenging paved course
10 km distance
Road race in scenic Kwidzyn
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: Bieg Marszałka is an annual running event in Sulejówek, inspired by the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches over a distance of 26 km. The event includes a 10 km main race and accompanying races for children and young people. The course runs along the streets of Sulejówek, mainly on asphalt, with a short section on cobblestones. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów. The race has historical and sporting significance, combining tradition with physical activity.
course_highlights: The 10 km main-race course runs along the streets of Sulejówek, mainly on asphalt
A short section of the course is on cobblestones
Start and finish at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów
additional: The Bieg Marszałka also includes accompanying races: the Halina Zielińska Memorial (approx. 3.6 km), the Little Ones’ Race (approx. 100 m) and the Older Kids’ Race (approx. 200 m). The Little Ones’ Race starts at 09:30 and the Older Kids’ Race at 09:40. Before the main race and the Memorial start at 09:50, a ceremony is held to lay flowers at the monument to Marshal Józef Piłsudski. 17:00–19:00 and on race day from 7:00 to 9:45. The organizer provides a recovery meal and water. Museum parking is available at the junction of Piłsudski Avenue and Matejki Street. The food area is in the Museum building and in the Museum courtyard.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Öland Ultra Trail
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a fantastic trail adventure through the beautiful natural surroundings of northern Öland. The race offers two distances, 50 km and 25 km, starting from Böda Sand and Byxelkrok respectively, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. The course offers scenic views and passes places such as Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, and pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Passes Skäftekärr, Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen
50 km starts at Böda Sand; 25 km starts at Byxelkrok
Both distances finish at Böda Sand
additional: Late registration is available until 11 June, as well as during bib collection on Friday 12 June from 19:00 to 20:00 and on race day, 13 June, from 07:30 to 09:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Aid stations are located along the course. A T-shirt is included in the entry fee for participants who register by 6 June and specify their shirt size. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. Pre-registered participants receive a T-shirt if they register by 6 June. The 50 km race starts at 09:00 and the 25 km race at 10:00.
