name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: Öllsjö Running Festival is a family-friendly and welcoming recreational race for participants of all ages and a range of physical abilities. The event offers several distances, including children’s races and longer routes, and focuses on the joy of movement and community. It features music and activities for the whole family, as well as a team competition with chip timing. This recurring running festival creates a wonderful atmosphere in Öllsjö every June.
course_highlights: Children’s races of 450 m and 1,700 m
5 km and 7.5 km trail-mix races
Automatic chip timing and a team competition
additional: The event area is open from 10:00 to 14:00. Bib pickup starts at 10:00. STC Härlöv leads warm-ups before the children’s races and the longer races. A candy shower for children takes place at 12:20. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:10 on the event area’s stage. Showers, changing facilities, and bag drop are available. The event has offered several different races and chip timing.

name: Alytaus maratonas 2026
location: Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkės, Alytus, Alytaus rajonas, Lietuva
description: Alytuje, Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkėse. Renginys skirtas populiarinti bėgimą Lietuvoje ir garsinti Alytų, kviečiant tiek mėgėjus, tiek profesionalus varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo vaikų 500 m iki pilno maratono. Dalyviai galės rinktis iš kelių bėgimo ir šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijų, o trasos yra techniškai paruoštos varžyboms su elektroniniu laiko matavimu. Renginys organizuojamas VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir užtikrina saugias bei taisyklingas varžybas visiems dalyviams.
course_highlights: Distancijos nuo 500 m vaikų bėgimo iki 42,195 km maratono
Startas ir finišas prie Didžiosios Dailidės ežero Alytuje
Elektroninis laiko matavimas su mikroschema ant marškinėlių
additional: Varžybų dalyviams draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones trasoje. Laiko matavimas vykdomas elektronine mikroschema, kuri turi būti pritvirtinta ant marškinėlių priekinės dalies. Varžybų limitai: maratonui 6 val., pusmaratoniui 3 val., 10,6 km - 2 val., 5,3 km - 1 val., 2 km - 0,5 val., šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijoms - 5 val. Startai skirtingoms distancijoms: 12:00 val. daugeliui bėgimų, 16:30 val. 2 km bėgimui, 16:45 val. 500 m vaikų bėgimui. Renginyje bus įrengtos vandens ir maitinimo stotelės, dalyvių limitas - 300, ir įvairios distancijos, įskaitant vaikų ir šeimų bėgimus. Registracija atidaroma balandžio 1 d. ir galioja iki pat renginio dienos.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competitions take place in Kohila and offer veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in a variety of track and field events. The competitions are intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy the thrill of athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competitions are open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group events available.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the distance. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: 15 Piknik Biegowy Biała Biega
description: The 15th Biała Biega Running Picnic is a family-friendly running event held in Biała Podlaska, attracting runners of different ages and abilities. The event has a picnic atmosphere, combining sporting competition with fun and a chance for the local community to come together. More than 260 people are already on the participant list, reflecting the event’s strong appeal and friendly atmosphere.
additional: More than 260 people have already registered, indicating the event’s popularity. The event is a family running picnic, suggesting activities for different age groups and opportunities for participants to connect.

name: XVII Elbląski Bieg Piekarczyka Mini Bieg Piekarczyka
description: The Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is one of the largest and best-known running events in Elbląg, held every year in June. The two-day event combines sporting competition with numerous side attractions, including races at various distances and activities for children. The route runs through the streets of the city centre and features a flat asphalt-and-cobblestone surface with one hill, making it suitable for fast times. The race attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, as well as many spectators cheering participants along the route.
course_highlights: Flat route with one hill on Teatralna Street
Asphalt (80%) and cobblestones (20%)
Route certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The time limit for completing the race is 1 hour and 30 minutes. The Mini Piekarczyk Run takes place on loops of Teatralna Street ranging from 50 to 600 metres, adjusted to the children's ages. Race packs are distributed at two locations: Ogrody Shopping Centre (13 June) and the “Helena” MOSiR ice rink (14 June). Participants over the age of 70 are exempt from the entry fee after registering.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual citywide celebration of running held in June in Suwałki. The three-day event attracts hundreds of participants of different ages and experience levels. The programme includes races for children, the Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), the Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (approx. 3.5 km). The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests, and the atmosphere combines sporting competition with community spirit.
course_highlights: Flat, fast urban courses
Evening 10.5 km main race—the Suwalska Ćwiartka
A range of distances for children and adults
additional: The three-day event includes races for children and young people, a 5 km race, the 10.5 km main race in the evening, and a recreational race of approximately 3.5 km with breakfast at the finish. The organizer is the Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach, which also offers bicycle and water-sports equipment rentals, as well as sports facility rentals.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organised by the Future for Children Foundation to support sick and disabled children from Warmia and Masuria. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is open to runners of varying abilities, including beginners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions, giving participants the chance to help through physical activity and fun. The run is the finale of the “GOOD GIVES BACK” campaign and supports rehabilitation and the purchase of medical equipment for children.
course_highlights: A scenic route by Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn
Welcoming and accessible to runners of all abilities, including walkers
5 km distance with a one-hour time limit
additional: The event also includes children’s fun runs over distances starting at 400 m, as well as junior and youth races over age-appropriate distances. The special guest is Krystyna Abramczyk Puzio, a multiple Polish and world champion in weightlifting. After the run, there is a family picnic with prizes and gifts for participants.

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a sporting event for dads and children that aims to inspire movement and quality time together. The event takes place both live in Hagaparken, Stockholm, and virtually for participants who cannot attend in person. It is a family-friendly activity that promotes healthy habits and a sense of community among active dads and their children.
course_highlights: Family-friendly run in Hagaparken, Stockholm
The event offers both live and virtual participation
Strollers are welcome during the run
additional: The event is part of a global virtual sports challenge featuring three sports over three months: running in May, cycling in June, and hiking. Strollers are welcome during the run. Virtual participation is free, and the event aims to create unforgettable memories and build healthy habits together with the children. Dadathlon consists of three events held at different times throughout the year. Activity can be recorded using an app or sports watch.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running race held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The race centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the routes run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the event is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas yra bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Ragožių kaime, Jonavos rajone. Tai tradicinis bėgimas, skirtas aktyviems sporto mėgėjams, siūlantis įvairias distancijas ir galimybę išbandyti savo ištvermę bei jėgas. Renginys yra atviras visiems, norintiems aktyviai praleisti laiką ir mėgautis bėgimu gamtoje. Organizuoja Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, kuri rūpinasi sklandžia varžybų eiga ir dalyvių patogumu.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Ragožių kaimo apylinkėse
Skirtingos distancijos pritaikytos įvairaus lygio bėgikams
Gamta ir natūralios trasos suteikia malonų bėgimo potyrį
additional: Renginys yra atviras visiems aktyviems ir sportiškiems Lietuvos žmonėms. Tarp skirtingų distancijų ir kliūčių ruožų kiekvienas gali rasti sau tinkamą iššūkį ar pramogą. Nėra specifinės informacijos apie renginio trasą ar dalyvių skaičių; registracijos vyksta per oficialią platformą.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Center for the Development of Physical Culture in Czerwonak. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors in a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix and is held regularly, promoting a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Bolechowo, in the Czerwonak municipality.
The previous recorded edition covered a distance of 5 km.
The event is part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series.
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually between 19:30 and 22:00. This recurring sporting event is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or required equipment.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
organizer: VIF Gute Friidrott och Blodcentralen i Visby
description: Blodomloppet in Visby is a fun run organised to raise awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km on scenic routes that include Visby’s city wall, old town, promenade, Almedalen and harbour. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children, with shorter distances. The event is open to individuals and teams, and ends with a group picnic for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km route follows Visby’s city wall and passes through the historic old town
The 10 km route includes the city wall, promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place in an urban setting and starts behind the main stage
additional: Late registration is available on site from 16:00 on 16 June at the Information Tent. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib, medal and gift for blood donors. Team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing or use a picnic card (valid only for Blodomloppet at a distance). The scenic routes pass through historic and central parts of Visby. Water stations and medical assistance are available. Changing facilities and toilets are provided. Parking information and directions are available on the website. Participants can register individually or in teams of up to five. Participants receive a T-shirt, race bib and medal; team members can collect a picnic bag after finishing. Lilla Blodomloppet has distances of 300 m and 1.6 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/visby/): 2027-06-15 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 15 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-15)

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or inline skating. The events take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring speed races with individual starts. The Tallinn event is held at Vabaduse väljak, on a short, technical course well suited to sprint enthusiasts. Series finishers are eligible for the Kullapada awards programme, which rewards consistent participation in every event.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV (400 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The series features various distances and age groups, with participants earning points according to their placing in each race. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners; payment is in cash at the venue. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 16:30 on race day. Those who register later will be placed in the later races. Series winners are determined by age group, and the awards ceremony takes place at the end of the series.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Municipality consisting of several stages and aimed at sports enthusiasts in the region. The series aims to promote sports and physical activity and give participants the opportunity to compete over various distances. Participants at each stage receive a commemorative medal, and points are tallied across the series in the competition classes. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is an athletics track-running series organized by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev, offering the opportunity to take part in multiple meets at stadiums in Tartu and Ülenurme. The series aims to provide competition opportunities for children and young people and promote participation in athletics in the city and county of Tartu. Competitions take place during the summer months and are open to various age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing for flexible participation.

name: Rakvere lahtised MV
description: The Rakvere Open Championships are athletics championships held at Rakvere Stadium. The competition brings together the local sporting community and offers an opportunity to watch a variety of track and field events. The event is open to everyone interested and creates a sporty, supportive atmosphere.

name: Tallinna noorte MV
description: The Tallinn Youth Championships is an individual athletics competition for young people and adults, held in Tallinn. The competition includes several age groups, from U-14 to adults, and a range of athletics events, including running, jumping, putting, and throwing. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at a stadium and starts at 11:00 in the morning; registration opens at 10:00.

name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a triathlon held in a beautiful location on the Baltic Sea, in the city of freedom and Solidarity. The event includes the T100 distance, consisting of a 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, an 80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, and an 18 km run along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish line is at the Gdańsk pier in Brzeźno, making for a unique finish experience. The event is an official qualifying race and attracts athletes from various categories, including Challenge Women by Brooks.
course_highlights: 2 km swim in the Gulf of Gdańsk, starting and finishing on Gdańsk Brzeźno beach
80 km fast bike course through the Vistula River delta, passing through Kiezmark, Cedry Małe, and Koszwały
18 km run over 4 laps along Gdańsk’s beach and Ronald Reagan Park, with aid stations along the course
additional: The Sprint distance starts at 8:00 from Gdańsk Brzeźno beach. The race office is open from 10:00 to 20:00. The option to purchase a start fee refund is available if withdrawing by 31 May 2027. The bike course consists of two fast laps through the Vistula River delta. The run course consists of 4 laps of 4.5 km, with aid stations on each lap. The finish line is at the pier in Gdańsk Brzeźno. Athletes must collect their race packs and attend the race briefing. The organizer reserves the right to change the course and race format in the event of adverse weather conditions.

name: Nocny Bieg Firmowy Warszawa
description: The Night Corporate Run in Warsaw is a charity relay for teams of five, held at the Służewiec Racecourse. Each participant runs approximately 5 km after dark, and the team’s combined time determines the result. It’s a unique opportunity to spend an evening together in an engaging nighttime atmosphere while supporting children from the Everest Foundation. The event combines sport, fun, and social good, creating an unforgettable experience for participants.

name: 17 Legionowska Dycha
description: The 17th Legionowo Ten is an annual 10 km race held in Legionowo. The start and finish are located outside Arena Legionowo. The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is open to adults and people over 16 who meet the requirements set out in the regulations. The event also includes the accompanying “Uniformed Services Ten” race for uniformed services and enthusiasts. Participants can expect electronic timekeeping and a time limit of 1 hour and 40 minutes to complete the course.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański
description: The Świętojański Night Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Gdynia. The main 10 km race takes place amid the city’s picturesque scenery, accompanied by races for children and youth. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support as well as photo and video coverage.

name: Birštono pusmaratonis. Lietuvos 10 km bėgimo plentu čempionatas.
location: Birštonas, Birštono savivaldybė, Kauno apskritis, Lietuva
organizer: Všį Birštono sportas, Asociacija Sporto renginiai
description: Birštono pusmaratonis Powered by Vytautas yra kasmetinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Birštone, kuris suburia tiek pradedančiuosius, tiek patyrusius bėgikus. Renginio metu siūlomos kelios distancijos, įskaitant pusmaratonį, 10 km bėgimą, kuris tuo pačiu yra Lietuvos 10 km bėgimo plentu čempionatas, 5,2 km bėgimą ir estafetę. Trasa veda per miesto centrą, Nemuno pakrantę, promenadą ir Žvėrinčiaus miško prieigas, suteikdama galimybę mėgautis tiek rezultatu, tiek aplinka. Birštonas garsėja savo sveikatingumo tradicijomis, o šis renginys skatina aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir bendruomeniškumą.
course_highlights: Trasa veda per miesto centrą, Nemuno pakrantę ir promenadą
Pusmaratonis sudarytas iš 4 ratų, 10 km bėgimas - 2 ratai
Estafetė 2x5 km mišri (1 vyras + 1 moteris)
additional: Startai: 10 km bėgimas 9:00 Basanavičiaus aikštėje, pusmaratonis 9:05 Jaunimo g., 5,2 km bėgimas 9:05, estafetė 2x5 km 9:05, vaikų 800 m bėgimas 12:15. Dalyvių avalynė turi atitikti LLAF rekomendacijas. 10 km čempionato dalyviams būtinas galiojantis antidopingo mokymų sertifikatas. Registracija tik savo vardu, numerio perdavimas draudžiamas. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio metu darytos nuotraukos ir filmuotė gali būti naudojamos rinkodarai be atskiro sutikimo. Renginio dalyviams siūloma registruotis užpildant formą, o renginio taisyklėse nurodyta, kad 10 km bėgime būtina turėti doping kontrolės pažymėjimą. Renginyje taip pat vyksta apdovanojimai ir rėmėjų dovanos.

name: Pasvalio maratonas
location: Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadionas, Pasvalys, Pasvalio rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: Bėgimo mėgėjų ir sveikos gyvensenos klubas „Vėtra“, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, Pasvalio sporto mokykla
description: Pasvalio maratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Pasvalio mieste, kuris siekia populiarinti bėgimą tarp jaunimo ir suaugusiųjų bei skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Renginys vyksta Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadione, kur dalyviai varžosi maratono, pusmaratono ir vaikų bėgimo distancijose. Trasos ilgis ir ratai pritaikyti skirtingoms distancijoms, o trasoje kas 5 km įrengtos vandens ir maitinimo stotelės. Dalyviai apdovanojami prizais ir atminimo medaliais, o renginys yra dalis Pasvalio miesto šventės „Vys par to ãlo“ programos.
course_highlights: 10 km trasa, maratonui 4 ratai, pusmaratoniui 2 ratai
Vandens ir maitinimo stotelės kas 5 km
Startas ir finišas Pasvalio kultūros ir poilsio parko stadione
additional: Numeriai išduodami nuo 8:00 val. Pasvalio stadione. Vaikų 400 m bėgimas startuoja 11:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti gydytojo leidimus arba paraiškas su gydytojo viza arba už savo sveikatą varžybų metu atsako patys. Dalyviai, pasiekę finišą per kontrolinį laiką, gauna atminimo medalius. Renginyje siūlomos įvairios distancijos, dalyvių laukia medaliai, diplomai, prizai ir vaišės.

name: Kuusalu valla kergej. MV
description: The Kuusalu Parish Athletics Championships is a traditional athletics competition held in Kuusalu. The event features various age groups and distances, offering opportunities for both recreational and advanced athletes. It is dedicated to the memory of Margus Keerma and is organized by the Treeningpartner sports club. The competition is a great opportunity to showcase your skills and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Kuusalu Parish.

name: Ümber Saadjärve jooks
description: The 38th Around Saadjärv Run takes place in Kukulinna, offering participants a 17 km run and a fitness walk around Lake Saadjärv. The course follows paved roads and has three refreshment stations to keep runners well supplied. In addition to the main race, children’s races are held in different age groups, along with a fitness walk suitable for everyone who enjoys being active. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and the best participants are awarded prizes by age group. The event is a long-standing tradition and is well organised, offering an enjoyable sporting experience for the whole family.

name: 46. skrējiens "Apkārt Vaidavas ezeram"
description: The “Around Lake Vaidava” race is a traditional running event held in the Vaidava area. Participants can take part in the 11.7 km race or the walk, enjoying beautiful scenery and a well-prepared course. The event is popular and attracts many participants, offering timing and service points. Commemorative medals are provided, but their number is limited and they are allocated in order of registration. The race is suitable for both athletes and people who enjoy active recreation.
course_highlights: 11.7 km running distance around Lake Vaidava
A walk along a scenic, well-prepared course
Service points and timing chips for race participants
additional: The number of commemorative medals is limited, and they are provided to participants in order of registration: medals go to 11.7 km race participants with registration numbers up to 340 and walk participants with numbers up to 100. Participants who register after the limit has been reached will receive a full participation package without a medal.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meet organized annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates Józef Żylewicz, an outstanding coach and sports official, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a contributor to the Polish national athletics team’s successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting professionalism with a welcoming atmosphere for the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. The event also includes the amateur 3,000 m race “Fast Arrow of the North,” open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or athletic requirements.

name: I Nocny Półmaraton Piaseczyńśki
description: The Piaseczno Night Half Marathon is a unique 21.0975 km road race held at night along the scenic, illuminated streets of Piaseczno and nearby towns. The course is certified by the PZLA, flat and fast, making it ideal for runners looking to improve their personal bests. Participants can expect professional organization, comprehensive medical coverage and well-stocked refreshment stations. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and a recovery area with drinks and a meal awaits at the finish. The event also offers an unforgettable atmosphere of running beneath the stars, with plenty of attractions and competitions for spectators.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, 21.0975 km long
Flat, fast course with minimal elevation changes
The course passes through Piaseczno, Górki Szymona, Głosków and Jazgarzew
additional: Race packs can be collected from 15–19 June at Decathlon Piaseczno and on 20 June at the Race Office. The half marathon is limited to 2,000 participants. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours gun time, with a 1.5-hour limit at the halfway point. There are three refreshment stations along the course (at approximately 5, 10 and 15 km). After the race, a finish area will offer water, isotonic drinks, a recovery meal, music and an LED screen. A competition will be held for the best spectator area. Race-pack transfers are available until 31.05.2027 for a fee of 20 PLN. A commemorative T-shirt is available separately for 75 PLN (orders accepted until 29.05.2027).

name: ULTRA TURNICKI
description: Ultra Turnicki is a unique running festival held in the scenic region of the Przemyśl Foothills and the Sanok-Turka Mountains. The event offers both winter and summer races over various distances, combining sporting competition with a rich cultural and festival program. The routes pass through distinctive landscapes, and participants can count on well-stocked aid stations and opportunities to connect with the local community. The start and finish are in Huwniki, offering easy access and attractive accommodation options.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Przemyśl Foothills and the Sanok-Turka Mountains
The summer race takes place during the Wianki festival, featuring workshops and concerts
The winter race offers views from the Żytnia Pass and has two aid stations along the route
additional: The summer race offers four distances: 10 km, 24 km, 48 km, and 75 km, with transport to the start and a rich festival program. The winter race has two distances: 15 km and 36 km, with transport to the start and aid stations along the route. After the races, there are social gatherings, talks, and an awards ceremony. Accommodation is available at agritourism farms, and camping is possible during the summer season. Public transport is available, and Huwniki can be reached by motorway and train.

name: Wieczorna Piątka
description: Wieczorna Piątka is a 5,000-meter race held on the tartan track at the Municipal Stadium in Maków Mazowiecki. The race is scheduled for 6:00 PM and will be divided into heats based on participants’ predicted times. It is organized by Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki, with a limit of 200 participants. The race is open to people over 15 years of age; minors must provide written consent from a guardian.
course_highlights: 5,000 m on the stadium’s tartan track
One lap is 400 m
Heats are based on predicted race times
additional: The limit is 200 race packages. Payments can be made online through the Przelewy24 platform or by bank transfer to the club’s account. The detailed schedule, including the heats, will be published on the website during the week before the race.

name: 15 Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej
description: The Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej is a mountain race held in Koszalin on a course around Góra Chełmska. Participants can choose between 10.55 km (quarter marathon) and 21.1 km (half marathon), which consists of two loops. The start and finish are at plac Gościńcowy near the summit of Góra Chełmska, and the course runs through scenic forest areas with views. The race is organized by the Stowarzyszenie Sport, rekreacja i wolontariat „SFX” and is recreational and sporting in nature, promoting an active lifestyle and forest tourism.
course_highlights: Mountain course around Góra Chełmska, reaching an elevation of 136.2 m above sea level
Two distances to choose from: 10.55 km (one loop) and 21.1 km (two loops)
Start and finish at plac Gościńcowy, between the sanctuary and the observation tower
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. The ceremonial start is from the square between the sanctuary and the observation tower. Awards will be presented at around 14:30. The course is well marked and measured. Participants can choose their distance during the race. Donations toward the statutory objectives of the SFX Association are required to participate and are non-refundable and non-transferable.

name: Bieg Dwie Wieże
description: Bieg Dwie Wieże is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The course follows a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk, offering varied terrain and scenic views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. Runners receive a timing chip and a race bib. Water stations are available along the course, and a recovery meal is provided at the finish. The event has professional medical coverage and is photographed.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km course
Race along a dirt road, the beach, and a sidewalk
Water stations at 4, 8, and 12 km, and at the finish
additional: Race office hours: 19.06, 13:00–19:00, and 20.06, 8:00–9:45 (verification closes at 9:45). Identity verification is mandatory (ID card/student ID). The timing chip is mandatory, collected at the race office and returned at the finish. Water and a recovery meal are available at the finish. Medical coverage is provided. Participation constitutes consent to the use of one’s image. Runners are asked to follow event rules and road traffic regulations.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Poland is a prestigious triathlon held in Gdańsk, offering a range of distances, including the popular T100 distance. The event takes place on the Baltic Sea, with a fast, flat cycling course and a scenic run along the beach and through Ronald Reagan Park. The start and finish are on the beautiful pier in Gdańsk, making it a unique attraction for athletes and spectators. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.
course_highlights: 2.0 km swim at the city beach by Brzeźno Pier
80 km flat and fast cycling course through the Vistula Żuławy
18 km run along Gdańsk Beach and through Ronald Reagan Park, finishing with a scenic stretch on the pier
additional: Option to purchase registration cancellation coverage until 31 May 2027. Special discounts for teams of 10 or more. The cycling course passes, among other places, by Polsat Plus Arena stadium. Races are held in several categories and distances, including solo and relay. The race office and expo are located at Brzeźno Beach. Awards ceremonies take place on the pier in Gdańsk.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The VI Świętojański Run is a 10 km race held in picturesque Zawichost, in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship. Runners can choose training plans tailored to different experience levels to help them prepare optimally for race day. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers provide expert support and the option to manage race information through an online platform.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on an asphalt course
Moderately challenging course
Picturesque location in Zawichost
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support is provided, along with the option to use a platform to manage the race listing and marketing collaborations.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Academic Championships of Łomża in night road running is an annual event organized by Łomża Academy and the AZS University Club of Łomża Academy. The race takes place on the streets of Łomża and aims to commemorate the founding of the Academy and promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, with the 10 km course certified by PZLA. The race starts in the evening, giving it a distinctive nighttime character.
course_highlights: 10 km course certified by PZLA
Road race through Łomża
Time limit: 1.5 hours from the start
additional: Participant limit: 100 runners for the 5 km and 100 for the 10 km, plus an organizer’s allocation. Runner check-in at the Race Office on the day of the event from 19:00 to 20:45. Runners must complete the entire declared distance on asphalt; taking a shortcut results in disqualification. Distance changes are possible on the day of the event at the timing tent.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Run for the Blue Ribbon is an annual event organized by the Stargard Athletics Club, which has been promoting health, fitness, and positive energy for 19 years. The main race takes place at night, giving it a unique atmosphere, and the route runs through the streets of Stargard, allowing participants to admire the city’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight. It’s an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and build physical and mental endurance. The organizers invite both amateurs and experienced athletes to celebrate exercise and a healthy lifestyle together.
course_highlights: An atmospheric night run at 9:00 p.m.
The route starts at the Amphitheatre and runs around the Jewel of Pomerania
Views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks in the moonlight
additional: The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere. The route is designed to let participants admire Stargard’s historic landmarks. The organizers encourage participants to build physical and mental endurance before the race. The event is international and organized by the Stargard Athletics Club.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a nature-focused running event offering several distances for all ages and levels, from children’s races to ultradistances. The races follow beautiful trails through forests, the archipelago, countryside and urban environments, with a high proportion of nature experiences. The event is marked by a strong environmental ethos and sense of community, where runners can challenge themselves in an inspiring, well-organized setting. The finish is at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården, with beautiful medals and an after-party for participants.
course_highlights: A high proportion of nature, with forest trails, archipelago and countryside
Viewpoints and sights along the course
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre on Norra Djurgården
additional: Mandatory equipment for 58 km includes a water container holding at least one liter, a cup or mug for drinks at aid stations, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number. Aid stations do not provide cups; participants must fill their own cup, mug or bottle. The time limit for 58 km is 11 hours. For 21 km, a cup, mug or bottle for drinks is required. There are also children’s races and virtual races at various distances. Wooden medals with a unique theme are awarded to everyone who finishes. Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheatre. All finishers receive a wooden medal.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/): 2027-06-19 — "19 juni 2027 EcoTrail Stockholm" (was estimated 2027-06-12)

name: Mano MAMA juda – Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026
description: Mano MAMA juda - Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026 yra šeimoms ir bėgimo entuziastams skirtas renginys, vykstantis Gelgaudiškio dvaro parke ir apylinkėse. Renginio tikslas - populiarinti bėgimo sportą Šakių rajone ir skatinti fizinį aktyvumą. Trasą sudaro miško takeliai ir asfaltas, o bėgimo metu įrengti spalvų punktai suteikia papildomo džiaugsmo dalyviams. Varžybos vyksta birželio 21 d., siūlant 400 m vaikų bėgimą, 5 km ir 10 km distancijas.
course_highlights: 5 km ratas pagrinde miško takais
10 km distancija - du 5 km ratai
Trasos danga - miško takeliai ir asfaltas
additional: Numerių išdavimas vyksta nuo 9:00 iki 10:00 val. Vaikų 400 m bėgimas startuoja 10:00 val., 5 km ir 10 km distancijos startuoja 10:30 val. Apdovanojimai numatyti 12:00 val. Nepilnamečiai dalyviai privalo turėti raštišką tėvų ar globėjų sutikimą. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio metu darytos nuotraukos ir filmuotą medžiagą organizatoriai gali naudoti rinkodaros tikslais. Renginys apima spalvų bėgimą, įvairias distancijas, iššūkius ir reljefo įvairovę. Dalyvių rezultatai fiksuojami profesionalia laiko matavimo sistema, tačiau svarbiausia - patirtis ir emocijos.

name: 55-asis bėgimas – pusė maratono „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“
description: 55-asis bėgimas „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“ yra tradicinis pusės maratono renginys Elektrėnuose, vykstantis vaizdingoje Elektrėnų marių apylinkėje. Renginys kviečia bėgikus mėgautis aktyviu laisvalaikiu ir pažinti šio jauno Lietuvos miesto gamtą bei istoriją. Bėgimas vyksta birželio mėnesį, suteikiant galimybę dalyviams pasimėgauti vasariška atmosfera ir Elektrėnų krašto lankytinomis vietomis. Tai puiki proga sportuoti ir kartu atrasti Elektrėnų regiono grožį.
course_highlights: Vaizdingas maršrutas aplink Elektrėnų marias
Gamta ir aktyvaus laisvalaikio galimybės Elektrėnų krašte
Pažintis su jauno Lietuvos miesto istorija ir kultūra
additional: Renginys vyksta birželio 21 d. nuo 08:30 iki 16:00 val. Elektrėnų turizmo informacijos centras teikia informaciją apie maršrutus, apgyvendinimą, maitinimą ir kitas aktyvaus laisvalaikio galimybes regione.

name: Panemunės pusmaratonis 2026
description: Panemunės pusmaratonis yra tradicinis 21 km bėgimas, vykstantis Panemunės šile, Kaune. Tai puiki galimybė mėgautis gamta ir aktyviai praleisti laiką bėgant gražiu miško taku. Renginys pritraukia tiek patyrusius bėgikus, tiek mėgėjus, kurie nori išbandyti savo jėgas pusmaratono distancijoje.
course_highlights: 21 km distancija per Panemunės šilo miško takus
Gamta ir rami aplinka Kauno mieste
Trasa pritaikyta tiek patyrusiems, tiek pradedantiesiems bėgikams

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together fitness enthusiasts and recreational runners from spring to autumn, offering a variety of running and walking opportunities. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and encourage local people to take part in sporting events. The 4th Pariisi Cross-Country Run takes place on 21 June at Pariisi Holiday Village and is part of a long-running series featuring different age groups and distance options. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest, reflecting the organisers’ care for participants’ comfort and safety.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu is a varied obstacle race held at the Rummu quarry. On the course, participants climb, crawl, lift and drag their way through mud, water, sand and hills, making it a challenge for everyone. The race is part of the Vägilase jooks series, known as Estonia’s best OCR event. The course is more substantial and offers exciting obstacles and experiences in nature.

name: Kõrgessaare jaanijooks
organizer: Kõrgessaare Vaba Aja Keskus TERKA ja Hiiumaa Spordiliit
description: Kõrgessaare Midsummer Run is a Midsummer running race held in Kõrgessaare, Hiiumaa. The race offers an opportunity to celebrate the start of summer in an active way and take part in a local community sporting event.
additional: The race has been part of the Hiiumaa Liigub series.

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Marathon in Every City Keila is a unique running event that gives participants the opportunity to run a marathon distance in different cities. There are refreshment stations every 400 metres along the course, as well as toilets, making the run more comfortable and supporting athletes’ well-being. The event is suitable both for experienced marathon runners and for those who want to test their endurance. It is well organised and offers an enjoyable experience for all participants.

description: Saulgriežu nakts Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, which takes place on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails. This leg offers a unique night trail-running experience in Liepāja, where participants can enjoy roads and trails with a variety of surfaces that wind through natural landscapes. The races are suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, with several distances, including options for children and young people. The event is friendly and inspiring, fostering a sporting spirit and a love of nature.
course_highlights: Roads and trails with a variety of surfaces — asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails and off-road terrain
A night trail run with a special atmosphere and challenges
Distances suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Registration closes at 12:00 on the Thursday before race week. Late registration is available at the event centre on race day until 30 minutes before the start. Participants are awarded in different age groups and in the overall standings. The series also includes the Latvian Youth Trail Running Championships.

name: Gryf Arena Run
description: Gryf Arena Run is an annual street race held in the town of Gryfice, attracting runners of different ages and abilities across various distances. The route runs through the town streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event also includes races for children, making it a family-friendly and inclusive gathering. This is the ninth edition of the popular race, an important sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Gryfice
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
Children’s races are part of the program, making the event family-friendly

name: Klon Biega i Chodzi Dla Zdrowia
description: Klon Runs and Walks for Health is a local initiative organized by the Association for the Development of the Village of Klon and Surrounding Areas. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and supporters of the region. The run and walk take place in the picturesque surroundings of Klon, bringing the local community together. The event is recreational and open to everyone.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
description: The STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The course is T-shaped and consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets. The event is organized by a local group of running enthusiasts who promote sport among residents and participants from across Poland. The race has an intimate atmosphere and is a great opportunity to enjoy an active day and connect with fellow runners.
course_highlights: T-shaped course
Two 5 km loops through the streets of Milanówek
Start and finish at SLO No. 5, 41 Herberta Street
additional: The race traditionally starts at SLO No. 5 (41 Herberta Street). The road course consists of two 5 km loops. The organizers are the local STO-nogi Milanówek group, which also organizes other races and running events. Organizer phone contacts: Leszek Janasik - 666 353 600, Jerzy Stypa - 601 825 560.

name: X Ostródzki Półmaraton św. Jerzego
description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is a jubilee edition of the event organized by the Ostróda Runners Group, PLAY Sports Club, and the Ostróda Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in picturesque Ostróda, on the shores of Lake Drwęckie. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and comprehensive organizational support. The event attracts local runners as well as visitors from other regions, and offers cash prizes to the top finishers. Race packs are distributed at the race office, and the organizers ensure smooth and safe service for participants.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course follows the picturesque lakeside promenade along Lake Drwęckie in Ostróda
Professional timekeeping with a returnable chip
Race packs can be collected at the lakeside Amphitheatre
additional: 7:00–9:00. Registration after 9:00 on race day is not possible. Race packs are issued upon presentation of an identity document. A race pack may be collected on behalf of another person with a signed authorization and a copy of their ID. The entry fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred to another participant. Cash prizes for the top female and male athletes are 1000, 700, and 500 PLN, paid into their bank accounts within 3 days of the race. 5 zł from each entry fee is donated to rehabilitation through a charity initiative.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Cross-Country Run takes place in the forested grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied terrain, uphill and downhill sections of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get off the asphalt or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as races for children and teenagers. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, and the top runners in each distance receive trophies.
course_highlights: The course runs through the forested grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Varied terrain with uphill and downhill sections, sand, and narrow sections through bushes
A cross-country course, unusual for an urban area
additional: All runners start at the same time, regardless of distance. The Nordic walking event covers 4 km. Children’s and teenagers’ races are held over 150 m (ages 0–6) and 800 m (ages 7–15). The event village offers attractions including a playground, pump track, water playground, beach volleyball courts, mini soccer and basketball courts, beach soccer courts, bathing areas, kayak rental, a golf driving range, and games and activities for children.

name: Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna
location: Centrum Rekreacji i Wypoczynku Deczno, Świecie, Poland
description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque surroundings of the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre. The event includes a 10 km main race and free races for children, making it appealing to families and runners of different ability levels. The main race route follows the banks of the Deczna River, offering participants beautiful views and pleasant racing conditions. The organizers provide professional timing and race kits with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 240 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km main race route along the banks of the Deczna River
Picturesque views and a natural setting around the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre
Additional free races for children, limited to 115 participants
additional: The main race is limited to 240 participants, and the children's races to 115 participants. The children's races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. 23:59.

name: XI Cienińska Szóstka
location: Cienin Zaborny, Słupca County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“
description: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“ yra renginys, skirtas skatinti visuomenę tapti vyresnių vaikų globėjais ir keisti neigiamas nuostatas apie globojamus vaikus. Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyne, startas ir finišas yra prie Lietuvos sporto universiteto centrinių rūmų. Renginys skirtas atkreipti dėmesį į globėjų šeimų laukiančius vyresnius nei 10 metų vaikus ir viešinti globos centro teikiamas paslaugas. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gauna atminimo medalį.
course_highlights: 5 km distancija - 2 ratai po 2,5 km
Startas ir finišas prie Lietuvos sporto universiteto centrinių rūmų
Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyne, prie paminklo S. Dariui ir S. Girėnui
additional: Varžybose yra trys distancijos: 500 m (gimę 2014 m. ir jaunesni, startas 18:30), 1 km (startas 18:45) ir 5 km (startas 19:05). Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Apdovanojami nugalėtojai ir prizininkai įvairiose amžiaus grupėse, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gauna atminimo medalį. Dalyviams ir palaikantiems asmenims draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ir asmeninę palydą varžybų metu. Registracija vyksta internetu, renginys skirtas vaikams ir jaunimui, siekiant skatinti aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir socialinį įsitraukimą

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: The Pärnumaa Victory Day Marathon takes place in Tori Parish, with the race headquarters located next to the historic Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church. The marathon brings several new features and is organized in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and its supporters. This traditional and legendary race offers athletes a varied and memorable experience.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommar 2027 is a personal and unique trail race held on the longest day of the year in Sollentuna, Stockholm. The race starts early in the morning at 02:00 and offers 30 kilometres of wonderful trail running at dawn, as participants meet the light along the way. With a maximum of 100 participants, the race focuses on the experience and the chance to enjoy nature as it awakens. Navigation is by GPS route and map, and a generous breakfast is served after the finish so participants can share the experience with other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running at dawn, welcoming the summer light
Two aid stations along the course
Navigation by GPS route and map
additional: Maximum 100 participants for a personal experience. Start and finish at Attunda Orienteering Club’s clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Take the commuter train to Rotebro station and walk 1.5 km to the start/finish. Parking at Sollentuna Golf Club, followed by a 500 m walk. Registration is open until one hour before the start. Minimum age: 18. Breakfast is served after the race. Participant numbers are limited. A generous breakfast is served after the finish.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.nighttrailrun.se/om-sommartrail): 2027-06-21 — "Måndag 21 juni 2027. Start klockan 02.00." (was estimated 2027-06-20)

name: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas
location: Sudeikių ežeras, Sudeikiai, Utenos rajonas, Lietuva
organizer: VšĮ Utenos verslo ir turizmo agentūra
description: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Sudeikių miestelyje, Utenos rajone, Joninių nakties išvakarėse. Maratonas suteikia galimybę sporto entuziastams patirti unikalią atmosferą ir išbandyti savo ištvermę gražioje gamtos aplinkoje prie Sudeikių ežero. Renginys prasideda vakare, birželio 23 dieną, 19:30 val., ir kviečia dalyvius bei žiūrovus į aktyvų ir smagų sporto vakarą.
course_highlights: Vyksta Sudeikių miestelyje prie Sudeikių ežero
Renginio pradžia Joninių nakties išvakarėse, birželio 23 d. 19:30 val.
Maratonas vyksta Utenos rajone, gamtos apsuptyje
additional: Registracija vykdoma per oficialią svetainę su galimybe prisijungti per Facebook. Renginys vyksta Joninių nakties išvakarėse, todėl startas numatytas vakare. Renginio vieta pažymėta Google Maps nuoroda Sudeikių miestelyje. Renginys apima ne tik bėgimą, bet ir kitus aktyvius užsiėmimus, registracija vyksta internetu, ir jis yra svarbi vietinė sporto šventės dalis.

name: Häädemeeste Võidupüha jooks
description: The Häädemeeste Victory Day Run is a traditional running event held near the Häädemeeste bus station. The event invites everyone who enjoys being active to celebrate Victory Day in a sporting and community-minded spirit. In addition to the main race, a children’s run for the youngest members of the family will be held for the first time. After the run, participants can enjoy the Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden. Participation is free, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Häädemeeste bus station
Children’s run before the main race
Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden after the run
additional: Registration and gathering take place on site at the Häädemeeste bus station from 16:00 to 17:30. Participation is free.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: The 49th Jaanijooks around the Karksi-Nuia Reservoir is a traditional running race held near the ruins of Karksi Order Castle. The race route circles the scenic Karksi-Nuia Reservoir, offering participants beautiful views and an enjoyable running experience. The event is intended for both recreational and experienced runners and offers a chance to enjoy an active day with the community.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: The Solstice Runs are an annual series of races consisting of several stages, where participants can earn points and compete in age groups. Jooks suvesse is one of the stages in the series and takes place in the Loode oak forest in Kuressaare. The course has varied terrain, including a cycle and pedestrian path and forest trails, which may be muddy depending on the weather. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet snack and drink at the finish.

name: Skrējiens “Jānis un Jānītis”
organizer: Noskrien Cēsis un Cēsu novada pašvaldība
description: The “Jānis and Jānītis” run is a traditional Cēsis race with a history dating back to 1989, inviting young and old alike to take part in a festive sporting atmosphere. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle, inspire new achievements, and promote Cēsis as a city for active recreation. A range of distances is offered, from a 600-metre children’s run through the city to a 13 km course on asphalt, gravel, and forest roads. Registration is open until 17 June, and places are limited.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 600 m children’s run to a 13 km course
The course includes asphalt, gravel, and forest roads
The race takes place in Cēsis and its surrounding area
additional: Registration must be completed by 17 June. The distances are suitable for different age groups and fitness levels.

name: Līgo skrējiens Ozolos, Liezēres pag.
description: The Līgo Run in Ozoli is an annual running event held in Liezēre Parish, Madona Municipality. The aim of the race is to promote running and Nordic walking as a healthy, active lifestyle, and to foster togetherness and a sporting atmosphere on Līgo Day. The course is a marked loop, offering different distances for children and adults, including a popular run and a Nordic walking distance. The event is suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, and is organized in cooperation with the Liezēre Parish Administration.
course_highlights: Loop course with a 3 km lap and a 500 m children’s lap
Various distances for children and adults, including 3 km, 6 km, and 9 km options
Course marked along its entire length
additional: The race takes place in Ozoli, Liezēre Parish, Madona Municipality, in the parking lot opposite the shop. The event runs from 11:00 to 16:00. Participants are divided into age groups and gender categories. The organizer is the association “Madonas rings,” in cooperation with the Liezēre Parish Administration.

name: Poznań Malta #67
description: Kiprun Poznań Malta #67 is a regular, informal running event organized by runners for runners by Lake Malta in Poznań. The event takes place in a friendly and safe atmosphere, with organizers explaining the rules and course before the start. Participants can choose between two distances and can count on accurate timekeeping. It’s a great opportunity both for those looking to spend time actively and for those focused on sporting competition.
course_highlights: A relaxed course by Lake Malta
Accurate timekeeping
A friendly and safe event format
additional: The event also includes Nordic walking. The event is free.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan stänger söndag 13 juni kl 23.59. Ordinarie avgift: 325 kronor.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Från 14 juni tillkommer 50 kronor extra (totalt 375 kr). Efteranmälan via hemsidan till söndag 20 juni kl 16.00.

description: Modine Söderköping City Race is a festive fun run taking place on 22 June 2027, with the start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 kilometres through the city’s beautiful surroundings along the Storån and Göta Canal. The race features music, performances and plenty of encouragement along the course, creating a wonderful atmosphere for both runners and spectators. After crossing the finish line, all participants are treated to a hearty summer plate from ICA Supermarket. This annual running festival is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb and attracts many participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 5 kilometres through Söderköping, starting and finishing in Brunnsparken
The course is run in three laps: the first along the Storån and Göta Canal, the second through central Söderköping, and the third around Brunnsparken and the residential neighbourhoods
Music and performances along the entire course create a festive atmosphere
additional: Race bibs can be collected at ICA Supermarket Söderköping on Monday 21 June from 12:00 to 18:00, or on race day in Brunnsparken from 15:00 to 18:30. The top tear-off strip on the race bib is the timing chip. Late registration in person is available at ICA Supermarket on 21 June from 12:00 to 18:00 and on race day from 15:00 to 18:30. Swish is the only accepted payment method for late registration in person. The 2027 race takes place on Tuesday 22 June, with the start at 19:00. All participants receive a medal. Late registration costs an extra 50 kronor.
