pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Tisdagen 22 juni 2027 är det dags för Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp!

name: 12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 12th Rõuge Trail Run and Walk is a trail running and Nordic walking event held in Rõuge Nightingale Valley, Võru County, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and exercise. The event is suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and walkers who want to spend their time actively. The Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity organises the event to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can experience beautiful scenery and the joy of exercise while enhancing their well-being.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
description: Herbatka u Tadka, or the Run to the Tea House, is a 10 km race held in Warsaw. Participants can prepare for the start with training plans tailored to different experience levels, offering expert support and detailed instructions. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on the streets of the capital in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on the streets of Warsaw
Training tailored to the runner’s VDOT level
Expert support and detailed training plans
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks and are tailored to each runner’s individual level. The platform can also be used to manage the race listing and support marketing collaboration.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 2. posms – Mežaparks
description: Izskrien Rīgu Stage 2 is part of the popular Riga running series, offering running fun for the whole family in the beautiful Mežaparks area. This stage is one of five unique runs held in different locations around Riga, featuring flat and scenic courses. The event brings together professional runners and amateurs alike, creating a friendly and sporting atmosphere. Traditionally, the race takes place in the evening, allowing participants to enjoy running in a city park.
course_highlights: A run through Mežaparks on flat and scenic trails
The course goes around a pond and through Māras Garden
Running in Riga’s most beautiful park areas
additional: The race traditionally starts at 18:30. The event is part of a five-stage series held in different parks and areas around Riga. Participants can take part individually or with their families. The event usually concludes with an awards ceremony and various activities.

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea, held in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubian region. Runners can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gains and scenic routes. The start and finish are at different locations, and the organizer provides transport to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to take on a challenging course and enjoy the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: 160 km distance with +/- 2,502 m of elevation gain, starting in Puck at 10:00
100 km distance with +/- 2,267 m of elevation gain, starting in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes run through Kashubia and coastal areas, with checkpoints and time limits
additional: For the start of the longest distance (160 km), runners are transported by coach from outside the Gdynia Sports Centre – National Rugby Stadium (paid transport). The time limit for the 160 km distance is 31 hours. The course has checkpoints with time limits and drop bags. The event includes both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through various towns in the region and providing an unforgettable experience for runners of all ability levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on the beauty of the courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, making them worth collecting. It’s a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of the night.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a traditional community celebration and running race held every year on the Friday after Midsummer in the beautiful summer town of Trosa. The race offers categories for all ages and ability levels, from young children to elite runners, on a varied course through the town centre and close to the water. Chip timing and several start groups create a welcoming, race-friendly atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners. Trosa Stadslopp is known for its positive atmosphere, enthusiastic spectators and compact course, creating a unique running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs through summery Trosa, close to the water
Chip timing with two intermediate timing points in the 8.9 km race
Competitive and recreational categories for all ages and ability levels
additional: Race bibs with disposable chips are handed out from 10:00 on race day at Team Sportia Trosa. The cutoff time to reach the lap point in the 8.9 km race is 40 minutes. Start groups are available for elite runners, and runners in categories 1 and 2 can choose their start group. The jogging and Nordic walking events start shortly before the competitive categories. Parking is available, with a voluntary fee supporting youth activities. All runners receive 50 cl of Vitamin Well at the finish of the 8.9 km and 4 km races. Registration is available via the race’s registration portal; late and on-site registration have specific dates and fees.

name: Sillamäe promenaadijooks
description: Sillamäe Promenade Run is a well-known city race held near the Sillamäe Cultural Centre. The race began as a stair run and has been called the Promenade Run since 2021. The event offers various distances, from short races for little ones to the adults’ 7 km main distance, which also challenges trained athletes. It is a community-oriented and engaging event, with several activities in addition to running, and important contributions from supporters and volunteers.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: The 9th edition of the Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) will be held in Narva, Ida-Virumaa County, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the Äkkeküla sports complex (Nut Hill). Organized by the nonprofit sports club SK ETR, the event features trails certified by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), with ITRA points awarded to finishers. The race offers several distances for trail runners of different levels, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km race held in Brodnica, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging paved course. The organizers offer training plans tailored to different ability levels, supporting participants in their preparations. The event is open and welcoming to runners, encouraging physical activity and competition on the city streets.
course_highlights: A paved course of moderate difficulty
A 10 km road race
Held in the picturesque city of Brodnica
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The III Run in Sławice is a 10 km road race held in the picturesque village of Sławice in the Masovian Voivodeship. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a moderately challenging asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is open and welcoming to runners who want to improve their results and enjoy sporting competition.
course_highlights: 10 km asphalt course
Moderate difficulty
Picturesque surroundings of Sławice
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the scenic area of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes cover varied terrain, including asphalt, paved roads and dirt paths, and participants climb 3 or 5 green hills depending on the distance chosen. The available distances are 13.8 km and 22.3 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and is also open to children and young people, who compete on the stadium track over designated loops.
course_highlights: Mountain route with 3 or 5 green hills
Varied terrain: asphalt (21–25%), paved roads (32–38%), dirt roads and paths (41–43%)
Start and finish at the market square in Lubenia
additional: Children’s and youth races take place on the stadium track over designated loops of 200 to 800 m, divided by age and gender categories. Children’s race bibs must be collected by 10:30. On race day, registration for the children’s races is unavailable because of the 200-participant limit. The children’s races start after the shorter main race. On-site registration at the stadium after 10:30 is limited.

name: XIII Bieg Cichociemnych
description: The Cichociemni Run is a demanding cross-country race dedicated to the memory of Poland’s heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The course is more challenging than most cross-country races and features natural and man-made obstacles of varying difficulty. Participants must tackle mud and water, jump over obstacles, crawl under them, and squeeze through channels. The race takes place every June in Sochaczew and offers a chance to test your strength and get to know the Bzura River and its surroundings.
course_highlights: A course featuring natural and man-made obstacles of varying difficulty
Sections through mud and water, and through channels
Views and proximity to the banks and riverbed of the Bzura River
additional: Registration is available through the Zmierzymy Czas platform. A dedicated T-shirt can be ordered during selected registration periods. Discounts are available for running groups of at least 6 people upon prior contact by email. Organizer: UKS Dragon Fight Club Sochaczew. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence, and the Mayor of the City of Sochaczew.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race held in Unisław as part of Unisław Days. The course follows paved roads through the scenic Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty. The race is part of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running and is certified by the Polish Athletics Association. The event also includes a Nordic walking event, making it appealing to a wide range of participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through Chełmno Landscape Park
Paved roads through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty
The course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association
additional: The race course is certified by the Polish Athletics Association.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family, with distances ranging from 0.9 km to the 42.2 km marathon. The race takes place in the idyllic summer landscape of Kristianopel and offers opportunities both to enjoy running and to set personal records. Team Blekinge provides enthusiastic support and cheerful encouragement along the course. The day can be combined with relaxing in the picturesque village, with swimming, restaurants and cafés. In 2027, the Swedish Veterans’ Marathon Championships will also be held in conjunction with the race.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the marathon and half marathon
Courses through the idyllic summer landscape around Kristianopel
Children’s race and Sommarlunken, a 4 km untimed run
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Regular registration can be paid for by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Distances have bib number ranges and colour codes, but late registrants may receive a different colour code. Sommarlunken is a 4 km course with no timing or medal, and prizes are awarded by lottery. Kristianopel offers swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. Registration opens in January 2027; late registration on race day is available from 08:00, subject to availability. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer.

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a half-marathon offering a fast, single-lap course through many of Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings. Runners pass, among other places, the Tegelviken allotment gardens, Stensö fishing harbour, Kalmarsundsparken with Kalmar Castle in the foreground, and areas around Ängöleden and Skälby. The race is open to both men and women and is known for many runners setting personal records here. There is also a 5 km fun run, Malkars Femman, open to everyone whether they walk, run or roll. All finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Single-lap course through Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings
Passes Kalmarsundsparken with Kalmar Castle in the foreground
Water stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 18 km and the finish
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Kalmar Malkars Västra, Torsåsgatan, on Friday, June 26, from 15:00 to 17:00 and on Saturday, June 27, from 12:00 to 15:00. Late registration is available through June 25 and thereafter at race-number collection. Everyone who registers for the 21.1 km race by June 20 receives a T-shirt with the Kalmar Malkars logo when collecting their race number. ICA MAXI provides a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate after the race. Timing and prize-giving in the men’s and women’s categories. All finishers receive a medal. The 2026 start time is listed as 15:00. Water stations are located after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km, and at the finish. A T-shirt is included for half-marathon runners who register by the final regular registration day.

name: Kristianopel Runt 10 km
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Kristianopel Runt is part of the running festival in Kristianopel, organised by Team Blekinge LF. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a marathon, with 10 km being a popular distance. The courses pass through idyllic summer scenery, with enthusiastic support and cheers from the race marshals. Participants can combine running with relaxing in picturesque Kristianopel, which offers swimming, restaurants and cafés. This year’s event also includes the Swedish Veterans’ Marathon Championships, adding to the competitive excitement.
course_highlights: Running through idyllic summer scenery on the east coast
Several distances from 0.9 km to 42.2 km, including the 10 km Kristianopel Runt
Courses with colour-coded number series and family-friendly races
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00, on a first-come, first-served basis. Payment for regular registration can be made by card or Swish; late registration can be paid for by Swish or cash. Number series and colour codes are used for the different distances. Kristianopel offers swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation for participants and their companions. The organiser’s website lists the 10 km start time as 11:00 and says that electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. It also states that the 2027 race will take place on 3 July, which differs from the date in the race metadata.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2027
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge - Pirita 2027 is a versatile running race held amid Pirita’s beautiful natural surroundings. The race offers a range of distances, suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes wind through the scenic Pirita area, giving participants an enjoyable running experience and a summer sporting challenge. The event is open to everyone and offers a great opportunity to enjoy active leisure time with family and friends.
course_highlights: Scenic Pirita area
A range of distances for runners of different abilities
Pleasant summer running environment
additional: The list of registered participants is updated once an hour. The event includes children’s and family runs, as well as various distances up to 10 km. The event is organized by MTÜ Rakvere Maraton.

name: Muraste jooks
description: Muraste Run is part of the Harku municipality running series and takes place at Muraste School stadium. The course follows Muraste’s streets and shared-use paths on marked, open roads. A range of distances is available for both children and adults, as well as a family race. The top finishers in each age group receive awards, and those who complete the series receive a season medal. The event is organised by MTÜ TreeningPluss, which promotes the joy of movement and active lifestyles.

name: Märgatud laps jooksmas
description: The charity running series “Märgatud Laps jooksmas” takes place at the Kose song festival grounds and offers participants the chance to enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The series aims to bring the community together and make the joy of exercise accessible to all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in running and creates a friendly, supportive atmosphere.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate off-road races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of several stages held on different courses with varying levels of difficulty, featuring two main distances: Szpurt (6–8 km) and Wertep (17–21 km). The events are characterized by environmental care, a limited number of participants, and an atmosphere of passion, competition, and friendship. Races usually start in the morning, and participants can expect professional organization, timekeeping, and prizes in various categories.
course_highlights: Off-road courses of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Carefully marked trails with aid stations along the longer-distance course
Races take place in the scenic regions of Podlasie and surrounding areas, with respect for nature
additional: Starts are organized in corrals based on results from the previous season. The race package includes a race number with a timing chip valid for the entire season, a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, medical support, aid stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography services, and prizes for the top athletes in the OPEN and age-group categories. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
description: The Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking events to an ultramarathon and half marathon, on routes through the picturesque Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Eve Run is an annual running event held in Łabiszyn, with the start and finish at the Municipal Stadium. The 5 km main race starts at 7:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Main-race participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after the competitions. The run is part of a running series and offers race packs to the first registrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn
5 km main-race route
Children’s and youth races in 4 age categories
additional: After the main race, participants receive a medal and a sweet snack, while children and youth receive a medal and a surprise. The awards ceremony for the top runners takes place after all races have ended. Race packs are available to the first registrants.

name: 3 Otwarty Bieg Sejmowy o Puchar Marszałka
Bieg Powitania Lata
location: Strzelce Wielkie, Pajęczno County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: V RUNda Żubra Biegi i Nordic Walking
Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand Beach Resort, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a challenging and fun race for the whole family, with distances from 500 meters to 10 kilometers. The race takes place on the beautiful, long sandy beach at Böda Sand Beach Resort on Öland, offering a unique and scenic running experience. Everyone who finishes the race receives a medal as a keepsake. The event is held annually and is part of Böda Sand’s wide range of summer activities and events.
course_highlights: Run on one of Öland’s most beautiful beaches, with almost two miles of white sand
Courses from 500 meters up to 10 kilometers
Family-friendly race with a medal for everyone who finishes
additional: The race is part of Böda Sand’s summer program, with activities for the whole family. There are several distances to choose from, making it accessible to both children and adults. Böda Sand also offers many other sports and leisure activities alongside the event. A lodging offer at Böda Sand has previously been mentioned in race information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bodasand.se/evenemang/): 2027-06-30 — "Böda Beach Run — 30 juni 2027" (was estimated 2027-06-23)

name: Byrundan
location: Unos park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The race offers distances for all ages, from children to adults, on a beautiful summer course through Gamleby. There are several categories and distances, including children’s and youth races, as well as a joint start for the 4 km and 8 km races. All participants receive a medal after finishing, and prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, along with sprint prizes in the 4 km and 8 km races. Byrundan is part of TOUR DE RUN and is organised by Gamleby OK.
course_highlights: The course runs through beautiful summer scenery in Gamleby
Start and finish in Unos Park
Water stations at the start/finish and at 4 km
additional: Race numbers can be collected in Unos Park from 15:00 until one hour before the start. Children are offered hamburgers/sausages after the race, sponsored by ICA Supermarket. Medals are sponsored by Metallfabriken Norden AB. Professional timing by Racetimer. The prize ceremony takes place at approximately 19:25 for children and 20:45 for everyone else. A sprint prize at 450 m for the 4 km and 8 km races is a gift card worth 3000 kr. The 8 km course record comes with a 1000 kr prize.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together recreational athletes and active people from spring to autumn, offering a chance to test their abilities in different age groups and distances. The 22nd Emumäe Run is the series’ fifth stage and takes place on 4 July at Emumäe. The series aims to popularise running and fitness walking and support local recreational athletes. Races are held over several distances, from short children’s races to main races of up to 10 km. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the stomach or chest.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
description: The Võhma health trail marathon is a trail marathon held on the Võhma town health trail. The course is a 620-metre loop that must be completed 68 times, for a total of 42.2 km. The race starts at 9:00 and offers participants a medal, timing, course support, refreshments at the finish and washing facilities. In addition to the marathon, participants can also run a shorter distance free of charge and without official timing, making it suitable for anyone who enjoys being active.

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: The Jüri Lossmann Memorial Run is a traditional running race held in Viljandi. The race starts at 19:00. The run is dedicated to Jüri Lossmann and offers participants the chance to enjoy a pleasant summer evening and a sporting challenge.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique nighttime half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from different cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become a tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to make Marlena, one of the foundation’s beneficiaries, dream come true: a trip to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sporting challenge, but also an opportunity to work together to support children in need.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowo ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different ages and ability levels. The race covers 10 km, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Centre, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from pieces awarded at the individual stages.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race, covering a distance of 31.13 km. It takes place in the scenic surroundings of Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a formal opening and closing ceremony, with awards presented. The event is national in scope and attracts runners from various age groups.

name: Bieg i Nordic Walking O Buławę Sieniawską
Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail
description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a challenging and scenic running experience in the deep forests of Kolmården, with distances of 45 km and 60 km. The course offers varied terrain, with forest trails, mountain ridges featuring spectacular views, sections along the shores of Bråviken, and technical running in nature reserves. The race is suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners seeking a memorable trail experience. At the finish, participants receive a medal and a light meal, included in the entry fee.
course_highlights: Start in Kolmården Forest, with trails through varied terrain
Views from the mountain ridge at Kvarseboklint and running along the shores of Bråviken
Technical and challenging running through Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack/belt with at least 0.5 L of fluids, a pressure bandage/blood stopper, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: the 45K has 4 stations, and the 60K has 5 stations offering sports drink, energy products, and water. The cutoff time for the 45K is 13:30 at 44 km (pace 9:00 min/km). Participants are served a light meal at the finish. Start and finish at Klintvallen in Kvarsebo. Medical services are available on site. After finishing, participants receive a medal and are offered hot vegetarian soup. Mandatory equipment rules apply; aid stations are located along the course.

name: 6. Navi jooksu-kõnnitiir
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances vary from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with a small section on soft terrain. The series also includes mini distances and runs for young children, suitable for all age groups. The events take place in various locations across Võrumaa, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the region’s beautiful nature and sporting community.

name: Navi jooksutiir
description: Navi Run is a running, Nordic walking and walking event held in Võru County and organized by Navi Village Association. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and a healthy lifestyle in beautiful surroundings, and is suitable for participants of different abilities. Navi Run is part of a broader initiative to promote physical activity, with the aim of supporting an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone who enjoys being active is invited to enjoy a sporty day and the joy of movement.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, taking place for the eighth time in 2026. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions, and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and chip timing.

name: 34 Bieg po Plaży
location: Jarosławiec, Postomino, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 34th Jarosławiec Beach Run is an annual running event organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino. The race takes place on a scenic route along the beach by the Baltic Sea, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by coastal nature. The event attracts runners from various regions, combining sporting competition with recreation and socializing. The organizers provide professional event support and attractive keepsakes for participants.
course_highlights: The race route runs along a sandy beach by the Baltic Sea
Scenic views of the sea and coastal nature
Flat, fast terrain conducive to good race times
additional: The event is organized by the Culture and Sports Centre in Postomino and takes place in Jarosławiec. The website has no detailed information about start waves, participant limits, or race packages. Reports and photo galleries from previous editions are available.

name: Naktinė bėgimo šventė „Kaišiadorys 2026/10“
location: Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė, Kaišiadorys, Lietuva
price_range: 4,- EUR iki 20,- EUR, registracijos ir dalyvio mokesčiai priklauso nuo distancijos ir registracijos laiko
description: Naktinė bėgimo šventė „Kaišiadorys 2026/10“ skirta paminėti Valstybės (Lietuvos karaliaus Mindaugo karūnavimo) dieną. Renginys vyks Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštėje ir apims įvairias amžiaus grupes bei distancijas, suteikiant galimybę bėgikams varžytis ir mėgautis bėgimu miesto gatvėse bei pažintiniuose takuose. Organizatoriai kviečia visus bėgimo mėgėjus dalyvauti ir populiarinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Varžybų metu bus filmuojama ir fotografuojama, o dalyviai sutinka, kad medžiaga gali būti naudojama rinkodaros tikslais.
course_highlights: Varžybų vieta - Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė, miesto gatvės, Girelės pažintinis takas, Gandriuko takas
Skirtingos distancijos nuo 436 m iki 8 km, pritaikytos įvairioms amžiaus grupėms
Naktinis bėgimas su galimybe įsigyti specialius bėgimo marškinėlius
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas varžybų vietoje nuo 17:00 val. iki 20:45 val. priklausomai nuo distancijos. Kaišiadorių švietimo ir sporto centro ugdytiniams ir darbuotojams dalyvio mokestis netaikomas. Galima įsigyti specialius bėgimo marškinėlius (šviesius arba tamsius) už 15 EUR. Varžybų metu būtina laikytis saugumo reikalavimų. Bėgimo vieta Kaišiadorių Teofiliaus Matulionio aikštė ir aplinkinės vietovės, registracija varžybų dieną, marškinėlių pardavimas, įvairios distancijos

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a three-stage running series inviting both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy an active time outdoors. At each stage, participants can choose between a lap of the approximately 5 km health trail and a 10 km race. There is also an exciting power run to find the best ratio of strength to speed. Series finishers are eligible for prizes and prize draws, including a bicycle as the grand prize. Participation is free, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Center. Held in the evening, it combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It has become a long-standing tradition, attracting participants who want to spend time outdoors running or walking in a friendly atmosphere. The event takes place around Bolechowo and lasts approximately two and a half hours.
course_highlights: Evening runs and walks outdoors
Route around Bolechowo and Czerwonak
Bringing the local community together through physical activity
additional: The event is free and takes place from 19:30 to 22:00. It is part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees, or online registration.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 4. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 4th stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event around Lake Viljandi on the health and ski trail. The race is part of the traditional Joosu Series, offering participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The course has good footing and is suitable for runners of different abilities. The event is organised by the Joosu Recreational Sports Club, which welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Tipujooks is a running competition organized by the Tartumaa Sports Association and held at Vooremäe. It is a traditional summer sporting event that invites running enthusiasts to take part and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and competitive sport. The competition is part of the Tartumaa sports calendar and is suitable for runners of different ability levels.

name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting grassroots triathlon experience. The main distance comprises a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain bike ride and a 4 km run, much of which follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Reserve. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and water stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike-washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre, over one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km bike course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Reserve
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each wave. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, water-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, use of the sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre, and changing facilities are available in the sauna anteroom. The swim start number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is permitted during the bike leg. Trail course, family events, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Mõisa jooks
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
description: Kehtna Manor Run is a friendly, community-focused running event held in the grounds of Kehtna Manor. It offers three distances: a 5 km main race, a 2.5 km youth race, and a 500 m children’s race, welcoming participants of different ages. Alongside the races, the event features Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines, creating a pleasant family-day atmosphere. It is organized by SK Team Kehtna, which is dedicated to promoting sport and physical activity in the community.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
description: The 5th Pühajärve Park Mile is a 1.6 km running race held in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Centre. The start and finish are at the same location, and the race begins at 12:10. The race is open to all running enthusiasts and offers a pleasant opportunity to enjoy a run in beautiful park surroundings. Participants receive a medal and bib number, chip timing, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mudajooks is a popular mass-participation sporting event in Central Estonia, offering participants an exciting and adventurous obstacle course of up to 10 km. The event takes place in Pajusi village and is suitable for both individual runners and teams. The course features natural and man-made obstacles that challenge participants’ physical and mental endurance. Separate courses are available for children, and all finishers receive a commemorative medal. Free parking and hot soup after the race are provided for participants.

name: Rojas pusmaratona festivāls
description: The Roja Half Marathon Festival is an annual running event held in Roja, offering a range of distances, including a 21.1 km half marathon, 12.3 km, 3 km, and children’s races. The competition takes place on a stadium track and a certified asphalt course suitable for timed races. The festival welcomes both professional and amateur runners and also features a 24-hour ultramarathon and other running options. It is a great opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and the Zvejnieksvētki morning activities in Roja.
course_highlights: Course lap length: 1234.7 m
Course surface: stadium track and asphalt
The course meets the requirements for timed races and has a World Athletics certificate
additional: Registration and bib collection take place from 7:00 to 8:45 (3 km) and until 9:15 (21.1 km, 12.3 km, and 400 m children’s races). The 3 km race starts at 9:00, the 12.3 km race and Nordic walking at 9:30, the half marathon at 9:30, and the children’s races at 9:45. The festival also includes 24-hour, 12-hour, and 6-hour races with separate start times. The awards ceremony takes place at around 12:00–13:00. Individual support points for the ultramarathon are available along the course.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a moderately challenging course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, providing convenient event facilities. We invite all running enthusiasts to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both amateurs and experienced runners. The race follows the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively, enjoy sporting competition, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of experience level, emphasizing the importance of exercise and positive energy.

name: Pozytywny Bieg Przełajowy - reaktywacja
location: Kalej, Wręczyca Wielka, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly running race held at Böda Sand SportCamp on Öland. The race offers several distances for both children and adults, with routes through lovely forest terrain. Adults can choose between 6.5 km and 4 km, while shorter distances are available for children and young people. All participants who finish the race receive a medal as a keepsake. The event has a welcoming atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Route through lovely forest terrain
Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp
Distances available for both children and adults
additional: Late registration is available through 8 July, followed by race-number collection on race day from 15:00. Payment can be made in cash, by card or via Swish. Children and young people under 11 are not timed and there is no prize ceremony for them. Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Register by 3 July 2027; late registration is available for a higher fee. Children aged 11 and under are not timed and there is no prize ceremony.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/bodasandsloppet/): 2027-07-10 — "Tid & datum 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-02)

name: Musköloppet
description: Musköloppet is a popular running race held in the spectacular archipelago setting of Muskö. The race has a long tradition and celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022, after being paused during the pandemic. There are several different courses and categories, including children’s races, and the event offers a wonderful nature experience, with the start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård. Late registration is available on site up to one hour before the start.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the beautiful archipelago setting of Muskö
Start and finish at Muskö Hembygdsgård
Children’s races over 1.5 km and 2.5 km for different age groups
additional: Late registration is available on site at the start and finish area up to one hour before the race begins. There are water stations along the course, and runners may arrange their own drinks. Race management may decide to restart the race if needed. Pacing assistance from non-competitors is not permitted. The children’s races start at 10:00 for 1.5 km (ages 7–10) and at 10:30 for 2.5 km (ages 11–14). The countdown on the official website indicates 10 July 2027. However, the published times and distances on the website are for 2026. The relay costs 150 kr per team, and the children’s race for ages 4–6 is free, according to the published information.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.muskoloppet.se/): 2027-07-10 — "Nedräkning till Musköloppet 10 juli 2027" (was estimated 2027-07-10)

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is a unique running adventure and a journey to explore your inner landscape. It is not a traditional race, but a self-supported run around the beautiful island of Gotland, including a loop around Fårö, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants have 10 days to complete the approximately 511 km course, with support from four Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides basic support, while runners are responsible for their own food and accommodation.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Visby, Gotland’s medieval capital
Clockwise loop around the island, including Fårö
Mixed terrain with asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter trails
additional: Participants must check in twice daily using an online tool. Accommodation on the first night is at Visby Fängelse Hostel in shared rooms. A pre-race dinner and briefing are held the evening before the start. Angel Stations offer support, water, rest, and sometimes shower facilities. The ferry to Fårö runs every 30 minutes, but requires a call between 22:00 and 05:30. The run must be completed on foot within 10 days, averaging approximately 51 km per day. Luggage storage is available at the hostel. Parking is available near the ferry terminal, with cheaper options at Visby Airport. This is a self-supported event: participants are responsible for most of their food and logistics. The entire distance must be completed on foot within ten days, with regular position reports.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://runtrip.se/race-memo-2027/): 2027-07-10 — "SATURDAY, JULY 10 — The race starts at 10:00 am outside the main entrance of Visby Fängelse" (was estimated 2027-07-03)

name: Klåveröd Backyard 2026
location: Klåveröd, Svalöv Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Klåveröd Backyard is a trail and backyard race in Klåveröd on Söderåsen, with running through beautiful beech forest. The race is described as a combination of trail and backyard and welcomes participants to a nature-focused running experience in Skåne. The 2026 event is scheduled for Saturday, July 11.
course_highlights: Trail through beech forest
Nature-focused setting in Klåveröd on Söderåsen
Combines trail with the backyard format
additional: The Facebook event for 2026 lists Saturday, July 11. At the 2024 race, the winner ran 14 laps, covering more than 90 km.

name: V-asis maratonas „Vilniaus tiltai“
location: Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto, Vilnius, Lietuva
description: Maratonas „Vilniaus Tiltai“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Vilniaus laisvalaikio zonoje prie Baltojo tilto. Renginyje dalyviai gali varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo vaikų 500 m bėgimo iki pilno maratono 42,195 km. Trasos vingiuoja Neries krantinėmis ir per Vilniaus tiltus, suteikdamos unikalų miesto vaizdą bėgikams. Renginys skirtas tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams, populiarinant bėgimo kultūrą Lietuvoje ir garsinant Vilnių.
course_highlights: Trasa vingiuoja Neries krantinėmis ir per Vilniaus tiltus
Maratono distancija sudaryta iš 4 ratų po 10,6 km
Galimybė varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo 500 m iki 42,195 km
additional: Numerių išdavimas prasideda 6:45 val. Maratono, pusmaratonio ir 10,6 km distancijų dalyvių apšilimas 7:50 val. Yra apdovanojimai vyrų ir moterų maratono distancijose, taip pat gausiausios ir ištvermingiausios komandų nominacijos. Laiko limitai: maratonui 7 val., pusmaratoniui 3 val., 10,6 km - 2 val., 5,3 km - 1 val., šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijoms - 6 val. Varžybų vieta - Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto; būtina registracija ir sveikatos patikrinimas; renginys skatina bendruomeniškumą ir aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Coastal scenery in the town of Võsu
A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka Tõusu Marathon is a summer marathon on the Viimsi Peninsula, offering participants one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied course includes both paved roads and forest trails, with several climbs and descents that make the run exciting and varied.

name: Liepājas pusmaratons (Jūras svētki)
location: Lielais Dzintars Concert Hall, Liepāja, Latvia
description: The Liepāja Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Liepāja, bringing together local and international runners. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy the city’s most beautiful spots and its proximity to the sea while completing the half-marathon distance. The event is part of Sea Festival celebrations, creating a special festive atmosphere for participants and spectators. It is a great way to combine sport with cultural activities and relaxation in Liepāja.
course_highlights: The route runs through the central streets of Liepāja
Views of the sea and the seaside promenade
Part of the Sea Festival celebrations, with a special atmosphere
additional: Finishers receive a Sea Festival commemorative medal, and participant registration includes BTA accident insurance.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place in Starogard Gdański. It’s an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on an asphalt surface, ideal for improving fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.

name: II Bieg po Borówkę
location: Centrum Olchowca, Olchowiec, Gmina Obsza, Poland
description: Bieg po Borówkę is a running event held in Olchowiec, in the Obsza municipality, as part of the Berry Relay. The program includes a 10 km run and a Nordic walking event over the same distance. The route takes runners through scenic terrain on the edge of Roztocze and the Solska Forest, combining sporting competition with the promotion of local berries.
course_highlights: Scenic surroundings of Roztocze and the Solska Forest
Route along the Tanew and Wirowa rivers
Section through a blueberry plantation
additional: The run and Nordic walking event are both held over a distance of 10 km. The start and finish are in the center of Olchowiec.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Subcarpathian Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing together Chamber members and their families. It will take place in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event features 10 km races, a 7 km Nordic walking event, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring together the civil engineering community. Participants can look forward to a sporting atmosphere and a fun finish.

name: X Bieg Pamięci Dywizjonu 303
description: The 303 Squadron Remembrance Run is an annual running event organized in the Borki Municipality. It aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, and to commemorate the soldiers of 303 Squadron who fought in World War II. The event takes place in Stara Wieś and offers various distances for adults and children. The organizers provide race packs, medals, a post-race meal, and medical care. The event attracts great interest from the local community and runners.
course_highlights: Main race distances of 11.3 km, 5.3 km, and 3.3 km
Children’s races of 100 m, 400 m, and 600 m
Scenic surroundings of Stara Wieś in the Borki Municipality
additional: The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, cotton bags, T-shirts, water for participants, race packs for children, trophies for the winners, a post-race meal, and medical care.

name: 43 Bieg o Złoty Kłos
location: Kołaczkowo, Września County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of track and field events combining throwing, jumping, and running disciplines. The series consists of several stages, where participants can compete in different distances and events, with the IAAF scoring tables used to determine the rankings. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and are open to athletes of varying abilities. The series offers a varied track and field experience for both recreational and advanced athletes.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a city race of approximately 6.3 km that takes place in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The race offers a scenic course along the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken, passing landmarks including the Stegeholm Castle ruins and Myntbryggan. After finishing, participants receive a medal as proof of their participation. The race is a popular summer tradition that welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A city race of approximately 6.3 km in central Västervik
The course follows the cycle path beside Gamlebyviken and passes the Stegeholm Castle ruins
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
additional: A children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) of 800 m for children up to 10 years old, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. Participants receive medals after finishing. A separate Sparbanksloppet of approximately 700 metres is offered for children up to 10 years old. Registration for the 2027 race opens on 1 May.
