pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Måndag den 12 juli är det dags för 2027 års löpartävling i Västerviks centrum!

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 3 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai atviras bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos vyksta penkiais etapais skirtingose vietovėse, kur bėgikai varžosi tarpusavyje ir renka taškus bendram įvertinimui. Kiekvienas etapas turi savo trasą ir starto laiką, o dalyvavimas yra nemokamas. Turnyrą organizuoja Jonavos sporto centras kartu su Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija ir kitais partneriais.
course_highlights: Penki etapai skirtingose Jonavos rajono vietovėse
Trasos nuo 6 km iki 8,4 km ilgio
Startas vakare, 19:30 val., numerių atsiėmimas prieš varžybas
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje. Registracija į kiekvieną etapą vykdoma atskirai internetu. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Varžybų trasos gali kirstis su kelių eismu, todėl dalyviai privalo laikytis kelių eismo taisyklių. 5 etapų serija, registracija internetu, atviros visiems Lietuvos ir užsienio dalyviams, startai dažniausiai 19:30 val.

name: Victorialoppet
description: Victorialoppet is a traditional running festival held every year in Borgholm on Öland. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including a 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini, a 1.5 km race for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful views along the shore and an enthusiastic crowd creating a wonderful atmosphere. The event is a popular celebration, with music along the course and a strong commitment to the Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with views along the shore
Music at several locations along the course
Courses adapted for all ages and abilities
additional: Bib pickup takes place on race day from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholms Sporthall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at Borgholms Sporthall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and there is music at several locations. Prizes are awarded in different categories, and participants receive medals, commemorative plaques, ice cream, and drinks, depending on the race. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the parasport categories. There are also parasport and youth categories. Water is available along the 9 km course, and changing rooms and showers are provided at Borgholms Sporthall and Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Fees vary depending on the race and registration date; an administration fee applies.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 3.posms Biķernieku trase
location: Biķernieku trase, Sergeja Eizenšteina iela, Riga, Latvia
organizer: Biedrība “Piedzīvojumu sacensību apvienība” sadarbībā ar Rīgas valstspilsētas pašvaldību
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series in Riga for the whole family, held at five unique locations around the city, including Biķernieku Track. The series offers a range of distances suitable for active runners, beginners, and children. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and encourage Riga residents to be physically active. Each event is specially organised with a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in family and sports-team categories.
course_highlights: Biķernieku Track, with 6 laps in the 10 km distance
The races take place in Riga’s parks and neighbourhoods on flat terrain
Distances are suitable for different age groups and fitness levels
additional: Participants may take part with strollers, but dogs are not allowed. A single registration gives participants a number that is valid for all events. Participants who take part in at least 4 of the 5 events receive a season commemorative prize. It is recommended to arrive 30–45 minutes before the start to collect your race number and warm up. The event centre is at Biķernieku Track by the stadium, on S. Eizenšteina Street. The course is marked. The venue is accessible by public transport, but parking is paid.

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third event in the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race distance is 4.5 km, and children’s toddler and mini runs are also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting competitive atmosphere. Children’s runs are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.

name: Ozolkalna VK
additional: The participation fee must be paid by bank card or bank transfer. If paying by bank transfer, registration details must be sent to latloppet@gmail.com.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometer night race held on the shores of the Baltic Sea as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, with city lights reflected on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining athletic competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.

name: Trakų naktinis pusmaratonis 2026
description: Trakų naktinis pusmaratonis yra unikalus bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Trakų pilies apylinkėse. Varžybų startas yra Karaimų gatvėje, o finišas - Birutės gatvėje prie bažnyčios. Renginys pritraukia bėgimo entuziastus, kurie mėgaujasi nepakartojama atmosfera ir gražia Trakų aplinka. Registracija vyksta internetu iki liepos 17 dienos, o dalyvių numerius galima atsiimti likus dienai iki varžybų.
course_highlights: Startas Karaimų g. 13
Finišas Birutės g. 4 prie bažnyčios
Trakų pilies apylinkės ir naktinė atmosfera
additional: Dalyvių numerius ir laiko matavimo elektronines mikroschemas atsiimti galima liepos 18 d. nuo 17 val. Trakuose, Birutės g. 4. Vakarinis naktinis bėgimas, trasa su kalniukais, apšviesta Trakų pilis, pusiasalis, muziejai, cerkvė, Lukos ežeras, startas prie pusiasalio pilies, distancijos: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, vaikų 500 m bėgimas, rekomenduojama pasiruošti ir mityba.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 is a multi-stage running and walking series featuring various races in the Lääne-Virumaa region. Stage 9, Rakvere Parish Summer Run, takes place at Kooli 4 in Rakvere. The series aims to offer a sporting challenge and enjoyment to running enthusiasts and promote an active lifestyle throughout the region.

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp
description: The Järvamaa Lake Runs is a traditional running series consisting of several stages by different lakes in Järvamaa. The Väinjärve Run is the sixth stage of the series. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers different distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: 12. skrējiens Piltene
description: Skrējiens Piltene is an annual running event in Piltene that brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels. Previous editions have included 10 km and 5 km races, as well as shorter events and Nordic walking starts. The event aims to promote an active, healthy lifestyle and popularize running.
course_highlights: The event’s main race is a 10 km road run.
Previous editions have also included a 5 km race.
Participants have also been offered a mile race and a 5 km Nordic walking start.

name: 12. Nocny Portowy Maraton Szczeciński oraz 7. Nocny Portowy Półmaraton Szczeciński
description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are unique night races held in Szczecin, taking runners through the city’s central streets, the port and the shipyard. The marathon course consists of two identical 42,195 m loops, while the half marathon covers 21,097 m; both courses are certified by the PZLA. The race starts at 23:00, creating a unique atmosphere in the city at night and allowing participants to admire Szczecin’s distinctive landmarks. The event promotes physical activity, a healthy lifestyle and the West Pomerania region.
course_highlights: The course passes through the city centre, the port and the Szczecin Wulkan Shipyard grounds
Scenic viewpoints at Wały Chrobrego, with music and spectator support
Two identical marathon loops and distance markers every 1 km
additional: The time limit for both races is 6 hours. The start and finish are at the Florian Krygier Municipal Football Stadium. The marathon course consists of two identical loops, while the half marathon is one loop. There are refreshment stations and distance markers every 1 km along the course. Participants must follow the instructions of the event and safety personnel.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail running event held in the picturesque landscapes of the Elbląg Upland overlooking the Vistula Lagoon. The course follows wild trails with varied elevation and peaceful natural scenery, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature, and is aimed at both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a generous race pack.
course_highlights: The wild natural landscapes of the Elbląg Upland, with picturesque hills
Routes through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest nature reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites, including Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race pack includes a waterproof race bib with a chip, medical support, course marking, aid stations, drinks and snacks at the finish, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts are staggered from 5:00 (81 km) to 10:30 (14 km), with separate Garmin Junior races for children. The system applies discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The program also includes Garmin Junior races over 200 m, 500 m, and 1,000 m.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice, attracting runners looking for sporting excitement and fun. The event takes place on Rybacka Street and offers plenty of attractions for participants. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a short distance and experience the atmosphere of a local sports celebration.
course_highlights: A road race in central Chojnice on Rybacka Street
A short 5 km distance, ideal for runners of all levels
The atmosphere of a local sports celebration with numerous attractions
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. It offers plenty of attractions for participants and spectators. The start and finish are on Rybacka Street in Chojnice.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
location: Kosewo, Mrągowo County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach głównych: 150,00 zł wpłata jednorazowa za cały cykl biegowy

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start w biegach dziecięcych i młodzieżowych jest bezpłatny

description: The Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur is a series of races held in the picturesque towns of Masuria, promoting outdoor activity and a connection with nature. The event includes main races of approximately 6.6 km, as well as races for children and young people in different age categories. The main race route runs along asphalt roads, cobblestones, and forest roads, offering participants varied surfaces and beautiful views. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the organizers provide water and a hot meal after the race. The event has a family-friendly, inclusive atmosphere, with activities for children and a concert after the winners’ awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The main race route is approximately 6.6 km long and runs along asphalt roads, cobblestones, and forest roads
Children’s and youth races over distances from 100 m to 800 m in different age categories
Picturesque Masurian landscapes around Kosewo
additional: The participant limit across all distances at each race is 400; the Race Office opens 1.5 hours before the start; race packs can be collected and registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; every participant receives a commemorative medal; the organizers provide water and a hot meal prepared by local rural homemakers’ associations; after the awards ceremony, the band Folk Banda will perform.

name: Puchar Polski Nordic Walking - II etap
XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 31. Jooks-kõnd ümber Uhtjärve
description: The 31st Run-Walk Around Lake Uhtjärv is a traditional running and walking series in the Võru region, offering a range of distances for every participant. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Uhtjärv, providing a sporting challenge for both runners and walkers. The series includes various distances and mini-distances suitable for beginners and experienced athletes alike. The event is part of the Võru County running and walking series, known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.

name: Sõõrikujooks
description: The Sõõrikujooks is a running event held by Õismäe Pond in Tallinn, organized by Marathon100. Running enthusiasts are welcome to enjoy a pleasant run and a day together.
course_highlights: The start and event venue are by Õismäe Pond.

name: Jooks ümber Uhtjärve
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events, offering a range of distances for both adults and children. The main distances range from approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with some off-road sections. The series also includes mini-distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in sport and promotes healthy lifestyles and community involvement.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Lublin – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque UMCS Botanical Garden in Lublin, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The race is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series, known for its scenic courses and friendly atmosphere. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this special summer edition.

name: Grand Prix Biskupca #3
location: Stadion Miejski, ul. Wiosenna, Biskupiec, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

description: Grand Prix Biskupca is a series of four races held in Biskupiec: the South Run, approximately 5 km long; the Morning Run; the Walrus Run; and the Night Run. The races follow scenic routes around lakes, city parks, and recreational areas, with electronic timing. Gross times count toward the overall standings, and the South Run is an individual 5 km race. The organizers set a participant limit and offer registration both online and on race day. The event is open to amateur and professional runners, with a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: The South Run course is approximately 5 km long and loops around a retention reservoir and the City Park.
The Morning Run is approximately 5 km long and loops around Lake Kraksy Małe and allotment gardens.
The Night Run is approximately 8 km long and follows paths, cycling routes, and the City Park.
additional: The participant limit for each event is 200. Entry fees can be paid using fast online payment methods after registration. Bib numbers and timing chips are issued at the race office. Chips are reusable and must be returned after the race. Bib numbers must be pinned to the front, at chest or waist height. Race-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start and must be paid for in cash. The route runs on asphalt, paving stones, sand, and grass; distance markers are placed every 500 m.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event on a scenic course through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so every runner, regardless of experience, can find a suitable course. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the extraordinary atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive, social atmosphere.

name: Piątka Królowej Bony
organizer: Gmina Różan, Lekkoatletyczny Klub Sportowy Maków Mazowiecki
description: Piątka Królowej Bony is a 5 km race held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event is open to people over the age of 15; minors must provide written consent from a guardian. The start and finish are located at Szkolna 3. The event is organized by the Municipality of Różan and the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club, and participants can expect professional support and timekeeping.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: The Pärnu Annual Runs are a traditional running series that began in 1985 and are inspired by the Eastern calendar, dedicating each year to its corresponding symbolic animal. The 2026 series is themed around the Year of the Fire Horse and consists of nine stages held in three different areas of Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering participants a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series aims to provide a sporting challenge and enjoyment for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a competition for sports enthusiasts in Kohila Parish, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age and ability groups. The series aims to promote recreational exercise and provide participants with an enjoyable sporting experience. Participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal at each stage, and the series standings are based on points. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Centre, which provides modern facilities and a strong sporting environment.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Running Series is a running series competition organised by Tartu Spordiselts Kalev and held in the city of Tartu. The series has several stages, offering opportunities to take part in track races across different age groups. Competitions are held mainly at Tamme and Ülenurme Stadiums and are aimed at both young people and adults, providing a sporty and friendly competition environment. Registration closes at 12:00 on race day, offering flexibility for participants.

name: Mispo maastikumaraton
description: Mispo Trail Marathon is a trail race held in the Kurgja area of North Pärnumaa. The race distances are 42.195 km (marathon), 21.097 km (half marathon), 14 km and 7 km. The start is at the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum at 11:00, and the race office opens at 9:00. All finishers receive a drink, food, access to the sauna, a diploma and a medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by Terviseklubi Mispo, an active sports club since 1989.

name: Sakala metsajooks
description: The Sakala Forest Run is a trail race held in the Metsarada area in Kurgja municipality. The event offers several distances, including a marathon, half marathon, and shorter 7 km and 14 km runs. The race starts at 11:00 from the C. R. Jakobson Farm Museum, and participants are provided with a drink, food, sauna, certificate, and medal at the finish. The traditional event is organised by the Mispo Health Club and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere.

name: Jelgavas nakts pusmaratons

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pusmaratona stafete sastāv no 2 dalībniekiem. Cena ir 20x2 = 40 euro €17,50 - +

description: BTA Jelgava Night Half Marathon is a night half marathon organized by the Baltic Events Association in Jelgava. Participants can compete individually in the half marathon or as a two-person relay team. The event is a popular sporting occasion that brings together runners who want to test their abilities at night in an urban setting.

name: Bieg Powstania Warszawskiego
description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an evening race through the streets of Warsaw, bringing together thousands of participants each year to honour the memory of the Warsaw Uprising insurgents. The event offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometres, on new routes passing historic sites such as the Warsaw Citadel, the Museum of Polish History and the Polish Army Museum. It is a unique opportunity to combine a sporting challenge with a tribute to Polish history. The race takes place on the last Saturday in July, and participants can also take part in a virtual edition.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Warsaw Citadel, a site of great historical significance.
The race passes by the Museum of Polish History and the Polish Army Museum.
An evening race through the streets of Warsaw, with a unique atmosphere and a tribute to the insurgents.
additional: The 5 km race starts at 20:15; the 10 km race starts at 21:15. Race bibs must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. Participants line up in start zones according to their predicted finish time. A virtual edition of the race is also available over 5 and 10 km, running from 15 July to 15 August.

name: 24 Bieg Uliczny św. Jakuba
description: The 24th Energa St. James’s Run is an annual running event held in Lębork to celebrate the city’s patron saint. The certified 10 km course runs through the city streets, with appropriate safety measures provided by the services responsible for order. The ceremonial start takes place at Peace Square, and the official start is on Armii Krajowej Street. Participants must obey traffic regulations. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Runs through the streets of Lębork
Ceremonial start at Peace Square; official start on Armii Krajowej Street
additional: 7:00–9:00 at the Race Office in the gymnasium of the Special Educational Centre in Lębork, at Curie-Skłodowskiej Street. Participants under 18 from Lębork County are exempt from the entry fee upon presenting a valid student ID. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal. A contest for the best cheering zone will be held, with a prize of PLN 1,000.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – summer edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport in Wielkopolska and beyond since 2014. The event places particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of its courses, offering picturesque and attractive routes for runners. It’s a great opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and enjoy an active day in Gdynia.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on picturesque routes
Routes with scenic and natural appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts
additional: Botaniczna Piątka has organized races and sporting events since 2014.

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organised by enthusiasts of the Strzyżów Foothills region, combining a love of running with exploring nature. The routes pass through scenic areas with diverse natural features, including old-growth deciduous forests, coniferous forests, loess gorges and unique rock formations. The race offers exceptional experiences, including running through several-hundred-metre-long wartime railway shelters in Strzyżów and Stępina. It is the largest running event in the region and attracts trail running enthusiasts every year.
course_highlights: Routes through the Brzeżanka range, the Kiczora massif, Herby and Chełm Mountain
Passage through the shelter tunnels in Stępina and Strzyżów
Varied terrain: old-growth deciduous forests, coniferous forests, loess gorges and rock formations
additional: The event is organised by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which takes care of logistics and makes the refreshment stations appealing. New features are planned in the finish area. The race offers four distances, with both new and refreshed routes showcasing the region’s best locations.

name: Hel - Rysy
location: Hel, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Hornsjön Runt
description: Hornsjön Runt is a traditional running race around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied Öland nature. The race offers several distances for both young people and adults, including a walking category. Along the course, participants pass gravel roads with limestone surfaces, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: The course goes around Öland’s only inland lake
Varied terrain including gravel roads, grass, cow pastures, deciduous and coniferous forest, and sand dunes
Three water stations along the course, as well as at the start/finish
additional: A walking category is available for 5.5 km and 11 km, with start times between 13:00 and 16:00 and no timing. Shower and changing facilities are available at Högby Idrottsplats. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all categories. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön. Youth categories have different start times from 15:30 to 16:00, depending on age and distance. There are distances for children and young people, as well as a walking category without timing.

name: XXXV-asis tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas „Medininkai - Vilnius“
description: XXXV-asis tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas „Medininkai - Vilnius“ yra seniausias Lietuvoje tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas, skirtas pagerbti Medininkų pasienio poste prie memorialo žuvusius. Renginys vyksta liepos mėnesį, startuojant prie Medininkų memorialo. Estafetė susideda iš 7 etapų po 5 km asfaltuoto kelio, kur dalyviai bėga komandose. Tai išskirtinė proga dalyvauti istorinėje ir prasmingoje sporto šventėje, jungiančioje Medininkus ir Vilnių.
course_highlights: 7 × 5 km estafetė asfaltuotu keliu
Startas prie Medininkų memorialo
Trasa skirta pagerbti pasienio poste žuvusius
additional: Renginį organizuoja Policijos departamentas prie Vidaus reikalų ministerijos, Muitinės departamentas ir LBMA. Renginio rezultatai bus skelbiami oficialioje organizatorių svetainėje. Renginys vyksta asfaltuotu keliu, todėl rekomenduojama tinkama bėgimo avalynė. Renginys skirtas pagerbti Medininkų aukas, vyko Vilniuje, dalyvavo pareigūnai, trasa 34 km, 7 etapai, simbolinė lazdelė su žeme, medaliai ir vaišės finiše

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas yra unikalus bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu, vykstantis Smiltynėje, Klaipėdoje. Renginys vyksta per Jūros šventę ir suteikia dalyviams nepakartojamų įspūdžių bėgant tarp jūros ir kopų. Varžybos populiarina bėgimo kultūrą Lietuvoje ir skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų ir mėgautis nuostabia pajūrio gamta bei švelniu vėju.
course_highlights: Bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu
Startas paplūdimyje prie pietinio molo, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distancijos 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km ir 10 km su 2 valandų laiko limitu
additional: Visoms distancijoms skirtas 2 valandų laiko limitas. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą ir pritvirtintą numerį bei elektroninę laiko matavimo mikroschemą ant marškinėlių. Varžybų dalyviai bėga laisva valia ir prisiima visą su dalyvavimu susijusią riziką. Bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu, įvairios distancijos (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), registracija internetu, nuostatai ir taisyklės, apdovanojimai ir atminimo medaliai.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community run offers beautiful views of the sea and the Old Town, with three distances to choose from. Participants can run, walk, or cover the distance with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located in the same place on the beachfront, and the route follows a seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits high.

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail is a varied trail run in Southern Estonia, held around the Leigo Lakes. The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, and the event offers a choice of distances and difficulty levels, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes follow forest trails, clay and gravel roads, and natural paths along the lakeshore, with technical climbs and descents and beautiful views. The event brings together nature, exercise, and community, offering an enjoyable experience for the whole family.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa running and Nordic walking series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main course, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and diplomas awarded to the top finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
location: Dąbki, Gmina Darłowo, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Seaside Spa Run is an annual running event held in Dąbki, promoting running as a simple form of exercise and a healthy lifestyle. The 10 km race is part of a larger sporting event that also includes races for children and young people and the Spa Nautical Mile. The event is family-friendly and recreational, and also aims to promote the Dąbki Spa and the Darłowo Municipality. It is organized by the Darłowo Municipality Office and the Seaside Spa Run Association, with support from numerous partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: 10 km course
The race takes place in the seaside town of Dąbki
Side events include the Spa Nautical Mile and races for children
additional: The event also includes the Spa Nautical Mile, covering 1,852 m, and races for children and young people over distances from 150 m to 1,100 m. The event is family-friendly and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland
organizer: Botaniczna Piątka; współorganizatorem edycji letniej jest Ogrody Przelewice
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice, combining sporting competition with the beauty of nature. The organizers place particular emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the proposed routes, making the race attractive to nature lovers and those who enjoy active recreation. It’s a great opportunity to combine a passion for running with a unique green setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Dendrological Garden in Przelewice
Picturesque, aesthetically pleasing natural surroundings
A race amid unique plant life and greenery
additional: The event is organized by a group of running enthusiasts that has been active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races and paying close attention to the aesthetics of the locations. In summer 2026, Botaniczna Piątka celebrated its 10th anniversary. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, entry fees, or additional services. In the previous summer edition, participants received a commemorative medal.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race held in Chełm, in the Lublin Voivodeship. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a trail course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for race day. The event is open to all and is aimed at runners looking to improve their 10 km performance.
course_highlights: A 10 km trail course
Scenic areas of Chełm and its surroundings
Challenging terrain requiring good fitness
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Organizers can manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing.

location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

description: Runmaröloppen is a unique running event in the heart of the Stockholm archipelago, on the island of Runmarö. The races offer a friendly, welcoming atmosphere and scenic courses suited to children, seniors and experienced runners alike. The start and finish are at Svängens Krog, and the day includes running, food, ice cream, swimming and a great atmosphere. The half marathon course is approximately 21 km long and is considered one of Sweden’s most beautiful, while Lunken, at 5.7 km, passes through lush sheep pastures and archipelago villages. Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan are shorter races for children and seniors, and there is also a dog category where the dog receives an edible medal.
course_highlights: Half marathon: 21 km around the whole of Runmarö, with historic and scenic views
Lunken: 5.7 km through lush sheep pastures and authentic archipelago villages
Mini-Lunken and Antikrundan: 1.5 km for children and seniors
additional: Mini-Lunken starts at 11:00, and Lunken and the half marathon start at 13:00. There are refreshment stations and encouragement all around the island. After finishing, everyone receives a medal and a finisher drink; Mini and Senior Lunkare are treated to ice cream. There are a maximum of 200 places for the half marathon and 120 for Lunken in the first release, with a further 30 places released later. There is a dedicated taxi boat between Stavsnäs Vinterhamn and Styrsvik, as well as Vaxholm boat line #23. Race bibs can be collected at Svängen and Låttas Bageri. An evening dinner and party will be held at Svängen after the race. 20% of the surplus is donated to Skärgårdsstiftelsen. The event offers children’s races, a 5.7 km race and a 21 km half marathon. Participant numbers are limited. According to the existing event information, 20 percent of the surplus goes to Skärgårdsstiftelsen.

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olympic Start is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletics Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions take place in different age groups and cover a range of athletics events. The 10th stage will be held at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young athletes the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun and motivating competitive environment.

name: ATEA Kalmarmilen
description: ATEA Kalmarmilen is an established 10K race in Kalmar for both recreational and elite runners. The course runs through urban areas and past well-known places in Kalmar, starting at Teatervallen and finishing at Larmtorget. The event also includes Lilla ATEA Kalmarmilen for children in different age groups.
course_highlights: Starts at Teatervallen and finishes at Larmtorget
The course passes Kalmar Castle and the Old Town
The route also goes via the harbor, Fredrikskans, Lindö and Ängö
additional: Lilla ATEA Kalmarmilen offers races for children in different age groups. The race also has DM/VDM status for Östsvenska and is part of the I Run Kalmar race series.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 4. posms – Lucavsala
description: Izskrien Rīgu Stage 4 is part of a popular running series held in Riga’s parks and neighborhoods, designed for the whole family. This stage will take place on Lucavsala, giving participants the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful, green urban setting. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and for welcoming both professional and amateur runners. At the end of the event, the fastest runners and the season’s overall leaders are traditionally honored.
course_highlights: Run through Lucavsala Park and the surrounding area
Green, flat terrain suitable for runners of all levels
Friendly atmosphere and the chance for the whole family to compete
additional: A concert and party are traditionally held at the end of the event, adding to the sporting experience. Participants can check in until noon on race day. The series brings together around two thousand participants at each stage.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Vormsi maraton
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on both days, with the courses running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The courses are marked, and timing is provided using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can join a social gathering and enjoy a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners.

name: „Biržų kilometrų“ bėgimas
description: Bėgimas „Biržų kilometrai“ yra tradicinis renginys, vykstantis Biržų miesto šventės metu. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką, susitikti su bendraminčiais ir mėgautis bėgimu gražioje miesto aplinkoje. Renginys kviečia įvairaus amžiaus dalyvius ir skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą bei bendruomeniškumą.
course_highlights: Bėgama Biržų mieste.
Renginys vyksta miesto šventės metu.
Bėgimas įtrauktas į Lietuvos bėgimo taurės etapų programą.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle course race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and are dragged through mud, water, sand and over hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition where each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the outdoor gym. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase jooks is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Łodzi, Łódź, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka is a series of cross-country races organized since 2014 by a group of running enthusiasts. The events take place on scenic courses in Wielkopolska and other locations, with an emphasis on their aesthetic and natural qualities. The summer edition in Łódź is a special opportunity to celebrate the event’s 10th birthday, with participants receiving special medals featuring a daylily motif. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and beautiful courses.
course_highlights: Cross-country races on scenic courses
The aesthetic appeal of the locations
Special birthday medals featuring a daylily
additional: The summer edition celebrates Botaniczna Piątka’s 10th birthday with unique medals. The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country running and the visual appeal of the courses. Events take place at various locations, including Łódź.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994, as an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. It is a major sporting event of the summer on the coast, attracting over 1,200 runners and tens of thousands of spectators, and offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic center. The course is a 1,412-meter loop along the streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, and also offers a rich program of accompanying events, including concerts and shows.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m course in central Gdańsk, with the start and finish by Neptune’s Fountain
A loop along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie and other streets
Incredible support from over 25,000 spectators along the course
additional: The event includes four races under the shared slogan “Chase St. Dominic”: the Prologue, open to all St. Dominic’s Fair participants; the 5 km Women’s Run Lotto Cup; the 5 km Men’s Run Energa Cup; and the Men’s Elite Run, the Polish 10 km Championships. The event takes place as part of the Running Festival, with a rich program of accompanying activities, including partner booths, presentations and Fair concerts.

name: Arm Race Kamień
description: Arm Race Kamień is an extreme obstacle race held in the Ceków-Kolonia municipality. The course offers a sporting challenge for participants of varying experience levels, combining competition, technique, and the satisfaction of overcoming obstacles. The event is part of an OCR race series that attracts both competitors focused on results and people new to obstacle-course racing, as well as entire families. It is not just a race, but also an exciting experience and an opportunity to get active outdoors.
course_highlights: A 5 km or 10 km course with around 25 or 40 obstacles
A range of formats: PRO, OPEN, FUN, and family and youth formats
Extreme obstacles requiring endurance, technique, and intensity
additional: Choose a format suited to your experience level, including PRO for those competing for results and OPEN for those looking for a sporting challenge. Family and youth formats are also available. The 2027 season pass includes 3 race entries (5 km or 10 km, including PRO/ELITE) for 699 zł, with an ARM RACE technical cap as a gift.

name: Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba
location: Wronka, Giżycko County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Wronka near Giżycko. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on gravel roads, as well as shorter races for children. Participants can expect professional timekeeping, race packs with medals, and a post-race meal. The event is organized by the Wronka Rural Housewives’ Association in cooperation with the Giżycko Municipality, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km race route on a gravel road
10 km race route on a gravel road
Children’s and youth races over a distance of 0.5 km
additional: The race office is open from 8:00 to 11:30 on event day. Race packs can be collected, and registration and cash payment are available on race day, subject to a limit of 200 participants. Participants receive a medal at the finish and a voucher for a post-race meal. Timekeeping is done using chips, which must be returned at the finish. Children’s and youth races have no timekeeping or classification.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various places. The event combines sport and recreation and takes place on a 5-kilometer course through the municipality’s scenic areas. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring together the local community and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: A 5 km course
A road race through the Czastary municipality
Scenic landscapes and a welcoming atmosphere

location: Wielgomłyny, Radomsko County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a challenging and tactical running race where participants run a 6,706-metre course, with a start every hour on the hour. To continue in the race, runners must start each lap, in accordance with last-man-standing rules and Backyard Ultra standards. The course is easy to run and varied, with asphalt and gravel/trail sections. It is located on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö, with good opportunities to rest and access services in the lap area. Participants can enjoy a scenic setting close to a playground, skatepark, swimming area and café. After completing at least one lap, runners receive a medal and a finisher beer as a reward.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre course with approximately 35 metres of elevation gain
Each lap has approximately 3 km of asphalt, with the rest on gravel/trail
Starts every hour on the hour, with all participants starting together
additional: The lap area offers an energy table with sports drink, water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, starting after four hours. There is space to set up a reclining chair and a small tent. Recommended parking costs 10 kr/day and is located at ICA Kvantum Teleborg. Littering results in immediate disqualification. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen by ICA, served by route 3. Backyard Ultra format, with a start every hour on the hour and last-man-standing rules. A previous edition was described as a Silver Ticket event.

name: 5-as pusės maratono bėgimas „Jonavos tiltai“ 2026
description: 5-asis pusės maratono bėgimas „Jonavos tiltai“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys Jonavoje, vykstantis miesto gatvėse ir tiltuose. Renginys suburia bėgimo entuziastus įpusėjus vasarai, siūlydamas išbandyti savo ištvermę ir mėgautis miesto vaizdais. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką ir susipažinti su Jonavos bėgimo bendruomene.
course_highlights: Bėgimas miesto gatvėmis ir tiltais
Vaizdingas maršrutas per Jonavos tiltus
Vasaros sezono renginys Jonavoje

name: Vääna-Jõesuu jooks
description: The Vääna-Jõesuu Run is part of the Harku Municipality Running Series and takes place at the Vääna-Jõesuu School stadium. The event offers several distances, from children’s races to the 5 km main race, which runs counterclockwise along the streets of Vääna-Jõesuu and a forest trail. The series aims to motivate people to take part in sports and to promote the enjoyment of exercise and an active lifestyle. The event is organized by local running and triathlon clubs in cooperation with the municipality and village associations.

name: Kresowe Trail #9
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of eleven races held over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (17–21 km). The events take place in scenic locations, with respect for the environment and local communities. Participants can expect professional organization, electronic timing, and a generous race package. Kresowe Trail also features Nordic Walking competitions and brings runners together in a spirit of fair play and friendship.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Scenic areas of Podlasie and the Vilnius Region, with marked routes and aid stations
Limited participant numbers to ensure safety and high-quality organization
additional: Starts are divided into waves according to results from the previous season. The race package includes a hot recovery meal, electronic timing, a race bib with a chip valid for the entire season, medical support, aid stations along the route and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for those who register in advance), photography services, and prizes for the top competitors. Littering on the route is strictly prohibited. Online registration is available until 08:40 on race day, and on-site registration is available from 8:00. If you register fewer than 10 days before the race, your race package may be incomplete.

name: XI Bieg Wśród Krasnych Pól
description: The 11th Run Among the Krasnopol Fields is an annual running event held in the picturesque municipality of Krasnopol. The course is approximately 10 km long and follows forest roads exclusively, with gravel and grassy surfaces, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy pleasant running conditions. The race office is located at the Municipal Reading and Culture Centre, and the race starts in the afternoon. The event is open to different groups of runners, including Nordic Walking over a distance of 5 km. The organizers help ensure participants’ comfort by providing maps and guidance on parking and starting points.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km on forest roads only (gravel and grassy surfaces)
Start and finish in the municipality of Krasnopol
Picturesque natural surroundings ideal for running
additional: The race office is open from 13:00 to 15:00 at the Municipal Reading and Culture Centre, ul. 1 Maja 1. Parking is permitted throughout the town in designated areas. The course follows gravel and grassy forest roads. Available distances: 10 km run and 5 km Nordic Walking. The races are free, but responsible registration is required.

name: XXXIV Bieg Jezior
location: Stary Uścimów, Lubartów County, Lublin Voivodeship, Poland

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne is a trail race offering several distances, with the start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala, Hässleholm. The races follow beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves, with a focus on minimizing asphalt and traffic exposure for a more immersive and technical running experience. TGS 60 consists of two laps (35+25 km), while TGS 35 and TGS 25 correspond to the first and second laps of the 60 km race, respectively. TGS 10 is a shorter distance that follows approximately the final 10 km of the longer races. Runners of all levels are welcome to enjoy the forest and the challenges of trail running.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in the Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
Less than 3 km on asphalt and only one major road crossing
Technical, nature-focused course with varied terrain
additional: TGS 60 has a lap point at 35.1 km, with a cutoff time of 13:30. Aid stations with food, water, cola and sports drink are located at several points along the course. The maximum time limit for TGS 60 is 9 hours and 15 minutes. The finish closes at 17:00 for TGS 35 and TGS 25. TGS 10 starts at 13:45. All distances start and finish at Trädhuset in Hovdala. The race offers a technical, nature-focused experience with minimal asphalt and traffic exposure. The distances are approximately 10.2 km, 26.6 km, 35.1 km and 61.7 km. For the 2026 edition, free parking near the start and finish is listed, and a post-race meal is included in the entry fee.

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Gauja Trail by UTMB
distance_verbose: 91 km, 53 km, Pusmaratons, 13.5 km, 13 km, 12 km, 6 km, 1.6 km
description: Gauja Trail by UTMB offers a beautiful trail run through the Gauja Valley, combining forest trails, hills, and scenic riverbanks. The 100 km course starts at Sigulda New Castle and passes through Līgatne and Cēsis, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy the nature and scenery of Gauja National Park. Runners should take note of the mandatory equipment required to ensure safety in varying weather conditions. The event takes place in August 2027 and is part of the UTMB World Series.
course_highlights: Beautiful forest trails and hilly terrain in the Gauja Valley
The course includes the Sigulda bobsleigh track and the sandstone cliffs of Līgatne
Finish at Rožu Square in Cēsis
additional: Participants must bring the mandatory equipment required to ensure safety in varying weather conditions, including the possibility of spending the night outdoors on the course. In hot weather, organizers may require additional fluids, a hat, and sunglasses. Registration is personal and cannot be transferred to another person or to the following year. After finishing the 100 K and 50 K distances, participants are provided with a meal and baggage transport.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti
description: Jurbarke, Nemuno gatvėje. Varžybose kviečiami dalyvauti tiek vaikai, tiek jaunimas, tiek suaugusieji, siūlomos trys distancijos: 400 m, 3 km ir 12 km. Renginys prasideda 11 val., o visi finišavę dalyviai bus apdovanoti atminimo dovanomis, o geriausi sportininkai - taurėmis. Tai puiki proga aktyviai paminėti Nemuno metus ir bėgti kartu gražioje gamtos aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Trijų distancijų pasirinkimas: 400 m, 3 km ir 12 km
Varžybos vyksta Nemuno gatvėje, Jurbarke
12 km distancija susideda iš 4 ratų
additional: Dalyvių numerių išdavimas nuo 10:00 val. Amžiaus grupės pagal distancijas: 400 m - B12/M12 (2014 m. ir jaunesni), 3 km - B14/M14, B18/M18 (vyresni be konkurencijos), 12 km - vyrai ir moterys skirtingose amžiaus grupėse. Visi finišavę dalyviai apdovanojami atminimo dovanomis, geriausi - taurėmis. bėgimų distancijos: 400 m, 3 km, 12 km; amžiaus grupės; išankstinė registracija; renginio dieną registruotis nebus galima

name: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lietuva
description: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“ yra naktinis bėgimo renginys, skirtas visiems aktyvaus gyvenimo būdo mėgėjams - nuo šeimų ir pradedančiųjų iki patyrusių bėgikų. Renginys vyksta Šilutėje, su apšviesta naktine trasa, muzika, atmosfera ir įvairiomis pramogomis. Dalyviai gali rinktis 1 km šeimų, vaikų ir augintinių bėgimą arba 5 km ir 10 km distancijas. Renginio metu dalyvių lauks finišo medaliai, prizai greičiausiems ir skanus maistas.
course_highlights: Apšviesta naktinė trasa
Vieta: Kiškio dauba, Šilutė
Distancijos: 1 km, 5 km ir 10 km
additional: Renginio programa: 18:00 numerių atsiėmimas, 19:30 oficialus renginio atidarymas, 20:00 1 km šeimų, vaikų ir augintinių bėgimas, 21:30 5 km ir 10 km bėgimai. Dalyviams bus muzika, prizai greičiausiems, įvairios pramogos ir skanus maistas. Renginio programa apima įvairias distancijas ir pramogas, dalyviams suteikiami medaliai ir prizai.

name: Druskininkų naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Druskininkų naktinis bėgimas yra unikalus vasaros naktinis bėgimas Druskininkuose, kviečiantis dalyvius patirti bėgimo ritmą po žvaigždėmis. Renginys pasižymi spalvinga atmosfera, muzika, šviesos efektais ir vaizdinga trasa aplink Druskonį. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant bėgimą, estafetę ir riedučių važiavimą, todėl tai puiki pramoga šeimoms ir draugams. Bėgimas simbolizuoja draugystę tarp Lietuvos ir Lenkijos ir yra dalis sporto projektų, skatinančių bendruomenių bendradarbiavimą.
course_highlights: Vaizdinga trasa aplink Druskonį (1,2 km ratas)
Naktinis bėgimas su muzika, šviesos ir dūmų efektais
Galimybė dalyvauti bėgimo ir riedučių rungtyse
additional: Startiniai numeriai ir paketai išduodami renginio miestelyje nuo 20:00 iki 21:40 val. Apšilimas su Zumba instruktore. 21:25 val. - 1,2 km važiavimas riedučiais (nefiksuojant laiko). 21:40 val. - 1200 m bėgimas (laikas nefiksuojamas). 22:00 val. - 4 km ir 12 km važiavimas riedučiais. 22:30 val. - 4 km, 8 km, 16 km ir estafetės 2×4 km startai. Renginys yra „Bėk drauge su draugu Druskininkuose“ projekto dalis, finansuojama valstybės biudžeto lėšomis. Renginys finansuojamas Interreg Lietuvos - Lenkijos programos, dalyvių numerių išdavimas rugpjūčio 8 d., startas Druskininkuose, dalyvių skaičius keli šimtai, tarptautinis projektas.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 20. Tapa linnajooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of events for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in different locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners the chance to enjoy both city and trail running. The 20th Tapa City Run takes place near Tapa Gymnasium and is part of the series’ long-standing tradition of bringing together recreational athletes and running enthusiasts. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and provide enjoyable running experiences.

name: Paldiski liigub
description: Paldiski Moves is the third stage of the West-Harju Movement Series, held at Paldiski Sports Centre. The course passes Paldiski’s main attractions, streets and shared-use paths, offering participants beautiful natural views and a historic atmosphere. Free children’s races are organised for the younger members of the family, with an emphasis on the joy of movement and lifelong physical activity. The event takes place as part of Paldiski City Day, when the series’ top performers are awarded, and the evening ends with a concert.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
location: Śliwice, Tuchola County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique timed race held in Koszalin at Górka Piaskowa. Participants compete on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through hilly forest terrain with sandy sections. The race lasts exactly 1 hour, during which runners can complete as many laps as they wish; the winner is the runner who completes the most. At the finish, unique, very heavy medals await, along with a barbecue and bonfire, creating a friendly, sociable atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 1 km loop through challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied surface with sandy sections
Challenging uphill sections and numerous elevation changes
additional: Start and finish at Górka Piaskowa in Koszalin. Electronic chip timing. Participants receive a race bib and safety pins. Drinks and medical support from the Polish Red Cross in Koszalin are available at the finish. After the race, refreshments include grilled sausage, sweet rolls, and a bonfire. Participant limit: 100. Entry is open to participants aged 18 and over with a current medical examination or a declaration.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate both sporting competition and the beauty of their surroundings. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden
Picturesque green spaces and natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packs can be collected by an authorised representative. The organisers place particular emphasis on the scenic appeal of the proposed race locations. This summer marks the 10th anniversary of Botaniczna Piątka.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is a flat, easy-to-run marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course consists of a 2.1 km loop in Löttorp, followed by an 11.2 km loop run three times, for a total distance of 42,195 metres, entirely on asphalt. During the race, runners have views of Blå Jungfrun and pass three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water. All finishers receive a unique medal made of Öland limestone, and the women’s and men’s winners each win dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course
100% asphalt
Three aid stations per lap offering sports drink, cola and water
additional: Bib numbers can be collected from 12:00 on race day. Personal energy supplies must be handed in at least one hour before the start. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Prizes are awarded to all age-group winners and the top overall finishers.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-marathon/): 2027-08-07 — "Tid & datum 07 augusti 2027 Start kl 14:00" (was estimated 2027-08-07)

name: Kräftivalloppet
description: Kräftivalloppet is a family-friendly running event in Tidaholm and part of Kraftivalen. There are races for children, adults and seniors, with shorter courses adapted for the youngest participants and a dedicated walker and senior race. Warm-ups are held before the races in collaboration with Hälsocenter. Advance registration is required for the adult race, while the children’s and senior races do not require advance registration.
course_highlights: Children’s race for ages 7 and up: approximately 600 metres per lap, up to three laps
Walker and senior race: approximately 600 metres
Race for children from age 2: approximately 400 metres
additional: Register for the adult race via motionsloppet.se. The children’s and senior races do not require advance registration.

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026
location: Vikbolandet, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a recreational race held on Vikbolandet in Östergötland during the summer. The main event is approximately 45 km long and features a scenic route with both gravel and asphalt sections. Along the way, participants can enjoy local delicacies at several aid stations. The event offers running, cycling and duo categories, as well as a children's race in the forest on illuminated trails. It is a welcoming, nature-oriented experience focused on community and local flavours.
course_highlights: Approximately 45 km, with a 50/50 mix of gravel and asphalt
Aid stations with locally produced delicacies and the opportunity to visit production facilities and a shop
Children's race in the forest on illuminated trails, with a medal and ice cream afterwards
additional: Start times: Children's race 10:30, Running + duo 11:30, Cycling 12:30. The children's race is free and does not require advance registration. Helmets are mandatory for cycling. All participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup to use at the aid stations to avoid disposable cups. On-site registration may be available if places remain, up until 30 minutes before the start. Participants who register in advance receive a collapsible cup, which they should bring along during the race to reduce the use of disposable cups.

name: VI Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas
location: Kretingos Vasaros estrada, Maironio g. 15, Kretinga, Lietuva
description: Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas yra tradicinis bėgimas, vykstantis Kretingos Vasaros estradoje. Varžybos vyksta ratų principu, kur maratono dalyviai įveikia vieną 2,2 km ratą ir dvylika 3,3 km ratų. Renginys skirtas pagerbti ilgametį bėgiką Piotrą Silkiną ir pritraukia bėgimo entuziastus iš įvairių vietovių. Dalyviai gali mėgautis tiek sportine varžyba, tiek bendruomeniška atmosfera.
course_highlights: Maratono trasa sudaryta iš 1 rato - 2,2 km ir 12 ratų po 3,3 km
Varžybos vyksta Kretingos Vasaros estradoje
Ratų bėgimo formatas leidžia stebėti varžybas ir palaikyti dalyvius
additional: Renginio metu vyks įvairūs nuotoliai ir amžiaus grupės, skelbiami rezultatai, registracija vyksta internetu.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the beauty of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and nature experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Kielce.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized since 2014, with an emphasis on off-road running
additional: The organizer states that they have been organizing races since 2014.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 4 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai tradicinis bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos yra atviros visiems bėgikams, kurie gali varžytis skirtinguose etapuose ir amžiaus grupėse. Kiekviename etape dalyviai renka taškus bendros įskaitos turnyrui, o trasos driekiasi įvairiose Jonavos rajono vietovėse, suteikdamos įdomią ir įvairiapusę bėgimo patirtį. Registracija vykdoma internetu, o numerių atsiėmimas - varžybų dieną starto vietoje.
course_highlights: Etapai vyksta įvairiose Jonavos rajono vietovėse: Šilai - Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai - Bartoniai, Jonava
Starto laikas kiekviename etape - 19:30 val.
Numerių atsiėmimas varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje
additional: Varžybų dalyviai registruojasi į kiekvieną etapą atskirai. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Varžybų trasos gali kirstis su kelių eismu, todėl dalyviai privalo laikytis kelių eismo taisyklių. Registracijos terminai skirtingi kiekvienam etapui, numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną starto vietoje. Registracija vykdoma internetu, varžybos vyksta įvairiose Jonavos rajono vietose, skirstymas į amžiaus grupes.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 VI etapp 1000m
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage VI (1000 m), takes place at the Kohila Sports Centre stadium and is open to everyone interested in running. The series includes different distances and age groups, with participants earning points and winners determined by age group. The entry fee is €8, or €5 for young people and pensioners. Registration is primarily available in advance, and on-site registration is possible until 18:30. The series winners will be awarded after the final race. To place among the prize winners, participants must take part in at least four stages.

name: Filter Temposari (5. etapp)
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia’s oldest and most prestigious time-trial series, offering the chance to test yourself in cycling, running or roller skating. The stages take place at various locations in Tallinn and the surrounding area, featuring individual-start speed races. The races are short and intense, suitable for both recreational and advanced participants. The series also includes the Kullapada prize programme, which rewards consistent participation in every stage over the same distance.

name: 14. ETAPP / Järve terviserada
description: 14th STAGE / The Järve health trail is a 10-stage relay race around Lake Viljandi, held on varied terrain and a health trail with different surface types. Teams consist of 10 members, with an equal number of women and men, who take turns running the different stages. The start and finish are at Viljandi City Stadium, and runners are taken to the stages on buses provided by the organizers. The race is part of the tradition of the Suurjooks ümber Viljandi järve and offers a sporting experience for schools, companies, and sports clubs.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 5. etapp
location: Viljandi Lake Health and Ski Trail, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 5th stage of the Joosu Lake Run series is a running race organized by the Joosu sports club. It takes place on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful lake views and varied terrain. It is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to take part in a friendly and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views along the route
Varied terrain suitable for runners

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique pilgrimage run from Radom to Częstochowa, held as a relay over several days. The event combines recreational sport with a spiritual experience, promoting a healthy lifestyle and prayer for world peace. It is organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association, which engages the local running community and promotes physical activity in the region.
course_highlights: Pilgrimage route from Radom to Częstochowa
Relay run spread over several days
Spiritual program modeled on traditional walking pilgrimages
additional: The run is held with prayers for peace in Ukraine and around the world. The organizers provide a spiritual program during the run. Participants run in relays. In the past, they held organizational meetings and asked people to express their willingness to lend cars for the duration of the pilgrimage.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

price_tiers.distance: Dam, herr och motion (5 km och 10 km)
