description: Vetlanda Citylopp is a welcoming urban race for all ages and ability levels. The start and finish are on Storgatan in the heart of Vetlanda, and participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course. Younger participants can choose shorter distances from 400 metres up to 1.7 km. The event is a community celebration, with activities and food service in the square, where runners and spectators alike can enjoy a great day together.
course_highlights: Fast loop course in central Vetlanda
Start and finish on Storgatan in the heart of town
Spectator-friendly, with activities and food service in the square
additional: Race bib collection and on-the-day registration take place at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of each class. Timing is provided by a chip in the race bib, and results are published live and on the OK Njudung website. Changing rooms and showers are available at Hövdingen sports hall near the start/finish. Previous editions have included children’s and youth classes as well as a Funkis class. Race-day bib collection, on-the-day registration and activities have previously been held at Stortorget.

name: BAMM
description: BAMM supported by OMM is a two-day ultramarathon in an Arctic mountain environment, where participants compete in pairs using mountain navigation across vast areas of unmarked terrain. The event offers several classes with different levels of difficulty and distances, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced adventurers. During the competition, participants experience spectacular mountain scenery and challenging navigation, with an overnight stay in the mountains. BAMM is a unique opportunity to combine physical challenge with a nature experience in one of Sweden’s most scenic environments.
course_highlights: Mountain navigation across unmarked terrain
Two-day competition with an overnight stay in the mountains
Arctic mountain environment with vast areas to navigate
additional: Participants compete in pairs (men’s, women’s or mixed teams). Transfers are available from Kiruna Airport to Hotell Riksgränsen and back, with times adapted to flight departures. Riksgränsen railway station is close to the hotel. Accommodation, equipment rental, food and practical information are available via the organiser’s website. The competition is held in teams of two. Mandatory equipment is part of the preparations; for BAMM 30, tents and sleeping bags are transported to the shared overnight camp. OMM is the main sponsor.

name: VIII-asis Žolinių maratonas
description: VIII Žolinių maratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Vingio parke Vilniuje, skirtas švęsti Žolinių šventę sveikai, linksmai ir prasmingai. Renginyje gali dalyvauti tiek profesionalūs sportininkai, tiek pradedantieji, siūlantis įvairias distancijas nuo vaikų bėgimo iki pilno maratono. Kiekvienas dalyvis apdovanojamas metaline statulėle, simbolizuojančia žolinių augalą, o trasos ilgis yra 5,275 km ratas, kurį bėgikai įveikia pagal pasirinktą distanciją. Renginys skatina bendruomeniškumą ir aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.
course_highlights: Trasa sertifikuota LAF matuotojo Alfonso Kazlausko
Rato ilgis - 5,275 km, maratonui numatyti 8 ratai
Startas priešais Vingio parko estradą
additional: Dalyviai gali rinktis iš 6 distancijų: maratonas (42,2 km), 31,6 km, pusmaratonis (21,1 km), 10,6 km, 5,3 km (vienas ratas) ir 600 m vaikų bėgimas. Kiekvienas dalyvis apdovanojamas metaline statulėle, kurios dizainas kasmet keičiasi, simbolizuojant skirtingus žolinių augalus. Renginys švenčia tradicijas ir bendruomeniškumą, siūlo įvairias distancijas ir simbolinius apdovanojimus su žoliniais augalais.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 27. Viru-Nigula Rahvajooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 offers a varied series of running and walking events, bringing together fitness enthusiasts and recreational athletes from spring to autumn. The 27th Viru-Nigula People’s Run takes place on the Viru-Nigula running track and in the long-jump pit. It is part of a long-running series that encourages participation across different age groups and distances. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and offer participants the chance to test their abilities. The events are well organized, with chip timing, ensuring participants an enjoyable and motivating running experience.

name: Kuldīgas 22. pusmaratons
description: The Kuldīga Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Kuldīga Municipality, bringing together local and visiting runners. The race takes place amid the scenic surroundings of the town and its nearby area, offering a chance to enjoy both a sporting challenge and beautiful natural views. The event is organized by Kuldīga Municipality Sports School, ensuring professional race management and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.

name: Kazdangas pils maratons
description: The Kazdanga Trail Marathon is an annual trail running and Nordic walking event held at the Dzirnezers recreation area in Kazdanga. The event offers marathon and half-marathon distances for both runners and Nordic walkers, giving participants the chance to experience a scenic and challenging trail route. Starts are in the morning, allowing participants to enjoy the natural scenery and sporting atmosphere of South Kurzeme Municipality. The event is suitable for athletes of various levels and fans of active recreation.
course_highlights: 42.195 km marathon and 21.097 km half-marathon distances
The recreation area by Dzirnezers serves as the start and finish venue
A trail route around Kazdanga amid natural scenery
additional: The marathon starts at 08:00 for Nordic walkers and 09:00 for runners. The half-marathon starts at 10:00 for Nordic walkers and 11:00 for runners. Each distance has separate starts for runners and Nordic walkers.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon held in Sztum, Mazowieckie. Runners have access to a training plan tailored to their level, helping them prepare optimally for the race. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to runners of various experience levels. The event takes place annually, and in 2026 it will be held on August 15.
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. The race listing can be managed and marketing partnerships arranged through the TreningBiegacza.pl platform.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community in Wielkopolska and beyond.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the proposed locations
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a classic night race held on 14 August 2027, with an evening start. The race offers 10 km and 5 km distances, taking participants through the lively streets of Södermalm in a festive atmosphere filled with music, cheers and camaraderie. In addition to the main races, there is also a costume category and children’s races, making the event a festival for all ages. Midnattsloppet is known for its uniquely late start time and the special atmosphere created among runners, spectators and race staff.
course_highlights: The original course around Södermalm in Stockholm
An evening start with a unique night-race atmosphere
A festive atmosphere with music and cheers from spectators along the course
additional: Start times vary by race: the Mini Race (300 m) starts between 11:45 and 15:30, the 2 km children’s races start at 18:30 and 18:50, the 10 km starts at 21:10, the 5 km starts at 21:40, and the costume category starts at 22:00. Corporate races and team competitions are offered to strengthen camaraderie and workplace health. Midnattsloppet is organised by Midnattsloppet Nordic AB, a wholly owned company of Hammarby IF Friidrott, and the surplus goes back to the sports clubs.

name: 6 sjöar
description: 6 Lakes is a race through the beautiful forests just outside Uppsala. You’ll run mainly on small forest roads, with shorter sections of trail. All distances loop around at least one lake, while the full marathon takes you around 6 lakes. With the environment in mind, we provide free bus transport for runners from Uppsala Central Station to the start in Fjällnora, and back after the race. The race is also free of disposable cups; instead, every runner receives a reusable cup.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes, 5 and 10 km long, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging participants to enjoy the outdoors. It attracts runners of different ages and experience levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lilla Blodomloppet för barn upp till 12 år kostar 100 kr och kan anmälas till denna avgift ända fram tills dagen loppet går.

description: Blodomloppet in Jönköping is a recreational event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. There is also a children’s race, Lilla Blodomloppet, for children up to 12 years old, with shorter courses. The event is a social and health-promoting activity where teams and individual participants can take part, and each team receives a picnic bag as part of the entry fee. Blodomloppet is part of Sweden’s largest recreational race series, with a strong focus on health and the importance of blood donation.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km and 10 km runs
Untimed 5 km walk
Lilla Blodomloppet for children up to 12 years old, with 400/800 m courses
additional: Teams can consist of 3–5 participants, and vacant places can be filled at no extra cost until 5 August by email. Registered blood donors receive a 40 kr discount when registering. A picnic bag from ICA is included with team registration and can be ordered separately for 250 kr each. Wellness allowances can be used via Wellnet, Epassi or Benify. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old, with shorter 400/800-metre courses. The event raises awareness of the need for blood donation. Participants can form teams, and the event usually ends with a picnic.

name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: The Health Run and Walk is a multi-stage running and walking event held in various parts of Tallinn, including the Estonian Open Air Museum. Each stage offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature trails and the benefits of recreational sport. The Estonian Open Air Museum stage is 4.2 km long and is well suited to both runners and walkers who want to spend active time outdoors. The event is a tradition and is open to everyone interested in recreational sport.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Convinistafetten is Sweden’s largest relay race, held annually in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm. Each team consists of five participants, each running 5 kilometres, and there is also a walking category where the team walks together. The event is a fun, energetic evening that promotes team building and company camaraderie. After the race, all teams are treated to a picnic with food, drinks, fruit and coffee on the grass. Convinistafetten has a long tradition dating back to 1986 and attracts over 3,000 teams every year.
course_highlights: Each team runs five legs of 5 km each
Start and finish by the transition zone in Stora Skuggan
A picnic with food and drinks is included after the race
additional: Relay teams start in three different waves, with the first start at approximately 17:30. The walking category starts at approximately 17:40. The team captain receives all the race bibs by mail. The final runner collects the picnic box from the picnic tent. It is possible to book extra picnic boxes and private tent packages to enhance the experience. Title sponsor Convini treats teams to a picnic after they finish.

name: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd
description: The 10th Üts Ummamuudu City Night Run-Walk is a physical activity event in Võru, featuring running, Nordic walking, and walking. The event is part of the activities of the Physical Activity Competence Centre, which aims to promote an active lifestyle and health. Everyone is welcome to take part, improve their wellbeing, and enjoy being active at every stage of life. The beautiful nature of Võru County provides a pleasant setting for physical activity.

name: Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VII etapp /Käru järve jooks
description: The 8th Liikumissari Järvamaa Lakes Runs, Stage VII, or the Käru Lake Run, is part of the Järvamaa running series, which brings together running enthusiasts who value healthy lifestyles. The race takes place by Käru Lake and is an individual stage of the series, with different age groups taken into account. The series aims to encourage recreational exercise and offer the opportunity to take part in several races across Järvamaa. Prizes are awarded to the top runners at each stage, and at the end of the season the top three in each age group and the most active families are recognized.
course_highlights: The race takes place around Käru Lake
The series has different age groups, from young children to older participants
Results are published on the Järvamaa Sports Association website
additional: Points are awarded according to a points table, with rankings determined by points. The best 9 race scores count toward the series results. At the end of the season, prizes are drawn among everyone who took part in all the races.

name: Izskrien Rīgu 5. posms – Māras dīķis
description: Izskrien Rīgu is a running series for the whole family, held at five unique locations in Riga and offering unforgettable runs. The 5th stage will take place by Māras Pond, where participants will run on a scenic, flat course around the pond and through Māras Garden. The event is suitable for both active runners and beginners, offering various distances and the option to take part in a health run. At the end, the fastest runners and overall season winners are traditionally celebrated, followed by a concert and party.
course_highlights: Course around Māras Pond and through Māras Garden
Flat terrain, suitable for speed and enjoyment
The run takes place in a Riga park with beautiful natural scenery
additional: Bib collection starts at 18:00. Staggered starts for the children's distances take place at 18:30. Only bags with a special tag, provided at registration together with the race bib, may be left at the bag drop. Public transport is the recommended way to get there, as parking in the area is limited. The 5 km distance consists of 3 laps of a 1.52 km course.

name: XXXV-as tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos Kelias“
description: XXXV-asis tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos kelias“ vyks 2027 m. rugpjūčio 21 - 24 dienomis. Bėgimas simboliškai atkartoja 1989 m. Baltijos kelią, kai milijonai lietuvių, latvių ir estų susikibo rankomis, siekdami laisvės ir nepriklausomybės. Apie 650 kilometrų ilgio trasa veda nuo Vilniaus per Rygą iki Talino, o bėgikai keičiasi estafetės principu, įveikdami skirtingo ilgio atkarpas. Tai ne tik sporto renginys, bet ir gyva istorijos pamoka bei bendruomeniškumo šventė, suburianti dalyvius ir palaikytojus iš trijų Baltijos šalių.
course_highlights: Apie 650 km trasa nuo Vilniaus per Rygą iki Talino
Estafetinis bėgimas per tris Baltijos valstybes
Simbolinis istorinės Baltijos kelio gyvos grandinės atkartojimas
additional: Bėgimas trunka keturias dienas, per kurias bėgikai kasdien įveikia iki 200 kilometrų. Renginio atidarymas vyksta Vilniaus Arkikatedros aikštėje. Dalyviai keičiasi estafetės principu, o bėgimą lydi susitikimai su miestų ir bendruomenių žmonėmis. Renginys yra nacionalinės fizinio aktyvumo programos dalis. Renginys vyksta keturias dienas, su galimybėmis pasitikti ir palaikyti bėgikus pakeliui, ir yra skirtas Baltijos tautų vienybės paminėjimui.

name: Grand Prix Biskupca #4
location: Island on Lake Kraksy, Biskupiec, Poland

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Udział płatny przelewem - 20,00 zł. Decyduje kolejność zgłoszeń w ramach limitu 200 uczestników na imprezę.

description: The Biskupiec Grand Prix is a series of four races held in Biskupiec and the surrounding area, including on an island in Lake Kraksy. The fourth edition is a Night Run of approximately 8 km, following paths and cycling routes and passing through the Municipal Park. The event uses electronic timing and includes an overall classification based on all four races. Participants must wear their race numbers at chest or waist height, and the participant limit is 200. The event has a sporting and recreational character, attracting runners from the region.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km route on an island in Lake Kraksy
Night run along paths and cycling routes and through the Municipal Park
Electronic chip timing
additional: Registration and payment are available at the race office until 30 minutes before the start; the fee is 30 zł, payable in cash. Race numbers must be pinned to the front at chest or waist height. Timing is electronic, and chips must be returned at the finish. The midday race in the series is held as a four-person relay, but the Night Run is an individual event. The course surface includes asphalt, paving stones, sand, and grass; the route is marked every 500 m. The time limit is 60 minutes, and the participant limit is 200.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Nattloppet in Kalmar is a unique running experience, inviting you to walk, jog or run 5 km in a wonderful atmosphere with music, lighting and surprises along the course. The start and finish are at Stortorget, where runners also pass through on each lap. All participants receive a special medal and, if they register in advance, a unique T-shirt, as well as a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate. The race is open to both men and women, and there is also a walking class without timing. The event is organised by Högby IF with support from Hagbloms and other sponsors.
course_highlights: 5 km course with the start, lap point and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
Run at your own pace with music and lighting along the way
Special medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place at the Högby tent at Stortorget on Thursday 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and on Friday 21 August from 18:00. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Everyone registered by 16 August receives the Nattloppet’s unique T-shirt. Prizes are raffled, including gift cards from Kallskänken. Open to walkers, joggers and competitive runners. Everyone who finishes receives a medal; participants who register in advance also receive the race’s unique T-shirt.

name: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė
location: Vingio parkas, Vilnius, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilnius, Lietuva
description: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė yra bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniuje, Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione. Renginys skirtas Vilniaus ir kitų Lietuvos miestų bėgimo klubams, sporto klubams, šeimoms, vaikams, jaunimui, suaugusiesiems, senjorams ir žmonėms su negalia. Pagrindinė rungtis yra komandinė estafetė 5×1000 m, kurioje dalyvauja penki dalyviai, taip pat vyksta individualūs 1000 m bėgimai ir vaikų 60 m bėgimas. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą, bendruomeniškumą ir sveiką gyvenimo būdą Vilniuje.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
Pagrindinė rungtis - komandinė 5×1000 m estafetė
Taip pat vyksta 1000 m individualūs bėgimai ir vaikų 60 m bėgimas
additional: Varžybų programa: 12:00 vaikų 60 m bėgimas, 13:00 1000 m moterų bėgimas ir moterų su triračiais bėgimas, 13:15 1000 m vyrų bėgimas ir vyrų su triračiais bėgimas. Komandinės estafetės rungtys moterims, mišrios ir vyrams atšauktos. Organizatoriai pasilieka teisę koreguoti startų laikus. Renginys apima įvairius bėgimo renginius, įskaitant vaikų, suaugusiųjų ir žmonių su negalia bėgimus, vyksiantis 2027 m. rugpjūčio 28 d.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
description: Lüganuse Public Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place in Kiviõli Central Square. The event offers several distances, from a children’s race to a 9 km run, suitable for different age groups and skill levels. Participants can enjoy a friendly, community-focused atmosphere and compete in the team category. Registration is easy and the entry fee is affordable, making this a great event for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Maraton Wigry
location: Wigry National Park, Suwałki County, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held within Wigry National Park, around the picturesque Lake Wigry. The route follows narrow, winding forest trails, long boardwalks across marshes and gravel roads, with a short stretch of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views. It is a great opportunity to explore the Suwałki and Sejny regions during an enjoyable yet challenging marathon. The event is recreational in nature and is not focused on breaking records, making it ideal for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: The route lies entirely within Wigry National Park
Narrow, winding forest trails along the lakeshore
Long boardwalks across marshes and gravel roads
additional: The marathon route is approximately 42.2 km long, of which 82% consists of forest and unpaved roads and trails, and 18% of asphalt and sidewalks. The start is at the Monastery in Wigry, and the finish is at the Municipal Square in Stary Folwark. Transport for participants to the start, a technical briefing, race office services until 8:30, and a bonfire for participants and spectators after the race are planned.

name: XI Bieg Obrońców Płocka 1920r
description: The International Run of the Defenders of Płock 1920 is an annual running event organized by the Płock Biega No Age Limit Club. The race commemorates the defenders of the city of Płock in 1920 and traditionally takes place in the second half of August. The event attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition in an atmosphere of historical remembrance.

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultrarunning event in the scenic surroundings of Lill-Jansskogen in Stockholm, offering distances of 30, 50 and 100 miles. The race combines physical endurance with a sense of community in an intimate setting with a maximum of 100 participants. The course is an 11.8-kilometre loop with aid stations serving food and drinks at set times. Finishers cross the line both day and night, with generous time limits for each distance. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with good transport links and nearby facilities.
course_highlights: 11.8-kilometre loop in Lill-Jansskogen
Scenic surroundings with magical forest sections
Aid station serving food and drinks from Umara at set times
additional: Time limits are 32 hours for 100 miles, 16 hours for 50 miles and 9 hours for 30 miles. The 30-mile finish cutoff is 23:00 on Saturday, the 50-mile cutoff is 06:00, and the 100-mile cutoff is 17:00 on Sunday. The start and finish area has parking, toilets, tents, a restaurant, a 4-H farm and a café. Drinks are provided by Umara. Volunteer opportunities are available. The information states that the venue has parking and is close to the metro and buses.

name: Tough Viking
description: Tough Viking Kungl. Djurgården is a spectacular obstacle course race that takes you through Stockholm’s beautiful and historic surroundings. The course offers a varied mix of fast running sections, technical obstacles, strength challenges, and water elements. The race is spectator-friendly and suits both beginners and experienced OCR runners looking to combine speed, nature, and an authentic race atmosphere. The start and finish are located on Djurgårdsbrunnsvägen near the Maritime Museum, with a well-organized event area and services.
course_highlights: The course winds through the lush parks and historic landmarks of Royal Djurgården
Varied terrain with fast running sections and technical obstacles
Includes strength challenges and water elements
additional: Start times are selected during registration and sent by SMS before race day. Race bibs and timing chips are collected at the black Tough Viking tents by the Maritime Museum. The chip must be worn around the right ankle. A group warm-up is held 10 minutes before each start. Shoes with metal spikes are prohibited and will result in disqualification. Participants can compete individually or in teams (at least four people per team). Bag storage is available on site. The Open class has a minimum age of 12; participants under 18 need a guardian’s signature. There are four hydration stations along the course. Missing obstacles results in five penalty laps. Parking is limited, and public transport is recommended; changing tents are available, but there are no showers.

name: Rinkebyloppet 2026
location: Ursvikssidan av gångbron, Rinkeby, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Rinkebyloppet is an annual running race that starts on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge in Rinkeby, crosses the bridge and follows Rinkeby Allé to the finish at Rinkeby Square. The race is a welcome tradition that also marks the start of the popular Rinkeby Festival. This year, there is also a class for participants with disabilities who use wheelchairs, following the same course and reaching the same finish as the other runners. Rinkebyloppet welcomes all runners and is part of the active and inclusive Rinkeby Run collaboration.
course_highlights: Start on the Ursvik side of the pedestrian bridge
Run across the bridge and along Rinkeby Allé
Finish at Rinkeby Square, marking the start of the Rinkeby Festival
additional: A new wheelchair class for participants with disabilities follows the same course and has the same finish as the runners. A wheelchair class is offered on the same course, with the same finish as the runners.

name: Jūrmalas krāsu skrējiens
organizer: UAB GEE TEAM sadarbībā ar Baltijasmaratoni.lv
description: The Jūrmala Color Run is a joyful and positive 5 km run held in Kauguri Park in Jūrmala. The event aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle by inspiring participants to take part in sports activities. The run is suitable for all fitness levels and ages, and is part of the global The Color Run™ movement, which creates happiness through sport. Both adults and children take part, and it is known as one of the happiest 5 km runs in the world.
course_highlights: 5 km distance in Kauguri Park with color challenges
Suitable for all fitness levels and ages
Part of the global The Color Run™ movement
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the event venue from 10:30 until 30 minutes before the start of each distance. A limited number of THE COLOR RUN™ souvenir shirts and extra color packets are available at the event. The children's distance is approximately 500 meters. There is no timekeeping; participants can complete the distance at their own pace.

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: The Full Bowl Run is an annual running event held in Szubin since 2023. It is a charity run and continues an initiative supporting animal shelters. The event attracts runners who want to combine sport with helping animals in need. It is organized by the "Pod Egidą" Association and the local community.

name: Biegi wokół Bursztynowej Góry
description: The Runs Around Bursztynowa Góra are an annual running event held in picturesque Bąkowo as part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The races attract runners from various age categories, offering appealing routes and the unique atmosphere of Kashubia. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors amid beautiful nature and local culture. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.

name: XVI Festiwal Biegowy Dziki Weekend
description: The 16th Dziki Weekend Running Festival is an annual running event held in Police that has gained considerable popularity in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship since 2010. The festival offers a range of trail and cross-country races, including races for children and young people, as well as extreme obstacle races. The courses run through the natural landscapes of the Wkrzańska Forest, promoting an active lifestyle and sporting competition in a unique atmosphere. The organizers welcome both recreational and experienced runners to take part in this dynamic and challenging event.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes through the Wkrzańska Forest with natural obstacles
Children’s and youth races with different distances and obstacles
Extreme trail races with military-style obstacles at the training ground
additional: The start and finish of all races are at the sports clearing at ul. Piaskowa 99 in Police. Children’s races start on 22.08 from 10:35, with waves starting every 5–10 minutes. Extreme obstacle races take place on 23.08, with waves starting every 3–5 minutes. The race office is in the sports hall at SP8, ul. Piaskowa 99. The courses feature natural obstacles such as tires, mud, walls, water obstacles, and ropes.

name: Bolechowo na Sportowo
organizer: Centrum Rozwoju Kultury Fizycznej AKWEN w Czerwonaku
description: Bolechowo na Sportowo, or Active Czerwonak at Night, is a recurring, free sporting event organized by the Czerwonak Physical Culture Development Centre. The event takes place in the evening and combines physical activity with bringing the local community together. It is a long-standing tradition that attracts participants who want to spend time outdoors, running or walking in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km distance confirmed for the 2026 edition
Evening event format in Bolechowo
Part of the Active Czerwonak at Night series
additional: The event is free and takes place in the evening, usually from 19:30 to 22:00. It is a recreational sporting event and part of the Czerwonak Grand Prix series. No information is available about participant limits, fees or required equipment. Previous editions took place in the evening; 82 participants took part in 2026.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
price_range: 350–450 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100–150 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr) kallat ”Efteranmälan”

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr Lilla Blodomloppet Anmälan från 7/8 – 150 kr

description: Blodomloppet in Västerås is a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, who can take part in different distances. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 1–12, with two shorter distances. The start and finish are at the Rocklunda area, with clearly marked courses and several marshals along the way. After the race, all participants receive a medal and a finish-line goody bag, and team participants are invited to a group picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area, on the football pitches north of the riding arena
The courses are marked with Blodomloppet course tape, with flag marshals at strategic locations
Lilla Blodomloppet for children features two distances of approximately 1,400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race offers a warm-up in front of the stage at approximately 17:00. Lilla Blodomloppet has two start times: approximately 17:15 for 1,400 m and approximately 17:25 for 500 m. Teams can consist of 3–5 participants and include a picnic for 5 people. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out, and there are water stations along the course. Registration is binding and cancellations are not accepted. Teams consist of 3–5 participants. The team fee covers five people and includes a picnic.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/vasteras/): 2027-08-25 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 25 augusti 2027" (was estimated 2027-08-25)

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis anmälan för alla barn och ungdomar.

description: NKPG City Norrköping City Race is a fast-paced and popular running race held in central Norrköping, starting and finishing on Olai Kyrkogata. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The course passes through classic surroundings, with packed spectator areas and more than ten music stations creating a fantastic atmosphere. The race welcomes both elite runners and recreational runners in a festive atmosphere, with great prizes and a large crowd. There is also a free 1 km children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet, with a medal and goodie bag for every participant.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata in central Norrköping
The course passes through classic Norrköping surroundings, with packed spectator areas
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
additional: Lilla Lundbergsloppet starts at 17:00 with four starts and is free for children. The children’s warm-up, led by Friskis & Svettis, begins at 16:40. The 10 km race starts at 18:30 and the 5 km race at 19:30, with a warm-up 15 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be collected at XXL Ingelsta on Wednesday 26 August from 11:00 to 18:00, or on race day from 15:00 at the start and finish area. There are veteran, junior and youth categories, as well as team competitions for women, men and mixed teams. Water stations are located at 2 km and 7 km (Nodra), and at 3.5 km and 8.5 km (ICA Strömmen). After finishing, participants are offered freshly drilled water from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is chip-based, and results are published immediately after the finish. The ARQLY Sprint is a race within the race over the final 85 metres, with sprint prizes. 5 km and 10 km.

name: Naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Naktinis bėgimas 2026 kviečia pajusti nakties ritmą ir pasinerti į vasaros pabaigos šurmulį Kaune. Tai unikali galimybė atsipalaiduoti nuo kasdienybės ir užbaigti vasarą energingu bėgimu su muzika, šviesų jūra ir įkvėptų bėgikų kompanija. Renginys vyksta Rotušės aikštėje ir Santakos parke, siūlant įspūdingus vaizdus ir nepamirštamą naktinį nuotykį. Dalyviai varžosi 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km distancijose, o renginys skirtas tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams.
course_highlights: Trasa Rotušės aikštėje ir Santakos parke
Naktinis bėgimas su muzika ir šviesų jūra
Varžybos 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km distancijose
additional: Dalyviai privalo prisitvirtinti numerį su laiko matavimo mikroschema ant marškinėlių priekio. Varžybų dalyvių laikas gali būti neužfiksuotas, jei trasos neįveikia per nustatytą laiko limitą. Griežtai draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones trasoje. Renginys vyks Kaune, trasa apima naktinį bėgimą su šviesomis, muzika ir nuotaikinga atmosfera. Registracija ir detalesnė informacija yra oficialioje svetainėje.

name: Telliskivi 5000
organizer: Buns Run Club ja Telliskivi Loomelinnak
description: Telliskivi 5000 is a 5-kilometre run held in Tallinn’s Telliskivi Creative City and its surroundings. The course is flat and fast, passing through different areas of North Tallinn and offering runners both an athletic challenge and entertainment along the route. The event brings sport and culture together, with a varied programme before and after the run, and ends with a fun finish-line party. All finishers receive a specially designed medal inspired by the identity of Telliskivi 5000.
course_highlights: A flat and fast 5 km course through areas of North Tallinn
The route passes through the Krulli Quarter, Telliskivi Creative City and smaller streets
A varied selection of entertainment along the route, from DJs to musicians and choirs
additional: All participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. There are several cheering points along the route in collaboration with Red Bull, Bolt and Nike. After the run, enjoy a cold drink at the finish and a lively programme in the Creative City and at several local bars. You can also take part in DIY activities, such as making jewellery or printing a race T-shirt. A photo booth captures runners’ reactions. Participation is for ages 18 and over. Runners have up to 60 minutes to complete the distance, and walking is allowed. There are no water stations or toilets on the route; these are available in the finish area. Bag storage is in the premises of Von Krahl Theatre and is unattended.

name: Šiaurės Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimas – 2026
location: Pakruojo miesto parkas, Pakruojo rajonas, Lietuva
price_range: 0, nemokama; 2,5 km – 3-6 EUR; 5 km – 5-10 EUR; pusės maratono – 10-20 EUR
description: Šiaurės Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimas - 2026 vyks Pakruojo rajono teritorijoje, šiaurinėje Lietuvos dalyje. Renginys skirtas populiarinti bėgimo kultūrą ir skatinti gyventojų aktyvumą, siūlant vaizdingas trasas turistų mėgiamose vietovėse. Varžybų startas ir finišas bus Pakruojo miesto parke, o dalyviai galės mėgautis ne tik sportu, bet ir pažinti šiaurinės Lietuvos gamtą bei kultūrą. Renginys sujungia įvairaus amžiaus ir socialinių grupių žmones aktyviai ir sveikai leisti laiką.
course_highlights: Vaizdingos trasos turistų mėgiamose vietovėse
Startas ir finišas Pakruojo miesto parke
Šiaurinės Lietuvos dalies pažinimas bėgimo metu
additional: Numerių išdavimas vykdomas nuo 8:00 iki 10:00 val. Pusės maratono startas 11:00 val., kitų distancijų startas 10:00 val. Varžybų dieną registracija nevyks. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio metu padarytos nuotraukos ir filmuotą medžiaga gali būti naudojama rinkodaros tikslais. Renginys apima skirtingas distancijas ir kategorijas, registracija vyksta internetu iki rugpjūčio pabaigos, renginio data - 2027 m. rugsėjo 4 d.

name: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis `26
organizer: TK Temple Kauno pusmaratonis TS Temple social club
description: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis '26 yra karščiausia vasaros bėgimo šventė Kaune, vykstanti rugpjūčio 29 dieną. Renginys siūlo keturias distancijas: pusmaratonį (21,089 km), 10 km, 5 km ir 400 m vaikų bėgimą. Tai ne tik varžybos, bet ir visa patirtis, kupina jaudulio, adrenalino ir bendruomeniškumo, kviečianti tiek siekiančius asmeninių rekordų, tiek norinčius pasimėgauti bėgimo šventės atmosfera. Šis renginys nuspalvina miestą dalyvių šypsenomis ir kviečia tapti istorijos dalimi.

name: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks
description: The 22nd Ülemiste Forest Run is an environmentally friendly 3 km trail run held around the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant. The event centre, start and finish are at Järvevana tee 3. The run starts at 11:50. Participants are provided with a marked course, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire route. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and offers an enjoyable sporting experience.

name: Sillamäe ultra 2026: Eesti meistrivõistlused 100 km jooksus
description: This is a traditional ultramarathon where participants run a road race distance, competing for the Estonian championship title. The race challenges both local and international ultrarunners, who appreciate the course’s variety and the event’s organization. Sillamäe Ultra is known for its organization and strong participant community.

name: Tallinna Vee 54. jooks ümber Ülemiste järve
description: The 54th Tallinna Vesi Run Around Lake Ülemiste is a traditional running race. The Run Around Lake Ülemiste is part of the Maru Lake Runs series, and this year’s race is the series’ final, fourth event. The marked course is 13.7 km long and starts and finishes at the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant at Järvevana tee 3. The race centre opens early in the morning, and race materials can be collected on site. Participants are provided with chip timing; the chip is attached to the back of the race number.

name: Taurlandia Taurkalnē

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dalības maksa 15 EUR. Pieteikšanās no 17.08.2027, kad noslēgusies 50K pieteikšanās

description: Taurlandia is an ultrarun in the Taurkalne area, offering a scenic 50 km distance along a trail steeped in legend. The race is part of the events organized by SK Mitauer, which promotes running and an active lifestyle in Latvia. Participants receive a healthy meal after the finish, aid stations along the course, and commemorative medals. The course is registered with the ITRA system, providing points and a ranking for finishers. Spectators can support runners at designated checkpoints, in accordance with the race rules.
course_highlights: A 50 km ultradistance through the beautiful natural surroundings of Taurkalne
Course registered with the ITRA system, with points and a ranking
Aid stations and four checkpoints where runners can receive support
additional: Participants receive a sweatband, a healthy post-finish meal (soup and cake), and aid stations along the sections between all four checkpoints. Spectators can support runners at checkpoints KP1, KP2, and KP4 with sports nutrition and encouragement, while equipment changes are allowed only at KP3. The course is partly accessible by car, and spectators have designated support rights along the course.

name: Półmaraton Roztoczański im. Czesławy Kwoki , Nielisz - Zamość
description: The Czesława Kwoka Roztocze Half Marathon is a half-marathon-distance race from Nielisz to Zamość. It is the final stage of the Four-Stage Peace Run in Memory of the Children of the Zamość Region. Join us for a race that combines sporting competition with commemorating the children of the Zamość Region.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course runs from Nielisz to Zamość.
The race is the final stage of the Four-Stage Peace Run in Memory of the Children of the Zamość Region.

name: UKIEL Susnet Run Olsztyn
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Olsztynie
description: Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, running through the center of Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel beach. The course is certified by the PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone awaits with music and lighting. It’s a great opportunity to combine sporting competition with the atmosphere of a city event.

name: 11 Łańcucka Piątka
description: The Łańcucka Piątka is an annual 5 km race held in Łańcut, combining sporting competition with charitable giving. The course passes through the town’s scenic areas, offering participants attractive views and a friendly atmosphere. The event draws runners of different ages and abilities, promoting physical activity and community spirit.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in central Łańcut
Scenic views and a welcoming urban setting
Held as part of the Łańcucki Bieg Dobroci
additional: The event also includes the Mini Łańcucka Piątka for children. Organizers provide race packs and prizes, and the event supports local charitable initiatives.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality and returns to Straszyn after a one-year break. It is organized by the Sports and Recreation Centre of the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality, which promotes sport and recreation among local residents. The event is an important sporting occasion in the region.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Dycha nad Wisłą is an annual road race held in Tczew and forms part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The race attracts runners from various regions and offers a scenic route along the Vistula. The event combines sport and recreation, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.

name: XVI Bałtycki Maraton Brzegiem Morza
description: The 16th Baltic Seaside Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both of which follow the coast, offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.

name: XXIX Bieg Miodobrania Kurpiowskiego
location: Kurpiowska Kraina nad Zalewem Wykrot, Wykrot, Poland
description: The 29th Kurpie Honey Harvest Run is an annual 10 km race on a certified course, running from Myszyniec to Kurpiowska Kraina by the Wykrot Reservoir. The event is held and organized by the Myszyniec Municipal Athletics Club. The program also includes shorter accompanying races for children and young people. The start and finish are located at Kurpiowska Kraina, and participants can expect professional timekeeping and an awards ceremony for the winners. The race has a family-friendly, regional character, promoting physical activity and local Kurpie culture.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km course
Starts in Myszyniec and finishes at Kurpiowska Kraina by the Wykrot Reservoir
Accompanying races for children and young people over distances from 200 to 1,200 m
additional: The race office and finish are at Kurpiowska Kraina, 1 Miodobrania Street, Wydmusy. The race starts in Myszyniec, and participants are transported by coach from the car park next to Karczma Kurpiowska. The timing chip is issued at the race office and must be returned after the race. The children’s accompanying races take place in the car park next to Karczma Kurpiowska. Competitors from the Myszyniec municipality and those in the 65–69, 70–74, and 75+ age categories receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when paying by traditional bank transfer. The children’s races cover distances of 200, 400, 800, and 1,200 m.

name: Piąteczka dla każdego
location: Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place on 29 August 2026, with beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned to reduce the total elevation gain while retaining a varied profile with sections through nature, crowd support and several power zones; the marathon course finishes with a spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge. The race attracts international participants and also features shorter races and a MINI children’s race, as well as offers for businesses and tent packages in the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Spectacular finish line right in the middle of Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern and through Jönköping and Huskvarna, on a redesigned course with less elevation gain
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 aid stations along the course plus 1 in the start/finish area, an interactive map and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: up to five runners can be registered at a time; race bibs are not sent out. The marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and 12+1 aid stations. The organizer offers tent packages for businesses in the start/finish area and the option to use a wellness allowance. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes a team relay and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and aid stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a business village with tents in the start/finish area.

name: Stockholm Trail
description: Stockholm Trail is a trail race organised by OK Södertörn, offering a unique running experience in the beautiful Nackareservatet, just outside Stockholm City. The races follow winding forest trails and cross sunlit rock slabs, with courses suited to both beginners and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Hammarbyhöjdens IP, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with encouraging marshals and personal service. All proceeds from the race go directly to OK Södertörn’s activities.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely through nature, along technical forest trails and over beautiful rock slabs
Fantastic views and unique natural areas in Nackareservatet
Clearly marked courses with encouraging marshals along the way
additional: There are six different courses: 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K fun run (untimed), 2.5K kids, and Mini Trail for the very youngest participants. All participants receive a race bib with their name and a unique medal after completing the race. Showers and changing facilities are available at the venue. The course requires shoes with good grip and careful attention to roots and rocks. The 21K has a generous time limit to suit all runners.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholmtrail.se/tack-for-i-ar-2026/): 2027-08-28 — "Nästa år är förresten planerat till lördagen den 28 augusti för er som vill boka in er redan nu." (was estimated 2027-08-21)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Nästa år är förresten planerat till lördagen den 28 augusti för er som vill boka in er redan nu.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
description: Stockholm Half Marathon is a popular 21,098-metre half marathon that runs through central Stockholm. The start and finish are located at Strömbron and Norrbron, in the heart of the city’s historic centre near the Royal Palace, the Parliament House and the Opera House. The course is easy to run and inspiring, taking runners past several of the city’s best-known buildings and neighbourhoods, including Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The first start is provisionally scheduled for 15:30. After finishing, runners can enjoy an after-run event in Kungsträdgården.
course_highlights: An easy-to-run course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Start and finish by the Royal Palace, the Parliament House and the Opera House
Passes several of Stockholm’s best-known buildings and historic sites
additional: Registration is binding and personal. Participants must be at least 17 years old (born in 2010 or earlier). Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish or invoice through Klarna. An after-run event is offered in Kungsträdgården after the race. After finishing, runners can enjoy an after-run event in Kungsträdgården. The official app offers live tracking, real-time results, maps and event information.

name: Trelleborgsloppet
description: Trelleborgsloppet is a well-known city race in Sweden’s southernmost city, Trelleborg, with a measured course offering both 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walk or Nordic walk. The race starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken, providing a lovely, spectator-friendly setting. Trelleborgsloppet is a festival for everyone, with both elite runners and recreational runners taking part, and participants can enter team competitions and prize draws for an extra chance to win. The event is marked by a sense of community and fun, with a focus on making the race enjoyable for all participants.
course_highlights: Measured city course with gun time
Starts at Östervångsstadion and finishes in Stadsparken
Course through an urban setting, with cultural landmarks and parks along the way
additional: Race bibs must be collected at Östervångsstadion no later than 45 minutes before the start, or the day before in the lobby of Söderslättshallen. Changing facilities are available at Söderslättshallen, with clothing transport to the finish. Timing uses a disposable chip (Neptron), and gun time is used. Late registration is available online until 45 minutes before the start and on site for an additional fee. A team competition is available, with extra prizes for groups of at least 8 participants. There is also a 5 km distance for walking and Nordic walking. Participants can compete individually or as part of a team.

name: Festivalloppet

late_fee.price: ordinarie anmälningsavgift + 60 kr för alla över 16 år

description: Festivalloppet is an annual running race organized in Strömsnäsbruk by SK Graal. The race offers an enjoyable competition setting for runners of different ages and ability levels, with the option to register late on race day. SK Graal is an active club that also offers training and membership benefits, such as discounts on running shoes. Festivalloppet is part of the club’s wide range of events and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The course runs along the River Lagan in Strömsnäsbruk.
Previous editions have offered distances of 10 km and 4.8 km.
Children’s and youth categories have been included in previous editions.
additional: Late registration is available on race day until one hour before each start. Payment can be made in cash or by Swish. There is no late registration fee for the youngest children, youth, or the walking class. Clubs registering more than 5 participants can email a registration list and will be invoiced afterward.

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytaus pusmaratonis 2026 kviečia visus bėgimo entuziastus į ypatingą vasaros finišą Alytuje. Renginys prasideda ir baigiasi Alytaus rotušės aikštėje, o trasa veda per gražiausias miesto vietas - žaliuojančius parkus, jaukias gatves ir Nemuno pakrantes. Dalyviai patirs bendrystę, judesį ir emocijas, o finiše jų lauks šventinė atmosfera ir palaikymas. Tai puiki proga pažinti Alytų ir išsinešti nepamirštamas emocijas tiek siekiant geriausio rezultato, tiek tiesiog praleidžiant prasmingą dieną.
course_highlights: Trasa veda per žaliuojančius parkus
Jaukios miesto gatvės
Įkvepiančios Nemuno pakrantės
additional: various race distances, registration required, medals for all participants, awards for top finishers

name: Sony Center Maardu City Run 2026
location: Maardu Vaba Aja Keskus, Maardu, Estonia
description: Sony Center Maardu City Run 2026 is a sporting event in Maardu that brings together running enthusiasts of different ages and ability levels. The race takes place around the Maardu Leisure Centre and offers a chance to enjoy urban scenery and stay active with friends and family. The event is organised by Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia in cooperation with other partners, offering an enjoyable and motivating running experience.
course_highlights: A run around the Maardu Leisure Centre
Urban scenery and cycle and pedestrian paths
A varied course suitable for different ability levels
additional: The registration view names the Maardu Leisure Centre as the event venue.

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: The 9th Kristiine Community Run takes place at the Löwenruh Park playground in Tallinn. It is a family event featuring children’s races for participants up to 10 years old, in addition to the main 5 km distance. The event centre, start and finish are located next to Löwenruh Park, providing a pleasant and safe setting for running enthusiasts. The event aims to promote running as an accessible form of exercise and offer a sporting experience for different age groups.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY is an extreme winter half marathon and quarter marathon held in the picturesque terrain of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The Cold Half is a challenging half marathon with Jurassic climbs and forest trails, a true test of character for runners. The Chilly Quarter is a shorter distance for runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts, offering a technical course and a unique winter-adventure atmosphere. The event takes place in December weather, further highlighting its distinctive character.
course_highlights: Jurassic climbs and forest trails
A technical course with picturesque scenery
Winter weather and challenging terrain
additional: Starts: Cold Half (21 km) at 10:30, Chilly Quarter (11 km) at 10:40, and the 11 km Nordic Walking event at 10:45. The finish closes at 13:05; results are announced and awards presented at 13:10. Partners and sponsors include Gmina Łazy, the Sports and Recreation Centre in Łazy, Under Armour, and Decathlon. GPX course files are available. Race office and phone contact: +48 664 715 931.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon and 10 km race is an annual sporting event held in Szczecin, combining competition with the chance to discover the city’s most beautiful sights. The course runs through central Szczecin, including Wały Chrobrego and Wojska Polskiego Avenue, offering participants exceptional views and comfortable running conditions. The start and finish are located at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square. Runners can choose their distance during the race: 10 km or a half marathon on a single PZLA-certified loop.
course_highlights: The course runs through central Szczecin and Wały Chrobrego
The route includes Wojska Polskiego Avenue, Szczecin’s longest street
Start and finish at John Paul II Jasne Błonia Square
additional: Runners can choose their distance (10 km or half marathon) during the race at the distance selection point, approximately 9.6 km into the course. The course is marked every 1 km. Time is recorded electronically using chips in the race bibs. Two race pack options are available: basic and extended, the latter including a Ventus technical shirt.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held on the shores of historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim and a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań. The run finishes at Enea Stadium, where a special sporting atmosphere awaits, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium. This exceptional event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run finishing at Enea Stadium, with the finish line on the pitch at Lech Poznań Stadium
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The finish line and race village are located at Enea Stadium and the Poznań International Fair. The race offers qualification slots for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. Participants must be at least 18 years old on race day.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is an intimate series of trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in natural surroundings. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The event is open to runners of all ages, offering a variety of distances and formats, and bringing the running community together through a spirit of passion, competition, and friendship. The organizers prioritize safety, high-quality event organization, and an environmentally friendly approach.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the scenic regions of Podlasie and the Lublin area
Carefully marked trails with refreshment stations on longer distances
A time limit of around 2 hours for the main distances, with electronic timing
additional: The race package includes a hot recovery meal with a vegetarian option, electronic timing, a free race bib with a chip valid for the entire season, medical support, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, a commemorative medal (for early registration), photography, and awards in age-group and open categories. Registration is also available on race day until 08:40. Littering on the course is strictly prohibited.

name: Półmaraton Buski
description: The half-marathon course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums, the scenic Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit for completing the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes, allowing both experienced runners and amateurs to finish at a comfortable pace. It’s a great opportunity to test your abilities and join the sporting celebration in Busko-Zdrój.
course_highlights: The course passes prominent hotels and sanatoriums in Busko-Zdrój
Run through the scenic Spa Park and charming promenades
Time limit of 3 hours and 30 minutes for the 21.0975 km distance
additional: Mass start from the Municipal Stadium. The course is available to download in GPX format for Suunto and Garmin devices. The 3-hour-and-30-minute time limit runs from the start to the finish.

name: Spring för kulturen
description: Spring for Culture is a cultural run through central Stockholm, bringing together artists, cultural workers and everyone interested to highlight the value of culture. The event is non-competitive and open to all; participants can run, walk, roll or dance along the route. It starts at Hakberget on Gärdet and finishes at the Swedish Parliament, covering approximately 3 km and passing central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made. During the run, the streets fill with music, dance, circus and other forms of cultural expression, creating a lively movement to make culture’s importance in everyday life visible.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km from Hakberget, Gärdet, to the Swedish Parliament
Passes central cultural institutions and places where decisions are made
The streets fill with music, dance, circus and other forms of cultural expression
additional: The start is by the Protest sculpture at Hakberget, Gärdet. The event is politically independent and aims to build a sense of community and highlight the value of culture in society. Information for 2026 states that the event starts on Gärdet and finishes at Gustav Adolfs torg.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: STAGE 17 / The Paljassaare Peninsula is part of the Stamina Health Run series and takes place on 2 September 2026 in the Paljassaare Beach car park in Tallinn. The race distance is 6.5 km, and the course winds through the scenic landscape of the Paljassaare Peninsula, offering participants an enjoyable challenge and the chance to enjoy nature. The event is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to take part in a sporting event focused on health and fitness. Stamina is the organizer and ensures a smooth, enjoyable race experience.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: IFK Växjö Friidrott och Blodcentralerna i Kronoberg
price_range: 350–400 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (uppgifter kan uppdateras inför 2027)
description: Blodomloppet in Växjö is a recreational event that raises awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The race starts and finishes in beautiful Linnéparken and offers a flat, fast course with plenty of spectator support along the way. There is also a shorter children’s and youth race, Lilla Blodomloppet, which follows a loop in the park. Blodomloppet is a social and health-promoting activity suited to both individual participants and teams, and it ends with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linnéparken, Växjö
Flat, fast 5 km course; the 10 km covers two laps
Separate 5 km walking route and Lilla Blodomloppet in the park
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum five participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Late registration is available at Linnéparken on event day. There is a separate 5 km walking category with its own course. Race bibs and T-shirts are handed out on site. You can also take part with a dog in a dedicated dog category. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event area. There are water stations along the course. The event ends with a shared picnic for participants. You can register individually or in a team of up to five participants. The 5 km walking category follows a separate route.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/vaxjo/): 2027-09-01 — "1 september 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-01)

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Kėdainių miesto gimtadieniui, „NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654”
description: NAKTINIAI KĖDAINIAI 654 yra bėgimas, skirtas Kėdainių miesto 654 metų sukakčiai paminėti. Varžybos vyksta miesto gatvėmis, kuriose gali dalyvauti įvairaus amžiaus bėgikai, nuo vaikų iki suaugusiųjų. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą ir bendruomeniškumą, suteikdamas galimybę varžytis ir išsiaiškinti pajėgiausius bėgikus. Startas ir finišas yra Didžiosios Rinkos aikštėje, o renginys vyksta vakare su apdovanojimais po bėgimų.
course_highlights: Bėgama miesto gatvėmis su asfaltu ir trinkelėmis
Trasa sudaryta iš ratų: 4 ratai po 1,6 km (6,4 km distancijai)
Vaikų bėgimai trumpesnėmis distancijomis - 500 m ir 1000 m
additional: Dalyvavimas varžybose nemokamas. Numeriai dalyviams išduodami starto vietoje nuo valandos iki 15 minučių prieš startą. Registracija vykdoma internetu iki rugsėjo 2 d. 23:59 val., papildoma registracija galima starto vietoje nurodytomis valandomis. Varžybų programa apima vaikų simbolinį bėgimą, vaikų bėgimą, pagrindinį 6,4 km bėgimą ir apdovanojimus. Miesto šventės programoje numatytas vaikų bėgimas 20 val., o naktinis bėgimas - 21 val. Ankstesnėje renginio programoje buvo 500 m, 1000 m ir 6,4 km distancijos; 500 m bėgime laikas nefiksuojamas.

name: Mägede järve jooks 8. etapp , Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjas
description: Mägede Lake Run is the 8th event in the Järvamaa Lakes Run series and takes place in the Mägede sports area. This traditional regional race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting challenge. The routes wind between lakes and forests, making them suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is part of Järvamaa’s active sports calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin and the final event of the Leśne Piątki season. The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in various age groups and disciplines. The race takes place on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail, amid scenic natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Course on the Karnieszewice Forest District’s educational forest trail
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
The course runs in the opposite direction to usual, offering a fresh experience
additional: Race numbers with timing chips can be collected from the race office on the day of the event. Participants can compete in the running race, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories. The race is part of the Tour Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, where participants can accumulate kilometres throughout the year. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in the main classifications, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories.

name: Toila rahvajooks
description: Toila People’s Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at Toila SPA Hotel. This public sporting event offers the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and a sporting community. The run takes place in early September and is suitable for runners of different levels. It is a traditional event that attracts participants from across the region.
course_highlights: The routes run around Toila SPA
Beautiful views of the sea and nature
Suitable for both recreational and experienced runners
additional: Toila People’s Run is the 7th stage of the Ida-Viru Running Series. The event takes place on Friday and starts at 17:45. The venue is Toila SPA Hotel. The series has 8 stages in total, held in different parts of Ida-Viru.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa running series is a traditional running and walking series offering distances suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in various locations across Lääne-Virumaa, offering runners diverse and interesting courses. The series lets participants enjoy both the competition and the sporting community, as well as the natural surroundings. Aseri Savijooks is one of the series’ events and takes place at Aseri Leisure Centre.

name: Bėgam už Kalvariją miesto gatvėmis XII
location: Centrinė aikštė, Laisvės g. 1A, Kalvarija, Lietuva
description: Bėgam už Kalvariją miesto gatvėmis XII yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Kalvarijos miesto gatvėse. Renginys skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir aktyvumą tarp miesto gyventojų bei bėgimo mėgėjų. Dalyviai varžosi 2,5 km vaikų bėgime ir 5 km bėgime su dviem ratais, o startas ir finišas yra centrinėje miesto aikštėje. Renginys yra atviras visiems norintiems, o dalyviai apdovanojami atskirai pagal lytį.
course_highlights: 5 km trasa - 2 ratai miesto gatvėmis
2,5 km vaikų bėgimas - 1 ratas
Startas ir finišas centrinėje Kalvarijos aikštėje
additional: Registracija ir numerių atsiėmimas vyksta renginio dieną nuo 10:00 val. Varžybų dieną 13:00 val. laiko matavimo sistema bus išjungta. Elektroninės mikroschemos yra vienkartinės ir jų grąžinti nereikia. Dalyviams draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ir asmeninę palydą varžybų metu. Starto ir finišo vieta - centrinė aikštė, Laisvės g. 1A. Trasose numatytas vandens punktas.

name: Labdaros bėgimas „Vaikai Vaikams“
organizer: Kauno sporto mokykla „Startas“ ir Rimanto Kaukėno paramos grupė
description: Labdaros bėgimas „Vaikai Vaikams“ yra kasmetinis renginys, skirtas padėti vaikams, kuriems reikalinga pagalba. Šio bėgimo misija yra paremti Nojų, sergantį cerebriniu paralyžiumi, kuriam reikalinga lazerinė terapija. Renginys kviečia dalyvauti visus - nuo mažiausių iki suaugusių, jungiant fizinę veiklą su svarbia parama. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, o visiems vaikams dalyvaujantiems bėgime dovanojami marškinėliai.
course_highlights: Trasa vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyno parke ir Valdo Adamkaus lengvosios atletikos manieže
Distancijos: 500 m, 1 km ir 5 km
Renginys skirtas labdarai, padedant vaikams su specialiais poreikiais
additional: Marškinėliai ir lipdukai dalyviams išduodami nuo 10:00 iki 12:00. Renginys organizuojamas Kauno sporto mokyklos „Startas“ ir Rimanto Kaukėno paramos grupės.

name: Rotary End Polio bėgimas
description: „Rotary End Polio bėgimas" yra labdaringas 5 km bėgimas ir ėjimas bei 400 m vaikų bėgimas Palangos mieste, skirtas prisidėti prie poliomielito išnaikinimo pasaulyje. Renginys vyksta Palangos stadione ir miesto gatvėse, įtraukiant pėsčiųjų, dviračių takus ir Palangos tiltą. Dalyviai gali pasirinkti bėgimą arba ėjimą, o renginys skatina sportuoti ir žmones su negalia. Visos surinktos lėšos skiriamos Rotary poliomielito išnaikinimo programai, o organizatoriai padengia renginio išlaidas savo lėšomis.
course_highlights: 5 km trasos danga: asfaltas, miesto gatvės, pėsčiųjų ir dviračių takai, parkas, Palangos tiltas
400 m vaikų bėgimas
Startas ir finišas Palangos stadione
additional: Amžiaus grupės skirstomos pagal gimimo metus, o absoliučios įskaitos nugalėtojai nepretenduoja į amžiaus grupių apdovanojimus. Laiko limitas 5 km bėgimui ir ėjimui - 100 min. Apdovanojimai vyks 12:00 val. Renginyje taip pat numatyta 400 m vaikų bėgimo rungtis.

name: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional running event in Pärnu, held on the first weekend of September. It brings together thousands of sports enthusiasts and offers a 10 km run, Nordic walking and an evening run. The event takes place in the beautiful city of Pärnu and around its bridges, providing a sporting experience for participants of all ages. The event is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites everyone to take part and enjoy being active.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: Kütioru Trail Run and Walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The event takes place at Kütioru Ski Centre, and the course is off-road, offering a varied running experience. The series includes different distances, from little ones’ races to main events, suitable for all levels. This traditional event is open to everyone interested in sport who wants to enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and friendly athletic company.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud
description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional sporting event in Pärnu that brings together thousands of running enthusiasts on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in Vaasa Park and offers a range of distances and ways to take part, including an evening run, wheelchair race and children’s races. The Two Bridges Run is known for its beautiful route through the city and along the bridges, offering a sporting challenge and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants. The event is open to recreational and experienced runners alike and celebrates the joy of exercise and community spirit.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
description: The International Race Walking Festival in Gdańsk is a prestigious sporting event that brings together competitors of different ages and skill levels. The festival features race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, including the Polish Masters Championships and the Polish U23 Championships. The event also promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, offering wheelchair races and FrameRunning events. The festival also includes the open “Walk with the Postman” and the Defenders of the Polish Post Office Run, creating a sporting atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Race walking events over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km for different age categories
Polish Masters and U23 Race Walking Championships
Competition and activities for people with disabilities: wheelchair races and FrameRunning events
additional: Defenders of the Polish Post Office Energa Cup. The event promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing parallel events adapted to their needs.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual night half marathon held in Warsaw, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The route passes through the picturesque districts of Praga, offering a unique night-running atmosphere in the heart of the city. The event is well organized, with timing and extensive facilities for participants. The event also includes the Praska 5K Run, welcoming runners of varying experience levels.
course_highlights: A night run through the streets of Warsaw’s Praga district
Picturesque views of historic neighborhoods
Professional timing and start zones
additional: The event also includes a 5 km race, the Praska 5K Run. Customer service is available Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00. The route and event program for 2027 will be announced closer to the event.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The XLVI Usedom Marathon is a unique race connecting two countries and offering unforgettable moments surrounded by nature. The route leads from Świnoujście along Europe’s longest seaside promenade, through the historic Kaiserbäder, coastal forests, and on to Wolgast. Runners will experience a variety of surfaces and landscapes, from asphalt and cobblestones to forest paths, with views of the Baltic Sea and a fresh sea breeze. The race starts at 9:00 in Świnoujście and finishes at Peene-Stadion in Wolgast, offering a unique sporting and maritime experience on the island of Usedom.
course_highlights: The route follows Europe’s longest seaside promenade
Varied surfaces: asphalt, cobblestones, and forest paths
Crossing the German-Polish border and views of the Baltic Sea
additional: Baggage transport to the finish stadium is provided. Time limits: runners must pass the Kölpinsee checkpoint (km 21.8) within 2:30 h and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 h. Runners who exceed the limits are withdrawn from the course and transported to the finish. After the time limits, there is no course support or refreshment stations.

name: XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is Sweden’s largest women’s race, offering a wonderful 10 km running experience in the scenic Södra Djurgården area of Stockholm. The race is all about community, strength, and personal goals, and welcomes all women aged 15 and over. Starting groups are divided by running ability to ensure a smooth flow and a positive experience for all participants. The course takes runners through beautiful surroundings, with plenty of crowd support along the way, making it a festive and inspiring day celebrating the joy of running.
course_highlights: 10 km run through scenic Södra Djurgården and central Stockholm
Starting groups divided into 12 levels, from fast runners to walking pace
Option to take a shorter 6 km shortcut from starting group 12
additional: Starting groups are divided into 12 levels to ensure a smooth flow. The option to opt out of timing is available. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start in Stockholm and 2 hours before the start in Sälen and Vemdalen, subject to availability. Payment can be made via online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice through Klarna.

name: Lasse-Majaloppet
description: Lasse-Majaloppet is a cross-country ski race organised by Arboga Ski Club, with three distances: 23 km, 13 km and 6 km. The race offers a great opportunity to ski through varied terrain and is a traditional event in Arboga. It welcomes both recreational and competitive skiers.
course_highlights: Three distances: 23 km, 13 km and 6 km
Varied terrain in Arboga
Organised by Arboga Ski Club
additional: The race has been held since the mid-1970s.

name: VI Zarasų pusmaratonis
description: VI Zarasų pusmaratonis yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Zarasuose, Sėlių aikštėje. Renginys skirtas populiarinti bėgimą kaip sveikatingumo priemonę ir garsinti Zarasų krašto vardą. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant pusmaratonį, 10,5 km, 5 km, 1,2 km ir 550 m bėgimus bei estafetes. Varžybos vyksta su oficialiu startu ir finišu Sėlių aikštėje, o trasos driekiasi miesto aplinkoje su atsigaivinimo punktais. Renginys yra atviras visiems norintiems, kurie pasitikrina sveikatą ir laikosi taisyklių.
course_highlights: Pusmaratonio trasa sudaryta iš 2 ratų
