Startas ir finišas Sėlių aikštėje, prieš savivaldybės pastatą
Trasos maršrutai viešai prieinami mappedometer.com
additional: Dalyvių numerių išdavimas prasideda nuo 9:00 val. Sėlių aikštėje. Bėgikų apšilimas vyksta 11:00 val., o Zarasų mero sveikinimo kalba - 11:10 val. Laiko limitai: pusmaratonis - 3 val., 10,5 km - 1 val. 30 min., 5 km - 60 min., 1,2 km - 15 min. Pirmieji 350 užsiregistravusių dalyvių gauna renginio marškinėlius. Trasos metu yra keli atsigaivinimo punktai su vandeniu ir vaisiais. Nuostatuose numatyti vandens ir vaisių punktai trasoje. Taip pat organizuojamas šiaurietiškas ėjimas.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Anija Parish, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Forest Run is a mass-participation sporting event held in the pristine Kõrvemaa nature reserve. The routes wind along forest and gravel roads, offering participants beautiful views and moderate elevation gain. The event is suitable for the whole family, with children’s races and a youth race alongside the main events. The race centre is conveniently located near Tallinn and offers participants hot soup, a sauna and a hot tub. All finishers receive a fine medal and gifts, while the winners are awarded Sportland gift vouchers.
course_highlights: The 21 km route runs along forest and gravel roads, with about 260 metres of elevation gain
The 10 km route is moderately rolling, with several climbs and descents; the gravel road is open to traffic
The 5 km route is varied and rolling, mainly on a wide forest road, and includes three longer climbs
additional: Children’s races are free and untimed; registration is on site. The 5 km youth race starts at 12:30 alongside the adults’ 5 km race. The entry fee is €15 with pre-registration. A Sportland pop-up shop will be open at the race centre, where runners can stock up on running gear. All participants can enjoy hot soup, and access to the sauna and hot tub is available from 13:00. Chip timing is provided for the 21 km, 10 km and 5 km distances. The race centre opens at 10:00, with registration and race-number collection starting at the same time. The 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races are timed. Participants will receive a medal, a drink and a bar at the finish; soup will be offered to everyone, and the sauna and hot tubs will be open.

name: Valmieras skrējiens
description: The Valmiera Run is an annual running event in Valmiera, offering various distances, including a half marathon and 10 km races. The races take place on certified courses, ensuring accurate distance measurements and a high standard of competition. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, offering the chance to enjoy running in a beautiful urban setting. The Valmiera Run is part of the Latvian athletics calendar and attracts participants from across Latvia.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon and 10 km distances
The race takes place within the city of Valmiera
Precisely measured courses with an A-level certificate
additional: The courses are certified through 31.12.2027 with an A-level certificate issued by Arturs Onzuls. The event is part of the Latvian Athletics Association calendar and is organized in accordance with LAA regulations.

name: Festiwal Sportowy im. Kazimierza Bubuli 2026
organizer: LKS Markam Wiśniowa – Osieczany, LKS Lubomir Wiśniowa oraz Gminny Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Wiśniowej
description: The Kazimierz Bubula Sports Festival in Wiśniowa is a special sporting and community event taking place on September 5, 2027. The program includes races at two distances: Wiśniowa Run (5 km) and the mountain Bieg Trzech Wysp (15 km), along municipal roads and hiking trails. In addition to the races, the festival features sports tournaments, roller-skiing competitions, and activities for children, making it a family-friendly event full of sporting excitement. Participants can look forward to attractive cash prizes and commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Wiśniowa Run — a fast, challenging 5 km course along municipal roads, partly closed to motor traffic
Bieg Trzech Wysp — a 15 km mountain race along municipal roads and hiking trails in the Grodzisko/Księża Góra/Ciecień massif
The courses are properly marked and secured
additional: The awards ceremony will take place at 3:00 p.m., followed by cross-country races for children. Cash prizes in the OPEN categories for women and men: 1st place — 700 zł, 2nd place — 400 zł, 3rd place — 300 zł. Additional prizes of 200 zł will go to the top residents of Wiśniowa Municipality in both races. Everyone who finishes within the time limit will receive a commemorative medal. A prize draw for goods will be held after the races. The race office is located in the gymnasium of the Primary School in Wiśniowa. The race pack includes a race bib, medal, meal voucher, and bag for depositing belongings.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
location: Obliwice, Nowa Wieś Lęborska, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: We invite you to the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, which will take place in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km loops, with the start and finish in the same place. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and a track and field athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual levels and offer support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for those who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running.

name: VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
price_range: 350 kr för 5 eller 10 km; 100 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet (preliminära uppgifter för 2027)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: därefter sker en höjning på 50 kr (400 kr)

description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. Participants can choose to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, either individually or as part of a team. The race starts and finishes in Stadsparken and follows a scenic route along the riverside promenade and the city streets. There is also Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet for those who want to take part in shorter distances. Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, Eskilstuna
5 km and 10 km routes along the riverside promenade and city streets
Officially measured 5,000 m course by an SFIF course measurer
additional: Registration is available individually or in teams of 3–5 participants, with a picnic for 5 people included. Team members may take part in different distances/classes (except Lilla Blodomloppet). The deadline for team registration is 31/8. Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet start in Stadsparken and follow shorter routes within the park. The course is officially measured, and timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km distances. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old; Specialomloppet is 1.5–3 km.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://blodomloppet.se/vara-lopp/eskilstuna/): 2027-09-06 — "Välkommen till Blodomloppet 2027! ... 6 september 2027" (was estimated 2027-09-06)

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, apimantis bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo varžybas. Renginys skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį gamtoje ir populiarina sportą įvairaus amžiaus dalyvių tarpe. Varžybos vyksta Ukmergėje, o pagrindinis organizatorius yra VšĮ Sportas miške. Dalyviai varžosi pagal amžiaus grupes ir rungčių tipus, o renginio metu vyksta bendras startas visoms grupėms. Laiko limitas varžyboms yra 120 minučių, išskyrus Mini Rogainingą.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus, Skärblacka, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual town race through beautiful Skärblacka in Östergötland. The event offers a festival atmosphere where everyone can take part, whether they choose to run 6 km, walk 4 km or cheer from the sidelines. The course runs on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and partly on trails, with the start and finish at Folkets Hus. There are great prizes and exciting features such as the Mericon sprint and prize ceremonies for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: 6 km run through Skärblacka on asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and trails
4 km walking class without timekeeping, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
Mericon sprint over the final 300 metres, with a chance to win a gift card
additional: Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on the Tuesday before the race between 11:00 and 18:00, or at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is available at race-number collection and on race day for an additional fee. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, gift cards are available for the Mericon sprint, and there are also prizes for picking up trimmers and tyres along the course. The walking class is not timed, and dogs are not allowed. A first-aid volunteer will be on site. There is also a 4 km walking class.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 6. etapp
description: The 6th stage of the 31st Joosu Lake Run series is a running and Nordic walking event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. This stage offers participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful lakeside scenery and get some exercise in pleasant company. The event is part of a traditional running series that brings together running enthusiasts from Viljandi County.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lakeside scenery
Suitable for both runners and Nordic walkers

name: Sormlands 100 Trail Run
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a running event offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most biologically diverse regions. The races range from 8 km to 100 miles and cover a mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and abilities and offers a memorable weekend in Nävekvarn, surrounded by beautiful nature and challenging terrain.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Distances ranging from 8 km to 100 miles
Beautiful, biologically diverse region along the Sörmlandsleden trail
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. After the race, a sauna and Nävekvarn Folkets Park are available. Well-stocked aid stations offer, among other things, Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, and locally produced food. GPS tracking and live results are available. Mandatory equipment requirements vary by distance and include a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, and a headlamp for longer distances. Transport from the finish is available for the 50 km distance, with a bus to Nyköping Central Station. Race weekend runs from 10–12 September 2027. Registration opens on 1 December.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is an ultramarathon offering a unique experience through one of Sweden’s most species-rich regions. The race offers several distances from 8 km up to 100 miles, across varied terrain including forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections. The event welcomes runners of all ages and levels and promises a memorable day in beautiful and challenging natural surroundings. After the race, sauna and locally produced food and drinks are available at Nävekvarn Folkets Park.
course_highlights: A mix of forest trails, technical coastal paths, and fast sections
Beautiful and challenging trail sections on the Sörmlandsleden trail
Well-stocked aid stations with a variety of energy options and drinks
additional: All distances are cupless, so participants must bring their own cup for drinks. Mandatory equipment includes a GPS tracker, a mobile phone with important numbers, a first-aid kit, a rain jacket, and a headlamp with extra batteries. Well-stocked aid stations along the course offer Coca-Cola, Umara, coffee, fruit, chips, and local specialties, among other items. After the race, sauna, locally produced food, and non-alcoholic beer are available. Shuttle buses from the finish of the 50 km race to Nyköping Central Station are available.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running event held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn. The start is on 12 September 2026 at 14:00. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers, with timed and untimed participation options. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the city’s autumn beauty.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through central Tallinn
Participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% off for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. A 10% group discount applies when at least 10 people register together. The event offers discounts for seniors, young people and groups, and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, taking place on 11–13 September 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running event for young people, held at Freedom Square in the heart of Tallinn. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the chance to take part in a fun, sporting event. The race starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and encouraging an active lifestyle among young people. Registration is easy, and early-bird prices are available.
course_highlights: Held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn
Evening start at 18:30
A safe running environment suitable for young people
additional: Registering early can secure lower entry fees. Young people and seniors can also get special discounts in the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are provided with a safe running environment and well-organised event. The race takes place in Tallinn’s Old Town and at Freedom Square. Participants can join a community of young athletes, and awards are presented to the top finishers.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Paala Lake Children’s Run is a traditional children’s running event held on the shore of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The event offers distances suited to different age groups, ranging from 300 metres to a two-lap run around the lake. Organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club, it gives children the chance to enjoy being active and spend time in nature. The run starts on 12 September 2026 at 10:00. Prizes and souvenirs are provided for participants.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton: poolmaraton 21,1 km
description: The Swedbank Tallinn Marathon is Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, taking place on September 10–12, 2027. The event hub and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, and the course winds through the city’s beautiful parks and coastal areas, offering participants a varied and inspiring running experience. The event is international and brings together thousands of running enthusiasts from Estonia and abroad. The Tallinn Marathon is known for its excellent organization, supportive spectators, and beautiful medals.
course_highlights: The course runs along the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Passes through several parks and coastal areas
Supportive and lively spectators line the course
additional: 20% discount for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. 10% discount for groups registering at least 10 people at once.

description: Zilo kalnu Stirnu buks is part of the popular Stirnu buks trail-running series, held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails. The event offers a range of distances for different ages and fitness levels, allowing participants to enjoy a scenic and challenging trail run. It welcomes both beginners and experienced runners, with awards for the top finishers in different age groups and distances. The Zilo kalnu event takes place in the city of Ogre and is part of a wider series of races held throughout Latvia.
course_highlights: A variety of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads, forest trails, and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups and fitness levels
The event takes place in Ogre, amid beautiful natural scenery and challenging trail sections
additional: Late registration is available on race day until 30 minutes before the distance start. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course between 9:00 and 10:30, with no timekeeping. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors, and special groups. Participant profiles are created and managed through the Stirnubuks.lv profile page.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines sporting excitement with tangible support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place throughout Poland, encouraging participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and support. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.

II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Sieroszewice
location: Sieroszewice, Sieroszewice Municipality, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVIII Bieg Papieski
location: Służewo, Aleksandrów Kujawski County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultramarathon; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many small, steep hills and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and that a large part of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultramarathon (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many small hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp in a tent on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire, BBQ and pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp each lap; there are special elements for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products, and support to help find a running buddy for laps in the dark. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate through the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a highly regarded race organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The race offers a varied course combining asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails through scenic, gently rolling terrain around Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg. The start and finish are at Edbergavallen, and the event offers several distances for both children and adults, with timing for most races. It is a family-friendly and inclusive competition, with medals for everyone who finishes and special commemorative medals for loyal participants.
course_highlights: A varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails
Scenic terrain around Lake Bysjön with moderate elevation changes
The 10 km course includes challenging trail sections and floodlit trails
additional: Start times: 700 m at 11:30, 1.3 km at 11:40, and 5 km and 10 km at 13:00. Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at Kanonvallen. A kiosk serving hot dogs, drinks and sweets is located at the event venue. Teams consist of 4–6 participants in any categories and receive a picnic bag from ICA Supermarket to share after finishing. Late registration is available on site from 10:00, with payment by Swish or cash; discount codes cannot be used for on-site late registration. The race has traditionally been held on the second Saturday in September and offers distances for children and adults.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a recreational race offering a unique nature experience and challenge across three distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The race features varied terrain, from asphalt to winding trails through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget. The start and finish are centrally located at Gränna Square, where participants can enjoy beautiful views of Lake Vättern and a mass start. All participants receive a unique medal, and all distances are timed. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners who want to combine performance with a nature experience.
course_highlights: 21 km course combining asphalt, trails and gravel roads
Route through beech forest and up to the summit of Grännaberget
Start and finish at Gränna Square, with views over Lake Vättern
additional: Mass start from Gränna Square, through town to the harbor, where timing begins. The event arena is in the center of Gränna, close to shops, cafés and accommodation. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits. Timing and a medal at the finish.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a trail race in the beautiful and rugged Paradiset Nature Reserve in southern Stockholm. The race offers challenging trail running along winding paths, across marshes and boardwalks, where runners experience forest, mountains and sea. Distances are 26 km, 13 km and 6 km, and the 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour. The race is marked by a strong sense of community and a festive atmosphere after the finish.
course_highlights: Beautiful, wild terrain with rocky outcrops and open pine forest
Small winding paths, marshes and boardwalks
The 26 km distance is a leg of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race offers three distances: 26 km, 13 km and 6 km. The terrain is challenging and gives a strong sense of achievement. 26 km. The race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly competitive and recreational race that has been held in Saltsjö-Duvnäs since 2007. The race is primarily intended for residents of Nacka, Värmdö and Saltsjöbaden, but welcomes other participants too. The start and finish are in Ringparken, and the race has strong local roots, with a focus on preserving its character as a family event for all ages. In 2027, the race celebrates 20 years with new start categories and continued community spirit among neighbours and runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Ringparken in Saltsjö-Duvnäs
Courses of 1.7 km, 5 km and 10 km (the 10 km course is two laps of the 5 km course)
The course features varied terrain with hills, a waterfront promenade and views around Duvnäs Udde
additional: Timing chips are now integrated into the race bib. Race administration opens the day before and on race day. Participant numbers are limited to preserve the family atmosphere. The children’s race has its own short course around Ringparken.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park och Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a relay race for teams of 2–4 people, held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The course is approximately 5.4 km long and winds through areas including ESS and Kunskapsparken, on a mix of asphalt and gravel. The relay is part of Innovationsloppet & stafetten, where participants kick off autumn together with an energy boost in a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere. The races celebrate Lund as a city of innovation and are organised in partnership by IFK Lund Friidrott and Ideon Science Park.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km and runs from Nobelparken via ESS and Kunskapsparken
A mix of asphalt and gravel, with a flat course and approximately 10 metres of elevation difference
Views of northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams can be women's, men's or mixed teams of 2–4 people, and runners may run more than one leg. The start and finish are in Nobelparken in Brunnshög. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal or a sausage. The competition area is easily accessible by tram and bus. Teams compete in women's, men's or mixed categories. Each runner runs approximately 5 km.

name: Enköpingsloppet
description: Enköpingsloppet is an annual running festival in Enköping that brings together hundreds of runners from across Sweden. The event offers several distances for runners of all levels, from a children’s race to longer 10 km races, and is a celebration for the whole city. The courses are scenic and flat, with beautiful views of Enköping’s parks and waterfront areas. There is a group warm-up, music and cheering along the course, as well as post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: A scenic two-lap course around Drömparken (5.5 km)
A flat, scenic 10 km course through Enköping, officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association
A water station halfway along the 10 km course, with music and cheering along the way
additional: Group warm-up approximately 15 minutes before each race starts. Post-race refreshments with recovery drinks and snacks for all runners. Results and finish times are available online immediately after finishing. The event area at ENA-vallen’s IP opens at 10:00. Start times: 11:00 Ajabaja Cancer Race (children’s race), 12:30 APC Race (5.5 km), 14:00 ICA Maxi Mile (10 km). Prize ceremonies take place after each race. The event area is located at ENA-vallen’s IP. The official website lists a different race date for 2027 than the stated date of 11 September.

name: Innovationsloppet
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott och Ideon Science Park
description: Innovationsloppet & the relay is a running event held in Nobelparken in Brunnshög, Lund. The event offers an individual 11 km distance or a relay with 4 legs of 5.5 km each. The course winds through areas such as ESS and Kunskapsparken, offering flat, varied terrain with asphalt and gravel. The event celebrates Lund as a city of innovation and is open to women’s, men’s and mixed relay teams, as well as individual runners. The start and finish are centrally located in Nobelparken, with good public transport connections by tram and bus.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5.4 km per lap, with two laps for individual runners
The terrain is flat, with approximately 10 metres of elevation difference, and consists of asphalt and gravel
Views over northwestern Lund from a hill in Kunskapsparken
additional: Relay teams consist of 2–4 people and can be women’s, men’s or mixed teams. Teams with fewer than 4 members must have runners complete more than one leg. The relay starts 15 minutes before the individual race. After finishing, participants can choose between a medal and a sausage. The entry fee includes a place in the event, a bib with timing, and a medal or sausage after the finish. Participants choose a medal or sausage when registering.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail is an exciting trail running event in Parainen, offering varied routes amid stunning archipelago scenery. The event features three main distances: 7 km, 14 km and a 21 km half marathon, suitable for both beginner and experienced trail runners. The routes include varied trails, fitness tracks and significant elevation changes, including the steep climbs of Svinövuori, offering unforgettable views and a challenge. The event’s relaxed atmosphere and careful organisation make it an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga yra nauja bendruomenės iniciatyva, skirta tiems, kurie mėgsta judesį, muziką ir gerą energiją. Renginys vyksta Palangoje ir apima mobilumo treniruotes, 5 km socialinį bėgimą su DJ muzika, ledinį vonios ritualą bei kavos pertraukėles. Tai puiki proga susipažinti su naujais žmonėmis, užmegzti pažintis ir patirti vasaros energiją viename rytiniame renginyje. Registracija yra būtina, o dalyviai kviečiami pasiimti sportinius batelius, maudymosi šortus ir rankšluostį.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The II Złotowska Dziesiątka is a 10 km road race held in Złotów. The course consists of two 5 km loops and runs along the city’s picturesque streets. The event is a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to enjoy an active day and compete in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers ensure participants’ safety and the smooth running of the event.
course_highlights: The course consists of two 5 km loops
A road race in the center of Złotów
Scenic views and safe conditions on the course
additional: The race takes place over two 5 km loops. The organizer works with the relevant services to ensure the safety of runners, pedestrians, and drivers. The ZCAS office is located at al. Mickiewicza 18 in Złotów.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting automotive events held at the Poznań race track. Participants can compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motoring enthusiasts and also offers the option to rent cars and take one-to-one lessons with instructors. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of motorsport and hone your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Poznań race track with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying events during the 2026 season
Training options and one-to-one lessons with instructors
additional: You can rent a car for yourself to drive on the track or as a gift. The entry package includes participation by one team member, the option to take part in a co-drive (age >17), full catering, individual timing, and instructor-led training options. To confirm participation, payments must include the required wording in the payment reference.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are annual running events held in Środa Wielkopolska. The event combines sporting competition with bringing together the region’s legal community. It attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and an opportunity to spend time actively outdoors. Registration for the run is now open, and participants can expect a well-organized event with a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through the scenic areas of Środa Wielkopolska
The run combines competition with bringing together the legal community
Held annually and backed by a long-standing tradition

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course runs along the city’s main avenues, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a special prestige. The race has an official course certification, attracting runners focused on a fast pace and setting personal bests. It’s an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in scenic urban surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the center of Częstochowa
Route passes near Jasna Góra
Officially certified course
additional: A structured training plan tailored to the 10 km distance is available.

name: Chyża 10
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a popular 10 km race organized by the Chyży Nowotomyski Running Club in Nowy Tomyśl. The course is fast and popular with participants, and the race takes place in a friendly atmosphere. It also counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix. The race is scheduled to start at 9:00, making for comfortable racing conditions. The organizers warmly invite runners to this event, which brings together a passion for sport and the local community.
course_highlights: A fast course popular with runners
A 10 km race in Nowy Tomyśl
Counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
additional: The race office is open from 07:00 to 08:30 on race day. Winners’ awards ceremony at 10:45. The race is co-funded by the Municipality of Nowy Tomyśl and Nowotomyski County.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Północy XI Maraton Bieg Czterech Latarni
location: Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event held on the Hel Peninsula, combining tradition with fresh energy. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a race for children and teenagers—the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. The course passes through scenic spots in Hel, Jastarnia and Rozewie, and participants get to run surrounded by four lighthouses, making this race unique in Poland. It is an excellent choice for runners of all abilities who want to combine sport with the beauty of the coastal landscape.
course_highlights: The course runs along Puck Bay, with views of the sea
Passes four lighthouses: Hel, Jastarnia and two in Rozewie
Scenic landscapes of the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The marathon relay races have been cancelled due to too few registrations. The marathon course is available to download in GPX, KML and TCX formats. The Władysławowo Municipality Resident Card can be used for discounts on entry fees. The Little Lighthouse Keeper Run is for children and teenagers up to 14 years old.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th DAMAK Tarczyn Half Marathon is a family celebration of running held in Tarczyn. Participants can look forward to a certified half-marathon course, a wonderful atmosphere, and sporting excitement in a welcoming, family-friendly setting. The event attracts runners from a range of backgrounds, offering memorable experiences and a community of running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Certified half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and a wonderful race-day experience
Sporting excitement and a chance for runners to connect
additional: The race office is located at 8 Szarych Szeregów Street in Tarczyn. The event takes place annually in September, with the start at 10:00. The program also includes the 5 km Tarczyn Run and races for children and young people.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The race takes place on scenic routes in the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, offering participants a unique experience surrounded by nature. The event brings people together and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the spirit of sobriety. The marathon has a long-standing tradition, and the organizers ensure a welcoming atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Kozienice Forest
Scenic forest trails and natural surroundings
The race takes place near Jedlnia-Letnisko
additional: Medals can be personalized during the event for a nominal fee of 10 PLN. The organizer is the “Biegiem Radom!” Association, which promotes running and physical activity in the region. The event is a forest cross-country race and traditionally takes place in September.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów in Running is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cyclists’ Association, taking place on September 12, 2027. The event features two distances: a 10 km main race and a 5 km accompanying race, both run around the Żyrardów Reservoir. The course is flat and consists of laps around the reservoir, offering scenic views and favorable conditions for fast times. Participants receive race numbers with chips, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also take part in the 10 km race. The event promotes physical activity and a welcoming sporting atmosphere in the city of Żyrardów.
course_highlights: Course around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance and 2 laps for the 5 km distance
A flat, scenic course that favors fast times
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected at the race office on race day. The event base (start, finish, and parking) is located by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street.

name: II Bieg Tropem Wilka
location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Palmirski Bieg Pamięci Janusza Kusocińskiego
Mälarömilen
description: Mälarömilen is a recurring running race on Ekerö that welcomes runners of all levels and the whole family. The event offers four different distances, from a children’s race for the youngest runners to the classic 10-kilometre main race. The courses pass through scenic surroundings on paved footpaths and park trails, with the start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Mälarömilen is organised by Mälarö SOK, and all proceeds go back to the club’s sporting activities.
course_highlights: Pleasant, runner-friendly courses on paved footpaths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground, in scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration is available on race day, subject to availability. There is a drinks station shortly after the start/lap point. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available in the KOM building at Träkvista sports ground. A first-aid tent is staffed throughout the event. All races start and finish at Träkvista sports ground. Group registration is available for teams and companies.

name: Brotorp Trailrun
location: Skogsluffarnas klubbstuga Brotorp, Bagarmossen, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Brotorp Trailrun is a challenging and enjoyable trail race on a technical 7 km loop through the finest parts of Nackareservatet. The race offers several distances, including a children’s course, 7 km, 14 km and 21 km, with the start and finish at Skogsluffarna’s clubhouse, Brotorp, in Bagarmossen. The courses feature varied terrain, with trails near lakes and hills, marked with orange ribbons and signs. There are aid stations along the course with water, sports drink and bananas, and after the finish, runners in the longer distances are served hamburgers. Timing is provided by Sportident, and prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Technical 7 km loop marked with orange ribbons and signs
The course passes through the finest parts of Nackareservatet, with lakes and hills
Aid stations every 3.5 km with water, sports drink and bananas
additional: The start and finish are at the Brotorp clubhouse. Bib collection takes place on race day, at least one hour before the start. Food and refreshments are available at the clubhouse. The time limit for the longest distance is 4 hours; everyone must finish before 14:00. Showers are available, but runners are encouraged to shower at home. The awards ceremony is planned for approximately 12:30. A discount code is available for children running 7 km (50% discount). According to the organizer, children who register for 7 km receive a 50 percent discount with the discount code “barnrabatt”.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
location: Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park, Linköping, Sweden
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively public relay in Collegium Park at Linköping Science Park. Teams consist of four people, and each runner covers approximately 3 kilometres. The race welcomes both elite teams and recreational groups, with plenty of colour and imagination along the course. After the finish, activities, food for sale, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw await.
course_highlights: Relay course of approximately 3 kilometres per runner
Four runners per team
Course in Collegium Park at Linköping Science Park
additional: According to the existing event information, the race starts at 17:00. After the race, activities, food for sale, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw will be held.

name: LöpRallarn
description: LöpRallarn is a running race organized by Bottnaryds IF at Bottnaryds IP. The race offers distances of 7.5 km and 15 km, on a course that includes loops through varied terrain. The event attracts both young people and adult runners and has a wonderful late-summer atmosphere, with energetic participants. The race has a tradition of bringing together a strong field and offers an enjoyable challenge for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 7.5 km and 15 km course options with two loops
Varied terrain and surfaces
Start and finish at Bottnaryds IP
additional: The race has two distances: 7.5 km and 15 km. In previous years, the race has had start groups and attracted over 100 participants. Results and contact details are available via christian.wigren@rallarloppet.se. Shorter distances of 1 and 2 km are also available. Bottnaryds IF’s pages list different dates for the 2027 race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.bottnarydsif.se/bottnarydsif-rallarloppen-loprallarn): 2027-09-16 — "RallarLoppen 2027 16 sep" (was estimated 2027-09-05)

name: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas
description: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas yra specializuotas bėgimo renginys, skirtas akliesiems ir silpnaregiams sportininkams. Varžybos vyksta Zelvėje, Elektrėnų savivaldybėje, ir yra organizuojamos Lietuvos aklųjų sporto federacijos (LASF). Federacija aktyviai remia aklųjų ir silpnaregių sportą Lietuvoje nuo 1990 metų, siekdama sudaryti lygias sąlygas dalyvauti įvairiose sporto varžybose ir renginiuose. Čempionatas yra svarbi tradicija, skatinanti sportininkų fizinį aktyvumą ir bendruomeniškumą.

name: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!", skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui
description: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!“ yra tradicinis Kauno technologijos universiteto organizuojamas renginys, skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui. Renginys kviečia dalyvius išbandyti savo jėgas įvairiose bėgimo ir ėjimo trasose, įskaitant naują 5 km bėgimą su šunimis. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir dalyvauti bendruomenės sporto renginyje. Varžybos vyksta KTU stadione ir Ąžuolyne, o dalyviai apdovanojami atminimo medaliais bei prizais pagal amžiaus grupes.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Autumn Run 2026 is a running, walking and hiking event held in Ida-Viru County, inviting everyone who enjoys being active to take part. The event is part of the activities of the Centre of Excellence for Recreational Sport, which aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. The Autumn Run offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and support your mental and physical health. Participants can choose the activity that suits them and share the joy of exercise with others.
course_highlights: Takes place around Astri Keskus in Ida-Viru County
Suitable for running, walking and hiking
An event that encourages participants to be active and promotes health
additional: The event includes running, hiking and walking and takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is open, and the event is intended for all age groups and ability levels.

name: Jõhvi rahvajooks
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: The Jõhvi People’s Run is a traditional running event, taking place for the 39th time at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. This year, the course has been updated: in addition to city streets, it also runs through a park and the shops of Pargi Centre. The event offers an exciting and varied running experience over both the 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a good sporting challenge.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
description: The 13th Saarepeedi Hills Run is a traditional running event held near the Saarepeedi Community Centre. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful scenery and hilly trails. It is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to test their endurance and agility. The organizers welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.

name: We Run Riga pusmaratons Mežaparkā

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties visās pasākuma aktivitātēs un skrējienos, tai skaitā vairākās distancēs, ja pasākuma programma to ļauj, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pasākuma dalības maksa iekļauj iespēju piedalīties bērnu skrējienā un citās pasākuma aktivitātēs, We Run Riga oficiālo Nike sporta T-kreklu, piemiņas medaļu un citus atbalstītāju sagatavotos labumus.

description: The We Run Riga Half Marathon in Mežaparks is the biggest running festival of the autumn, taking place on 18 September in Mežaparks, Riga. The event offers a range of distances, including a half marathon, relay, 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as children’s races. Participants receive an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other benefits. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, and participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.0975 km in Mežaparks
2 × 10.5 km relay
Races over various distances: 5 km, 10 km and children’s races
additional: Participants can take part in several distances at once, choosing their distance at the starting line. The entry fee includes an official Nike running T-shirt, a commemorative medal and other participant benefits.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
location: Ochotnicza Straż Pożarna w Janiszewicach, Janiszewice, gmina Zduńska Wola, Poland
description: The 11th Run Around Zduńska Wola Municipality is an annual running event organized by the Volunteer Fire Brigade in Janiszewice. The race is aimed at fans of fast, flat asphalt courses, which have been officially certified at 10 km since 2021. The event is both sporting and community-focused, and also includes children’s races that promote physical activity among the youngest participants. The website features reports, photos, and results from previous editions, highlighting the event’s growing popularity and record attendance.
course_highlights: Flat, fast asphalt course
Officially certified 10 km course since 2021
Children’s races over shorter distances
additional: Children aged 4–15 can take part in races of approximately 300 metres, held without pressure or competition and aimed at fostering a love of movement. The children’s races are for participants aged 4–15.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the scenic Gontyniec massif. Runners cover as much distance as possible, with fully equipped aid stations after each loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, beautiful views of the Noteć Valley, and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It’s a special experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable memories.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
location: Parking przy Operze Leśnej, Sopot, Poland
description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race held in the scenic surroundings of the Forest Opera in Sopot. The route runs through the forest, with numerous climbs and descents, including a steep climb up Łysa Góra, and passes former ski jumps and residential areas. The start and finish are in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the participant limit is 250. The race is part of the Run in Sopot series, which also includes beach races.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the parking lot by the Forest Opera in Sopot
The route runs through the forest and past former ski jumps on Łysa Góra
A steep climb up Łysa Góra and varied terrain with switchbacks
additional: The finish is at the starting point. Only people wearing a race bib may be on the course. Competitors line up in the designated start area.

name: Kung Björn Loppet

price_tiers.distance: Mini Kung Björn (barn upp till 7 år)
Lilla Kung Björn (barn upp till 12 år)
10 km, 6 km och Trail ca 5 km

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälan sista veckan 345 kr för samtliga klasser

description: Kung Björn Loppet is a trail race in Uppsala that welcomes elite runners, recreational runners and children of all ages, with families at its heart. The race is held at OK Linné’s clubhouse and offers several distances, including a children’s race, 6 km, 10 km and a trail race of approximately 5 km. The courses consist of gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt, with water stations along the longer distances. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a prize draw for participants.
course_highlights: Trail race on gravel roads, forest trails and asphalt
Courses of approximately 10 km and 6 km, plus a trail race of approximately 5 km
Two water stations on the 10 km course and one on the 6 km course
additional: Race bibs with electronic chips can be collected from Löplabbet the day before race day or on race day from 09:00. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the event site, but space is limited. A kiosk sells drinks, hot dogs and baked goods. Start groups are available for the 10 km, with a choice of faster and slower groups. Paid parking is available, but public transport and cycling are recommended. The event includes race-bib collection with electronic chips and an awards ceremony.

name: Kistaloppet
location: Jan Stenbecks torg, Kista, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Kistaloppet is a popular running event in Kista, Stockholm, offering races for the whole family, with distances ranging from 400 metres for the youngest participants to 5 km for adults. The race passes through Kista’s distinctive surroundings, including the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green spaces of Järvafältet and the IT cluster that has made Kista known as the Silicon Valley of Northern Europe. The event has a festive atmosphere, with music and entertainment along the course, and an inclusive spirit in which all participants receive a medal. Kistaloppet is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works to promote health and physical activity in suburban communities.
course_highlights: A 5 km measured course through Kista’s Million Programme neighbourhood and green spaces
Start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg, in central Kista
Entertainment and music stations along the course to keep participants motivated
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the event centre in Kista Galleria, in the premises opposite McDonald’s, on Friday 12:00–18:00 and Saturday 09:15–13:00. Late registration is available on site, subject to availability. There is a water station at the finish. Medical staff will be on site. All participants receive a specially designed medal. Music and DJs along the course create a festive atmosphere. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date or registration terms for 2027. The 2026 information also lists a 1.6 km untimed Fun Run and children’s races of approximately 1.6 km and 500 metres.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOK clubhouse Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an ultramarathon in Västerås with several distances, including 100 miles, 50 miles, Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a 10-mile (16.1 km) loop with varied surfaces, including technical trails, jogging paths, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt. Runners who complete 100 miles in under 24 hours receive a belt buckle, while all other finishers receive a medal. Runners can donate their medal in support of Doctors Without Borders.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: technical trails, jogging paths, gravel roads, hiking trails and asphalt
One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km)
Start, lap point and finish at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, with changing rooms, showers and a sauna
additional: If you run 100 miles in under 24 hours, you receive a belt buckle. Runners can opt to forgo their medal in support of Doctors Without Borders; 20 kr per medal is then donated to the organization. Showers and a sauna are also available in the clubhouse near the start/finish. Runners who complete 100 miles within 24 hours receive a belt buckle; all other finishers receive a medal.

name: Taurostos ruduo
description: Taurostos ruduo yra rudens bėgimas, vykstantis Taurostos parke ir per Jonavos tiltus, skirtas klubo nariui Jonui Verikui atminti. Renginys siūlo tris distancijas: 1 km, 7 km ir pusmaratonį (21,1 km). Numeriai dalyviams išduodami nuo 9:30 val., o startas prasideda 11:00 val. 1 km distancijai ir apie 11:30 val. 7 km bei pusmaratonio bėgimams. Tai tradicinis renginys, kuris suburia bėgimo entuziastus Jonavoje ir suteikia galimybę mėgautis rudens gamta bei aktyviu laisvalaikiu.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Taurostos parke ir per Jonavos tiltus
Trijų distancijų pasirinkimas: 1 km, 7 km ir pusmaratonis
Renginys skirtas klubo nariui Jonui Verikui atminti

name: ENERGIZER Baltic Beach Run 2026
description: ENERGIZER Baltic Beach Run brings runners and walkers to the coastal town of Narva-Jõesuu. The 2026 event was scheduled for September 20, with running and walking on the program. This sporting event, named a beach run, invites participants to take part on either a running or walking route.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: The 43rd Rakvere Folk Run is a traditional mass-sport event that welcomes all running enthusiasts. The race takes place at Rakvere City Stadium and offers a variety of distance options for both children and adults. The courses have been carefully chosen to provide an enjoyable running experience and promote a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to anyone sufficiently trained to complete their chosen distance.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
location: Park Miejski w Mosinie, Mosina, Poland
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an attractive course and sporting competition. It attracts both amateur and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and bringing the local community together. The organizers provide professional support and a generous race pack.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechit Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at St. Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, following the route of Otto III’s historic journey. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timekeeping, and course safety. Participants receive a race package with a medal and a recovery meal.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Half Marathon along the Red Oak Avenue is a half-marathon race (21.097 km) taking place in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Municipal Sports and Tourism Centre in Wieruszów. The race is open and runner-friendly, with a scenic route along the Red Oak Avenue. The race office will be open on event day from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing will be electronic. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and attractive race-day conditions.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help participants prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy friendly competition in a welcoming atmosphere.

name: XV Półmaraton Augustowski
description: The 15th Augustów Half Marathon will take place in Augustów, starting at 13:00 by the Municipal Amphitheatre. Competitors will cover the half-marathon distance of 21.0975 km, running a race that is half the length of a marathon. The event is organized by the Augustów Swimming Association and is an important running event in the region.

name: Hökensås Trail
location: First Camp Hökensås, Tidaholm Municipality, Sweden
description: Hökensås Trail is a trail race starting at First Camp Hökensås, where pine heath and rolling ridges create a nature-close running experience. Choose from distances of 5.5 km, 11.5 km and 19 km. The race is suitable both for those who want to try trail running and for those seeking a longer challenge in a forest setting.
course_highlights: Run across the pine heath and rolling ridges of Hökensås.
Three distances: 5.5 km, 11.5 km and 19 km.
Start and finish at First Camp Hökensås.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
description: Coop Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping, with Trädgårdsföreningen as its meeting place. Runners can come together for a day of exercise and the joy of running in a welcoming setting. The race is organized by Linköpings GIF, and registration for the 2026 edition is open.
course_highlights: Trädgårdsföreningen is the race’s meeting place.
The race takes place in Linköping.
Details of the course route are not available in the sources provided.
additional: Members of Linköpings GIF can participate for free in all categories with the campaign code LGIF2026.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is Nacka’s big autumn running festival, with races for all ages and abilities. The main event is a 10 km recreational race along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energiloppet, Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old, and Mini Sickla for the youngest runners. The races offer a scenic, fast course, a great atmosphere, and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a public health event for Nacka and Stockholm.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of asphalt, gravel, and a wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with spectators and musical entertainment
additional: The race venue opens at 08:00 at Marcusplatsen in Sickla Köpkvarter, with race-number pickup and on-site registration. Food trucks and partners will be on site. Lilla Sicklaloppet starts at times between 09:15 and 10:15 for different age groups. Sicklaloppet 5 km starts at 11:45, and the 10 km starts at 13:00. The time limit for the 10 km is 1 hour and 15 minutes, with a cut-off at Kyrkviken after approximately 7.5 km. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation. All races start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter. The race website describes the 2026 edition.

name: 20. ETAPP
description: The 20th stage is part of the running series organized by Stamina Sports Club and takes place on the Järve health trail in Tallinn. This stage gives participants the chance to enjoy a health trail close to the city, well suited to both recreational and experienced runners. The event is traditional and well organized, offering an enjoyable sporting experience and a sense of community. Participants can also enjoy beautiful nature and healthy exercise in the fresh air.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Kauno rajono mero Valerijaus Makūno ir olimpiečio Kęstučio Orento taurei laimėti
description: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos Zapyškyje, skirtos Kauno rajono mero Valerijaus Makūno ir olimpiečio Kęstučio Orento taurei laimėti, kviečia bėgimo entuziastus dalyvauti ir išbandyti savo jėgas. Varžybos vyksta natūralioje aplinkoje Kauno rajone, suteikiant galimybę mėgautis sportu ir bendruomeniškumu. Renginys yra puiki proga susitikti su bėgimo mėgėjais ir profesionalais bei pasisemti įkvėpimo iš olimpiečio Kęstučio Orento pavyzdžio.
additional: Varžybos yra nemokamos. Renginys vyksta Zapyškyje, Kauno rajone. Organizatorius - Kauno rajono sporto centras. Registracija vykdoma per oficialią registracijos formą svetainėje.

name: Rava järve jooks, Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 9.etapp
description: The Rava Lake Run is part of the Liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Lakes Run Series and takes place by Lake Rava in Järvamaa. Runners of all ages take part, from toddlers to seniors. The race features a single lap around the lake, with prizes awarded to the fastest men and women. It is a traditional, community-focused running event that offers both a sporting challenge and a chance to enjoy nature.

name: Greičio ratai 2026
description: Renginys apima 60 m bėgimus vaikams, 1000 m bėgimus su specialiomis kategorijomis neįgaliesiems su triračiais, bei 5×1000 m estafetės varžybas mišrioms, vyrų ir moterų komandoms. Varžybų tikslas - skatinti bėgimą kaip sveiką gyvenimo būdą, populiarinti lengvąją atletiką ir išaiškinti pajėgiausias komandas. Dalyviai privalo laikytis taisyklių, o renginys yra atviras visiems norintiems, registracija vyksta iš anksto.

name: #BeActive bėgimas, skirtas Europos sporto savaitei
description: Europos sporto savaitės #BeActive renginys Vilkaviškyje yra svarbi bendruomenės tradicija, kviečianti įvairaus amžiaus ir fizinio pasirengimo žmones aktyviai praleisti laiką. Renginio programa apima estafetes, judriuosius žaidimus, futbolo, imtynių, šachmatų varžybas, linijinius šokius, mankštą, šiaurietišką ėjimą ir bendrą žygį po miestą. Vakarinę programą vainikuoja bendras šokis ir energingas „Dance party“ su zumbos ritmais, kuris suvienija dalyvius ir pabrėžia judėjimo svarbą bendruomenėje.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4 km, 1.7 km
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and a much-loved running challenge held annually on Lidingö since 1965. More than 30,000 runners gather during race weekend to run scenic, hilly courses, from short children’s races to the classic 30 km race, a true test of endurance. The race is a world-class celebration of running and a showcase for the joy of movement and public health, with nature always at its heart. Participants can also enjoy a sports expo featuring partners and exhibitors offering inspiration ahead of the race.
course_highlights: A hilly cross-country course featuring flat meadows, gravel roads and steep climbs
The 30 km race has 522 metres of elevation gain and is open for training around the clock before race day
Aid stations along the course offering sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas
additional: The sports expo at Lidingövallen takes place during race weekend, where participants collect their race bibs and can browse offers and expert advice. Free buses run between Ropsten and Lidingövallen during race weekend. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Photographers are stationed along the course and at the finish, with photos available to purchase after the race. The course profile and elevation gains are presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ feature for pace planning. Aid stations offer sports drink, water, pickled cucumber, buns and bananas. Lidingöloppet encourages environmentally friendly travel by public transport, bicycle or carpooling. Lidingöloppet weekend includes races for different ages and levels, from a 1.7 km children’s race.

name: XXVI Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas. Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimo čempionatas.
description: Tarptautinis Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas yra tradicinis ir kasmetinis renginys, vykstantis Kuršių nerijoje, Nidoje. Renginys apima pusmaratonio distanciją, 5 km YIT bėgimą bei trumpesnes vaikų ir jaunuolių distancijas. Tai puiki proga tiek profesionaliems bėgikams, tiek mėgėjams pasimėgauti bėgimu unikalioje gamtinėje aplinkoje ir dalyvauti Lietuvos pusės maratono čempionate. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą ir sporto populiarinimą Lietuvoje, o dalyvių laukia profesionaliai paruoštos trasos ir draugiška atmosfera.

name: VERTICAL VILNIUS 2026
organizer: TA Trail Akademija VŽ Vaidas Žlabys
description: Vertical Vilnius yra Lietuvos vertikaliausios bekelės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniuje. Dalyviai įveikia Liepkalnio šlaitus, varžybos suteikia galimybę pelnyti ITRA reitingo taškus. Taip pat organizuojamas ekologinis „Trash Vertical“ iššūkis, skatinantis dalyvius rūpintis aplinka. Registracija į renginį yra nemokama, todėl kviečiame visus aktyviai prisijungti ir išbandyti savo jėgas šioje unikalioje trasoje.

name: 26-as Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono Bėgimas
description: 26-asis Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono bėgimas vyks. Nidoje. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas: pusmaratonį, 5 km YIT bėgimą, 2 km jaunuolių bėgimą bei trumpuosius vaikų bėgimus (500 m ir 210 m). Bėgimo trasos yra sertifikuotos pagal World Athletics ir AIMS reikalavimus, o startai vyksta skirtingose Nidos vietose. Tai tradicinis renginys, skatinantis sportuoti ir populiarinti bėgimą bei lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje.

name: Vertical Vilnius
description: Vertical Vilnius yra Lietuvos vertikaliausios bekelės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Liepkalnio šlaituose Vilniuje. Dalyviai įveikia stačius kalnų šlaitus, siekdami pelnyti ITRA reitingo taškus ir dalyvauti ekologiniame „Trash Vertical“ iššūkyje. Varžybos skatina fizinį aktyvumą ir gamtos tausojimą, kviečiant bėgikus išbandyti savo jėgas unikalioje trasoje.

name: ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: The ELKE Tallinn Run takes place in Noblessner, offering the joy of exercise and experiences for the whole family. This beautiful seaside area provides an ideal setting for both sporting activities and an enjoyable day out. Race day begins with a children’s run and offers a choice of distances to suit both beginners and experienced runners. In addition to sports, the programme includes a free concert and a varied programme, creating a wonderful atmosphere for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The beautiful seaside area of Noblessner
Views of Noblessner and North Tallinn
A variety of distances for children and adults
additional: Race day begins with the children’s run at 13:00. The 2.5 km and Stebby 5 km distances start at 14:30, and the Neptunas 10 km distance starts at 15:10. The event centre’s programme runs from 11:00 - 17:10. A free concert by INGER takes place at Noblessner Central Square at 13:40. Outdoor seaside setting, family-friendly, includes a run and a concert, autumn event

name: 44. Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks
description: The Viking Window Paide-Türi Fun Run is a traditional mass-participation sporting event that brings together running enthusiasts from Järvamaa and beyond. The course features varied terrain, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event is suitable for all age groups and, in addition to the main race, includes children’s runs and other active activities. Completing the course between Paide and Türi is an annual highlight that brings the community and sports enthusiasts together.

name: Siguldas kalnu maratons (SKM)
organizer: Biedrība Kalnkāpēju sporta centrs sadarbībā ar IK Adventure Company
description: Sigulda Mountain Marathon (SKM) is Latvia’s hilliest trail race, held in the Sigulda area among steep hills and beautiful views of Gauja National Park. The event offers three distances: a full marathon of approximately 70 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain, a 35 km half marathon, and a 10+ km mountain cross-country distance that is also suitable for walking. SKM tests both physical and psychological endurance, and the marathon distance is the Latvian Trail Running Championship. Participants receive unique finisher medals, and the course is regularly updated to keep it exciting and challenging.
course_highlights: The steep slalom slopes in the Sigulda hills have an elevation difference of up to 80 metres
The course includes Gauja National Park trails with stairs and impressive views
The full marathon distance is approximately 70 km with 3,000 metres of elevation gain and loss
additional: Participants completing the full marathon distance receive a unique finisher medal forged by blacksmith Jānis Banka. The 35 km and 70 km distances are worth ITRA points (2 and 3 points). The course is regularly adjusted and cleared to ensure the best conditions, taking into account natural conditions and storm damage. The 10+ km mountain cross-country distance is suitable for walking and is not intended for awards. The 2026 programme included approximately 70 km, 35 km, and a shorter distance. Participants in the longer races could earn ITRA points.

name: 62. Daugavpils skrējiens "Daugavpils-Mežciems"
description: The Daugavpils “Daugavpils-Mežciems” Run is a traditional event that promotes a healthy lifestyle and running as a mass-participation sport in Daugavpils and Latvia. The race takes place at Vienības Square in Daugavpils and offers several distances, including 10 km, a 5 km mass-participation run, and children’s races. The course is flat with slight inclines. The surface is mainly asphalt and paving stones, with a few short gravel sections. The event is open to all interested participants, subject to age restrictions, and offers race-bib collection on the day before the event and on race day.
course_highlights: The 10 km course is one loop on asphalt and paving stones
The 5 km mass-participation run and Nordic walking follow one 5 km loop
The terrain is flat, with slight, gradual inclines
additional: Race-bib collection takes place on 25 September from 14:00 to 19:00 and on 26 September from 9:00 at the Daugavpils Tourist Information Centre (Rīgas iela 22). Registration is not available on race day. Participant results are processed by SIA “MANI APĻI”. Results are recorded for the 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women.

name: Skrējiens “Apkārt Lielezeram”
description: The “Around Lielezers” race is a traditional autumn sporting event in Limbaži, bringing runners together for the tenth time. The competition offers two distances—13.7 km and 6 km—with participants able to compete for course records and cash prizes. The event is popular with local and visiting athletes alike, offering exciting competition and a wonderful autumn atmosphere by Lielezers. The organizers give the fastest runners extra motivation with increased cash prizes and the chance to beat previous records.
course_highlights: Two distances—13.7 km and 6 km
A chance to set course records and cash prizes for the fastest runners
A race around scenic Lielezers in Limbaži
additional: The fastest man and woman overall in each distance receive a €100 prize. If course records are broken, an additional €100 or €200 is awarded. The event is organized by Limbaži Municipality. Contact details: Rīgas iela 16, Limbaži; phone +371 64023003 and +371 28398978. At the 2026 competition, cash prizes were planned for the fastest men and women in both distances.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometer race taking place in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are on the illuminated pitch at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can enjoy a spectacular show featuring lasers, music, and light effects. The course runs through the city and features cheering points with music and fire shows, creating a one-of-a-kind nighttime atmosphere. This new version of the well-known race held alongside the half marathon has moved to Saturday evening to give runners and spectators a special experience.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon, and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by the PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a great opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.

name: XI Bieg po Gminie Zduńska Wola
description: The 11th Run Around Zduńska Wola Municipality is an annual running event organized by the Janiszewice Volunteer Fire Department. The race is aimed at fans of fast, 10 km asphalt courses, which have been certified since 2021. The event is open and welcoming to runners of different experience levels, and also includes children’s races that promote physical activity among young participants. The website features reports, photos, and results from previous editions, highlighting the event’s tradition and growing popularity.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km asphalt course
Flat, fast course conducive to good results
Children’s races over distances of approximately 300 m for ages 4–15
additional: Children’s races take place during the event, offering distances of approximately 300 meters for children aged 4–15, without the pressure of competition. The organizers provide reports, photos, and results from previous editions of the race.

name: Gudö Run of Hope
description: Gudö Run of Hope is a beautiful trail race in Tyresö, held in support of the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities to run, walk or jog. Participants can choose from several distances, from 1 km to 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk. The event is part of the fight against childhood cancer and offers a meaningful and enjoyable experience in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: A beautiful trail race in Tyresö
Several distances: 1 km, 3 km, 6 km, 10 km and a 5 km walk
Suitable for runners of all ages, big and small
additional: The race is organised by Gudö Sportklubb in Tyresö. Participants can run, walk or jog. The event encourages donations via Swish and QR code for those who cannot participate. The Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund is the organiser, and the contact persons can be reached via the email address provided. Proceeds go to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of distance options for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in beautiful locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners both the excitement of competition and an enjoyable sporting experience. The main races, along with the youth and children’s races, are popular and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The series’ stages have secured a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts.

organizer: Ogres novada sporta centrs sadarbībā ar Ogres novada pašvaldību un biedrību “Sporta klubs SportLat”

description: Izskrien Ogre is an annual running event held in the Birch Avenue Square in Ogre, bringing together experienced runners, families with children, and active-lifestyle enthusiasts. The event is friendly and suitable for participants of various ages and fitness levels, offering a sporting atmosphere and the chance to enjoy running in an urban setting. It is organized by the Ogre Municipality Sports Centre in cooperation with Ogre Municipality and the “Sporta klubs SportLat” association.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Birch Avenue Square
5 km and 10 km routes through city streets and parks
A short children’s run of approximately 500 metres

name: Kazdangas taku maratons
