description: The Kazdanga Trail Marathon is an annual trail-running event held at the recreation area by Lake Dzirnezers in Kazdanga. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy a scenic and challenging trail marathon course, with professional RFID timing. The event is suitable for both experienced trail runners and those looking to test themselves in a natural setting. Traditionally, the race brings together athletes from various places, creating a friendly and sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A trail marathon course with varied terrain
Beautiful natural scenery by Lake Dzirnezers
Professional timing with RFID equipment

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to a large field, with start corrals based on declared finish times, and also offers the option of taking part in four-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timing, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as raising the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Start corrals based on declared finish times
additional: The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish times (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race pack includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timing, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration is online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and young people are also available.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a special running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The course passes through the capital’s most beautiful and historic locations, offering unique views and an unforgettable atmosphere. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, while spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that brings together sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start beneath the Palace of Culture and Science in the centre of Warsaw
The course passes along Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat, over Poniatowski Bridge with views of the Vistula, and by PGE Narodowy
Road closures ensure safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The race number must be worn on the front of the clothing and must not be covered or altered. The start and finish are in the city centre, near metro stations. On race day, baggage storage, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions and cheering zones, as well as a programme at the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the #BiegamDobrze charity programme with a free race number. Races include a 10 km event (Warszawska Dycha) and the Mini Marathon for children and young people, held during the same weekend. Registration is available through the official website, and the event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km race. The organisers provide attractions and support for participants.

name: 1 Półmaraton Ostrzeszowski
description: The Half Marathon on the Crown of the Wielkopolska Hills is a unique race held in picturesque Ostrzeszów. The half-marathon course takes runners over two hills and past two springs, offering participants distinctive views and off-road challenges. It’s a great opportunity to tackle a demanding course and enjoy a sporting adventure in the heart of Wielkopolska. Runners are invited to take part and celebrate sport and nature together.
course_highlights: The course takes runners over two hills
It passes by two springs
Picturesque landscapes of Wielkopolska

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity amid the natural surroundings of eastern Poland. The series consists of eleven stages, held mainly in Podlasie, with routes of varying difficulty suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The races are non-commercial and have a limited number of participants, helping ensure safety and respect for local communities and the environment. The series offers two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 6–8 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), as well as a Nordic Walking competition. The 2027 season finale will take place on September 26 in Michałowo.
course_highlights: Trail routes of approximately 6–8 km (Szpurt) and 17–21 km (Wertep)
Routes marked with colored arrows (green on a yellow background for Szpurt, red for Wertep)
Races take place in the scenic regions of Podlasie and the Vilnius Region, with respect for nature and local communities
additional: Runners start in waves based on results from the previous season. Time limits are approximately 2 hours for the shorter distance and 2 hours 15 minutes for the longer one. The race package includes a race bib with a chip, a hot recovery meal (including a vegetarian option), refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, medical support, a commemorative medal (for those who register in advance), and race photography. Registration is available on race day until 08:40, though the race package may be incomplete. The organizer allows the entry fee to be transferred to another date at no additional cost before online registration closes.

name: XXVIII Jesienne Biegi Małkińskie
description: The 28th Małkinia Autumn Runs is an annual running event held in Małkinia Górna, attracting running and Nordic walking enthusiasts from across the region. The route follows scenic forest paths near the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre, offering participants a unique sporting experience and a chance to connect with nature. The event brings people together and promotes an active lifestyle among different age groups. The organizers ensure a friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Scenic forest paths around the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre
Route suited to runners and Nordic walking participants
A regional event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The event takes place near the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre in Małkinia Górna. It brings together runners and Nordic walking participants. The organizer is the Municipal Culture and Sports Centre in Małkinia Górna.

name: Festiwal Biegowy i Nordic Walking
location: Olszewo-Borki, Ostrołęka County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nice To Fit You Warszawska Dycha
XII Zielona Wierzchosławicka Dycha
location: Wierzchosławice, Tarnów County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet 250 kr till och med 26/9 2027

description: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (the Pink Ribbon Race) is an inspiring fun run held amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö. The race offers two distances, 4 km and 10 km, on gentle courses with an elevation gain of 209 metres. It is part of the Pink Ribbon campaign and aims to promote physical activity and raise awareness of cancer-preventive lifestyle habits. Everyone aged 9 and up is welcome to take part, and part of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. The race is an official launch event for the Pink Ribbon campaign and is organised in cooperation with the Swedish Cancer Society.
course_highlights: Gentle courses amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Lidingö
Two distances: 4 km and 10 km, with 209 metres of elevation gain
Course profile presented by Garmin with PacePro functionality
additional: All runners aged 9 and up for the 4 km and 11 and up for the 10 km are welcome. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes directly to the Swedish Cancer Society. All finishers receive a bronze medal featuring a unique Carl Milles design. Marathon Photos photographs participants along the course and at the finish. The course profile is presented by Garmin, with the PacePro™ function for pace planning. The race is part of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern. From 2025, there is a 4 km category for ages 9–15.

name: Kauno rajono bėgimas 2026
location: Aikštė prie Senosios Zapyškio Šv. Jono Krikštytojo bažnyčios, Zapyškis, Kaunas District Municipality, Lietuva
description: Tradiciškai rengiamas „Kauno rajono bėgimas“ kviečia bėgimo entuziastus į Pakaunę, šiemet vyksiančią Zapyškyje prie Senosios Zapyškio Šv. Jono Krikštytojo bažnyčios. Renginys skirtas įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams, siekiantiems aktyviai praleisti laiką ir išbandyti savo jėgas gražioje gamtos aplinkoje. Tai puiki proga susitikti su bendraminčiais ir mėgautis sporto švente Kauno rajone. Renginys organizuojamas profesionaliai, užtikrinant dalyvių saugumą ir gerą nuotaiką.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas prie Senosios Zapyškio Šv. Jono Krikštytojo bažnyčios aikštės
Maršrutas veda per gražią Pakaunės gamtą ir kaimo vietoves
Tradicinis renginys su draugiška atmosfera ir įvairių amžiaus grupių varžybomis

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.lbmaregistracija.lt/krs/): 2026-09-30 — "Varžybos ... yra nukeliamos į 2026 m. rugsėjo 30 d." (was estimated 2027-06-05)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Varžybos ... yra nukeliamos į 2026 m. rugsėjo 30 d.

name: 16. ETAPP
description: The 16th stage is part of a recreational running series held in Tallinn. The event centre, start and finish are at Järve Health Trail, offering participants an enjoyable running and Nordic walking experience at the car park by the shared-use path. The route is easily accessible by car and public transport, making it convenient to take part. The series aims to offer everyone an opportunity to spend their free time in an active and healthy way.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking on Järve Health Trail
Start and finish at the car park by the Järve shared-use path
Easy access by car and public transport
additional: The event centre, start and finish are at the car park by the Järve shared-use path, at the Viljandi mnt end of Järve Health Trail. Those arriving by car are advised to park at Järve Selver, from where it is about a 400 m walk or jog to the event centre. Those travelling by bus should get off at the Risti stop, from where it is about a 300 m walk to the event centre.

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
description: ACE BATTLE RUN is an innovative tactical team running format held over one mile (1609 m) at Podskarbińska Stadium in Warsaw. The competition combines individual qualifying with team competition, where individual and team results contribute to the official runners’ ranking. The 2027 season features exciting head-to-head matchups and competition for a place in the ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Runners can compete solo or in teams, earning levels and ratings in the ACE BATTLE RUN system.
course_highlights: One-mile distance (1609 m) on a stadium track
Individual and team competition with an official ranking
Exciting team matches in a tactical format
additional: The competition consists of three stages: individual qualifying, a team race for an ABR level, and an ACE BATTLE Mile team rating. Teams earn an official rating, and each participant becomes an ABM athlete. After the season, teams with a rating compete in head-to-head matches in the ACE BATTLE Mile City League Warsaw. Results and photo galleries from past events are available online. The official website lists Podskarbińska Stadium as the venue for the ACE BATTLE RUN format. The program also includes a briefing, team roles, and prizes.

name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in central Tartu, taking place on 2 October at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, along city streets, offering a chance to enjoy the atmosphere of the autumn city with friends. This is not a race; participants can choose to run with or without timing. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4 km course in central Tartu
The course runs along city streets and park paths
One split-timing point on the timed distance
additional: The race number must be pinned to the chest and visible throughout the distance. The timing chip is attached to the back of the race number and is for single use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish closes at 21:45. The entry fee includes a marked course, race number, timing (if using a chip), services at the finish, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until 2 October at 17:00 and on site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts.

name: Bėgimas skirtas Sporto ir kūno kultūros dienai paminėti
description: Lietuvos sporto dienos bėgimas Alytuje yra masinis bėgimo renginys, skirtas skatinti fizinį aktyvumą ir sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Renginys yra Nacionalinės fizinio aktyvumo programos dalis ir vyksta spalio mėnesį. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš trijų distancijų, kurios pritaikytos skirtingoms amžiaus grupėms. Visus finišavusius dalyvius pasitinka atminimo suvenyrai, o geriausi apdovanojami medaliais.
course_highlights: Trasa Alytaus miesto teritorijoje
Skirtingos distancijos pagal amžiaus grupes: 1,5 km, 3 km ir 6 km
Startas ir finišas prie Alytaus sporto centro
additional: Registracija vyksta tiek iš anksto internetu, tiek renginio dieną nuo 10:00 iki 11:15 val. Starto numeriai privalo būti prisisegti ant marškinėlių priekio. Dalyviai dalyvauja savo noru ir prisiima visą su bėgimu susijusią riziką.

name: 16. Tartu Linnamaraton
description: The 16th Tartu City Marathon is a traditional autumn running event held in Tartu, starting on Vabaduse Boulevard and finishing at Town Hall Square. The event features three distances: a full marathon (42 km), a half marathon (21 km), and a 10 km run, suitable for both runners and walkers. The courses pass through the city of Tartu and offer intermediate timing points and strong event support, including transport for participants who withdraw. Participants receive medals and personalized diplomas, and 42 km finishers also receive a finisher T-shirt. The event is part of the Tartu Marathon Classic series and also offers a virtual run.
course_highlights: Start and finish in central Tartu: Vabaduse Boulevard and Town Hall Square
Intermediate timing points on the marathon course at 10 km, 21.1 km, and 30 km
Courses are suitable for both runners and walkers, with separate start groups for Nordic walkers
additional: Entry fees are non-refundable, but upon presentation of a medical certificate by 01.10.27 at 17:00, half of the entry fee will be credited to the participant’s user account. A 30% discount is available to pensioners of the Republic of Estonia and young people up to 18 years old; a 10% discount is available for groups of at least 10 people. Discounts do not apply on the morning of race day. Timing for all distances starts at the starting signal; results for runners and walkers are published together. Transport to the finish is provided for participants who withdraw. Finishers of the 42 km distance receive a finisher T-shirt. The event centre is open at Town Hall Square, where race numbers are distributed and sports goods are sold. Participants receive a medal and a personalized diploma; 42 km finishers also receive a finisher shirt.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: The Tartu City Marathon children's races are open to all children, with the joy of taking part as the main goal. Recommended guidelines apply to distances and age groups, but every child is welcome on the course and treated equally. Bib numbers are issued one hour before the start, and the event is not ranked. The event takes place in Tartu Town Hall Square, with registration available both in advance and on site.

name: Dubultmaratons Taisnais Ērgļu stacijā
location: Sauriešu dzelzceļa stacija, Saurieši, Ropaži Municipality, Latvia
description: Dubultmaratons Taisnais is an endurance race along the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line. The routes are marked and easy to follow, and can be completed by running, Nordic walking, or walking while enjoying Latvia’s beautiful natural scenery. The race offers three distances: double marathon (84.4 km), marathon (42.195 km), and half marathon (21.0975 km). It is organized by the Taisnais association in cooperation with the municipalities of Ogre and Madona. The start and finish are at railway stations. The race aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and identify Latvia’s most enduring long-distance runners and Nordic walkers.
course_highlights: The route follows the embankment of the former Saurieši–Ērgļi railway line
A flat sandy path with no climbs, passing through dense forest, open areas, and over river bridges
The start and finish are at railway stations, and the course is clearly marked
additional: Participants must be at least 18 years old. Spectators may accompany participants on foot or by bicycle without disturbing others, but may not help them move along the course. Finish times differ for runners and Nordic walkers in each distance.

name: Lāčplēšu kross Rīgas Mežaparkā
description: Lāčplēšu Cross is a patriotic trail and obstacle race held in Riga’s Mežaparks. The event offers a range of distances for both children and adults, with participants following a marked course featuring natural and man-made obstacles. It brings together participants of different ages and fitness levels, including accomplished athletes, and fosters a sense of patriotism and unity through sporting activities. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish, and the fastest runners in the main distances receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Marked course through Mežaparks’ trails and meadows
Natural obstacles: sandy areas, roots and forest terrain
Man-made obstacles on various distances
additional: The event centre is located in the Great Meadow of Mežaparks. During the event, younger participants can take part in craft workshops, try archery and watch knight demonstrations. There are also interactive games about waste sorting and green living. An awards ceremony and a raffle with valuable prizes take place after the races. Participants can buy food and drinks at the event centre.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Biegnij Warszawo is one of Poland’s most recognisable running events, bringing together thousands of participants every year in the heart of the capital. The race takes place on the first Saturday in October and features a 10 km route through Warsaw’s most iconic locations. The FUNRUN format welcomes everyone, regardless of age or experience, focusing on the joy of movement and having fun without the pressure of competition. Participants can look forward to music zones, crowd support and comprehensive medical cover along the route.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Warsaw’s most atmospheric and iconic locations
Music zones and crowd support along the entire route
The route is certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA) and is beginner-friendly
additional: The race pack includes a Nike Dri-FIT T-shirt with a commemorative print, a race bib with a timing chip, gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. There is a hydration station halfway along the route, and the organiser provides comprehensive medical cover. The participant limit is 10,000.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Czerwonce Włościańskiej, Czerwonka Włościańska, Poland
description: The Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazowieckiej is a 5 km race held in the picturesque village of Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are at the Primary School in Czerwonka, and the route follows National Road No. 60 between Maków Mazowiecki and Różan. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and participants can expect professional organization and an awards ceremony for the winners. The race is open to people over 18 and to younger participants with the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along National Road No. 60
Start and finish at the Primary School in Czerwonka Włościańska
Picturesque surroundings of the Masovian Lowland
additional: The participant limit is 200 race packs. Registration and race-pack pickup take place at the race office on the school sports field in Czerwonka from 08:30 to 10:00. An awards ceremony for the winners and an event wrap-up are scheduled after the race.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Ekerumsloppet
location: Ekerum Resort, Borgholm Municipality, Öland, Sweden
description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, an autumn trail race on Öland, starting and finishing at Ekerum Resort. The 10-kilometre course follows forest trails around Ekerum and Rällaskogen, and young runners can take part in a course of approximately 1.3 kilometres. A pleasant opportunity to experience Öland’s natural surroundings in your running shoes.
course_highlights: Trail running on forest paths
Course around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
additional: 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for young runners. According to the existing information, the start times are 11:00 and 10:00, respectively.

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon is a recreational running event held in Tidaholm, offering both recreational and competitive races, individually and as a relay. The race is part of Motionsloppet.se’s series of events and also includes the Swedish Half Marathon Championships. It is a welcoming event for runners of different levels, organized by Cykelklubben U6 and Grebbestad Multisport.
course_highlights: Running in and around Tidaholm
Individual race and relay option
Includes the Swedish Half Marathon Championships
additional: Umara is the sports drink supplier at the events.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organised by Motala AIF Friidrott, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a renewed old course that runs through central parts of Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km race having a separate lane for lapping on the first lap. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to give runners the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, centrally located in Motala
Renewed old course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration takes place on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Race bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on Friday 2/10 from 10:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 3/10 from 10:00 to 12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop is by the stage.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: Hiit Out Trailrun 12 km
description: HIIT OUT Trailrun is a trail race offering varied terrain with forest, trails, elevation changes and technical sections in Mellingerum, Oskarshamn. The race focuses not only on finishing time but also on the experience along the way, with a challenge, the joy of running and a wonderful experience in nature. The 12 km distance is one of several course options, suitable for both experienced trail runners and beginners aged 15 and over. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with dedicated volunteers and spectators.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest and trails
Elevation changes and technical sections
A nature-rich experience along the trails
additional: Everyone aged 15 and over is welcome to take part. The race is organised with a focus on the experience and the joy of running, not just race time. Results from previous years show participation in the 8 km, 12 km and 16 km distances. A medal is awarded at the finish.

name: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 104 km, 81 km, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 9 km, 5 km
description: JuraRun 2026 Running Festival is a unique trail-running event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, in Podlesice. Participants can choose from a range of distances, from short children’s races to demanding ultramarathons that follow scenic forest trails, limestone rock formations, and the upland’s hills. This event is for lovers of sport and nature, combining a passion for running with the chance to discover the beauty of the region. JuraRun is also an opportunity to meet people with similar interests and enjoy an unforgettable running adventure.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the scenic landscapes of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
Limestone rock formations and forest trails of varying difficulty
Distances range from 100 metres for children to an ultramarathon of over 100 km
additional: Starts take place in waves, including the JuraRun Night 10+ night race at 21:00 and the JuraRun ULTRA 100+ and ULTRA 80+ ultramarathons at 23:00. The race office is open from Friday at 17:00 until Saturday at 13:30, with registration closing at different times for each distance. The event also includes a 12 km Nordic walking event and children’s races starting at 100 metres. Places for each distance are limited, and race packages are available at different times.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The Poznań Marathon is the 25th-anniversary edition of the city’s premier 42.195 km marathon, held in the heart of Poznań. The route runs along the city’s most important streets, including a return to the Old Market Square after 18 years, as well as scenic locations such as Sołacki Park, Malta and Enea Stadium. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic spectator support. Organizers have prepared a new, attractive course and a rich accompanying program, including children’s races and shorter distances.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Old Market Square, Ratajskiego Square and Wolności Square
Runs through the scenic areas around Malta and Sołacki Park
Finish at Plac Marka, at the Poznań International Fair
additional: The start for wheelchair athletes is at 8:55, and for runners at 9:00. Start corrals are assigned according to the declared marathon finish time and marked with colored stripes on race bibs. The participant limit is 8,000. The race office is open October 2–3 at the Poznań International Fair.

name: II Radomski Bieg Onkologiczny
description: The 2nd Radom Oncology Run is a sporting event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association in Radom, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The run is charitable and inclusive, welcoming people of different ages and running abilities. The organizers emphasize community and support for people affected by cancer, combining sport with an important social mission. The event takes place in the scenic surroundings of Radom and welcomes both runners and fans of physical activity.

name: Olsztyn Półmaraton
description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual 21.1 km race held around the picturesque Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn. The course has a mix of surfaces, including compacted gravel, forest trails, asphalt, and paving blocks. The route is marked every kilometer, and runners have access to at least two refreshment stations. The event also features a 5 km race and races for children, creating a sporting atmosphere for the whole family. The organizers provide professional support and an appealing schedule, welcoming both recreational and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km course around Lake Ukiel
Mixed surfaces: gravel, forest trails, asphalt, and paving blocks
At least two refreshment stations on the course
additional: The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 45 minutes for the 5 km race. The race office is open on the day before and on race day. Registration is not available on race day. The course is not certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA).

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

name: Bieg o Puchar Wójta Mikołajki Pomorskie
Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with climbs of 300, 600 and 1,500 metres respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance involving five ascents of the mountain. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and tough trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails through pristine wilderness
Beautiful views of small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children's race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Bib transfers are possible under the terms on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, as well as VMX Kids. Trail-running shoes are recommended.

name: Solvalla Trail
location: Solvalla Sports Institute, Nuuksio, Espoo, Finland
description: The event offers runners the chance to enjoy scenic trails on two different distances: 9 km and 18 km. Esbo IF organizes the event, which is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Join us for a fast-paced and memorable trail-running event amid stunning scenery.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Running Series, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups. The course loops around Rava Artificial Lake and features varied terrain of sand, soil and gravel. The best runners will be awarded, and the event is suitable for both recreational runners and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, skirtas populiarinti bėgimą, dviračių sportą ir orientavimąsi gamtoje. Varžybos vyksta Ukmergėje, o dalyviai varžosi bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo rungtyse. Renginys skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį įvairaus amžiaus žmonėms ir jaunimo domėjimąsi sportu. Varžybų startas vyksta Šilo pagrindinės mokyklos stadione, o laiko limitas yra 120 minučių (išskyrus Mini Rogainingą).

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, apimantis bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo varžybas. Renginys vyksta Kopūstėlių miške Ukmergėje ir skirtas skatinti aktyvų laisvalaikį gamtoje bei populiarinti sportą įvairaus amžiaus dalyvių tarpe. Varžybų startas yra bendras visoms grupėms ir vyksta vakare, o dalyviai varžosi pagal amžiaus grupes ir rungčių tipus. Pagrindinis organizatorius yra VšĮ Sportas miške, o renginys remiamas kelių Ukmergės įmonių.

name: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: Šis renginys žymi naują tradiciją, suburiantį bėgikus iš Lietuvos ir užsienio. Maratonas vyks aktyviame ir sportiškame mieste, kuris garsėja savo sporto renginiais ir aktyviu gyvenimo būdu. Renginį organizuoja BK „Kaišiadorys bėga“, Kaišiadorių rajono savivaldybė, Kaišiadorių švietimo ir sporto centras bei VšĮ „Maratomanija“.

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: „Gintarinė jūrmylė“ yra tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios nuostabioje Smiltynėje. Renginys siūlo įvairius nuotolius: 0,5 jūrmylės vaikams, 1 jūrmylę visiems norintiems, 3 jūrmyles moterims ir 6 jūrmyles vyrams bei profesionalams. Startas ir finišas yra Sporto sveikatingumo bazėje, o dalyviai vaišinami kareiviška koše ir arbata. Varžybų tradicija įamžina nugalėtojų vardus atminimo akmenyje, iškeltame iš marių dugno.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 42nd Munamäe–Võru cross-country run and walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, which offers a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads, providing a varied course in the Võru area. The series also includes shorter distances and children’s runs, suitable for participants of all ages. The event takes place at the SA Võru Sports Centre ski base in Kubija, known for its beautiful natural surroundings and good course conditions.

description: Stirnu buks is a popular trail running series held on Latvia’s most beautiful forest trails, offering a range of distances for participants of different ages and fitness levels. The series aims to bring participants into nature, where they can improve their physical and mental well-being while enjoying scenic routes. The Grand Finale in Priekuļi is one of the series’ final and most anticipated events, bringing together trail runners from all over Latvia. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, and also offers special distances for young people and children.
course_highlights: Routes and trails with varied surfaces — asphalt, gravel, forest roads and off-road terrain
Five different distances are available for different age groups
The race takes place on scenic trails in Latvia’s forests
additional: Participants can register on the event website in the “Your profile” section. Last-minute registration is available on race day no later than 30 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. “ENEFIT Taku gājējs” participants start first; hiking participants can set off on the course from 9:00 to 10:30, with no timing. After 12:00, fast runners may be encountered on the courses. Discounts are available for juniors, seniors and special groups. Season passes are available at a discount, and the fee varies depending on the time of registration.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
organizer: Fundacja Krok do Natury; Stowarzyszenie Sport dla Każdego; Sport & Event Consulting Piotr Książkiewicz

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in seven locations, including Warsaw’s Młociński Park. The races are recreational and sporting events that promote physical activity outdoors and a healthy lifestyle. The series includes four races in each location, and participants can compete in local and overall standings. Races take place during the season from October to April, with the main race starting at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests or urban parks
A race in the natural surroundings of Młociński Park in Warsaw
A series of four races per season in each location
additional: The race office opens at 8:30, and race bibs and chips are collected on race day. The entry fee on race day is PLN 60. A season pass also allows one free start in a city other than the main location, provided the participant applies by email in advance. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants (born 2008–2010) may take part with parental consent. The race schedule is fixed and also includes CITY TRAIL Junior races for children. The Warsaw races for the 2026/2027 season are scheduled for October 10, November 21, January 16, and March 20; the start is at 11:00.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a running event held at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. The race offers a challenging 25 km course for both women and men, where participants can experience beautiful scenery and varied terrain in the Skrylle area. The event brings together runners from different clubs and towns, creating a sense of community and competition. Skrylle Challenge is a popular race for both experienced runners and enthusiasts looking to test their endurance in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: 25 km of running on varied terrain
Scenic views in the Skrylle area
A challenging course for both women and men
additional: Participant lists show separate bib numbers and clubs for women and men in the 25 km class.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race organised by Ryssbergets IK in Bromölla, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is clearly marked with arrows, lines and tape, and marshals are on hand to show the way. Participants can expect water stations serving water and sports drink, as well as a friendly atmosphere with coffee and grilled sausages served after the race. Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and medical staff are available in the start and finish area. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and results and to the use of photographs and videos from the event.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations serving water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. The prize ceremony begins at 12:30. Registration is primarily by advance entry, but on-site registration is also available. The event follows the Swedish Athletics Association’s rules for road races. The race information states that prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category. Race numbers must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. The published information applies to the 2026 edition and does not confirm the date 9 October 2027.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race takes place at the Swedish Maritime Museum in Stockholm and offers an easy-to-run 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. All participants contribute to psychiatric research, as all proceeds go directly to this cause. Mental Health Run welcomes everyone, regardless of background or fitness level, and promotes community and the joy of movement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Maritime Museum
Easy-to-run/walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course through the scenic surroundings of Djurgården
additional: A medal can be selected as an optional extra when registering. The dog race is a special event where participants run or walk together with their dog, which must be kept on a leash throughout the race. The dog race focuses on the joy of movement and community rather than performance. Participation is at your own risk, and dog owners are responsible for their dogs. Participants in the dog race start at the back of the field. There is also a virtual race from 10–31 October 2027. A medal is included for in-person participants. The deadline to register for the in-person race is 8 October 2027 at 12:00.

name: Tjurruset
organizer: Marathongruppen tillsammans med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun trail race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, where participants can choose between 5 or 10 kilometres. The race features muddy sections, trail paths and wet conditions, and is perfect for anyone who doesn’t mind getting dirty and wants a different kind of running experience. Showers and rinse-off facilities are available after the race, and the event is marked by a spirit of community where determination matters more than running technique. Tjurruset is organised by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Terrain with muddy sections and wet conditions
Trail paths in Norra Djurgården
Challenging forest terrain with natural obstacles
additional: Warm showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinse-off facilities right after finishing. There are collection points for clothes that cannot be taken home. Shoes with good grip and clothes you don’t mind getting dirty are strongly recommended, as the mud can suck a shoe off mid-stride. Companies and larger groups can arrange a joint registration and book a company tent.

name: Borgen Outdoor Run
description: Borgen Outdoor Run is a challenging trail race held in the Alandsryd area at Friluftsgården Borgen in Värnamo. The race offers a fun and varied course featuring a ski slope and forest trails, giving participants a wonderful experience in nature. The event is well established and attracts runners who appreciate both a challenge and a sense of community in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Alandsryd area
Route through the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope, with elevation changes
Scenic and varied course with forest trails
additional: Groundwork is underway at the Alandsrydsbacken ski slope (between 2–3 km) to increase the vertical drop, which may result in minor course adjustments in that area. According to the event information, the race is open to all ages, and participants can run individually or as part of a pre-registered team.

name: Terräng DM
description: Welcome to the District Championships in cross-country running, held at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School. The race features a course that is mostly on grass, with a short 70-metre hill on asphalt. Runners in different age groups and masters categories can take part over a range of distances. Bib numbers and check-in are at the race office by the start area.
course_highlights: The course is mostly on grass
A 70-metre hill on asphalt
Start and finish at Nytorp sports field near Hammarby Södra School
additional: Check-in and bib numbers are at the race office beside the start. The events include youth and masters categories. Check-in and bib numbers are collected at the race office next to the start.

name: Gränbyloppet
price_range: 100–200 kr för icke-medlemmar (2026 års priser); gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott
description: Gränbyloppet is organized by Upsala IF Friidrott and takes over from Ultunamilen, with a focus on the joy of running in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for youth and adults. The start and finish are at the intersection just northeast of the pergola in the middle of Gränbyparken, near IFU Arena. The race is open to both members and non-members, with a simple and clear online registration process.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with a blue 2.5 km loop
The race is held in conjunction with the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a clearly visible race bib. The start and finish are approximately 800 metres from IFU Arena. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held in conjunction with Gränbyloppet for youth aged 14 and under. The race takes place in conjunction with Terrängserien, whose final day is aimed at youth aged 14 and under. Information about distances and fees applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event being held for the tenth time, inviting runners to experience Porvoo’s most beautiful trails and seaside scenery in the fresh October air. The event offers a variety of route options for all fitness levels, from the 2 km children’s Trail Dash to a 42 km trail run. Race day begins with the children’s Trail Dash and continues with several different distances, taking runners along beautiful and varied trails in the Porvoo area. The entry fee includes a range of services, and photos and videos will be taken during the event and used for event communications.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series that offers a variety of running opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. The stages take place in the Lääne-Virumaa region, offering runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the 7th stage of the series. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running traditional race series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional endurance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race route goes around Lake Viljandi, and the event is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting competitions, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several recreational sports events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an energetic and enjoyable experience for both recreational runners and professional athletes.

name: Latvijas čempionāts krosa skrējienā
description: The Latvian Cross Country Running Championships is a prestigious competition featuring athletes from various age groups, from youth to masters. The competition takes place over different distances and is a significant event in Latvia’s athletics calendar. The event brings together professional athletes and amateurs, offering a challenge and the opportunity to compete for Latvian champion titles. Traditionally, the competition is held in October and is organised by the Latvian Athletics Association.
course_highlights: The competition features different distances for various age groups
Held on cross-country courses with varied surfaces and terrain
An opportunity to compete for Latvian champion titles
additional: The competition includes the U12, U14, U16, U18 and U20 age groups, adults and masters. The event is organised by the Latvian Athletics Association. Previous competitions have been held in Carnikava, while the 2027 competition is planned for Daugavpils.

name: Piwna Mila
location: Wąsowo, Kuślin, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Beer Mile is a unique race over a flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres and the main event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start immediately after drinking a beer, and beer stations are placed along the course approximately every 500 metres. Runners must drink the beer at each station. This sporting celebration brings together runners, spectators and families, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a special finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Flexible distance of 1,700 to 2,000 metres
Beer stations approximately every 500 metres
The race starts after runners drink their first beer
additional: 9:30–10:30. The race bib must be pinned to the front of your clothing and must not be altered. You can order a T-shirt when paying for your race bib in the Runner’s Panel. Photos from the event will be available after the race.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
location: Skrzeszewo, Gmina Żukowo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Friendship Run is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque area around Skrzeszewo, giving participants the chance to spend time actively and discover the charms of Kashubia. The series attracts runners of different ages and abilities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque landscapes of Kashubia
The race takes place in a natural, welcoming environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL is a nationwide series of 5 km cross-country races held in the beautiful wooded settings of city parks and forests. In Poznań, the course loops around Lake Rusałka, starting near Św. Wawrzyńca Street, with the finish by the municipal beach on the lake. The races are open to runners of all abilities, from beginners to more experienced runners, who can compare their results on the same course over the years. The event promotes outdoor physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 5 km course through woodland around Lake Rusałka
Start near Św. Wawrzyńca Street; finish by the municipal beach on Lake Rusałka
Suitable for both beginner and advanced runners
additional: The race office opens at 8:30 and closes at 10:30. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the 10:45 start. The event follows a consistent schedule, and the race office remains in the same location throughout the season. Participants under 16 may take part with the consent of a parent or guardian. The series also includes races for children and young people.

Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
