description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwestern Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day also features Lilla Hässelbyloppet, a children’s and youth race with shorter distances and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The start and finish are at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through northwestern Stockholm
Start and finish at Hässelby Idrottsplats, near the metro
Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people, with timing for participants aged 9 and over
additional: Pacers are available from 37:30 to 60 minutes. Bib pickup opens the day before the race. Lilla Hässelbyloppet offers timing for participants aged 9 and over, and refreshments and snacks after the finish. Hässelbyloppet starts in a large field about 400 metres from Hässelby Idrottsplats. Lilla Hässelbyloppet has bibs and timing for participants aged 9 and over. The start and finish are at Hässelby IP, Loviselundsvägen 100. The official website lists 3 October 2027 as the date of Hässelbyloppet.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon running event in which competitors run 6.706-kilometre laps within an hour, continuing for as long as multiple runners are able to keep going. The competition is unique because it has no predetermined finishing time or distance, and the winner is the one who runs one more lap than the others. The event is held at the Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers a challenge for runners who value perseverance and endurance. The competition originated in the United States and is also known as “Just one more Loop.”

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run is a unique trail race in Sollentuna, focused on the experience of darkness and nature. The race offers several distances, including a challenging 30 km course where runners navigate using GPS and a map. The start and finish are at Väsby gård, and the course is marked with reflectors to create a magical atmosphere in the glow of headlamps. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with special rules for younger participants on the shorter distances.
course_highlights: Course marked with clear reflectors for a night-running experience
Navigation using GPS and a map on the 21 km and 30 km distances
Start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 for the 5 km and 10 km. The 21 km and 30 km start on Saturday, October 17, at 16:45 and 16:00, respectively. Minimum age is 18, but participants aged 15–18 may run the 5 km and 10 km if accompanied by an adult. A good headlamp is recommended, preferably with an extra lamp for the 30 km. The time limit for the 30 km is 4 hours and 30 minutes. Aid stations are available along the 21 km and 30 km courses. Previous organizer information states an age limit of 18 and a 4-hour-and-30-minute time limit for the 30 km.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: The Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running event in Kuressaare, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part. The competition offers several distance options and age groups, with opportunities for both young people and adults. Registration takes place on site, and the entry fee is affordable, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. The competition is part of a larger running series, which also includes season standings and an awards ceremony.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas yra unikalus bekelės bėgimo renginys, kuriame bėgikai kas valandą turi įveikti 6,7 km ratą tol, kol lieka paskutinis stovintis. Varžybos vyksta kalnuotose ir bekelės trasose, kurios reikalauja ištvermės ir valios. Renginys yra iššūkis tiek fizinei, tiek psichologinei ištvermei, o nugalėtojas visada yra tik vienas. Trailo Kalvė organizuoja šį renginį su ypatingu dėmesiu trasų kokybei ir dalyvių patirčiai, kviesdama bėgikus išbandyti save ir įveikti save pačius.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
description: Pagarbos ir paramos bėgimas „In Memoriam“ Vilniuje yra iškilus renginys, skirtas pagerbti šiais metais mirusius Lietuvos kariuomenės karius ir paremti jų šeimas. Renginys vyksta Vingio parke ir apima 1 km bei 4 km distancijas be varžybų, taip pat 10 km atvirą Lietuvos kariuomenės bėgimo čempionatą. Bėgimas gimė kaip jautri iniciatyva atminti jauną karininką ir tapo svarbia kasmetine pilietine bei patriotine tradicija. Organizuoja LDK Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų sąjunga kartu su Krašto apsaugos ministerija ir Lietuvos kariuomene.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė yra tradicinis Kelmės rajono bėgimas, skirtas Vaidoto Rimkaus atminimui. Varžybos vyksta spalio mėnesį ir siekia populiarinti bėgimą bei lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir didinti rajono gyventojų aktyvumą. Renginys pritraukia įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus, o dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant 8 km pagrindinį bėgimą. Varžybų metu dalyviai apdovanojami taurėmis, medaliais ir atminimo prizais.

name: Atviros Vilniaus rajono kroso pirmenybės
location: Miško slidinėjimo trasos prie biatlono šaudyklos, Nemenčinė, Vilnius County, Lietuva
description: Atviros Vilniaus rajono kroso pirmenybės vyksta Miško slidinėjimo trasose prie biatlono šaudyklos Nemenčinėje. Tai tradicinės varžybos, kuriose dalyviai varžosi įvairiose amžiaus grupėse ir distancijose, siekdami geriausių rezultatų krosų bėgimo trasose. Renginys suburia bėgimo entuziastus iš Vilniaus rajono ir aplinkinių vietovių, skatinant aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir sportinę draugystę.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta miško slidinėjimo trasose
Trasos yra prie biatlono šaudyklos Nemenčinėje
Krosų bėgimo trasos įvairaus sudėtingumo ir ilgio
additional: Varžybose numatytos atskiros vyrų ir moterų kategorijos.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition held in the village of Iide. The competition consists of three stages, where participants can enjoy Saaremaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain. The competition is open to different age groups and offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for all running enthusiasts. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet treat and a drink after the run.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
location: Luzino, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
description: The Dziewicza Góra Grand Prix Mountain Running Series is a series of races held in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park, promoting physical activity and environmental protection. The races take place on forest trails around the park’s highest elevation, Dziewicza Góra. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km races, a Nordic Walking event, and shorter races for children and young people. The event brings together runners of different ages and ability levels, creating a welcoming atmosphere of sporting competition and recreation.
course_highlights: The course follows a 5.15 km loop entirely on forest trails
The route climbs twice to the summit of Dziewicza Góra, the highest point in the Zielonka Forest Landscape Park
The route passes through the event center after approximately 3.7 km, where spectators can cheer on the runners
additional: The race office is open from 8:15 to 10:30 in the building of the Łopuchówko Forest District Education Center. Children’s races start between 9:00 and 9:45, over distances of 200m, 500m, 1000m, and 1500m. The 5 km race starts at 10:50, the 10 km race at 11:00, and Nordic Walking at 11:02. The participant limit is 500. After leaving the forest, runners finishing the race should head to the left side of the balloon marked Finish; 10 km runners pass under the Finish balloon and continue for a second loop.

name: 35 Orla Pięść
location: Świeszyno, Koszalin County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Festiwal Biegowy w Nadleśnictwie Kli...
location: Sowno, Goleniów County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Stockholm Cross Country
description: Stockholm Cross Country is a cross-country race in Stockholm organized by Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb. The race offers challenging distances in scenic surroundings on Gärdet, with courses of 2.5 km and 5 km. It is a popular race for both recreational runners and competitive runners looking to test their cross-country ability in a beautiful setting close to the city. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in scenic surroundings on Gärdet in Stockholm
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Organized by Turebergs Fri-idrottsklubb

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is for those who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on experiencing nature as on performance. The event is held and offers a memorable course in hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event offering a wonderful day at Hellasgården, close to the city. The races pass through the beautiful Hellas area, by lakes and hills, along lovely running trails and roads. There are races for all ages, from the very youngest children, who can run 100 metres without registering in advance, to children aged 5–8 on a flat course. The day offers the joy of running, uphill sections, music and a lovely autumn setting, with refreshments and activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: Races through the Hellas area, with lakes and hills
Lovely running trails and roads
Flat course for children aged 5–8
additional: The first race starts at 10:00, and the final start for the 10 km race is expected around 12:00. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize ceremonies take place throughout the day. Athletics activities are available on site, with stations where you can try running, throwing and jumping. All children born in 2022 or later can run 100 m without registering in advance and will receive a medal. Refreshments are available throughout the day. The first race starts at 10:00, and the 10 km race is expected to start around 12:00. The 100-metre race for the youngest children does not require advance registration. Parking is available, and refreshments are served.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Växjö Marathon is a fast, flat marathon course consisting of eight laps around the beautiful Växjö Lake. The course is mostly paved, with a short section of fine gravel, and has very little elevation gain—about 3 meters per lap. The event welcomes both experienced runners and beginners, and also offers a relay race for teams. This is the 32nd edition of the race, which is known as Sweden’s fastest marathon course. The course is marked and has a lead cyclist and course marshals, but it is not closed to traffic during the race.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjö Lake
Flat, fast course with about 3 m of elevation gain per lap
Mostly paved surface, with about 300 meters of fine gravel
additional: The course is marked, and there is a lead cyclist and course marshals. Relay races are also available for teams. A children’s race is held as well. Sports drinks, dietary supplements, and energy and protein bars are available. The organizer is Växjö Running Club. The marathon relay has teams of four, with each runner completing two laps. The course is not closed to pedestrians, cyclists, or motor traffic.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a challenging trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne. Participants can choose from four distances: 2.5 km, 6 km, 11 km and 17 km, as well as an untimed children’s race. The courses feature gently rolling terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, hills and running on sand by the sea, providing a unique running experience. The race is part of Skåne Trailcup and also offers a team competition with great prizes. The event is open to everyone and has a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Gently rolling terrain with varied surfaces
A mix of trails, sand dunes and challenging hills
Running on sand along the sea
additional: Participant limit: 1,000. The children’s race is approximately 350 m long, has individual starts and is free to enter. Start times: 2.5 km and 6 km start at 12:30, 11 km and 17 km start at 12:40, and the children’s race has individual starts between 13:00 and 15:00. The time limit for the 17 km race is 2 hours and 50 minutes. Parking is limited; follow the instructions of event staff. Valuables storage is available for a fee of 20 SEK. Toilets are 200 metres from the event venue. The venue at Strandridaregården is approximately 100 metres from the sea. The children’s race is approximately 350 metres and is untimed. Prices are reported for the 2026 edition.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a race for everyone, from elite runners to recreational runners, offering a completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan. The course has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association and is eligible for seeding at many races in Sweden and internationally. The race offers a great atmosphere, pacers for different finishing times, and the opportunity to take part in team competitions with friends. It’s a perfect chance to set a personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run with colleagues or friends.
course_highlights: A completely flat and fast course in central Jönköping
The 5K runs one lap; the 10K runs two laps
A water station with UMARA sports drink along the course
additional: Pacers carrying flags for 40-, 45- and 50-minute times in the 10K. Team competition with a 10% discount when registering with two friends. Warm-up with Fitness24Seven at 10:40 in the start/finish area. Limited bag drop in the start area in the morning. Parking is available in nearby parking garages for a fee. Register three people as a team for a 10% discount on the entry fee and a chance to win prizes. Up to five runners can be registered at the same time.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run Hundtrail is a unique evening race in Sollentuna where you can run with your dog over 5 or 10 kilometres. The courses are marked with reflectors, and headlamps are mandatory to create a magical nighttime experience. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, but young people aged 15 to 18 may participate if accompanied by an adult. It is an unforgettable evening enjoyed by both two- and four-legged participants.
course_highlights: The courses are marked with reflectors
Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (until 19:00 for 10 km)
Headlamps are mandatory, and dogs must be kept on a leash
additional: A maximum of one dog per runner. Age limit: 18; participants aged 15–18 may take part accompanied by an adult. Dogs must be kept on a leash and be comfortable around other dogs and people. The race takes place in the dark, with narrow passages and frequent encounters with other dogs, so reactive dogs are not recommended. One dog per runner; dogs must be kept on a leash. Flexible start times: 18:00–19:30 for 5 km and 18:00–19:00 for 10 km. Age limit: 18; young people aged 15 and over may participate with a responsible adult.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholm’s Steepest is an intense, energetic race that challenges you to run both up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken. The course is just over 3 km long and includes three climbs, taking you up two different ski slopes. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to test their lactic acid threshold and mental toughness. The finish is at the top of Hammarbybacken, with a fantastic view of Stockholm as the backdrop.
course_highlights: Just over 3 km with three climbs
Up two different ski slopes
Finish at the top of Hammarbybacken with views of Stockholm
additional: Bib collection takes place at the Hammarby Fabriksväg event area from 09:30 on race day. Bibs are personal and must be worn on the chest using safety pins. There are hydration stations along the course. For the relay, teams complete a total of 8 laps of approximately 1 km each, with 2–4 people per team. Children’s races are available for ages 7–12 (approximately 500 m) and ages 0–6 (approximately 300 m; registration via Skistar). The event area is easy to reach by public transport, and parking is limited. The relay covers approximately 8 km for teams of 2–4 people. Brantaste Mini is approximately 500 metres for children aged 7–12, and Valle’s Friends’ Race is approximately 300 metres for children aged 0–6. The start and finish are at Hammarbybacken; the organiser recommends public transport because there is no parking at the hill.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 75 kr

description: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026 is a unique running event celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race consists of a 6,706-metre loop starting at Bubblan in Toredal and running on asphalt and gravel. Participants run as many loops as they can manage over twelve hours, with a start every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00. To continue, runners must complete each loop in under an hour, and the most enduring runner who is fastest on the final loop wins. There are women’s and men’s categories, as well as a MiniBackyard for children and young people who want to run shorter distances.
course_highlights: The loop is 6,706 metres long, with approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel
The course includes several longer climbs, including towards Sandbäcksvägen and the promenade
Start and finish at Bubblan in Toredal, with a final flat asphalt stretch leading to the grass field
additional: The race starts every hour on the hour from 09:00 to 20:00, with up to 12 loops over twelve hours. Runners must complete each loop in under an hour to continue. MiniBackyard starts at 14:00 and lasts for a maximum of 45 minutes. Registration for MiniBackyard takes place on site. Coffee and refreshments are served at 20:00 after the final loop. The first start is at 09:00 and the last start is at 20:00. There is also a MiniBackyard with a loop of at least 670 metres; on-site registration costs 75 kr.

name: Botanic Five Kaunas
location: Vytautas Magnus University Botanical Garden, Kaunas, Lietuva
description: Botanic Five Kaunas yra unikalus 5 km bėgimas, vykstantis Vytauto Didžiojo universiteto Botanikos sode Kaune. Šis renginys suteikia galimybę bėgti gražioje gamtos aplinkoje, mėgautis botanikos sodo augalų įvairove ir kvapais. Taip pat organizuojami vaikų bėgimai, todėl renginys yra tinkamas visai šeimai. Botanikos sodas suteikia ramybės ir natūralumo pojūtį, todėl bėgimas čia yra ypatinga patirtis tiek pradedantiesiems, tiek patyrusiems bėgikams.
course_highlights: 5 km maršrutas VDU Botanikos sode
Bėgimas gamtos apsuptyje su įvairiais augalais ir kvapais
Vaikų bėgimai šeimoms
additional: Renginys vyksta VDU Botanikos sode, kuris dirba nuo 09:00 iki 19:00 val. ne sezono metu. Botanikos sode yra oranžerija ir tropinių drugių paroda, kurią galima aplankyti renginio metu. Lankytojams suteikiama galimybė įsigyti lankytojo bilietus, o po 17 val. į parką įeiti galima tik su elektroniniu bilietu ar abonementu.

name: Krusensterni jooks
description: The Krusenstern Run is a traditional running race that starts at the Purila bus stop and finishes at Hagudi Manor. The race is 4.2 km long and is suitable for schoolchildren, pensioners and adults. The top men and women are awarded prizes, with special prizes also awarded to veteran athletes, the youngest and oldest finishers, and the largest family. Participants take part at their own risk, and all finishers are offered water, a treat and hot tea.

name: 10 Półmaraton Lubelski
description: The 10th Lubelski Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Lublin, attracting runners from across the region. The half-marathon course runs through the city streets, offering participants dynamic and fast sections. The event is part of Lublin’s running calendar for the 2026 season and is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and bringing the running community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of Lublin
Dynamic and fast sections
Picturesque urban scenery
additional: The event is part of the 2026 Grand Prix of Lublin. Lublin’s running calendar features many events, and the half marathon is one of the season’s major races.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
description: The XVII Puck Region Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in a new format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. Held in autumn, it offers a refreshed course and a unique atmosphere, serving as the final event in the Puck Running Triad. It’s an ideal opportunity to end the running season on a high note, competing in the half marathon or shorter races and Nordic walking events. The organizers provide participants with comprehensive information and support, including the event schedule, course maps, and baggage-drop areas.
course_highlights: Refreshed half-marathon course measuring 21.097 km
Autumn atmosphere and the final event in the Puck Running Triad
Additional 5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race office open 15:00–20:00 and 7:00–9:00 on race day at MOKSiR Puck. Baggage drop available 8:00–13:00. Start times: half marathon 10:00, 5 km race 10:05, 5 km Nordic walking 10:07. For children: Mini Kids Run (approx. 400 m) and Mega Kids Run (approx. 800 m) after the half marathon. Winners’ awards ceremony at 13:00.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Coop Tartu jooksuõhtud 2026 IV etapp
description: Coop Tartu Running Evenings is the fourth event in a running series organized by Tartu Ski Club, held in Raadi Park. This is an enjoyable, athletic event that invites running enthusiasts to enjoy autumn scenery and stay active. The series offers various distances and a friendly race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Runs take place on the beautiful and varied terrain of Raadi Park
The routes are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
An opportunity to enjoy the autumn scenery and fresh air

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki, offering distances of 1 km for children, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is flat and fast, mainly on asphalt and outdoor trails, and loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki. The event is open to runners of all ages and abilities, offering a chance to enjoy exercise and beautiful nature together with others. The event hub is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, and refreshments and snacks are available.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili Runs is a cheerful school community running event held in Kadriorg Park in autumn, with students, teachers and parents taking part. The focus is on the joy of movement and supporting one another, not on speed. This traditional event fosters a sense of togetherness and offers the community enjoyable moments of exercise in the fresh air. The first run took place amid golden leaves and was an inspiring start to the school holiday.

name: Älvsjöloppet night trail
location: Gamla Älvsjö IP, Älvsjö, Stockholm, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr; gratis för medlemmar i OK Älvsjö-Örby
description: Älvsjöloppet Night Trail is an exciting 5 km evening race over hilly terrain in Älvsjöskogen, with 150 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at Gamla Älvsjö IP, about a 15-minute walk from Älvsjö station. The course is marked with reflective markers and requires a bright headlamp, preferably at least 1000 lumens, as well as good trail shoes to handle the terrain. After finishing, all runners are treated to sausages and drinks in a friendly atmosphere. The race is organised by OK Älvsjö Örby and is open to everyone, with free entry for club members.
course_highlights: 5 km reflective-marked course over hilly terrain with 150 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at Gamla Älvsjö IP, near Älvsjö station
Requires a bright headlamp and trail shoes with good grip
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are handed out from 18.15 to 18.45. The chip must be returned at the finish. Toilets and changing rooms are available on site. Parking is available in the area and at Herr Stens väg 2, but walking, cycling or running to the start is recommended. Live results and the results list are available at alvsjoloppet.se. After finishing, all runners are treated to sausages and drinks; no other refreshments are available. For 2026, a headlamp of at least 1000 lumens and trail shoes, preferably with metal studs, are recommended.

name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV Skiers’ Series Run + Nordic Walking is a multi-stage running and Nordic walking series held at Kangrumäe in Järva County. The competition consists of five stages: the first four use staggered starts, and the final stage has a mass start. The best four stage results count toward the standings, and participants are divided into different age groups. The competition is intended for runners using ski poles, which can also be borrowed if needed. Everyone who completes all five stages receives a special prize.
course_highlights: Five stages: four staggered starts and a mass start for the final stage
Held at Kangrumäe in Järva County
Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings
additional: Age groups range from age 6 to 55+. Ski poles can be borrowed if needed.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 3rd Holstre-Polli Night Run takes place on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre in Viljandi County. This night run gives participants the chance to experience the wilderness and tranquillity surrounding the sports centre. The event is part of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre’s sports event series and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners. Participants can enjoy a unique night-running experience amid beautiful nature.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
description: Sporto šventė „Juodšilių ruduo“ yra Vilniaus rajono sporto renginys, vykstantis Juodšiliuose. Renginys skatina bendruomenės narius aktyviai sportuoti ir populiarina lengvąją atletiką bei bėgimą. Varžybose gali dalyvauti įvairaus amžiaus sportininkai, o renginys yra atviras visiems norintiems. Dalyviai varžosi 600 m, 4 km ir 12 km distancijose, o renginys vyksta draugiškoje ir saugioje aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Trasa vyksta Juodšilių apylinkėse, Vilniaus rajone
Varžybos vyksta 600 m, 4 km ir 12 km distancijose
Dalyviai privalo laikytis trasos ir taisyklių, draudžiama vedžioti gyvūnus trasoje
additional: Numerių išdavimas ir registracija vyksta nuo 10:00 iki 11:30 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Draudžiama perduoti numerį kitam dalyviui, naudotis asmenine palyda ir vedžioti gyvūnus trasoje. Už mažamečius dalyvius atsako jų globėjai arba treneriai. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio metu daryta vaizdo medžiaga gali būti naudojama rinkodaros tikslais.

name: Tõstamaa jooks
location: Tõstamaa Keskkool, Tõstamaa, Pärnu County, Estonia
description: The Tõstamaa Run is a traditional running event in the Tõstamaa area. In previous editions, the race started by Tõstamaa Secondary School and covered a distance of 7.5 km. The run offers an opportunity to come together and enjoy being active in the Tõstamaa community.
course_highlights: In previous editions, the distance was 7.5 km.
The race started by Tõstamaa Secondary School.
The run takes place in the Tõstamaa area.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is one of Östergötland’s most unique and challenging running races, held at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope in Yxbacken, Norrköping. The race challenges participants with five laps up a hill with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres, for a total distance of approximately 7 kilometres. Whether you run fast or take it easy, everyone is welcome to take part, and the most important thing is to make it to the top. New this year is also a relay, adding an extra dimension to the race. Children can take part for free in the Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C, making it a family-friendly running festival.
course_highlights: Five laps up Yxbacken, with 100 metres of elevation gain over 350 metres per lap
Approximately 7 kilometres in a unique race setting in Östergötland
Start at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 18:00, or at the start and finish area no later than one hour before the start. The bib includes a timing chip, which must be used to record your time. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal sponsored by Energi & Inneklimat. Companies can rent a partner tent at the race venue for team spirit and exposure through Rent a Tent. E2C was title partner for the fourth year in the 2024 edition.

name: VSM terräng
description: The Swedish Cross Country Championships are organised by Västerås FK and the Swedish Athletics Federation at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The course is 2 km long and consists mostly of grass, with some other surfaces, including fast-running grass and gravel paths. The competition includes several categories, including seniors, youth, masters and para-athletes, with individual races and team competitions. The event also offers the option of pre-booked lunch and good accommodation options close to the venue.
course_highlights: 2 km course consisting mostly of grass, with some other surfaces
Fast-running grass and a 2–3-metre-wide gravel path, crossed four times per lap
Hay-bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected at the start/finish area at least 60 minutes before the start. Access to the start area opens 10 minutes before the start and closes 2 minutes before. Water is available at the lap point and finish, with Dextrosol at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at Expandia Arena. Free parking and local buses are available. Clubs may set up their own tents in the designated area. Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels near the venue. Doping tests may be conducted during the competition weekend. The 2026 event took place at Rocklunda IP in Västerås. The organiser’s website states that Västerås FK handed over hosting duties for the 2027 Swedish Cross Country Championships to Mora.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes allowed for each lap. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, and a headlamp is mandatory because almost the entire race takes place in the dark. All participants who complete at least one lap receive a beautiful wooden medal, and the winners receive unique winner’s medals.
course_highlights: 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Running direction changes after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflective markers and trail tape; the surface is mostly trails, with approximately 700 metres of gravel
additional: Energy is served during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), along with sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are very limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and approximately 25 sq m of covered shelter. Toilets are outdoors in the forest. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and anyone who completes a lap faster can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. A headlamp and mobile phone are listed as mandatory equipment. The race website lists 70 places.

name: Halloween Night Trail
location: Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs, Ronneby, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Halloween Night Trail is an exciting night trail race in the Karlsnäs area north of Ronneby, with distances of 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The race offers a unique Halloween atmosphere, with themed features such as Zombie Hill, Count Dracula’s abode and the Bat Cave along the course. The event venue is at Friluftscentrum Karlsnäs, where the finish is indoors. After the race, grilled hamburgers and drinks are served and included in the entry fee. The race is organised by Ronneby Orienteering Club, which has extensive experience organising major orienteering competitions.
course_highlights: Run along small trails and through terrain, with reflectors showing the way in the dark
Themed features such as Zombie Hill, the Cemetery, Count Dracula’s abode and the Bat Cave
The finish area is indoors at Karlsnäs outdoor recreation centre
additional: Electronic timing for 5 km and 10 km; no timing for 2 km. Race bibs and chips can be collected at the venue from 17:00. The awards ceremony is provisionally scheduled for 20:45. Shoes with good grip and a headlamp are recommended. Parents can run with children in the 2 km race without registering. All participants receive a specially designed medal. The entry fee includes a hamburger and a drink. Electronic timing is offered for the 5 km and 10 km races, but not the 2 km race. The finish area is indoors.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Rumšiškėse prie Lietuvos etnografijos muziejaus. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo vaikų bėgimo iki pusmaratonio, kuriame dalyviai bėga kelis ratus pagal nustatytas taisykles. Varžybos vyksta spalio mėnesį, o dalyviai yra apdovanojami amžiaus grupėse bei absoliučioje įskaitoje. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką ir pasitikrinti savo jėgas įvairaus amžiaus bėgikams.
course_highlights: Distancijos nuo 300 m vaikų bėgimo iki 21,098 km pusmaratonio
Pusmaratonio distancija bėgama 4 ratais aplink Lietuvos etnografijos muziejų
Varžybos vyksta Rumšiškėse, Kaišiadorių rajone, su startu ir finišu muziejaus teritorijoje
additional: Varžybų programa prasideda registracija nuo 09:00, o startai vyksta nuo 11:00 iki 13:00 skirtingoms distancijoms. Pusmaratonio startas pagal handicap taisykles, kurios skelbiamos varžybų vietoje ir svetainėje. Apdovanojimai vyksta nuo 14:00 val., įskaitant Lietuvos bėgimo taurės amžiaus grupių apdovanojimus.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km ajavõtuga jooks ja retk I voor

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 10 km ajavõtuga jooks ja retk II voor

tiers.label: tier_3

description: Pärnu Beach Run is a season-ending running and Nordic walking event held in Pärnu’s beautiful beach area. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which run along the seaside promenade and past architectural landmarks characteristic of the city. The course offers beautiful natural scenery and is suitable for both runners and Nordic walkers. Children’s races and virtual runs are also on the programme, allowing people to participate from home.
course_highlights: The course runs through Pärnu’s beach area along the seaside promenade
Beautiful natural scenery and architectural landmarks characteristic of the city
Choose between 5 km and 10 km; suitable for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: The distances can be completed by running or Nordic walking. Children’s races and virtual runs are also held. The course also takes participants along the beach promenade, offering sea views.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: PKO Sopot Half Marathon is an annual running event held in the seaside city of Sopot, attracting runners from across Poland and abroad. The half marathon course runs through the city’s picturesque streets, offering exceptional views and the atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, adding a distinctive character and sporting spirit to the event. It is also an opportunity for families to celebrate sport together, with numerous accompanying races for different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A seaside course through the streets of Sopot
Finish line at ERGO Arena—a unique place to cross the finish
The atmosphere of running to the rhythm of the city, attracting runners and spectators
additional: The event also includes accompanying races such as the Half Marathon Relay, the 5 km Run, and races for children and juniors. The race pack includes a medal and other merchandise. The finish at ERGO Arena provides a unique atmosphere and comfort for participants. The organizer also offers the “Run, Be Ready” training plan for those preparing for the race.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja jesienna 2026
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night road race in Koszalin, offering three distances: 7 km, a half marathon, and a marathon. The course runs through the city streets, with the start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium. The race has official PZLA certification, ensuring accurate course measurement and the possibility of setting records. The event has a one-of-a-kind atmosphere, with a laser start at 2:00 a.m. highlighting its unique nocturnal character. Participants can expect excellent organization, attractive prizes, and keepsakes.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified course, confirming accurate measurement
A loop of approximately 7 km, completed multiple times depending on the distance
Start and finish at the ZOS “Bałtyk” Stadium in Koszalin
additional: The race starts at 2:00 a.m. with a laser start. The race office for children and young people is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall. The course runs through the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. After each distance, children receive gifts and prizes directly at the stadium. The course is undulating, and runners can rest at the stadium, which the loop passes through.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
description: The Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Dolnej Doliny Wisły is an annual running event held in Tczew County. The event features two races: a PZLA-certified marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. The routes pass through the scenic Vistula Valley, over a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces, with traffic restricted during the race. The start and finish are located in Tczew, and the event attracts runners from various regions, offering professional organization and clearly marked routes.
course_highlights: A PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
A 21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals; traffic is restricted during the race
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid entrants. The marathon starts at 09:00 at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew; the half marathon starts at 11:00 at the Primary School in Małe Walichnowy. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon course is PZLA-certified; the half marathon course is not. The course is marked with road markings and signs at 1 km intervals.

name: 63 Bieg Republiki Ostrowskiej
location: Ostrów Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: II Jesienny Bieg Charytatywny Artbud Group – Biegniemy dla Rodzin Zastępczych
XIV Pętla Krosowa Grodziskiego Klubu Biegacza
Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a longstanding running race celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. The race is organized by Boxholm-Ekeby Ski Club and takes place at Boxholm’s ski stadium. It is a popular event for runners of all ages and abilities, with a beautiful and challenging course. More information and registration will be available closer to race day.
course_highlights: Scenic route around the Sjögarp area
Challenging 14 km course, with a course profile available
The race takes place at Boxholm’s ski stadium
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. Links are available to the invitation, race information, start list, and preliminary results from previous years. The course profile and a course map are available to runners. Gathering is scheduled for 09:30.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Castle Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around the historic Löfstad Castle. The race offers a unique running experience as participants run through the castle park, along forest trails and over unmarked terrain lit by headlamps. The event consists of two races: the Little Twilight Race for children in the park and Löfstad’s Darkest, a 7-kilometre night race for adults. Löfstad Castle Trail combines nature, history and community in a beautiful and challenging setting.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and course tape
Little Twilight Race: 1,000 metres in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 at the castle courtyard. Löfstad’s Darkest starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp and trail shoes. The Little Twilight Race is a children’s race with no timing, and all participants receive a prize. The joint awards ceremony takes place after the races. On-site registration is available. Parking is available up to 500 metres from the castle. A headlamp is mandatory for the 7 km race, and trail shoes are recommended. The children’s race is untimed. The start and finish are at Löfstad Castle.

name: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles
description: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Paradiset Nature Reserve in Huddinge. The race offers a unique terrain experience, with scenic views and technical trails that test both endurance and mental strength. It is a well-regarded event for experienced ultrarunners seeking a long-distance challenge in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Running in Paradiset Nature Reserve with varied terrain
Technical trails and scenic views
A challenging 100-mile distance
additional: The race also offers 100 km and 65 km distances. According to the available race information, drop bags and toilets are available, along with water, tea, coffee and broth at Torpet Paradiset.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Bydgoszcz, edycja jesienna
location: Botanical Garden of the Kazimierz Wielki University, Bydgoszcz, Poland

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: The Jätten Bule Run is a traditional race organised by IFK Österbymo, set in the scenic, enchanting woodland around Österbymo. The race offers three distances: 10 km, 5 km and 2.4 km. Participants run on trails and gravel roads across varied terrain, with beautiful views. The start and finish are at Bulevallen. The race is sanctioned by the Östergötland Athletics Association, with chip timing. Changing rooms, refreshments and race-bib collection are available on site, making for a welcoming, well-organised race day.
course_highlights: The 10 km course winds through enchanting woodland on trails and gravel roads, with both climbs and descents
The 5 km course is a miniature version of the 10 km course, with a new route from 2024, and is marked in blue
The 2.4 km course follows the floodlit trail and is somewhat more challenging
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 at IFK Österbymo’s clubhouse by the start area. Bulis will lead the warm-up before the children’s race, at approximately 10:00. Timing is by chip. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse. Refreshments, including coffee and hamburgers, are available at the start area; payment by Swish or cash. The start and finish are at the sports ground in Österbymo. The 10 km and 5 km distances are available both as running and walking.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
location: Käpylä railway station, Käpylä, Helsinki, Finland
description: Pohjoisbaanan maili is an accessible running event held annually at the end of the year, featuring the middle-distance classic, the mile (1,609 metres). The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on a paved route in Käpylä, Helsinki, near Käpylä station. The start is near Tempo Running Store, and the route follows Pohjoisbaana south to the finish by the Hakamäentie bridge. The event is popular and community-oriented, and is organized annually by Helsingin Juoksijat ry.
course_highlights: The route follows the paved Pohjoisbaana southward
The start is next to Käpylä station
The finish is by the Hakamäentie bridge
additional: Changing rooms and toilets are not available, but you can store your belongings in the back room of Tempo Running Store at your own risk.

location: Ugāles manēža, Ugāle, Ventspils Municipality, Latvia

name: Höstmilen
location: Sörsjön, Kolmårdsskogarna, Åby, Norrköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Höstmilen is a trail race along the paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön, outside Åby, north of Norrköping. The race offers a challenging course through scenic terrain and an enjoyable experience for all participants. You can choose between a long course of 10.6 km, a shorter course of 5.2 km, and courses for children and young people. The shorter courses start and finish at Lillsjön. The event is organised by OK Kolmården, a ski and orienteering club for all levels and ages.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Scenic terrain in the Kolmården forests
Challenging courses of both 10.6 km and 5.2 km
additional: Registration closes on 29 October at 23:00. After that, you can register on 31 October from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start area on 1 November. There are also classes for children and young people. Race director: Johan Malm. Parking and transport information is available on the website. If you have mild symptoms of illness, you should stay at home. The race has been held since 1971.

name: Fiz-Kul-Tūre
description: Fiz-Kul-Tūre is a running and Nordic walking series in Valmiera Municipality, held in several stages at different locations, including Valmiera and Rencēni. The autumn stages give participants the chance to enjoy running and Nordic walking in natural surroundings and a pleasant autumn atmosphere. The event welcomes both beginners and experienced athletes, and the best participants in the season’s overall standings are awarded at the end. Fiz-Kul-Tūre promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in Valmiera Municipality.
course_highlights: Courses in the natural surroundings of Valmiera Municipality
Running and Nordic walking across multiple stages
Friendly atmosphere and awards for the season’s overall standings
additional: The Fiz-Kul-Tūre season finale takes place on a late autumn evening, ending on a positive note. Stages are held at different locations in Valmiera Municipality, such as Valmiera and Rencēni. Participants can take part in both running and Nordic walking.

name: XVII-asis bėgimas „Varnutės ruduo“
description: Varnutės bėgimas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys Jonavoje, siūlantis trasas įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams. Renginyje vyksta 10 km ir 2,5 km distancijos su papildomu 300 m bėgimu vaikams. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką ir pasimėgauti bėgimu bendruomenėje.
course_highlights: 10 km ir 2,5 km distancijos
300 m bėgimas vaikams
Renginys vyksta Jonavoje

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
location: Vooremäe terviserajad, Kastre Parish, Tartu County, Estonia
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ is a trail race on the Vooremäe health trails, offering participants challenges on forest paths and with elevation gain. The race takes place on a 14 km loop, with the marathon distance consisting of three loops. The race centre is located by the new Vooremäe service building, where participants can shower and change clothes after the race. There is one staffed aid station on the course, and timing uses the contactless SPORTIdent system. Competition categories are separate for men and women, with an untimed hiking category.
course_highlights: A 14 km loop; the marathon consists of three loops
One staffed aid station on the course, passed four times
Timing with the contactless SPORTIdent (SI AIR) system
additional: The start number can be found before the race in the start list on the Seiklushunt website. Race materials are distributed at the race centre secretariat. There are 1–2 checkpoints on the course, where the SPORTIdent chip records passage. Showers and changing facilities are available at the race centre after the race. On-site registration is not available.

name: Jāņa Daliņa piemiņas skrējiens un soļojums
20 Gminne Biegi z okazji Święta Niepodległości
Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Jämjöhalvan and Jämjöhallenstafetten are mass-participation races in Jämjö, with distances ranging from a children’s race to a half marathon. The race follows a fast, spectator-friendly loop course combining asphalt and gravel, and is a qualifying race for Göteborgsvarvet. Jämjöhallenstafetten is a relay in which four people run a half marathon together. The start and finish are near Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and the event offers a sense of community for runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Loop course: four laps for the half marathon, two laps for 10 km and one lap for 5 km
The course is 40% asphalt and 60% firm-surface gravel
Start and finish near Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, approximately 20 km east of Karlskrona
additional: Starts take place at different locations depending on the distance. The half marathon and relay start at 11:00, the 10 km at 11:10, the 5 km and youth races at 11:15, and the children’s race at 13:15. Relay teams can be mixed freely, and the baton handover takes place near the lap point. The course uses right-hand traffic, and runners are asked to keep to the right unless they are running fast.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a running race held in Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, part of the Royal National City Park. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, half marathon and marathon, all on officially measured courses starting and finishing at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race offers a lovely blend of nature and culture amid the vibrant colours of autumn and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. It’s a perfect way to finish the running season or kick off winter training, with good support and encouraging pacers along the course.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km, half-marathon and marathon courses in Norra Djurgården
The course is mostly flat and fast, with asphalt and gravel surfaces
Two aid stations with water and sports drink along the course
additional: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen, near Ropsten metro station. Race bibs are available at Runners’ Store in Stockholm and at the venue on race day. There are three start groups for the half marathon and four for the 10 km, based on expected finish time. Pacers are available for all distances. Drinks and something to eat are provided after the finish. Showers are available for a small fee at a nearby climbing centre.

name: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL
location: Academy of Physical Education and Sport (AWFiS), Gdańsk, Poland

description: Grand Prix CITY TRAIL with the Lotto Foundation is a nationwide cross-country running series covering 5 km and held in seven locations, including the Tricity (Gdańsk and Gdynia). The races take place in forests and urban parks, giving participants the chance to compete outdoors in a natural setting. The series consists of four races at each location, with results combined for the overall standings. The races are open to participants aged 16 and over, as well as younger participants with the appropriate permission. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through forests and urban parks
Tricity location: Gdańsk Forest District, Tricity Landscape Park near the Gdańsk University of Physical Education and Sport
Regular schedule and consistent race-office locations
additional: A charity package supporting the Siepomaga Foundation is available for purchase. The race office opens at 8:30; race numbers and timing chips can be collected on race day. Participants with a season pass can take one free start in another city after notifying the organizers by email in advance. There is no participant limit. A group warm-up with the CITY TRAIL Ambassadors takes place before the start. In the 2026/2027 season, CITY TRAIL races in the Tricity are held in Gdańsk and Gdynia.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
description: The Międzyzdroje Running League is an annual, free running and Nordic walking league held on the scenic routes of the Międzyzdroje Municipality. In the 2026/2027 season, participants compete over distances of approximately 5 and 10 km in the running events, and 5 and 7 km in Nordic walking. The league is known for its friendly, family atmosphere and healthy competition, welcoming both returning participants and newcomers who enjoy active recreation. To qualify for the overall standings, participants must complete at least four events at the required distances. The events are open to people over 14, and participation is free.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 5 and 10 km for runners
Routes of approximately 5 and 7 km for Nordic walkers
Scenic routes in the Międzyzdroje Municipality
additional: Participation is free. Participants must be at least 14 years old; minors may take part with written permission from a parent or guardian and under their supervision. To be included in the league standings, participants must enter and complete at least four events at the required distances (two 5 km and two 10 km running events, or two 5 km and two 7 km Nordic walking events). The series includes several events during the season; participation in at least four is required for the overall standings. Registration is handled through ProTiming24. Participant age: 14 and over; minors need written permission from a parent or guardian.

name: VII Bieg Chrystowskich dla Niepodległości
location: Tłokinia Kościelna, Gmina Opatówek, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Biega Running Club. The 10 km main race takes place on November 11 and promotes an active lifestyle and running in Rzeszów and the Podkarpackie region. Participants compete in various age categories, and everyone receives a commemorative medal at the finish. The organizer provides a race pack, including a T-shirt, bib number, and chip, as well as the option to have the medal engraved.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Classifications by age and special categories (e.g. doctors, top Rzeszów residents)
Participants must wear the organizer’s T-shirt (white or red)
additional: The participant limit is 3,500. On race day, race packs are available only at the race office; payment is by cash. Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of PLN 30. Participants compete at their own risk and must have a valid medical certificate or submit a declaration of fitness to participate.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
location: al. Jana Pawła II, Warsaw, Poland
description: The 36th Independence Run in Warsaw is a classic 10-kilometer road race that brings together thousands of participants each year to actively celebrate Independence Day. The course is fast and ideal for setting personal bests, with the start and finish at Jana Pawła II Avenue. Alongside the main race, there are also events for children and young people over the symbolic distance of 1,918 meters, and a Nordic Walking march of approximately 6 kilometers. The event combines sporting competition with a patriotic atmosphere and a shared celebration.
course_highlights: A 10 km course through the streets of Warsaw, starting and finishing at Jana Pawła II Avenue
A fast course conducive to personal bests, almost unchanged for years
The symbolic 1,918 m Independence Mile for children and young people
additional: On race day, the race bib must be worn on the front of the outfit, and participants must line up in the appropriate start zone based on their predicted finish time. The organizers provide spectator zones and activities for participants and their loved ones near the start and finish. Press accreditation is also available, with limited access to the start and finish zones. A Virtual Independence Run over 10 km is available for those who cannot be in Warsaw.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

tiers.description: Okolicznościowy pas na numer startowy – 30 zł.

description: The Wrocław Independence Day Run with a Moustache is an annual running event held on November 11, commemorating the 108th anniversary of Poland regaining its independence. Participants can choose between a PZLA-certified 10 km distance and a 5 km fun run. The start and finish are located at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław. The routes are closed to road traffic. Participants can purchase a commemorative T-shirt and a medal that is part of a six-race series, with the medals together forming the outline of Poland.
course_highlights: The 10 km route is a single PZLA-certified loop on asphalt and gravel
The 5 km route runs along the Oder Canal embankments and the Chrobry Bridges; it is not PZLA-certified
Start and finish at the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium
additional: Race packs include a race bib, race wristband, stick-on moustache, Nose Up strip, a Primator Polska product, GO Tarczyński kabanos sausages, a 2027 calendar, and a medal at the finish. The race office is open from 8:00 on race day and on the preceding days at the Olympic Stadium. Travelling by tram is recommended due to limited parking and road closures. After the race, participants receive a recovery snack (a sweet roll/doughnut and tea).

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with the celebration of Poland’s Independence Day. The event takes place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and includes 5 km and 10 km races, Nordic walking, and children’s races of up to 400 metres. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to whole families with children, creating an atmosphere of community and patriotism. The main race is scheduled to start at 9:00, and places are limited, so registration is online.
course_highlights: The race routes run through the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre and along nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska
Available distances are 5 km and 10 km, as well as Nordic walking
Children’s races on short routes of up to 400 metres
additional: The start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre. The event also includes Nordic walking and children’s races. Traffic disruptions are expected along the race route.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run with PGZ Naval Shipyard is an annual running event held in Gdynia to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. The event attracts thousands of participants who come together to celebrate the run’s patriotic spirit. The route passes through charming parts of the city, and participants can expect professional organization and a festive sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Gdynia
The event takes place in November to commemorate National Independence Day
A patriotic atmosphere and sporting camaraderie among residents
additional: Photos and video footage are taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of Gdynia.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
location: Władysławowo–Rozewie–Jastrzębia Góra, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 2nd Polish Legions Run commemorates the anniversary of Poland regaining its independence and offers two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The route passes through the scenic locations of Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra. Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument in Władysławowo, while the 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski in Rozewie. The race office is open on the days before the run, and the course is available online to view.
course_highlights: The route passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra
The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument on Morska Street in Władysławowo
The 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski on Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on the day before the run and on race day at specified times and locations.

name: XXXVIII Goleniowska Mila Niepodległości o Puchar Burmistrza Gminy Goleniów
description: The Goleniów Independence Mile is an annual road race held in the Gmina of Goleniów to commemorate Poland regaining its independence. The event attracts strong interest from the local community and runners from the region. The race course is one mile long, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. The organizers ensure professional event management and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: A one-mile course (approx. 1,609 meters)
A road race in central Goleniów
An event commemorating Poland regaining its independence

name: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai
description: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai vyks Tauragėje lapkričio 17 d., šeštadienį. Renginys prasidės 11 val. vaikų ir tėvelių 600 m bėgimu, o 11.20 val. startuos 1,8 km distanciją pasirinkę bėgikai, kurie įveiks tris 600 m trasos ratus. 12 val. startuos 6 ir 12 km distancijų dalyviai. Registracija vyksta iki lapkričio 16 d. internetu www.begimotaure.lt, o kiekvienos amžiaus grupės nugalėtojai bus apdovanoti medaliais ir prizais.

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas išsiskiria ne tik šventine nuotaika, bet ir išskirtiniais dalyviais, bėgimo šventei specialiai pasidabinusiais kalėdiniais (ir ne tik!) kostiumais. Šiemet renginio programa pasislinko taip, kad dalyviai galėtų bėgti jau sutemus, kai sostinės gatvėse atsiskleis magiška kalėdinė dvasia! Kviečiame ruošti ne tik kalėdinius kostiumus, bet ir šviečiančius akcentus, kurie pavers bėgikų būrį tikra kalėdine švytinčia magija!

Šį kartą dalyviams teko išbandyti paruoštą 7 km vaizdingą trasą Panoterių kaimelyje, kuri šį rugpjūtį buvo ypatinga dėl Panoterių mokyklos 115 metų sukakties ir 30-mečio, kuomet buvo pašventinta Šv. Kryžiaus Atradimo bažnyčia. Nors bėgikus lydėjo gausus lietus, tai nesutrukdė šventiškai bėgimo nuotaikai – apdovanojimai vyko pačioje Panoterių bažnyčioje.

Čia jūs galėsite pasirinkti distancijas: bėgimas - maratonas, pusmaratonis, 7 km, 3 km ir 400 m (vaikų bėgimas). Šiaurietiškas ėjimas - pusmaratonis ir 7 km. PINK RUN metu tiek vyrai, tiek moterys gali išreikšti palaikymą ir meilę savo artimiausioms moterims: mamai, dukrai, seseriai, žmonai ar geriausiai draugei.

name: Sõeru Kevadjooks
description: The Sõeru Spring Run is dedicated to the historic Sõeru spring, located on the Vanamõisa multifunctional health and learning trail. The event aims to promote recreational running, provide an opportunity to compete, and determine the winners in different distances. It is also important to introduce the area, offer the whole family an opportunity to spend active leisure time outdoors, and promote a sporting lifestyle.
additional:

Race packs will be distributed on 12 May from 17:00 to 20:00 at the café in Vanamõisa Caravan Park (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 18). On 13 May, race pack distribution and competitor registration begin at 15:00 in the log hall at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. Race numbers will be distributed until 17:15, and until 16:30 for the children’s runs.

The children’s runs start at 17:00
The main race starts at 18:00
The youth race starts at 18:10
All races start at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. The finish is at the same location.

name: 41. Jõulumäe Metsajooks
description:
The Jõulumäe Forest Run takes place on the third Sunday of November, 15 November, bringing running enthusiasts from Pärnu County and beyond together for the 41st time in the scenic Jõulumäe dune pine forest. It is one of Jõulumäe’s oldest and most beloved races. Come celebrate this sporting tradition with us—it’s a day when the entire pine forest fills with happy participants, supporters cheering on the runners, and autumn colours.

The Forest Run is open to everyone who enjoys being active. In addition to the traditional 9 km main race, the programme includes shorter races for children (500 m, 1,000 m and 2,000 m). This year, jogging has been added alongside recreational walking. No times are recorded for these 5.6 km distances; participants can enjoy the activity for themselves.

Runners compete in 18 age categories. Early registration is open until 12.11.2026 at 23:59.

Recommendations:

To avoid unnecessary rushing on site, early registration is strongly recommended.
By registering early, you help ensure the event is better organised—we know to expect you and can plan accordingly. You’ll also have more time to get ready on site.
If registering on site, please arrive promptly and adhere to the registration schedule.

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
The course starts from the Kopli Lines promenade. The route continues through Kopli Käsepark, then along the seashore.

The first half of the route follows the seashore, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare Conservation Area, a beautiful nature reserve known for birdwatching. We then continue through the Tallinn Water property, where you can see how water is treated, before returning to the promenade.

name: 24. Jooks ümber Võhma
description: Jooks ümber Võhma is a local running race that follows the streets and health trail of the town of Võhma.
course_highlights: A 5 km route on the streets of Võhma and the health trail
Mostly hard-surfaced, with arrows marking the route on the asphalt
A cyclist rides ahead of the competitors; the route is open to traffic
additional: Registration is online at timesport.ee until 24 September, and on race day in front of Võhma School from 10:00 to 11:40. Timing is electronic, using a chip attached around the ankle, which must be returned at the finish. A €70 fee applies for chips that are not returned or are lost. Participants receive medals, and prizes are raffled. Competitors are responsible for their own health. Children may take part in the race under their parent’s responsibility. Registration is available both online and on site, and participants receive prizes and medals. The route runs along the town’s streets and asphalt, offering a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event takes place on 26 September 2026.

name: SPORTLAND KÕRVEMAA METSAJOOKS  27. SEPTEMBER 2026
description:
Why take part in the Kõrvemaa Forest Run?

- Probably the most beautiful trails, surrounded by unspoilt nature.
- 100% of the course is in a stunning nature reserve.
- Give your body and mind a boost.
- Bring the whole family: activities and childcare are organised for the little ones, too.
- A convenient, compact event centre close to Tallinn.
- Free soup, a smoothie and other surprises from our partners for everyone.
- Of course, there’ll also be a hot sauna and, for the bolder participants, a hot tub.
- You can also take part with your whole work team to boost team spirit and health.
- Together, we’re helping improve public health in Estonia.

The Sportland pop-up shop will be open all day, so you can top up your running gear if you’ve forgotten something at home or want the best functional gear for the course. Every finisher will receive a great medal, a GRAM drink and a Nicks bar. Winners will receive Sportland credit, a sapling and gifts from our partners. The season’s best in each age group and the season’s best team will also be recognised.

Want to enjoy a private sauna with your group? Rent the Iglusaun by the pond! Would you like to stay overnight in Kõrvemaa? Check availability at Kuuse Elamusmajad.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through a stunning nature reserve
Trail running in unspoilt nature, with a mix of climbs and descents
Routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike
additional:
Register online at iseteenindus.sportlandkorvemaa.ee or through the Sportos platform, where Stebby is also available as a payment method.

The event takes place on Sunday, 27.09.2026. On race day, you can register at the start venue from 10.00. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start.

Seniors (aged 60+) and young people (aged up to 17) receive a 50% discount on the main distances when registering in advance. The discount is applied automatically during registration based on year of birth. The minimum discounted price is 15 EUR; the discount will not reduce the price below this amount. The discount does not apply to youth races, which already have a special price of 15 EUR. Only one discount can be used at a time; the system always applies the larger discount.

A 10% discount applies when registering at least 5 people together. A 20% discount applies when registering at least 10 people together. If you are registering from the same company, club or group of friends, be sure to enter your team name, as we will award the best team to take part in the series at the end of the season.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton
description:
Swedbank Tallinn Marathon and Tallinn Autumn Run invite you to register!

Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon, takes place from September 11 to 13. The programme of this event, which brings together thousands of active people, includes the classic marathon (42.195 km) and marathon relay, half marathon (21.1 km), Tallinn Autumn Run (10 km), Nike Youth Run (5 km), Welcome Run and Limpa Kids’ Runs.

The Tallinn Marathon’s event centre and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The course runs along streets and cycle and pedestrian paths, passing interesting places and offering a colourful overview of Estonia’s capital.

Over the years, more than 340,000 active people have taken part in the Tallinn Marathon across its various distances. The record for international participants at Estonia’s largest sporting event by number of participants was set in 2025, when runners came from as many as 93 countries.

Take this opportunity to be part of Estonia’s most spectacular movement event!

name: Apkaimju brīvības skrējiens
description: The Neighborhood Freedom Run is a friendly, community-building run held in Atgāzene, Riga’s smallest neighborhood. The run covers Atgāzene, Torņakalns, and Ziepniekkalns. Its aim is not competition, but a sense of community and support for Latvia’s freedom. The route is approximately 10.2 km long, and the pace is moderate, accommodating all participants. The event takes place on November 18, starting at 11:00, and includes several breaks for rest and water.
course_highlights: The route covers Atgāzene, Torņakalns, and Ziepniekkalns
Three five-minute breaks with water and first aid available
Start and finish at the intersection of Atgāzenes iela and Vienības gatve
additional: The first 40 people to register and run will receive a commemorative gift from the organizers. Participants can leave warm clothing and bags in the organizers’ car at the start/finish area. The run aims to foster a sense of community and support for Latvia, not to compete for results. During the run, the organizers avoid having groups gather and adapt the pace to the slower participants.

name: Rembates aplis
description: “Rembates Circuit” is a running event in Rembate that brings together running enthusiasts for a shared competition. Participants can compete in various distances and age groups. The event offers an opportunity to test their abilities and enjoy the running atmosphere in Rembate.

name: Tautas skrējiens “Ieelpo Rēzekni”
description: The “Breathe in Rēzekne” public run is an annual running event held in Rēzekne, in the heart of Latgale, on November 18. The run brings together participants of different ages, encouraging an active lifestyle and a sense of community among the city’s residents. The event is part of the celebrations marking the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia and offers an opportunity to discover Rēzekne’s scenery and culture in a sporty atmosphere. The run is scheduled to start at 11:00 and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: The run takes place within Rēzekne, offering beautiful city views
The event is part of the celebrations marking the 108th anniversary of the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia
The run starts at 11:00, providing an opportunity for daytime activities
additional: The event takes place on November 18 from 11:00 to 14:00. No information about entry fees or registration is available. The run is a community event aimed at fostering a sense of belonging and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Latvijas kontūras skrējiens
location: Valmiera Town Hall Square (Valmieras rātslaukums), Valmiera, Latvia
description: The Latvian Contour Run in Valmiera is a traditional holiday run held on November 18 at Valmiera Town Hall Square. Participants can complete a 12.3 km route along streets named after notable figures and past popular attractions in Valmiera. The event also includes a holiday quiz with 12 checkpoints. Participants use the Qrenteerings mobile app to check in and enter a prize draw. The run is open to everyone, and finishing time is not important, so participants can complete the route at their convenience throughout the day.
course_highlights: A 12.3 km route along Valmiera streets named after notable figures
The route passes Valmiera Castle ruins, Vecpuiši Park, Valmiera Olympic Centre and the Music School
12 checkpoints with QR codes for quiz participants
additional: Participants can complete the route at any time that suits them throughout the day. To take part in the quiz, download the Qrenteerings app and use course code valmiera22. There are no traffic restrictions, and participants must obey traffic regulations. Participants are encouraged to attach a ribbon in the colors of the Latvian flag or another Latvian-themed decoration to their clothing. The route has 12 QR checkpoints, and the quiz in the Qrenteerings app is available from 9:00 to 21:00. Part of the route follows minor roads and paths that may be harder to navigate by bicycle or with a stroller. There are no traffic restrictions; participants must obey traffic regulations.

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Kościan County Grand Prix is a series of five 5 km races, organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County under the patronage of the Kościan County Governor. Its aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and community integration. Residents of the county who turn 16 in 2025 may participate. Each race requires a separate entry fee, and the overall standings are based on the total points earned across the races.
course_highlights: A series of five 5 km races
Organized by all the municipalities in Kościan County
Separate standings for women and men, with no age categories
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for each individual race, set locally, is payable. The races are scheduled from June to December 2025 in various locations across the county. Points from the individual races are added together, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of the individual races. The series comprises five 5 km races held from June to December, with overall standings and prizes for the top finishers. The main 10 km race is scheduled for 15 November 2026 in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather and possible rain.
